91}

116async function saveAs() {
117 try {
118 fileHandle = await window.showSaveFilePicker({ suggestedName: 'schema_circuit.json', types: [{ description: 'Fichier JSON Circuit', accept: { 'application/json': ['.json'] } }] });
119 setCircuitDisplayName(fileHandle.name);
120 const writable = await fileHandle.createWritable(); await writable.write(getCircuitDataJSON()); await writable.close();
121 } catch (err) { fallbackDownload(getCircuitDataJSON()); }
122}
123async function saveFile() {
124 if (fileHandle) { try { const w = await fileHandle.createWritable(); await w.write(getCircuitDataJSON()); await w.close(); } catch (e) { await saveAs(); } } else { await saveAs(); }
125}
126function fallbackDownload(content) {
127 const a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([content], { type: 'application/json' })); a.download = 'schema_export.json'; a.click();
128}
129async function openFile() {
130 if (circuit.components.length > 0 && confirm("Voulez-vous sauvegarder votre schéma actuel ?")) { await saveFile(); }
131 try {
132 const [handle] = await window.showOpenFilePicker({ types: [{ accept: { 'application/json': ['.json'] } }] });
133 fileHandle = handle;
134 setCircuitDisplayName(handle.name);
135 loadCircuitFromJSON(await (await handle.getFile()).text());
136 } catch (err) {
137 if (err?.name === 'AbortError') return;
138 const input = document.createElement('input'); input.type = 'file'; input.accept = '.json,application/json';
139 input.onchange = e => {
140 const file = e.target.files?.[0];
141 if (!file) return;
142 fileHandle = null;
143 setCircuitDisplayName(file.name);
144 const r = new FileReader();
145 r.onload = ev => loadCircuitFromJSON(ev.target.result);
146 r.onerror = () => alert('Impossible de lire le fichier sélectionné.');
147 r.readAsText(file, 'UTF-8');
148 };
149 input.click();
150 }
151}
152function syncCountersFromLabels(components) {
153 for (const comp of components) {
154 const pfx = COMPONENT_PREFIX[comp.type];
155 if (!pfx || !comp.label?.startsWith(pfx)) continue;
156 const n = parseInt(comp.label.slice(pfx.length), 10);
157 if (Number.isFinite(n) && n > (counters[comp.type] || 0)) {
158 counters[comp.type] = n;
159 }
160 }
161}
162
163function repairComponentsAfterLoad(components) {
164 migrateLoadedComponents(components);
165 for (const comp of components) {
166 if (comp.type === 'arduino_uno') {
167 if (typeof comp.sketch !== 'string') comp.sketch = DEFAULT_ARDUINO_SKETCH;
168 if (!comp.fqbn) comp.fqbn = 'arduino:avr:uno';
169 comp.pinModes = comp.pinModes || {};
170 comp.pinLevels = comp.pinLevels || {};
171 comp.lastCompileLog = typeof comp.lastCompileLog === 'string' ? comp.lastCompileLog : '';
172 applyArduinoSketchToComponent(comp);
173 }
174 }
175}

187function loadCircuitFromJSON(jsonText) {
188 try {
189 const data = normalizeCircuitPayload(parseJsonText(jsonText));
190 if (data.name) setCircuitDisplayName(data.name);
191 resetArduinoEditorOnCircuitLoad();
192 for (const k of Object.keys(counters)) counters[k] = 0;
193 circuit.components = data.components;
194 circuit.wires = data.wires;
195 circuit.autoJunctions = data.autoJunctions;
196 Object.assign(counters, data.counters);
197 repairComponentsAfterLoad(circuit.components);
198 ensureAllCounters();
199 syncCountersFromLabels(circuit.components);
200 interaction.selectedComponents = [];
201 interaction.selectedAutoJunctions = [];
202 interaction.selectedWire = null;
203 undoStack.length = 0;
204 redoStack.length = 0;
205 stopSimulation();
206 closeSourcePanel();
207 closeScopePanelFully();
208 resetUiAfterCircuitLoad();
209 onCircuitLoaded();
210 draw();
211 } catch (e) {
212 console.error('loadCircuitFromJSON', e);
213 alert(`Erreur lors de la lecture du fichier JSON.\n\n${e?.message || e}`);
214 }
215}

301// --- GESTION DES MOUSE EVENTS ---
302function updateMouseState(e) {
303 const mousePos = toGridCoords(e.clientX, e.clientY);
304 interaction.hoverJonction = null; interaction.hoveredComponent = null; interaction.hoveredWire = null;
305 if (flags.isPanning || flags.isSelectingZone) return;
306
307 interaction.hoveredComponent = circuit.components.find(comp => componentHitTest(comp, mousePos.x, mousePos.y));
308 for (let comp of circuit.components) {
309 for (let j of getComponentJonctions(comp)) { if (Math.hypot(mousePos.x - j.x, mousePos.y - j.y) < 12) { interaction.hoverJonction = j; break; } }
310 if (interaction.hoverJonction) break;
311 }
312 if (!interaction.hoverJonction) {
313 for (let aj of circuit.autoJunctions) { if (Math.hypot(mousePos.x - aj.x, mousePos.y - aj.y) < 12) { interaction.hoverJonction = aj; break; } }
314 }
315 if (!interaction.hoveredComponent && !interaction.hoverJonction && !interaction.activeWire) {
316 for (let w of circuit.wires) {
317 for (let i = 0; i < w.points.length - 1; i++) {
318 if (isPointOnSegment(mousePos.x, mousePos.y, w.points[i], w.points[i+1], 5)) { interaction.hoveredWire = w; break; }
319 }
320 if (interaction.hoveredWire) break;
321 }
322 }
323 canvas.style.cursor = flags.isShiftPressed ? 'cell' : (interaction.activeWire || interaction.hoverJonction ? 'crosshair' : (flags.isDraggingComponent ? 'grabbing' : (interaction.hoveredComponent ? 'pointer' : (interaction.hoveredWire ? 'help' : 'grab'))));
324}
325
326canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
327 const mousePos = toGridCoords(e.clientX, e.clientY); const sX = snapToGrid(mousePos.x), sY = snapToGrid(mousePos.y);
328 lastMouseGridPos = { x: sX, y: sY }; updateMouseState(e);
329 if (e.button === 0) {
330 const hitComp = circuit.components.find((c) => componentHitTest(c, mousePos.x, mousePos.y));
331 if (hitComp?.type === 'potentiometer') {
332 const ctrl = potentiometerControlHit(hitComp, mousePos.x, mousePos.y);
333 if (ctrl) {
334 if (!flags.isSimulating) saveState();
335 const step = 5;
336 const pos = hitComp.position ?? 50;
337 hitComp.position = ctrl === 'inc' ? Math.min(100, pos + step) : Math.max(0, pos - step);
338 draw();
339 if (flags.isSimulating) requestLiveSimulation();
340 return;
341 }
342 }
343 if (hitComp?.type === 'switch_spdt' && !interaction.hoverJonction && switchSpdtToggleHit(hitComp, mousePos.x, mousePos.y)) {
344 if (!flags.isSimulating) saveState();
345 hitComp.state = hitComp.state === 1 ? 0 : 1;
346 draw();
347 if (flags.isSimulating) requestLiveSimulation();

578canvas.addEventListener('dblclick', async (e) => {
579 const mousePos = toGridCoords(e.clientX, e.clientY); const target = circuit.components.find(c => componentHitTest(c, mousePos.x, mousePos.y));
580 if (target) {
581 if (target.type === 'cd4511') {
582 openCd4511DocModal(target.label);
583 return;
584 }
585 if (target.type === 'bargraph_dc10h') {
586 openBargraphDocModal(target);
587 return;
588 }
589 if (target.type === 'ic_74hc90') {
590 openHc90DocModal(target.label);
591 return;
592 }
593 if (target.type === 'arduino_uno') {
594 openUnoDocModal(target.label);
595 return;
596 }
597 if (target.type === 'oscilloscope') {
598 closeSourcePanel();
599 openScopePanel(target);
600 return;
601 }
602 if (target.type === 'bode_analyzer') {
603 closeSourcePanel();
604 closeScopePanelFully();
605 openBodePopup(target);
606 return;
607 }
608 if (target.type === 'gimp' || target.type === 'gsin' || target.type === 'gsqr') {
609 closeScopePanelFully();
610 openSourcePanel(target);
611 return;
612 }
613 const live = flags.isSimulating;
614 if (target.type === 'resistor') {
615 let v = await showValuePrompt(`Valeur de ${target.label} :`, target.value || "1k");
616 if (v) { if (!live) saveState(); target.value = v.trim(); draw(); if (live) requestLiveSimulation(); }
617 }
618 else if (target.type === 'potentiometer') {
619 let v = await showValuePrompt(`Résistance totale de ${target.label} (ex. 10k) :`, target.value || '10k');
620 if (v) {
621 if (!live) saveState();
622 target.value = v.trim();
623 const p = await showValuePrompt('Position du curseur (0–100 %) :', String(target.position ?? 50));
624 if (p !== null && p.trim() !== '' && !isNaN(parseFloat(p))) {
625 target.position = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, parseFloat(p)));
626 }
627 draw();
628 if (live) requestLiveSimulation();
629 }
630 }
631 else if (target.type === 'capacitor') {
632 let v = await showValuePrompt(`Capacité de ${target.label} (ex. 1u, 100n, 10p, 1m) :`, target.value || "1u");
633 if (v) { if (!live) saveState(); target.value = v.trim(); draw(); if (live) requestLiveSimulation(); }
634 }
635 else if (target.type === 'speaker') {
636 let v = await showValuePrompt(`Impédance de ${target.label} (Ω, ex. 8) :`, target.value || '8');
637 if (v) { if (!live) saveState(); target.value = v.trim(); draw(); if (live) requestLiveSimulation(); }
638 }
639 else if (target.type === 'inductor') {
640 let v = await showValuePrompt(`Inductance de ${target.label} (ex. 1m, 10u) :`, target.value || "1m");
641 if (v) { if (!live) saveState(); target.value = v.trim(); draw(); if (live) requestLiveSimulation(); }
642 }
643 else if (target.type === 'diode') {
644 let v = await showValuePrompt(`Modèle diode ${target.label} (ex. 1N4148) :`, target.value || "1N4148");
645 if (v) { if (!live) saveState(); target.value = v.trim(); draw(); if (live) requestLiveSimulation(); }
646 }
647 else if (target.type === 'opamp') {
648 let vp = await showValuePrompt('Alimentation + (V) :', String(target.vp ?? 15));
649 if (vp === null) return;
650 let vn = await showValuePrompt('Alimentation − (V) :', String(target.vn ?? -15));
651 if (vn === null) return;
652 if (!live) saveState();
653 target.vp = parseFloat(vp) || 15;
654 target.vn = parseFloat(vn) || -15;
655 draw();
656 if (live) requestLiveSimulation();
657 }
658 else if (['battery', 'vcc'].includes(target.type)) {
659 let v = await showValuePrompt("Tension (Volts) :", target.value !== undefined ? String(target.value) : "5");
660 if (v && !isNaN(parseFloat(v))) { if (!live) saveState(); target.value = parseFloat(v); draw(); if (live) requestLiveSimulation(); }
661 }
662 else if (target.type === 'logic_terminal') {
663 if (live) { alert("Arrêtez la simulation."); return; }
664 let v = await showValuePrompt("Tension Niveau Haut (Volts) :", target.highVoltage !== undefined ? String(target.highVoltage) : "5");
665 if (v && !isNaN(parseFloat(v))) { saveState(); target.highVoltage = parseFloat(v); draw(); }
666 }
667 else if (target.type === 'grove_dht22') {
668 const curT = target.temperature ?? 24;
669 const curH = target.humidity ?? 55;
670 const t = await showValuePrompt(`Température simulée ${target.label} (°C) :`, String(curT));
671 if (t === null || t.trim() === '') return;
672 const tVal = parseFloat(t);
673 if (!Number.isFinite(tVal)) return;
674 const h = await showValuePrompt(`Humidité simulée ${target.label} (%) :`, String(curH));
675 if (h === null || h.trim() === '') return;
676 const hVal = parseFloat(h);
677 if (!Number.isFinite(hVal)) return;
678 if (!live) saveState();
679 target.temperature = Math.max(-40, Math.min(80, tVal));
680 target.humidity = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, hVal));
681 draw();
682 if (live) requestLiveSimulation();
683 }
684 else if (target.type === 'push_button') {
685 const cur = target.maintained ? 'maintenu' : 'momentane';
686 let v = await showValuePrompt(
687 `Mode de ${target.label} — "momentane" (fermé pendant l'appui) ou "maintenu" (1er clic ferme, 2e clic ouvre) :`,
688 cur
689 );
690 if (v) {
691 if (!live) saveState();
692 target.maintained = v.trim().toLowerCase().startsWith('maint');
693 target.state = 0;
694 heldPushButton = null;
695 draw();
696 if (live) requestLiveSimulation();
697 }
698 }
699 }
700});

727function applyNewComponentDefaults(nc, type) {
728 if (type === 'gimp') {
729 nc.frequency = 2;
730 nc.dutyCycle = 50;
731 nc.voltageRail = 5;
732 nc.flipX = false;
733 } else if (type === 'potentiometer') {
734 nc.value = '10k';
735 nc.position = 50;
736 } else if (type === 'switch_spdt') {
737 nc.state = 0;
738 } else if (type === 'push_button') {
739 nc.state = 0;
740 nc.maintained = false;
741 } else if (type === 'speaker') {
742 nc.value = '8';
743 } else if (type === 'gsin') {
744 nc.peakAmplitude = 5;
745 nc.frequency = 440;
746 nc.offset = 0;
747 } else if (type === 'gsqr') {
748 nc.peakAmplitude = 5;
749 nc.frequency = 1000;
750 nc.offset = 0;
751 } else if (type === 'capacitor') {
752 nc.value = '1u';
753 } else if (type === 'inductor') {
754 nc.value = '1m';
755 } else if (type === 'diode') {
756 nc.value = '1N4148';
757 } else if (type === 'npn') {
758 nc.value = '2N2222';
759 nc.flipX = false;
760 } else if (type === 'opamp') {
761 nc.value = 'uA741';
762 nc.vp = 15;
763 nc.vn = -15;
764 nc.flipX = false;
765 nc.flipY = false;
766 } else if (type === 'oscilloscope') {
767 nc.timeDivSec = 0.001;
768 nc.ch1VoltsPerDiv = 1;
769 nc.ch2VoltsPerDiv = 1;
770 nc.ch1PositionDiv = 0;
771 nc.ch2PositionDiv = 0;
772 nc.timePositionDiv = 0;
773 } else if (type === 'arduino_uno') {
774 nc.sketch = DEFAULT_ARDUINO_SKETCH;
775 nc.fqbn = 'arduino:avr:uno';
776 nc.pinModes = {};
777 nc.pinLevels = {};
778 nc.avrRegisters = null;
779 nc.lastCompileOk = null;
780 nc.lastCompileLog = '';
781 } else if (type === 'grove_lcd16x2') {
782 nc.i2cAddress = 0x3e;
783 nc.flipX = false;
784 } else if (type === 'bargraph_dc10h') {
785 nc.barColor = 'red';
786 nc.flipX = false;
787 } else if (type === 'grove_dht22') {
788 nc.flipX = false;
789 nc.temperature = 24;
790 nc.humidity = 55;
791 }
792}

796 const type = menuDrag.draggedComponentType
797 || e.dataTransfer?.getData('text/plain')
798 || '';

800 if (flags.isSimulating) {
801 alert('Arrêtez la simulation pour ajouter un composant.');
802 finishMenuDrag();
803 return;
804 }
805 saveState();
806 const gp = toGridCoords(e.clientX, e.clientY);
807 const nc = {
808 type,
809 x: snapToGrid(gp.x),
810 y: snapToGrid(gp.y),
811 label: newComponentLabel(type),
812 rotation: 0,
813 state: 0,
814 highVoltage: 5,
815 };
816 applyNewComponentDefaults(nc, type);
817 circuit.components.push(nc);
818 interaction.selectedComponents = [nc];
819 interaction.selectedAutoJunctions = [];
820 interaction.selectedWire = null;
821 finishMenuDrag();
822 if (nc.type === 'gimp' || nc.type === 'gsin' || nc.type === 'gsqr') {
823 closeScopePanelFully();
824 openSourcePanel(nc);
825 } else if (nc.type === 'oscilloscope') {
826 closeSourcePanel();
827 openScopePanel(nc);
828 } else if (nc.type === 'arduino_uno') {
829 openArduinoEditor(nc);
830 }
831}

840 .replace(/[\u{2190}-\u{21FF}\u{2300}-\u{23FF}\u{2460}-\u{24FF}\u{25A0}-\u{25FF}]/gu, '')

30 if (pathname.startsWith('/Simulateur')) return origin;
31 return origin;

48function updateCompileStatusUi(board) {

52 if (!status || !btn) return;
53
54 if (!board) {
55 status.textContent = '';

61 }

63 }

79 setCompileLogVisible(false);
80 } else {
81 btn.classList.add('hidden');

86function escapeHtml(s) {
87 return String(s || '')
88 .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
89 .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
90 .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
91 .replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
92}

94function renderLibraryItem(lib, mode) {
95 const li = document.createElement('li');
96 li.className = 'arduino-lib-item';
97 const meta = [lib.author, lib.version].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
98 const desc = lib.description ? `<div class="arduino-lib-item-meta">${escapeHtml(lib.description)}</div>` : '';
99 const btnClass = mode === 'install' ? 'arduino-btn--install' : 'arduino-btn--uninstall';
100 const btnLabel = mode === 'install' ? 'Installer' : 'Retirer';
101 const btn = mode === 'local'
102 ? '<span class="arduino-lib-item-meta">local</span>'
103 : `<button type="button" class="arduino-btn arduino-btn--small ${btnClass}" data-lib-name="${escapeHtml(lib.name)}">${btnLabel}</button>`;
104 li.innerHTML = `
105 <div class="arduino-lib-item-info">
106 <button type="button" class="arduino-lib-item-name" title="Voir les commandes">${escapeHtml(lib.name)}</button>
107 ${meta ? `<div class="arduino-lib-item-meta">${escapeHtml(meta)}</div>` : ''}
108 ${desc}
109 </div>
110 ${btn}
111 `;
112 li.querySelector('.arduino-lib-item-name')?.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
113 e.stopPropagation();
114 openArduinoLibPopup(lib.name);
115 });
116 if (mode !== 'local') {
117 li.querySelector('button')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
118 if (mode === 'install') installLibraryByName(lib.name);
119 else uninstallLibraryByName(lib.name);
120 });
121 }
122 return li;
123}

135export async function refreshInstalledLibraries() {
136 const list = libInstalledEl();
137 if (!list) return;
138 list.innerHTML = '';
139 setLibMsg('Chargement des bibliothèques…');
140 try {
141 const base = resolveApiBaseUrl();
142 const r = await fetch(`${base}/api/arduino/libraries`);
143 const data = await r.json();
144 const libs = Array.isArray(data.libraries) ? data.libraries : [];
145 if (libs.length === 0) {
146 setLibMsg('Aucune bibliothèque installée. Recherchez « LiquidCrystal I2C » ci-dessus.', '');
147 } else {
148 setLibMsg(`${libs.length} bibliothèque(s) disponible(s).`, 'ok');
149 }
150 for (const lib of libs) {
151 const mode = lib.source === 'local' ? 'local' : 'uninstall';
152 list.appendChild(renderLibraryItem(lib, mode));
153 }
154 await refreshArduinoCliStatus();
155 } catch (err) {
156 setLibMsg(err?.message || 'Impossible de charger les bibliothèques.', 'err');
157 }
158}
159
160export async function searchLibraries(query) {
161 const q = String(query || '').trim();
162 const list = libSearchResultsEl();
163 if (!list) return;
164 list.innerHTML = '';
165 if (!q) {
166 setLibMsg('Saisissez un nom à rechercher.', 'err');
167 return;
168 }
169 setLibMsg(`Recherche « ${q} »…`);
170 try {
171 const base = resolveApiBaseUrl();
172 const r = await fetch(`${base}/api/arduino/lib/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(q)}`);
173 const data = await r.json();
174 const libs = Array.isArray(data.libraries) ? data.libraries : [];
175 if (!data.ok) {
176 setLibMsg((data.errors || []).join(' ') || 'Recherche échouée.', 'err');
177 return;
178 }
179 if (libs.length === 0) {
180 setLibMsg('Aucun résultat. Essayez « LiquidCrystal » ou mettez à jour l\'index (↻).', 'err');
181 return;
182 }
183 setLibMsg(`${libs.length} résultat(s).`, 'ok');
184 for (const lib of libs.slice(0, 12)) {
185 list.appendChild(renderLibraryItem(lib, 'install'));
186 }
187 } catch (err) {
188 setLibMsg(err?.message || 'Recherche impossible.', 'err');
189 }
190}
191
192export async function installLibraryByName(name) {
193 const libName = String(name || '').trim();
194 if (!libName) return;
195 setLibMsg(`Installation de « ${libName} »…`);
196 try {
197 const base = resolveApiBaseUrl();
198 const r = await fetch(`${base}/api/arduino/lib/install`, {
199 method: 'POST',
200 headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
201 body: JSON.stringify({ name: libName }),
202 });
203 const data = await r.json();
204 if (!data.ok) {
205 setLibMsg((data.errors || []).join('\n') || data.log || 'Installation échouée.', 'err');
206 return;
207 }
208 setLibMsg(`« ${libName} » installée.`, 'ok');
209 libSearchResultsEl()?.replaceChildren();
210 await refreshInstalledLibraries();
211 } catch (err) {
212 setLibMsg(err?.message || 'Installation impossible.', 'err');
213 }
214}
215
216export async function uninstallLibraryByName(name) {
217 const libName = String(name || '').trim();
218 if (!libName) return;
219 if (!confirm(`Retirer la bibliothèque « ${libName} » ?`)) return;
220 setLibMsg(`Retrait de « ${libName} »…`);
221 try {
222 const base = resolveApiBaseUrl();
223 const r = await fetch(`${base}/api/arduino/lib/uninstall`, {
224 method: 'POST',
225 headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
226 body: JSON.stringify({ name: libName }),
227 });
228 const data = await r.json();
229 if (!data.ok) {
230 setLibMsg((data.errors || []).join('\n') || data.log || 'Retrait échoué.', 'err');
231 return;
232 }
233 setLibMsg(`« ${libName} » retirée.`, 'ok');
234 await refreshInstalledLibraries();
235 } catch (err) {
236 setLibMsg(err?.message || 'Retrait impossible.', 'err');
237 }
238}

300export async function refreshArduinoCliStatus() {
301 const el = statusEl();
302 if (!el) return;
303 el.textContent = 'Vérification arduino-cli…';
304 try {
305 const base = resolveApiBaseUrl();

308 if (data.ok && data.version) {
309 el.textContent = `arduino-cli OK — ${String(data.version).split('\n')[0]}`;
310 el.className = 'arduino-cli-status arduino-cli-status--ok';

321export async function compileActiveSketch() {
322 if (!activeBoard) return;
323 applySketchToBoard();
324 saveState();
325 const log = logEl();
326 const status = compileStatusEl();
327 const btn = showErrorsBtn();
328 if (status) {
329 status.textContent = 'Compilation…';
330 status.className = 'arduino-compile-status arduino-compile-status--busy';
331 }
332 if (btn) btn.classList.add('hidden');
333 if (log) {
334 log.textContent = 'Compilation en cours…';
335 log.classList.add('hidden');
336 }
337 const base = resolveApiBaseUrl();
338 try {
339 const r = await fetch(`${base}/api/arduino/compile`, {
340 method: 'POST',
341 headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
342 body: JSON.stringify({
343 sketch: activeBoard.sketch,
344 sketchName: activeBoard.label,
345 fqbn: activeBoard.fqbn || 'arduino:avr:uno',
346 }),
347 });
348 const data = await r.json();
349 activeBoard.lastCompileOk = !!data.ok;
350 activeBoard.lastCompileLog = data.log || (data.errors || []).join('\n');
351 if (data.ok) {
352 applyArduinoSketchToComponent(activeBoard);
353 onArduinoSketchUpdated();
354 if (flags.isSimulating) {
355 import('./simulation.js').then((m) => m.requestLiveSimulation());
356 }
357 }
358 if (log) log.textContent = activeBoard.lastCompileLog;
359 updateCompileStatusUi(activeBoard);
360 draw();
361 } catch (err) {
362 activeBoard.lastCompileOk = false;
363 activeBoard.lastCompileLog = err?.message || String(err);
364 if (log) log.textContent = activeBoard.lastCompileLog;
365 updateCompileStatusUi(activeBoard);
366 draw();
367 }
368}

5

17 commands: [
18 { sig: "lcd.init()", desc: "Initialise l’afficheur HD44780 (4 bits via I²C).", simSupported: true },
19 { sig: "lcd.begin(cols, rows)", desc: "Alias de init() avec taille optionnelle.", simSupported: true },
20 { sig: "lcd.backlight()", desc: "Rétroéclairage ON.", simSupported: true },

25 { sig: 'lcd.print("texte")', desc: "Affiche une chaîne ou un nombre.", simSupported: true },
26 { sig: 'lcd.print(F("texte"))', desc: "Chaîne en mémoire programme (FLASH).", simSupported: true },
27 { sig: "lcd.write(byte)", desc: "Écrit un caractère (code ASCII).", simSupported: true },
28 { sig: "delay(ms)", desc: "Pause en millisecondes (animation LCD en simulation).", simSupported: true },
29 { sig: "lcd.scrollDisplayLeft()", desc: "Décale l’affichage d’une colonne vers la gauche.", simSupported: true },
30 { sig: "lcd.scrollDisplayRight()", desc: "Décale l’affichage d’une colonne vers la droite.", simSupported: true },

32 { sig: "lcd.blink() / noBlink()", desc: "Clignotement du curseur.", simSupported: false },

113/**
114 * @param {string} libName
115 * @returns {typeof ARDUINO_LIB_DOCS[0] | null}

117export function resolveArduinoLibDoc(libName) {
118 const n = String(libName || "").trim();
119 if (!n) return null;
120 for (const doc of ARDUINO_LIB_DOCS) {
121 if (doc.match.test(n)) return doc;
122 }
123 if (/i2c/i.test(n) && /lcd/i.test(n)) {
124 return ARDUINO_LIB_DOCS.find((d) => d.id === "liquidcrystal_i2c") ?? null;
125 }
126 return null;
127}

1// arduino-lib-popup.js — fenêtre flottante : commandes d'une bibliothèque Arduino

4let floatX = 160;
5let floatY = 90;
6let dragging = false;
7let dragOffX = 0;
8let dragOffY = 0;
9
10const popupEl = () => document.getElementById('arduino-lib-popup');
11const titleEl = () => document.getElementById('arduino-lib-popup-title');
12const bodyEl = () => document.getElementById('arduino-lib-popup-body');
13
14function escapeHtml(s) {
15 return String(s || '')
16 .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
17 .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
18 .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
19 .replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
20}
21
22function applyFloatPosition() {
23 const el = popupEl();
24 if (!el) return;
25 el.style.left = `${floatX}px`;
26 el.style.top = `${floatY}px`;
27}
28
29function clampFloatPosition() {
30 const el = popupEl();
31 if (!el) return;
32 const w = el.offsetWidth || 480;
33 const h = el.offsetHeight || 400;
34 floatX = Math.max(4, Math.min(window.innerWidth - w - 4, floatX));
35 floatY = Math.max(48, Math.min(window.innerHeight - h - 4, floatY));
36}
37
38function renderUnknownLib(libName) {
39 return `
40 <p class="arduino-lib-doc-note">
41 Aucune fiche détaillée pour <strong>${escapeHtml(libName)}</strong>.
42 Consultez la documentation du Library Manager ou le fichier <code>README</code> de la bibliothèque.
43 </p>
44 <p class="arduino-lib-doc-note">
45 Bibliothèques documentées dans le simulateur :
46 <strong>LiquidCrystal I2C</strong>, <strong>Wire</strong>, <strong>Grove LCD RGB</strong>.
47 </p>
48 `;
49}
50
51function renderLibDoc(doc) {
52 const header = doc.header
53 ? `<pre class="arduino-lib-doc-code">${escapeHtml(doc.header)}</pre>`
54 : '';
55 const ctor = doc.ctor
56 ? `<pre class="arduino-lib-doc-code">${escapeHtml(doc.ctor)}</pre>`
57 : '';
58 const note = doc.note
59 ? `<p class="arduino-lib-doc-note">${escapeHtml(doc.note)}</p>`
60 : '';
61 const rows = doc.commands.map((cmd) => {
62 const badge = cmd.simSupported
63 ? '<span class="arduino-lib-doc-badge arduino-lib-doc-badge--sim">simulateur</span>'
64 : '<span class="arduino-lib-doc-badge">compilation</span>';
65 return `<tr>
66 <td><code class="arduino-lib-doc-sig">${escapeHtml(cmd.sig)}</code>${badge}</td>
67 <td>${escapeHtml(cmd.desc)}</td>
68 </tr>`;
69 }).join('');
70 return `
71 ${note}
72 ${header}
73 ${ctor}
74 <table class="arduino-lib-doc-table">
75 <thead>
76 <tr><th>Commande</th><th>Description</th></tr>
77 </thead>
78 <tbody>${rows}</tbody>
79 </table>
80 <p class="arduino-lib-doc-legend">
81 <span class="arduino-lib-doc-badge arduino-lib-doc-badge--sim">simulateur</span> effet visible en simulation
82 · <span class="arduino-lib-doc-badge">compilation</span> compile uniquement (arduino-cli)
83 </p>
84 `;
85}
86
87export function isArduinoLibPopupOpen() {
88 const el = popupEl();
89 return el && !el.classList.contains('hidden');
90}
91
92export function openArduinoLibPopup(libName) {
93 const name = String(libName || '').trim();
94 if (!name) return;
95 const doc = resolveArduinoLibDoc(name);
96 if (titleEl()) titleEl().textContent = doc ? doc.title : name;
97 if (bodyEl()) {
98 bodyEl().innerHTML = doc ? renderLibDoc(doc) : renderUnknownLib(name);
99 }
100 applyFloatPosition();
101 popupEl()?.classList.remove('hidden');
102}
103
104export function closeArduinoLibPopup() {
105 popupEl()?.classList.add('hidden');
106}
107
108export function initArduinoLibPopup() {
109 document.getElementById('arduino-lib-popup-close')?.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
110 e.stopPropagation();
111 closeArduinoLibPopup();
112 });
113
114 const handle = document.getElementById('arduino-lib-popup-drag-handle');
115 handle?.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
116 if (e.button !== 0) return;
117 if (e.target.closest('#arduino-lib-popup-close')) return;
118 dragging = true;
119 const rect = popupEl()?.getBoundingClientRect();
120 if (rect) {
121 dragOffX = e.clientX - rect.left;
122 dragOffY = e.clientY - rect.top;
123 }
124 e.preventDefault();
125 });
126
127 window.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
128 if (!dragging) return;
129 floatX = e.clientX - dragOffX;
130 floatY = e.clientY - dragOffY;
131 clampFloatPosition();
132 applyFloatPosition();
133 });
134
135 window.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
136 dragging = false;
137 });
138
139 window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
140 if (isArduinoLibPopupOpen()) {
141 clampFloatPosition();
142 applyFloatPosition();
143 }
144 });
145}

1/** Coloration syntaxique sketch Arduino (style proche de l’IDE). */
2
3const KEYWORDS = new Set([
4 'if', 'else', 'for', 'while', 'do', 'switch', 'case', 'default', 'break', 'continue', 'return', 'goto',
5 'void', 'boolean', 'byte', 'char', 'int', 'long', 'float', 'double', 'short', 'unsigned', 'signed',
6 'const', 'static', 'volatile', 'sizeof', 'true', 'false', 'NULL', 'struct', 'enum', 'typedef',
7 'uint8_t', 'uint16_t', 'uint32_t', 'int8_t', 'int16_t', 'int32_t', 'word', 'string', 'String',
8]);
9
10const TYPE_WORDS = new Set(['boolean', 'byte', 'char', 'int', 'long', 'float', 'double', 'short', 'void', 'word', 'String']);
11
12function escapeHtml(s) {
13 return String(s)
14 .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
15 .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
16 .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');
17}
18
19function span(cls, text) {
20 return `<span class="${cls}">${escapeHtml(text)}</span>`;
21}
22
23function skipString(src, i, quote) {
24 i++;
25 while (i < src.length) {
26 if (src[i] === '\\' && i + 1 < src.length) { i += 2; continue; }
27 if (src[i] === quote) return i + 1;
28 i++;
29 }
30 return src.length;
31}
32
33function skipBlockComment(src, i) {
34 i += 2;
35 while (i < src.length - 1) {
36 if (src[i] === '*' && src[i + 1] === '/') return i + 2;
37 i++;
38 }
39 return src.length;
40}
41
42/** @param {string} code */
43export function highlightArduinoSource(code) {
44 const src = String(code);
45 let out = '';
46 let i = 0;
47 while (i < src.length) {
48 const ch = src[i];
49 const next = src[i + 1];
50
51 if (ch === '/' && next === '/') {
52 const end = src.indexOf('\n', i);
53 const slice = end === -1 ? src.slice(i) : src.slice(i, end);
54 out += span('ard-hl-cmt', slice);
55 i += slice.length;
56 continue;
57 }
58 if (ch === '/' && next === '*') {
59 const end = skipBlockComment(src, i);
60 out += span('ard-hl-cmt', src.slice(i, end));
61 i = end;
62 continue;
63 }
64 if (ch === '#') {
65 const end = src.indexOf('\n', i);
66 const slice = end === -1 ? src.slice(i) : src.slice(i, end);
67 const inc = slice.match(/^#include\s+([<"][^>"]+[>"])/);
68 if (inc) {
69 const head = slice.slice(0, inc.index + inc[0].indexOf(inc[1]));
70 const lib = inc[1];
71 out += span('ard-hl-pre', head) + span('ard-hl-lib', lib) + span('ard-hl-pre', slice.slice(head.length + lib.length));
72 } else {
73 out += span('ard-hl-pre', slice);
74 }
75 i += slice.length;
76 continue;
77 }
78 if (ch === '"' || ch === "'") {
79 const end = skipString(src, i, ch);
80 out += span('ard-hl-str', src.slice(i, end));
81 i = end;
82 continue;
83 }
84 if (/[0-9]/.test(ch) || (ch === '.' && /[0-9]/.test(next))) {
85 let j = i;
86 while (j < src.length && /[0-9.xXa-fA-FuUlL]/.test(src[j])) j++;
87 out += span('ard-hl-num', src.slice(i, j));
88 i = j;
89 continue;
90 }
91 if (/[A-Za-z_]/.test(ch)) {
92 let j = i;
93 while (j < src.length && /[A-Za-z0-9_]/.test(src[j])) j++;
94 const word = src.slice(i, j);
95 let k = j;
96 while (k < src.length && /\s/.test(src[k])) k++;
97 const isCall = src[k] === '(';
98 if (word === 'F' && src[k] === '(') {
99 out += span('ard-hl-macro', word);
100 } else if (KEYWORDS.has(word)) {
101 out += span(TYPE_WORDS.has(word) ? 'ard-hl-type' : 'ard-hl-kw', word);
102 } else if (isCall) {
103 out += span('ard-hl-fn', word);
104 } else {
105 out += escapeHtml(word);
106 }
107 i = j;
108 continue;
109 }
110 out += escapeHtml(ch);
111 i++;
112 }
113 return out;
114}
115
116let highlightEl = null;
117let textareaEl = null;
118
119/** Ajuste la hauteur des deux calques pour qu’ils restent superposés. */
120function syncEditorHeight() {
121 if (!textareaEl || !highlightEl) return;
122 textareaEl.style.height = '0px';
123 const h = Math.max(240, textareaEl.scrollHeight);
124 textareaEl.style.height = `${h}px`;
125 highlightEl.style.height = `${h}px`;
126}
127
128function syncHighlight() {
129 if (!highlightEl || !textareaEl) return;
130 highlightEl.innerHTML = highlightArduinoSource(textareaEl.value);
131 syncEditorHeight();
132}
133
134export function initArduinoSyntaxHighlight() {
135 textareaEl = document.getElementById('arduino-sketch-input');
136 highlightEl = document.getElementById('arduino-sketch-highlight');
137 if (!textareaEl || !highlightEl) return;
138
139 const refresh = () => syncHighlight();
140
141 textareaEl.addEventListener('input', refresh);
142 textareaEl.addEventListener('focus', refresh);
143 window.addEventListener('resize', refresh);
144
145 refresh();
146}
147
148export function refreshArduinoSyntaxHighlight() {
149 syncHighlight();
150}

1// bode-popup.js — fenêtre diagramme de Bode (gain en dB, axe fréquence semi-log)
2import { flags, simulationResults } from './state.js';
3
4let popupComp = null;
5let popupCanvas = null;
6let popupCtx = null;
7
8let floatX = 140;
9let floatY = 90;
10let dragging = false;
11let dragOffX = 0;
12let dragOffY = 0;
13
14/** Curseur souris : fréquence (Hz) sous le pointeur, null = masqué */
15let cursorFreqHz = null;
16
17/** Géométrie du dernier tracé (pour convertir souris ↔ fréquence) */
18let plotGeom = null;
19
20const popupEl = () => document.getElementById('bode-popup');
21const titleEl = () => document.getElementById('bode-popup-title');
22const infoEl = () => document.getElementById('bode-popup-info');
23
24function getBodePlotForComp(comp) {
25 if (!comp) return null;
26 const plots = simulationResults.bodePlots;
27 if (!plots || typeof plots !== 'object') return null;
28 if (plots[comp.label]) return plots[comp.label];
29 const keys = Object.keys(plots);
30 if (keys.length === 1) return plots[keys[0]];
31 return null;
32}
33
34function applyFloatPosition() {
35 const el = popupEl();
36 if (!el) return;
37 el.style.left = `${floatX}px`;
38 el.style.top = `${floatY}px`;
39}
40
41function formatFreqHz(f) {
42 if (!Number.isFinite(f) || f <= 0) return '?';
43 if (f >= 1e6) return `${(f / 1e6).toFixed(f >= 10e6 ? 0 : 2)} MHz`;
44 if (f >= 1000) return `${(f / 1000).toFixed(f >= 10e3 ? 1 : 2)} kHz`;
45 return `${f < 10 ? f.toFixed(2) : Math.round(f * 10) / 10} Hz`;
46}
47
48function freqToX(freq, fMin, fMax, x0, plotW) {
49 const lo = Math.log10(Math.max(fMin, 1e-6));
50 const hi = Math.log10(Math.max(fMax, fMin * 1.01));
51 const f = Math.max(freq, fMin);
52 return x0 + ((Math.log10(f) - lo) / (hi - lo)) * plotW;
53}
54
55function xToFreq(x, fMin, fMax, x0, plotW) {
56 const lo = Math.log10(Math.max(fMin, 1e-6));
57 const hi = Math.log10(Math.max(fMax, fMin * 1.01));
58 const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (x - x0) / plotW));
59 return Math.pow(10, lo + t * (hi - lo));
60}
61
62function gainToY(gainDb, gMin, gMax, y0, plotH) {
63 const t = (gainDb - gMin) / Math.max(gMax - gMin, 1e-6);
64 return y0 + plotH - t * plotH;
65}
66
67function interpolateGainDb(frequency, gainDb, f) {
68 if (!frequency?.length || f <= 0) return NaN;
69 if (f <= frequency[0]) return gainDb[0];
70 if (f >= frequency[frequency.length - 1]) return gainDb[gainDb.length - 1];
71 for (let i = 1; i < frequency.length; i++) {
72 if (f <= frequency[i]) {
73 const f0 = frequency[i - 1];
74 const f1 = frequency[i];
75 const g0 = gainDb[i - 1];
76 const g1 = gainDb[i];
77 if (f1 <= f0) return g0;
78 const t = (Math.log10(f) - Math.log10(f0)) / (Math.log10(f1) - Math.log10(f0));
79 return g0 + t * (g1 - g0);
80 }
81 }
82 return gainDb[gainDb.length - 1];
83}
84
85function drawBodeGrid(ctx, x0, y0, plotW, plotH, fMin, fMax, gMin, gMax) {
86 ctx.strokeStyle = '#1a3a4a';
87 ctx.lineWidth = 1;
88 const decades = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(Math.log10(fMax / Math.max(fMin, 1e-6))));
89 for (let d = 0; d <= decades; d++) {
90 const f = fMin * Math.pow(10, (d / decades) * Math.log10(fMax / fMin));
91 const x = freqToX(f, fMin, fMax, x0, plotW);
92 ctx.beginPath();
93 ctx.moveTo(x, y0);
94 ctx.lineTo(x, y0 + plotH);
95 ctx.stroke();
96 }
97 for (let i = 0; i <= 4; i++) {
98 const y = y0 + (i / 4) * plotH;
99 ctx.beginPath();
100 ctx.moveTo(x0, y);
101 ctx.lineTo(x0 + plotW, y);
102 ctx.stroke();
103 }
104}
105
106function drawFreqLabels(ctx, x0, y0, plotW, plotH, fMin, fMax) {
107 ctx.fillStyle = '#8899aa';
108 ctx.font = '10px Arial';
109 ctx.textAlign = 'center';
110 ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
111 const ticks = [fMin, fMin * 10, fMin * 100, fMin * 1000, fMax].filter((f) => f >= fMin && f <= fMax * 1.001);
112 const seen = new Set();
113 for (const f of ticks) {
114 const key = Math.round(Math.log10(f) * 100);
115 if (seen.has(key)) continue;
116 seen.add(key);
117 ctx.fillText(formatFreqHz(f), freqToX(f, fMin, fMax, x0, plotW), y0 + plotH + 6);
118 }
119 ctx.textAlign = 'right';
120 ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
121 ctx.save();
122 ctx.translate(x0 - 8, y0 + plotH / 2);
123 ctx.rotate(-Math.PI / 2);
124 ctx.fillText('Gain (dB)', 0, 0);
125 ctx.restore();
126 ctx.textAlign = 'center';
127 ctx.fillText('Fréquence', x0 + plotW / 2, y0 + plotH + 22);
128}
129
130function drawGainLabels(ctx, x0, y0, plotH, gMin, gMax) {
131 ctx.fillStyle = '#8899aa';
132 ctx.font = '10px Arial';
133 ctx.textAlign = 'right';
134 ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
135 for (let i = 0; i <= 4; i++) {
136 const g = gMin + (i / 4) * (gMax - gMin);
137 ctx.fillText(`${g.toFixed(0)}`, x0 - 6, gainToY(g, gMin, gMax, y0, plotH));
138 }
139}
140
141function drawCursor(ctx, plot, geom) {
142 if (cursorFreqHz == null || !plot?.frequency?.length || !geom) return;
143 const { x0, y0, plotW, plotH, fMin, fMax, gMin, gMax } = geom;
144 const f = Math.max(fMin, Math.min(fMax, cursorFreqHz));
145 const gain = interpolateGainDb(plot.frequency, plot.gainDb, f);
146 if (!Number.isFinite(gain)) return;
147 const cx = freqToX(f, fMin, fMax, x0, plotW);
148 const cy = gainToY(gain, gMin, gMax, y0, plotH);
149
150 ctx.save();
151 ctx.beginPath();
152 ctx.rect(x0, y0, plotW, plotH);
153 ctx.clip();
154 ctx.strokeStyle = '#ff9800';
155 ctx.lineWidth = 1;
156 ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]);
157 ctx.beginPath();
158 ctx.moveTo(cx, y0);
159 ctx.lineTo(cx, y0 + plotH);
160 ctx.stroke();
161 ctx.setLineDash([]);
162 ctx.fillStyle = '#ff9800';
163 ctx.beginPath();
164 ctx.arc(cx, cy, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
165 ctx.fill();
166 ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff';
167 ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
168 ctx.stroke();
169 ctx.restore();
170
171 if (infoEl()) {
172 let txt = `f = ${formatFreqHz(f)} | Gain = ${gain.toFixed(2)} dB`;
173 if (plot.responseHint?.includes('passe-haut')) {
174 txt += ` — ${plot.responseHint}`;
175 }
176 infoEl().textContent = txt;
177 }
178}

180function updateCursorFromMouse(clientX, clientY) {
181 if (!plotGeom || !popupCanvas) return;
182 const rect = popupCanvas.getBoundingClientRect();
183 const scaleX = popupCanvas.width / rect.width;
184 const scaleY = popupCanvas.height / rect.height;
185 const mx = (clientX - rect.left) * scaleX;
186 const my = (clientY - rect.top) * scaleY;
187 const { x0, y0, plotW, plotH, fMin, fMax } = plotGeom;
188 if (mx < x0 || mx > x0 + plotW || my < y0 || my > y0 + plotH) return;
189 cursorFreqHz = xToFreq(mx, fMin, fMax, x0, plotW);
190 renderBodePopup();
191}

193export function isBodePopupOpen() {
194 const el = popupEl();
195 return popupComp != null && el && !el.classList.contains('hidden');
196}

198export function renderBodePopup() {
199 if (!popupComp || !popupCtx || !popupCanvas) return;
200 const w = popupCanvas.width;
201 const h = popupCanvas.height;
202 const margin = { l: 52, r: 20, t: 28, b: 44 };
203 const plotW = w - margin.l - margin.r;
204 const plotH = h - margin.t - margin.b;
205 const x0 = margin.l;
206 const y0 = margin.t;
207
208 popupCtx.fillStyle = '#050a0e';
209 popupCtx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
210
211 const plot = getBodePlotForComp(popupComp);
212 plotGeom = null;
213
214 if (!flags.isSimulating || !plot?.frequency?.length) {
215 if (infoEl()) {
216 infoEl().textContent = flags.isSimulating
217 ? 'Sin requis — + sur la sortie du filtre, − sur la masse'
218 : 'Lancez la simulation';
219 }
220 popupCtx.fillStyle = '#8899aa';
221 popupCtx.font = '13px Arial';
222 popupCtx.textAlign = 'center';
223 popupCtx.textBaseline = 'middle';
224 const lines = flags.isSimulating
225 ? ['Aucune courbe', 'Générateur Sin + filtre RC/RL/RLC']
226 : ['Lancez la simulation pour voir le diagramme de Bode'];
227 lines.forEach((line, i) => {
228 popupCtx.fillText(line, w / 2, h / 2 - 10 + i * 20);
229 });
230 return;
231 }
232
233 const { frequency, gainDb, fMin, fMax } = plot;
234 let gMin = Math.min(...gainDb);
235 let gMax = Math.max(...gainDb);
236 if (gMax - gMin < 6) {
237 const mid = (gMax + gMin) / 2;
238 gMin = mid - 6;
239 gMax = mid + 6;
240 } else {
241 gMin -= 2;
242 gMax += 2;
243 }
244
245 plotGeom = { x0, y0, plotW, plotH, fMin, fMax, gMin, gMax };
246
247 if (cursorFreqHz == null && frequency.length > 0) {
248 const midIdx = Math.floor(frequency.length / 2);
249 cursorFreqHz = frequency[midIdx];
250 }
251
252 drawBodeGrid(popupCtx, x0, y0, plotW, plotH, fMin, fMax, gMin, gMax);
253 drawGainLabels(popupCtx, x0, y0, plotH, gMin, gMax);
254 drawFreqLabels(popupCtx, x0, y0, plotW, plotH, fMin, fMax);
255
256 popupCtx.save();
257 popupCtx.beginPath();
258 popupCtx.rect(x0, y0, plotW, plotH);
259 popupCtx.clip();
260 popupCtx.strokeStyle = '#7cff6b';
261 popupCtx.lineWidth = 2;
262 popupCtx.beginPath();
263 let started = false;
264 for (let i = 0; i < frequency.length; i++) {
265 const x = freqToX(frequency[i], fMin, fMax, x0, plotW);
266 const y = gainToY(gainDb[i], gMin, gMax, y0, plotH);
267 if (!started) {
268 popupCtx.moveTo(x, y);
269 started = true;
270 } else {
271 popupCtx.lineTo(x, y);
272 }
273 }
274 if (started) popupCtx.stroke();
275 popupCtx.restore();
276
277 drawCursor(popupCtx, plot, plotGeom);
278
279 if (infoEl() && cursorFreqHz == null && plot.responseHint?.includes('passe-haut')) {
280 infoEl().textContent = plot.responseHint;
281 }
282
283 popupCtx.fillStyle = plot.responseHint?.includes('passe-haut') ? '#ff9800' : '#7cff6b';
284 popupCtx.font = '12px Arial';
285 popupCtx.textAlign = 'left';
286 const title =
287 plot.responseHint?.includes('passe-haut')
288 ? '⚠ Passe-haut — vérifiez le câblage (+ jonction R/C, − GND)'
289 : '|H(jω)| — déplacez la souris sur la courbe';
290 popupCtx.fillText(title, margin.l, 16);
291}
292
293export function refreshBodePopup() {
294 if (isBodePopupOpen()) renderBodePopup();
295}

297export function openBodePopup(comp) {
298 if (!comp || comp.type !== 'bode_analyzer') return;
299 popupComp = comp;
300 popupCanvas = document.getElementById('bode-popup-canvas');
301 popupCtx = popupCanvas?.getContext('2d') ?? null;
302 cursorFreqHz = null;
303 plotGeom = null;
304 if (titleEl()) titleEl().textContent = `${comp.label} — Analyse fréquentielle`;
305 applyFloatPosition();
306 popupEl()?.classList.remove('hidden');
307 renderBodePopup();
308}
309
310export function closeBodePopup(clearComp = false) {
311 popupEl()?.classList.add('hidden');
312 if (clearComp) popupComp = null;
313 cursorFreqHz = null;
314 plotGeom = null;
315}

317function clampFloatPosition() {
318 const el = popupEl();
319 if (!el) return;
320 const pw = el.offsetWidth || 680;
321 const ph = el.offsetHeight || 440;
322 floatX = Math.max(4, Math.min(window.innerWidth - pw - 4, floatX));
323 floatY = Math.max(48, Math.min(window.innerHeight - ph - 4, floatY));
324}
325
326export function initBodePopup() {
327 document.getElementById('bode-popup-close')?.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
328 e.stopPropagation();
329 closeBodePopup();
330 });
331
332 const handle = document.getElementById('bode-popup-drag-handle');
333 handle?.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
334 if (e.button !== 0) return;
335 if (e.target.closest('#bode-popup-close')) return;
336 dragging = true;
337 const rect = popupEl()?.getBoundingClientRect();
338 if (rect) {
339 dragOffX = e.clientX - rect.left;
340 dragOffY = e.clientY - rect.top;
341 }
342 e.preventDefault();
343 });
344
345 window.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
346 if (dragging) {
347 floatX = e.clientX - dragOffX;
348 floatY = e.clientY - dragOffY;
349 clampFloatPosition();
350 applyFloatPosition();
351 return;
352 }
353 if (isBodePopupOpen() && plotGeom) {
354 updateCursorFromMouse(e.clientX, e.clientY);
355 }
356 });
357
358 window.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
359 dragging = false;
360 });
361
362 window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
363 if (isBodePopupOpen()) {
364 clampFloatPosition();
365 applyFloatPosition();
366 }
367 });
368}

1/** Géométrie CD4511 : boîtier 4×8 pas, broches ±3 pas, espacement vertical 1 pas. */
2import { GRID_SIZE as G } from './state.js';
3
4/** Rectangle central : 4 pas (L) × 8 pas (H), centré sur le composant. */
5export const CD4511_BOX_L = -2 * G;
6export const CD4511_BOX_R = 2 * G;
7export const CD4511_BOX_T = -4 * G;
8export const CD4511_BOX_B = 4 * G;
9
10/** Libellés à ½ pas à l’intérieur du cadre. */
11export const CD4511_LABEL_L = CD4511_BOX_L + G / 2;
12export const CD4511_LABEL_R = CD4511_BOX_R - G / 2;
13
14/** Jonctions à 1 pas à l’extérieur du boîtier (colonne grille). */
15export const CD4511_JUNC_L = -3 * G;
16export const CD4511_JUNC_R = 3 * G;
17
18/** 7 broches, 1 pas entre chaque niveau, centrées verticalement (±3 pas). */
19export const CD4511_PIN_Y = [-3, -2, -1, 0, 1, 2, 3].map((n) => n * G);
20
21export const CD4511_HIT_DX = 3 * G + G / 2;
22export const CD4511_HIT_DY = 4 * G + G / 2;
23
24/** Noms de jonctions schéma (suffixe après le label) → indice broche SPICE. */
25export const CD4511_JONCTION_SUFFIX = {
26 A: 0,
27 B: 1,
28 C: 2,
29 D: 3,
30 LE: 4,
31 BI: 5,
32 LT: 6,
33 a: 7,
34 b: 8,
35 c: 9,
36 d: 10,
37 e: 11,
38 f: 12,
39 g: 13,
40};
41
42/** @param {string} label ex. CD45111 */
43/** @param {string} jonctionId ex. CD45111_A */
44export function cd4511JonctionToTerminalKey(label, jonctionId) {
45 if (!label || !jonctionId?.startsWith(`${label}_`)) return null;
46 const suffix = jonctionId.slice(label.length + 1);
47 const idx = CD4511_JONCTION_SUFFIX[suffix];
48 if (idx === undefined) return null;
49 return `${label}#${idx}`;
50}

10export function voltageToAdc(volts) {
11 if (!Number.isFinite(volts)) return 0;

13 return Math.round((v / VREF) * ADC_MAX);

16/** Tension fixe d'une jonction d'alimentation (broches UNO, GND, VCC…). */
17export function fixedVoltageAtJunction(jid) {
18 if (!jid) return null;
19 if (jid.startsWith("GND") || /^GND\d+_/.test(jid)) return 0;
20 if (/_GND2?$/.test(jid)) return 0;
21 if (/_5V$/.test(jid) || jid.endsWith("_VCC")) return 5;
22 if (/_3V3$/.test(jid)) return 3.3;
23 return null;
24}
25
26function isGndJunction(jid) {
27 return fixedVoltageAtJunction(jid) === 0;

30function parseResistorOhms(value) {
31 const s = String(value || "1k").trim().toLowerCase();
32 const m = s.match(/^([\d.]+)\s*([kmg]?)$/);
33 if (!m) return 1000;
34 let n = parseFloat(m[1]);
35 if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n <= 0) return 1000;
36 if (m[2] === "k") n *= 1e3;
37 else if (m[2] === "m") n *= 1e6;
38 else if (m[2] === "g") n *= 1e9;
39 return n;
40}

42function gsinVoltageAt(comp, tSec) {
43 const a = comp.peakAmplitude ?? 5;
44 const f = comp.frequency ?? 1000;
45 const o = comp.offset ?? 0;
46 return o + a * Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * f * Math.max(0, tSec));
47}

49function gimpVoltageAt(comp, tSec) {
50 const rail = comp.voltageRail ?? 5;
51 const f = comp.frequency ?? 2;
52 const duty = (comp.dutyCycle ?? 50) / 100;
53 if (f <= 0) return 0;
54 const period = 1 / f;
55 const phase = ((tSec % period) + period) % period;
56 return phase < period * duty ? rail : 0;
57}
58
59function gsqrVoltageAt(comp, tSec) {
60 const a = comp.peakAmplitude ?? 5;
61 const f = comp.frequency ?? 1000;
62 const o = comp.offset ?? 0;
63 if (f <= 0) return o;
64 const period = 1 / f;
65 const phase = ((tSec % period) + period) % period;
66 return o + (phase < period / 2 ? a : -a);
67}

69function voltageFromVoltmetersOnNet(net, voltmeters) {

71 for (const [name, measure] of Object.entries(voltmeters)) {
72 const v = typeof measure === "object" ? measure?.voltage : measure;
73 if (!Number.isFinite(v)) continue;
74 const inn = `${name}_in`;
75 const out = `${name}_out`;
76 if (net.has(inn) || net.has(out)) return v;

81/** Pont diviseur : deux résistances sur le même nœud. */
82function tryResistorDivider(jonctionId, ctx, visiting) {
83 const { components, wires, autoJunctions = [] } = ctx;
84 const net = reachableJonctions(jonctionId, wires, autoJunctions);
85 const legs = [];
86 for (const comp of components) {
87 if (comp.type !== "resistor" || !comp.label) continue;
88 const inn = `${comp.label}_in`;
89 const out = `${comp.label}_out`;
90 if (!net.has(inn) && !net.has(out)) continue;
91 const touch = net.has(inn) ? inn : out;
92 const other = touch === inn ? out : inn;
93 const branch = new Set(visiting);
94 const vOther = resolveNetVoltage(other, ctx, branch);
95 if (!Number.isFinite(vOther)) continue;
96 legs.push({ ohm: parseResistorOhms(comp.value), vOther });

98 if (legs.length !== 2) return null;
99 const [a, b] = legs;
100 if (a.vOther === b.vOther) return a.vOther;
101 const high = a.vOther > b.vOther ? a : b;
102 const low = a.vOther > b.vOther ? b : a;
103 const rTop = high.ohm;
104 const rBot = low.ohm;
105 if (rTop + rBot <= 0) return null;
106 return low.vOther + (high.vOther - low.vOther) * (rBot / (rTop + rBot));

109/**
110 * Tension (V) sur le réseau câblé à une jonction.
111 */
112export function resolveNetVoltage(jonctionId, ctx, visiting = new Set()) {
113 if (!jonctionId || visiting.has(jonctionId)) return null;
114 visiting.add(jonctionId);
115
116 const { components, wires, autoJunctions = [], tSec = 0, getVoltageAtJonction, voltmeters } = ctx;
117 const net = reachableJonctions(jonctionId, wires, autoJunctions);
118
119 for (const j of net) {
120 const fixed = fixedVoltageAtJunction(j);
121 if (fixed !== null) return fixed;
122 }
123
124 for (const comp of components) {
125 if (!comp.label) continue;
126 if (comp.type === "vcc") {
127 for (const j of net) {
128 if (j.startsWith(`${comp.label}_`)) return Number(comp.value) || 5;
129 }
130 }
131 if (comp.type === "battery" && net.has(`${comp.label}_in`)) {
132 return Number(comp.value) || 5;
133 }
134 if (comp.type === "logic_terminal") {
135 if (net.has(`${comp.label}_out`) || net.has(`${comp.label}_in`)) {
136 return comp.state ? 5 : 0;
137 }
138 }
139 }
140
141 for (const comp of components) {
142 if (comp.type !== "potentiometer" || !comp.label) continue;
143 const wip = `${comp.label}_wip`;
144 if (!net.has(wip)) continue;
145 const branch = new Set(visiting);
146 const vIn = resolveNetVoltage(`${comp.label}_in`, ctx, branch);
147 const vOut = resolveNetVoltage(`${comp.label}_out`, ctx, branch);
148 const pos = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, Number(comp.position) || 50)) / 100;
149 const vi = Number.isFinite(vIn) ? vIn : 5;
150 const vo = Number.isFinite(vOut) ? vOut : 0;
151 return vi * (1 - pos) + vo * pos;
152 }
153
154 const dividerV = tryResistorDivider(jonctionId, ctx, visiting);
155 if (Number.isFinite(dividerV)) return dividerV;
156
157 for (const comp of components) {
158 if (!comp.label) continue;
159 const outJ = `${comp.label}_out`;
160 if (!net.has(outJ)) continue;

162 if (comp.type === "gimp") return gimpVoltageAt(comp, tSec);
163 if (comp.type === "gsqr") return gsqrVoltageAt(comp, tSec);
164 }
165
166 for (const comp of components) {
167 if (comp.type !== "arduino_uno" || !comp.label) continue;
168 for (const j of net) {
169 if (!j.startsWith(`${comp.label}_`)) continue;
170 const suffix = j.slice(comp.label.length + 1);
171 if (!/^A\d+$|^D\d+$/.test(suffix)) continue;
172 const modes = comp.pinModes || {};
173 const levels = comp.liveLevels || comp.pinLevels || {};
174 if (modes[suffix] === "OUTPUT") return levels[suffix] ? 5 : 0;
175 }
176 }
177
178 const vmV = voltageFromVoltmetersOnNet(net, voltmeters);
179 if (Number.isFinite(vmV)) return vmV;
180
181 if (typeof getVoltageAtJonction === "function") {
182 const v = getVoltageAtJonction(jonctionId);
183 if (Number.isFinite(v)) return v;
184 }
185
186 return null;
187}

189/** Valeurs ADC 0–1023 pour A0–A5 d'une carte UNO. */
190export function readUnoAnalogInputs(uno, ctx) {
191 const out = {};
192 if (!uno?.label) return out;
193 for (let i = 0; i <= 5; i++) {
194 const label = `A${i}`;
195 const jid = `${uno.label}_${label}`;
196 const v = resolveNetVoltage(jid, ctx);
197 out[label] = voltageToAdc(Number.isFinite(v) ? v : 0);
198 }
199 return out;
200}

1/**
2 * Registres GPIO ATmega328P — DDRx / PORTx (Arduino UNO).
3 * Port D : D0–D7 | Port B : D8–D13 | Port C : A0–A5 (D14–D19).
4 */
5
6export const AVR_GPIO_PORTS = ["B", "C", "D"];
7
8/** @typedef {{ DDRB: number, DDRC: number, DDRD: number, PORTB: number, PORTC: number, PORTD: number }} AvrRegisters */
9
10export function createEmptyAvrRegisters() {
11 return { DDRB: 0, DDRC: 0, DDRD: 0, PORTB: 0, PORTC: 0, PORTD: 0 };
12}
13
14export function cloneAvrRegisters(reg) {
15 return { ...createEmptyAvrRegisters(), ...(reg || {}) };
16}
17
18/** Broches GPIO câblables (D0–D13, A0–A5). */
19export function allArduinoGpioLabels() {
20 const labels = [];
21 for (let i = 0; i <= 13; i++) labels.push(`D${i}`);
22 for (let i = 0; i <= 5; i++) labels.push(`A${i}`);
23 return labels;
24}
25
26/**
27 * @param {number|string} pin — 0–13, 14–19, Dn, An, A0…
28 * @returns {{ port: 'B'|'C'|'D', bit: number, label: string }|null}
29 */
30export function arduinoPinToPortBit(pin) {
31 if (typeof pin === "string") {
32 const a = pin.match(/^A(\d)$/i);
33 if (a) {
34 const bit = parseInt(a[1], 10);
35 if (bit >= 0 && bit <= 5) return { port: "C", bit, label: `A${bit}` };
36 return null;
37 }
38 const d = pin.match(/^D?(\d+)$/i);
39 if (d) return arduinoPinToPortBit(parseInt(d[1], 10));
40 return null;
41 }
42 const n = pin;
43 if (n >= 0 && n <= 7) return { port: "D", bit: n, label: `D${n}` };
44 if (n >= 8 && n <= 13) return { port: "B", bit: n - 8, label: `D${n}` };
45 if (n >= 14 && n <= 19) return { port: "C", bit: n - 14, label: `A${n - 14}` };
46 return null;
47}
48
49export function labelToPortBit(label) {
50 return arduinoPinToPortBit(String(label || ""));
51}
52
53export function isPinOutput(reg, label) {
54 const pb = labelToPortBit(label);
55 if (!pb || !reg) return false;
56 return ((reg[`DDR${pb.port}`] || 0) >> pb.bit) & 1;
57}
58
59export function isPinInputPullup(reg, label) {
60 const pb = labelToPortBit(label);
61 if (!pb || !reg) return false;
62 if (isPinOutput(reg, label)) return false;
63 return ((reg[`PORT${pb.port}`] || 0) >> pb.bit) & 1;
64}
65
66export function getPinPortLevel(reg, label) {
67 const pb = labelToPortBit(label);
68 if (!pb || !reg) return 0;
69 return ((reg[`PORT${pb.port}`] || 0) >> pb.bit) & 1;
70}
71
72/** @param {'OUTPUT'|'INPUT'|'INPUT_PULLUP'} mode */
73export function applyPinModeToRegisters(reg, label, mode) {
74 const pb = labelToPortBit(label);
75 if (!pb || !reg) return;
76 const ddrKey = `DDR${pb.port}`;
77 const portKey = `PORT${pb.port}`;
78 const mask = 1 << pb.bit;
79 if (mode === "OUTPUT") {
80 reg[ddrKey] = (reg[ddrKey] | mask) & 0xff;
81 } else if (mode === "INPUT_PULLUP") {
82 reg[ddrKey] = reg[ddrKey] & ~mask & 0xff;
83 reg[portKey] = (reg[portKey] | mask) & 0xff;
84 } else {
85 reg[ddrKey] = reg[ddrKey] & ~mask & 0xff;
86 reg[portKey] = reg[portKey] & ~mask & 0xff;
87 }
88}
89
90export function applyDigitalWriteToRegisters(reg, label, high) {
91 const pb = labelToPortBit(label);
92 if (!pb || !reg) return;
93 applyPinModeToRegisters(reg, label, "OUTPUT");
94 const portKey = `PORT${pb.port}`;
95 const mask = 1 << pb.bit;
96 if (high) reg[portKey] = (reg[portKey] | mask) & 0xff;
97 else reg[portKey] = reg[portKey] & ~mask & 0xff;
98}
99
100export function registersToPinModes(reg) {
101 const modes = {};
102 for (const label of allArduinoGpioLabels()) {
103 if (isPinOutput(reg, label)) modes[label] = "OUTPUT";
104 else if (isPinInputPullup(reg, label)) modes[label] = "INPUT_PULLUP";
105 else modes[label] = "INPUT";
106 }
107 return modes;
108}
109
110export function registersToPinLevels(reg) {
111 const levels = {};
112 for (const label of allArduinoGpioLabels()) {
113 if (isPinOutput(reg, label)) levels[label] = getPinPortLevel(reg, label);
114 }
115 return levels;
116}
117
118export function formatRegByte(n) {
119 const v = (Number(n) || 0) & 0xff;
120 return `0x${v.toString(16).toUpperCase().padStart(2, "0")}`;
121}
122
123export function formatAvrRegistersSummary(reg) {
124 if (!reg) return "";
125 return `DDRB${formatRegByte(reg.DDRB)} PORTB${formatRegByte(reg.PORTB)} DDRC${formatRegByte(reg.DDRC)} PORTC${formatRegByte(reg.PORTC)} DDRD${formatRegByte(reg.DDRD)} PORTD${formatRegByte(reg.PORTD)}`;
126}
127
128function resolveAvrBitToken(token, port) {
129 const t = String(token || "").trim();
130 const num = t.match(/^(\d+)$/);
131 if (num) {
132 const b = parseInt(num[1], 10);
133 return b >= 0 && b <= 7 ? b : null;
134 }
135 const px = t.match(/^P([BCD])(\d)$/i);
136 if (px && px[1].toUpperCase() === port) return parseInt(px[2], 10);
137 const ddx = t.match(/^DD([BCD])(\d)$/i);
138 if (ddx && ddx[1].toUpperCase() === port) return parseInt(ddx[2], 10);
139 return null;
140}
141
142function evalAvrMaskExpr(expr, port) {
143 const s = String(expr || "").trim();
144 if (!s) return null;
145 if (/^0[xX][0-9a-fA-F]+$/.test(s)) return parseInt(s, 16) & 0xff;
146 if (/^0[bB][01]+$/.test(s)) return parseInt(s.slice(2), 2) & 0xff;
147 if (/^B[01]+$/i.test(s)) return parseInt(s.slice(1), 2) & 0xff;
148 if (/^\d+$/.test(s)) return parseInt(s, 10) & 0xff;
149
150 const invert = /^\~\s*(.+)$/.test(s) ? true : false;
151 const inner = invert ? s.replace(/^\~\s*/, "").trim() : s;
152
153 let mask = 0;
154 const shiftRe = /(?:\(\s*)?1\s*<<\s*([^)\s,|&]+)(?:\s*\))?/gi;
155 let sm;
156 while ((sm = shiftRe.exec(inner)) !== null) {
157 const bit = resolveAvrBitToken(sm[1], port);
158 if (bit == null) return null;
159 mask |= 1 << bit;
160 }
161 if (mask) return (invert ? ~mask : mask) & 0xff;
162
163 const bv = inner.match(/_BV\s*\(\s*P([BCD])(\d)\s*\)/i);
164 if (bv && bv[1].toUpperCase() === port) {
165 const v = (1 << parseInt(bv[2], 10)) & 0xff;
166 return invert ? (~v & 0xff) : v;
167 }
168
169 return null;
170}
171
172function avrRegPortFromName(regName) {
173 const m = String(regName || "").match(/^(?:DDR|PORT)([BCD])$/i);
174 return m?.[1]?.toUpperCase() || null;
175}
176
177function applyRegOp(reg, regName, op, value) {
178 const port = avrRegPortFromName(regName);
179 if (!port || !AVR_GPIO_PORTS.includes(port)) return;
180 const cur = reg[regName] & 0xff;
181 const v = value & 0xff;
182 if (op === "=") reg[regName] = v;
183 else if (op === "|=") reg[regName] = (cur | v) & 0xff;
184 else if (op === "&=") reg[regName] = (cur & v) & 0xff;
185 else if (op === "^=") reg[regName] = (cur ^ v) & 0xff;
186}
187
188/** Parse écritures directes DDRx / PORTx dans le sketch (AVR). */
189export function parseAvrRegisterWrites(sketch) {
190 const reg = createEmptyAvrRegisters();
191 const src = String(sketch || "");
192 const re = /\b(DDR[BCD]|PORT[BCD])\s*(\|=|\&=|\^=|=)\s*([^;]+)/gi;
193 let m;
194 while ((m = re.exec(src)) !== null) {
195 const regName = m[1].toUpperCase();
196 const port = avrRegPortFromName(regName);
197 if (!port) continue;
198 const mask = evalAvrMaskExpr(m[3], port);
199 if (mask == null) continue;
200 applyRegOp(reg, regName, m[2], mask);
201 }
202 return reg;
203}
204
205/**
206 * Fusionne pinModes / pinLevels / phases dans les registres AVR.
207 * @param {object} parsed — sortie parseArduinoSketch (sans avr)
208 */
209export function buildAvrRegistersFromParsed(parsed, sketch) {
210 const reg = parseAvrRegisterWrites(sketch);
211
212 for (const [label, mode] of Object.entries(parsed?.pinModes || {})) {
213 if (mode === "OUTPUT" || mode === "INPUT" || mode === "INPUT_PULLUP") {
214 applyPinModeToRegisters(reg, label, mode);
215 }
216 }
217
218 for (const [label, level] of Object.entries(parsed?.pinLevels || {})) {
219 applyDigitalWriteToRegisters(reg, label, !!level);
220 }
221
222 return reg;
223}
224
225/** Applique niveaux dynamiques (phase / pulse) sur une copie PORT sans toucher DDR. */
226export function applyDynamicLevelsToRegisters(reg, levels) {
227 const out = cloneAvrRegisters(reg);
228 for (const [label, level] of Object.entries(levels || {})) {
229 if (!isPinOutput(out, label) && level !== undefined) {
230 applyPinModeToRegisters(out, label, "OUTPUT");
231 }
232 if (isPinOutput(out, label)) {
233 applyDigitalWriteToRegisters(out, label, !!level);
234 }
235 }
236 return out;
237}

202/** Bargraph DC10H câblé directement sur des sorties GPIO Arduino (s1…s10, COM→GND). */
203export function getIdealBargraphFromArduino(barLabel, components, wires, tSec = 0, autoJunctions = []) {
204 if (!barLabel) return null;
205 const vCom = traceJonctionToIdealVolts(`${barLabel}_COM`, components, wires, tSec, autoJunctions);
206 const vc = vCom != null ? vCom : 0;
207 const segments = {};
208 let anyDrive = false;
209 for (let i = 1; i <= 10; i++) {
210 const name = `s${i}`;
211 const v = traceJonctionToIdealVolts(`${barLabel}_${name}`, components, wires, tSec, autoJunctions);
212 if (v == null) {
213 segments[name] = false;
214 continue;
215 }
216 anyDrive = true;
217 segments[name] = v - vc >= BARGRAPH_LIT_DELTA_V;
218 }
219 return anyDrive ? { segments } : null;
220}

181 case "<=": out.push(av <= bv ? 1 : 0); break;

185 case "!=": out.push(av !== bv ? 1 : 0); break;
186 case "&": out.push(av & bv); break;
187 case "^": out.push(av ^ bv); break;
188 case "|": out.push(av | bv); break;
