573 }
574
575 let m = text.match(/^([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s*(\+\+|--)$/) ||
576 text.match(/^(\+\+|--)\s*([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)$/);
577 if (m) {
578 const name = /[A-Za-z_]/.test(m[1][0]) ? m[1] : m[2];
579 const op = /[A-Za-z_]/.test(m[1][0]) ? m[2] : m[1];
580 state.vars[name] = (state.vars[name] || 0) + (op === "++" ? 1 : -1);
581 return 0;
582 }
583
584 m = text.match(/^(DDR[BCD]|PORT[BCD]|[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s*(\|=|&=|\^=|\+=|-=|\*=|\/=|%=|<<=|>>=|=)\s*([\s\S]+)$/);
585 if (!m) return 0;
586 const target = m[1];
587 const op = m[2];
588 const rhs = evalExprState(m[3], state);
589 const cur = /^(DDR|PORT)[BCD]$/.test(target)
590 ? state.regs[target] || 0
591 : state.vars[target] || 0;
592 let val;
593 switch (op) {
594 case "=": val = rhs; break;
595 case "|=": val = cur | rhs; break;
596 case "&=": val = cur & rhs; break;
597 case "^=": val = cur ^ rhs; break;
598 case "+=": val = cur + rhs; break;
599 case "-=": val = cur - rhs; break;
600 case "*=": val = cur * rhs; break;
601 case "/=": val = rhs === 0 ? cur : Math.trunc(cur / rhs); break;
602 case "%=": val = rhs === 0 ? cur : cur % rhs; break;
603 case "<<=": val = cur << rhs; break;
604 case ">>=": val = cur >> rhs; break;
605 default: val = rhs;
606 }
607 if (/^(DDR|PORT)[BCD]$/.test(target)) {
608 state.regs[target] = val & 0xff;
609 if (state.assignedRegs) state.assignedRegs.add(target);
610 } else {
611 const isFloat = state.floatVars?.has(target);
612 state.vars[target] = isFloat ? val : Math.trunc(val);
613 }
614 return 0;
615}
616
617function execStatements(stmts, state, onDelay) {
618 for (const st of stmts) {
619 if (st.type === "expr") execExprStatement(st.text, state, onDelay);
620 else if (st.type === "if") {
621 if (evalExprState(st.cond, state)) execStatements(st.body, state, onDelay);
622 else if (st.elseBody) execStatements(st.elseBody, state, onDelay);
623 } else if (st.type === "while") {
624 let guard = 0;
625 while (evalExprState(st.cond, state) && guard < MAX_WHILE_ITER) {
626 guard++;
627 execStatements(st.body, state, onDelay);
628 }
629 }
630 }
631}
632
633/**
634 * Exécution pas-à-pas du loop() sous forme de générateur : chaque delay(ms)
635 * rendu (yield) permet de suspendre l'exécution et de l'aligner sur le temps réel.
636 */
637function* runLoopGen(stmts, state) {
638 for (const st of stmts) {
639 if (st.type === "expr") {
640 const d = execExprStatement(st.text, state);
641 if (d > 0) yield d;
642 } else if (st.type === "if") {
643 if (evalExprState(st.cond, state)) yield* runLoopGen(st.body, state);
644 else if (st.elseBody) yield* runLoopGen(st.elseBody, state);
645 } else if (st.type === "while") {
646 let guard = 0;
647 while (evalExprState(st.cond, state) && guard < MAX_WHILE_ITER) {
648 guard++;
649 yield* runLoopGen(st.body, state);
650 }
651 }
652 }
653}
654
655const PORT_TO_LABELS = {
656 PORTD: ["D0", "D1", "D2", "D3", "D4", "D5", "D6", "D7"],
657 PORTB: ["D8", "D9", "D10", "D11", "D12", "D13"],
658 PORTC: ["A0", "A1", "A2", "A3", "A4", "A5"],
659};
660const DDR_FOR_PORT = { PORTD: "DDRD", PORTB: "DDRB", PORTC: "DDRC" };
661
662function resolveOutputLevels(state) {
663 const levels = {};
664 for (const [port, labels] of Object.entries(PORT_TO_LABELS)) {
665 const ddr = state.regs[DDR_FOR_PORT[port]] || 0;
666 const val = state.regs[port] || 0;
667 labels.forEach((label, bit) => {
668 if ((ddr >> bit) & 1) levels[label] = (val >> bit) & 1;
669 });
670 }
671 for (const [label, lv] of Object.entries(state.pins)) levels[label] = lv ? 1 : 0;
672 return levels;
673}
674
675/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
676 * Runtime temps réel : exécute setup() une fois puis loop() en boucle pendant
677 * la simulation (delay(), digitalWrite, registres PORT, digitalRead…).
678 * ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
679
680/** Le sketch définit-il une fonction loop() non vide ? */
681export function sketchHasLoop(sketch) {
682 const loop = extractFunctionBody(stripComments(sketch || ""), "loop");
683 return !!loop.trim();
684}
685
686/** Le loop() lit-il une entrée (digitalRead) ? */
687export function sketchUsesLiveInput(sketch) {
688 const loop = extractFunctionBody(stripComments(sketch || ""), "loop");
689 return /\bdigitalRead\s*\(/i.test(loop);
690}
691
692/** Le loop() utilise-t-il analogRead ? */
693export function sketchUsesAnalogInput(sketch) {
694 const loop = extractFunctionBody(stripComments(sketch || ""), "loop");
695 return /\banalogRead\s*\(/i.test(loop);
696}
697
698export function createArduinoRuntime(uno) {
699 const src = stripComments(uno?.sketch || "");
700 const setupBody = extractFunctionBody(src, "setup");
701 const loopBody = extractFunctionBody(src, "loop");
702 const init = collectInitialVars(src);
703 const state = {
704 vars: init.vars,
705 floatVars: init.floatVars,
706 regs: {},
707 pins: {},
708 inputs: {},
709 analogInputs: {},
710 simTimeMs: 0,
711 serial: createSerialState(),
712 };
713 execStatements(parseStatements(setupBody), state, (ms) => { state.simTimeMs += ms; });
714 return {
715 sketch: uno?.sketch || "",
716 state,
717 loopStmts: parseStatements(loopBody),
718 gen: null,
719 sleepMs: 0,
720 passDelays: 0,
721 idle: false,
722 lastInputs: null,
723 };
724}
725
726/**
727 * Avance le runtime de deltaMs (temps réel), en consommant les delay().
728 * @param {object} rt runtime créé par createArduinoRuntime
729 * @param {number} deltaMs durée écoulée depuis le dernier pas
730 * @param {Record<string, number>} inputs niveaux d'entrée live (ex. { D13: 0 })
731 * @param {Record<string, number>} [analogInputs] valeurs ADC 0–1023 (ex. { A0: 512 })
732 */
733export function stepArduinoRuntime(rt, deltaMs, inputs, analogInputs) {
734 if (!rt) return;
735 rt.state.inputs = inputs || {};
736 rt.state.analogInputs = analogInputs || {};
737 const inKey = JSON.stringify(rt.state.inputs);
738 if (rt.lastInputs !== inKey) rt.idle = false;
739 rt.lastInputs = inKey;
740 if (rt.idle) return;
741 let budget = Math.min(Math.max(0, deltaMs), 2000);
742 let guard = 0;
743 while (budget > 0 && guard < 200000) {
744 guard++;
745 if (rt.sleepMs > 0) {
746 const c = Math.min(budget, rt.sleepMs);
747 rt.sleepMs -= c;
748 budget -= c;
749 rt.state.simTimeMs += c;
750 if (rt.sleepMs > 0) break;
751 continue;
752 }
753 if (!rt.gen) { rt.gen = runLoopGen(rt.loopStmts, rt.state); rt.passDelays = 0; }
754 const r = rt.gen.next();
755 if (r.done) {
756 rt.gen = null;
757 if (!rt.loopStmts.length) {
758 rt.idle = true;
759 break;
760 }
761 if (rt.passDelays > 0) {
762 rt.passDelays = 0;
763 continue;
764 }
765 // loop() sans delay : une itération par frame (effets cumulatifs, digitalRead…)
766 break;
767 }
768 rt.sleepMs = Math.max(0, Number(r.value) || 0);
769 rt.passDelays++;
770 }
771}
772
773export function arduinoRuntimeLevels(rt) {
774 return rt ? resolveOutputLevels(rt.state) : {};
775}
776
777export function getRuntimeSerialTx(rt) {
778 return rt?.state?.serial?.tx ?? "";
779}
780
781export function injectRuntimeSerialRx(rt, text) {
782 if (!rt) return;
783 const ser = ensureSerial(rt.state);
784 for (const ch of String(text)) ser.rx.push(ch.charCodeAt(0) & 0xff);
785}
786
787export function getRuntimeSerialMeta(rt) {
788 const ser = rt?.state?.serial;
789 return { begun: !!ser?.begun, baud: ser?.baud ?? 0 };
790}
791
792function formatBindingValue(name, value, floatVars) {
793 const v = typeof value === "number" ? value : Number(value);
794 if (!Number.isFinite(v)) return "0";
795 if (floatVars?.has(name) || !Number.isInteger(v)) return v.toFixed(2);
796 return String(Math.trunc(v));
797}
798
799/**
800 * Évalue les variables locales du loop() (analogRead, calculs float…) pour lcd.print(var).
801 * @param {string} sketch
802 * @param {Record<string, number>} [analogInputs] ex. { A0: 512 }
803 * @returns {Record<string, string>}
804 */
805export function evaluateLoopVarBindings(sketch, analogInputs = {}) {
806 const src = stripComments(sketch || "");
807 const loopBody = extractFunctionBody(src, "loop");
808 if (!loopBody.trim()) return {};
809 const init = collectInitialVars(src);
810 const state = {
811 vars: { ...init.vars },
812 floatVars: new Set(init.floatVars),
813 regs: {},
814 pins: {},
815 inputs: {},
816 analogInputs: analogInputs || {},
817 simTimeMs: 0,
818 };
819 const bindings = {};
820 for (const st of parseStatements(loopBody)) {
821 if (st.type !== "expr") continue;
822 const text = st.text.trim();
823 const isLocalDecl = /^(?:const\s+)?(?:unsigned\s+)?(?:int|long|byte|short|float|double)\s+[A-Za-z_]\w*\s*=/i.test(text);
824 if (!isLocalDecl) continue;
825 execExprStatement(text, state, null);
826 const m = text.match(
827 /^(?:const\s+)?(?:unsigned\s+)?(?:int|long|byte|short|float|double)\s+([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s*=/i
828 );
829 if (m && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(state.vars, m[1])) {
830 bindings[m[1]] = formatBindingValue(m[1], state.vars[m[1]], state.floatVars);
831 }
832 }
833 return bindings;
834}
835
836/**
837 * Exécute setup() puis loop() une fois et renvoie l'état final des registres.
838 * Résout les variables et expressions (PORTD = x, PORTD = x << 1, etc.).
839 */
840function interpretRegisterState(src) {
841 const setupBody = extractFunctionBody(src, "setup");
842 const loopBody = extractFunctionBody(src, "loop");
843 if (!setupBody && !loopBody) return null;
844 if (!/\b(?:DDR|PORT)[BCD]\s*(?:\|=|&=|\^=|=)/.test(`${setupBody};${loopBody}`)) return null;
845 const init = collectInitialVars(src);
846 const state = { vars: init.vars, floatVars: init.floatVars, regs: {}, pins: {}, assignedRegs: new Set() };
847 execStatements(parseStatements(setupBody), state, () => {});
848 execStatements(parseStatements(loopBody), state, () => {});
849 return { regs: state.regs, assigned: state.assignedRegs };
850}
851
852/** Exécute le sketch (setup + loop) pour générer des phases temporelles. */
853function interpretRegisterPhases(src) {
854 const setupBody = extractFunctionBody(src, "setup");
855 const loopBody = extractFunctionBody(src, "loop");
856 if (!loopBody) return null;
857 if (!/\bdelay\s*\(/i.test(loopBody)) return null;
858 // Réservé aux écritures registre PORTx dans loop() (compteurs, séquences).
859 // Les clignotements digitalWrite restent gérés par la logique dédiée.
860 if (!/\bPORT[BCD]\s*(?:\|=|&=|\^=|\+=|-=|\*=|\/=|%=|<<=|>>=|=)/.test(loopBody)) return null;
861
862 const init = collectInitialVars(src);
863 const state = { vars: init.vars, floatVars: init.floatVars, regs: {}, pins: {} };
864 execStatements(parseStatements(setupBody), state, () => {});
865
866 const loopStmts = parseStatements(loopBody);
867 const phases = [];
868 const MAX_PHASES = 64;
869 const seen = new Set();
870
871 for (let iter = 0; iter < 256 && phases.length < MAX_PHASES; iter++) {
872 let emitted = false;
873 execStatements(loopStmts, state, (ms) => {
874 if (ms <= 0) return;
875 phases.push({ durationMs: ms, levels: resolveOutputLevels(state) });
876 emitted = true;
877 });
878 if (!emitted) break;
879 const key = JSON.stringify(state.vars) + "|" + JSON.stringify(state.regs) + "|" + JSON.stringify(state.pins);
880 if (seen.has(key) && phases.length >= 2) break;
881 seen.add(key);
882 }
883
884 return phases.length >= 2 ? phases : null;
885}
886
887/**
888 * Niveau logique d'une broche à l'instant tSec (phases / pulsations du sketch).
889 * N'utilise pas liveLevels — adapté à l'oscilloscope et aux courbes idéales.
890 */
891export function resolveArduinoPinLevelAt(uno, pinLabel, tSec = 0) {
892 if (!uno || !pinLabel) return 0;
893 const dynamic = computeDynamicPinLevels(uno, tSec);
894 if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(dynamic, pinLabel)) {
895 return dynamic[pinLabel] ? 1 : 0;
896 }
897 const lv = uno.pinLevels?.[pinLabel];
898 if (lv === 1 || lv === "1" || lv === true) return 1;
899 if (lv === 0 || lv === "0" || lv === false) return 0;
900 return 0;
901}
902
903function computeDynamicPinLevels(uno, tSec = 0) {
904 const levels = {};
905 const pinPhases = uno?.pinPhases;
906 if (Array.isArray(pinPhases) && pinPhases.length >= 2) {
907 const totalMs = pinPhases.reduce((s, p) => s + (p.durationMs || 0), 0);
908 if (totalMs > 0) {
909 let rem = (((tSec * 1000) % totalMs) + totalMs) % totalMs;
910 for (const ph of pinPhases) {
911 const d = ph.durationMs || 0;
912 if (rem < d) return { ...(ph.levels || {}) };
913 rem -= d;
914 }
915 return { ...(pinPhases[pinPhases.length - 1].levels || {}) };
916 }
917 }
918 const pinPulses = uno?.pinPulses || {};
919 for (const [pin, pulse] of Object.entries(pinPulses)) {
920 if (pulse?.highSec > 0 && pulse?.lowSec > 0) {
921 const period = pulse.highSec + pulse.lowSec;
922 const phase = ((tSec % period) + period) % period;
923 levels[pin] = phase < pulse.highSec ? 1 : 0;
924 }
925 }
926 return levels;
927}
928
929function parseLoopPhases(loopBody) {
930 const phases = [];
931 let current = {};
932 let hadWrite = false;
933 const re =
934 /digitalWrite\s*\(\s*([^,)]+)\s*,\s*(HIGH|LOW|1|0)\s*\)|delay\s*\(\s*(\d+)\s*\)/gi;
935 let m;
936 while ((m = re.exec(loopBody)) !== null) {
937 if (/digitalWrite/i.test(m[0])) {
938 const pin = resolvePinToken(m[1]);
939 const label = pinLabel(pin);
940 if (!label) continue;
941 current[label] = /HIGH|1/i.test(m[2]) ? 1 : 0;
942 hadWrite = true;
943 continue;
944 }
945 const delayMs = parseInt(m[3], 10);
946 if (hadWrite && delayMs > 0) {
947 phases.push({ durationMs: delayMs, levels: { ...current } });
948 }
949 hadWrite = false;
950 }
951 return phases;
952}
953
954/** Deux phases ou plus sur une seule broche → pulsation carrée (clignotement). */
955function singlePinPulseFromPhases(phases) {
956 const pins = new Set();
957 for (const ph of phases) {
958 for (const label of Object.keys(ph.levels || {})) pins.add(label);
959 }
960 if (pins.size !== 1) return null;
961 const label = [...pins][0];
962 let highMs = 0;
963 let lowMs = 0;
964 for (const ph of phases) {
965 if (ph.levels?.[label]) highMs += ph.durationMs || 0;
966 else lowMs += ph.durationMs || 0;
967 }
968 if (highMs <= 0 || lowMs <= 0) return null;
969 return { label, pulse: { highSec: highMs / 1000, lowSec: lowMs / 1000 } };
970}
971
972/**
973 * Niveaux GPIO D0–D13 à l'instant tSec (phases loop, pulsations ou statique).
974 * @returns {Record<string, number>}
975 */
976export function resolvePinLevelsAt(uno, tSec = 0) {
977 if (uno && uno.liveLevels) return { ...uno.liveLevels };
978 const base =
979 uno?.avrRegisters ||
980 buildAvrRegistersFromParsed(
981 {
982 pinModes: uno?.pinModes,
983 pinLevels: uno?.pinLevels,
984 pinPulses: uno?.pinPulses,
985 pinPhases: uno?.pinPhases,
986 },
987 uno?.sketch || ""
988 );
989 const dynamic = computeDynamicPinLevels(uno, tSec);
990 const hasDynamic = Object.keys(dynamic).length > 0;
991 if (!hasDynamic) return registersToPinLevels(base);
992 return registersToPinLevels(applyDynamicLevelsToRegisters(base, dynamic));
993}
994
995export function arduinoGpioIsTimeVarying(uno) {
996 if (!uno || uno.type !== "arduino_uno") return false;
997 if (Array.isArray(uno.pinPhases) && uno.pinPhases.length >= 2) return true;
998 return !!(uno.pinPulses && Object.keys(uno.pinPulses).length > 0);
999}
1000
1001/**
1002 * @returns {{ pinModes: Record<string, string>, pinLevels: Record<string, number>, pinPulses: Record<string, { highSec: number, lowSec: number }>, pinPhases: Array<{ durationMs: number, levels: Record<string, number> }> }}
1003 */
1004export function parseArduinoSketch(sketch) {
1005 const src = stripComments(sketch);
1006 const pinModes = {};
1007 const pinLevels = {};
1008 const pinPulses = {};
1009 let pinPhases = [];
1010
1011 for (const m of src.matchAll(/pinMode\s*\(\s*([^,)]+)\s*,\s*(OUTPUT|INPUT_PULLUP|INPUT)\s*\)/gi)) {
1012 const pin = resolvePinToken(m[1]);
1013 const label = pinLabel(pin);
1014 if (!label) continue;
1015 const mode = String(m[2]).toUpperCase();
1016 if (mode === "INPUT_PULLUP") pinModes[label] = "INPUT_PULLUP";
1017 else if (/INPUT/i.test(mode)) pinModes[label] = "INPUT";
1018 else pinModes[label] = "OUTPUT";
1019 }
1020
1021 const loopBody = extractLoopBody(src);
1022 const writes = [];
1023 const writeRe = /digitalWrite\s*\(\s*([^,)]+)\s*,\s*(HIGH|LOW|1|0)\s*\)/gi;
1024 for (const m of loopBody.matchAll(writeRe)) {
1025 const pin = resolvePinToken(m[1]);
1026 const label = pinLabel(pin);
1027 if (!label) continue;
1028 writes.push({ label, level: /HIGH|1/i.test(m[2]) });
1029 }
1030
1031 const loopPhases = parseLoopPhases(loopBody);
1032 let blinkApplied = false;
1033
1034 if (loopPhases.length >= 2) {
1035 const singlePulse = singlePinPulseFromPhases(loopPhases);
1036 if (singlePulse) {
1037 pinModes[singlePulse.label] = "OUTPUT";
1038 pinPulses[singlePulse.label] = singlePulse.pulse;
1039 delete pinLevels[singlePulse.label];
1040 blinkApplied = true;
1041 } else {
1042 pinPhases = loopPhases;
1043 for (const ph of pinPhases) {
1044 for (const label of Object.keys(ph.levels || {})) {
1045 pinModes[label] = "OUTPUT";
1046 delete pinLevels[label];
1047 delete pinPulses[label];
1048 }
1049 }
1050 }
1051 } else {
1052 const stepRe =
1053 /digitalWrite\s*\(\s*([^,)]+)\s*,\s*(HIGH|LOW|1|0)\s*\)\s*;\s*delay\s*\(\s*(\d+)\s*\)/gi;
1054 const steps = [];
1055 let match;
1056 while ((match = stepRe.exec(loopBody)) !== null) {
1057 const pin = resolvePinToken(match[1]);
1058 const label = pinLabel(pin);
1059 if (!label) continue;
1060 steps.push({
1061 label,
1062 level: /HIGH|1/i.test(match[2]),
1063 delayMs: parseInt(match[3], 10),
1064 });
1065 }
1066
1067 if (steps.length >= 2) {
1068 const labels = [...new Set(steps.map((s) => s.label))];
1069 if (labels.length === 1) {
1070 const label = labels[0];
1071 let highMs = 0;
1072 let lowMs = 0;
1073 for (const s of steps) {
1074 if (s.level) highMs += s.delayMs;
1075 else lowMs += s.delayMs;
1076 }
1077 if (highMs > 0 && lowMs > 0) {
1078 pinModes[label] = "OUTPUT";
1079 pinPulses[label] = { highSec: highMs / 1000, lowSec: lowMs / 1000 };
1080 delete pinLevels[label];
1081 blinkApplied = true;
1082 }
1083 }
1084 }
1085
1086 if (!blinkApplied && loopPhases.length === 1) {
1087 for (const [label, level] of Object.entries(loopPhases[0].levels || {})) {
1088 pinModes[label] = "OUTPUT";
1089 pinLevels[label] = level ? 1 : 0;
1090 delete pinPulses[label];
1091 }
1092 } else if (!blinkApplied && writes.length > 0) {
1093 const lastByPin = {};
1094 for (const w of writes) lastByPin[w.label] = w.level;
1095 for (const [label, level] of Object.entries(lastByPin)) {
1096 pinModes[label] = "OUTPUT";
1097 pinLevels[label] = level ? 1 : 0;
1098 delete pinPulses[label];
1099 }
1100 }
1101 }
1102
1103 if (pinPhases.length < 2) {
1104 const regPhases = interpretRegisterPhases(src);
1105 if (regPhases && regPhases.length >= 2) {
1106 pinPhases = regPhases;
1107 for (const ph of pinPhases) {
1108 for (const label of Object.keys(ph.levels || {})) {
1109 pinModes[label] = "OUTPUT";
1110 delete pinLevels[label];
1111 delete pinPulses[label];
1112 }
1113 }
1114 }
1115 }
1116
1117 for (const label of Object.keys(pinModes)) {
1118 if (pinModes[label] !== "OUTPUT") {
1119 delete pinLevels[label];
1120 delete pinPulses[label];
1121 continue;
1122 }
1123 if (pinLevels[label] === undefined && !pinPulses[label] && pinPhases.length < 2) {
1124 pinLevels[label] = 0;
1125 }
1126 }
1127
1128 if (/\bSerial\.begin\s*\(/i.test(src)) {
1129 pinModes.D1 = "OUTPUT";
1130 pinLevels.D1 = 1;
1131 if (!pinModes.D0) pinModes.D0 = "INPUT_PULLUP";
1132 }
1133
1134 const avrRegisters = buildAvrRegistersFromParsed(
1135 { pinModes, pinLevels, pinPulses, pinPhases },
1136 sketch
1137 );
1138
1139 // L'interpréteur résout les variables/expressions (PORTD = x, PORTD = x << 1…)
1140 // que l'analyse statique ne peut pas évaluer. On écrase les registres touchés.
1141 // Ne pas écraser les registres si des phases temporelles existent (sinon bargraph figé).
1142 const execState = interpretRegisterState(src);
1143 if (execState && pinPhases.length < 2) {
1144 for (const reg of execState.assigned) {
1145 avrRegisters[reg] = (execState.regs[reg] || 0) & 0xff;
1146 }
1147 }
1148
1149 const syncedModes = registersToPinModes(avrRegisters);
1150 const syncedLevels = registersToPinLevels(avrRegisters);
1151 for (const label of Object.keys(syncedModes)) {
1152 if (syncedModes[label] !== "OUTPUT") {
1153 delete syncedLevels[label];
1154 continue;
1155 }
1156 if (pinPulses[label] || (pinPhases.length >= 2 && pinPhases.some((ph) => label in (ph.levels || {})))) {
1157 delete syncedLevels[label];
1158 }
1159 }
1160
1161 return {
1162 pinModes: syncedModes,
1163 pinLevels: syncedLevels,
1164 pinPulses,
1165 pinPhases,
1166 avrRegisters,
1167 usesLiveInput: sketchUsesLiveInput(sketch),
1168 };

1/**

11export function sketchUsesSerial(sketch) {
12 return /\bSerial\.begin\s*\(/i.test(String(sketch || ""));
13}
14
15/** Bits 8N1 LSB-first : start 0, 8 data, stop 1. */
16export function uartByteBits(byte) {
17 const code = byte & 0xff;
18 const bits = [0];
19 for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) bits.push((code >> i) & 1);
20 bits.push(1);
21 return bits;
22}
23
24/**
25 * Niveau TX (0/1) à l'instant tMs dans une trame.
26 * @param {Array<{ startMs: number, data: string }>} schedule
27 */
28export function uartTxBitAt(schedule, baud, tMs) {
29 if (!schedule?.length || !baud || baud <= 0) return 1;
30 const bitMs = 1000 / baud;
31 for (const ev of schedule) {
32 let cursor = ev.startMs;
33 const data = String(ev.data || "");
34 for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {
35 for (const bit of uartByteBits(data.charCodeAt(i))) {
36 if (tMs >= cursor && tMs < cursor + bitMs) return bit;
37 cursor += bitMs;
38 }
39 }
40 }
41 return 1;
42}
43
44/** Niveau TX avec période de boucle (affichage stable sur l'oscillo). */
45export function uartTxBitAtLoop(schedule, baud, tMs, loopPeriodMs) {
46 if (!loopPeriodMs || loopPeriodMs <= 0) return uartTxBitAt(schedule, baud, tMs);
47 const tMod = ((tMs % loopPeriodMs) + loopPeriodMs) % loopPeriodMs;
48 const bitMs = 1000 / baud;
49 for (const ev of schedule) {
50 const start = ((ev.startMs % loopPeriodMs) + loopPeriodMs) % loopPeriodMs;
51 let cursor = start;
52 const data = String(ev.data || "");
53 for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {
54 for (const bit of uartByteBits(data.charCodeAt(i))) {
55 let end = cursor + bitMs;
56 if (end <= loopPeriodMs) {
57 if (tMod >= cursor && tMod < end) return bit;
58 } else if (tMod >= cursor || tMod < end - loopPeriodMs) {
59 return bit;
60 }
61 cursor = end;
62 if (cursor >= loopPeriodMs) cursor -= loopPeriodMs;
63 }
64 }
65 }
66 return 1;
67}
68
69/** Somme des delay() dans void loop() — sans exécuter le sketch. */
70export function uartSketchLoopPeriodMs(sketch) {
71 const loopBody = String(sketch || "").match(/void\s+loop\s*\(\s*\)\s*\{([\s\S]*?)\}/i)?.[1] || "";
72 let delaySum = 0;
73 for (const m of loopBody.matchAll(/delay\s*\(\s*(\d+)\s*\)/gi)) {
74 delaySum += parseInt(m[1], 10);
75 }
76 return delaySum;
77}
78
79function parseSerialBaud(sketch) {

81 return m ? parseInt(m[1], 10) : 0;
82}
83
84/** Période de boucle UART pour réglage auto scope (s), sans rejouer le runtime. */
85export function arduinoUartScopePeriodSec(components) {
86 let min = Infinity;
87 for (const c of components) {
88 if (c.type !== "arduino_uno") continue;
89 if (!sketchUsesSerial(c.sketch)) continue;
90 const loopMs = uartSketchLoopPeriodMs(c.sketch);
91 if (loopMs > 0) {
92 min = Math.min(min, loopMs / 1000);
93 continue;
94 }
95 const baud = parseSerialBaud(c.sketch) || 9600;
96 min = Math.min(min, uartCharDurationSec(baud) * 2);
97 }
98 return Number.isFinite(min) ? min : 0;
99}
100
101function inferLoopPeriodMs(sketch, schedule) {
102 const delaySum = uartSketchLoopPeriodMs(sketch);
103 if (delaySum > 0) return delaySum;
104
105 const loopEvents = schedule.filter((ev) => ev.loopPhase);
106 if (loopEvents.length >= 2) {
107 const d = loopEvents[1].startMs - loopEvents[0].startMs;
108 if (d > 0) return d;
109 }
110 if (schedule.length >= 2) {
111 const d = schedule[schedule.length - 1].startMs - schedule[0].startMs;
112 if (d > 0) return d;
113 }
114 return 0;
115}
116
117/**
118 * Rejoue le sketch pour construire le planning des émissions UART.
119 * @returns {{ schedule: Array<{startMs:number,data:string}>, baud: number, loopPeriodMs: number }}
120 */
121export function buildUartScopeModel(uno, inputs = {}, replayMs = 3500) {
122 if (!uno || !sketchUsesSerial(uno.sketch)) {
123 return { schedule: [], baud: 9600, loopPeriodMs: 0 };
124 }
125 const rt = createArduinoRuntime(uno);
126 const ser = rt.state.serial;
127 const setupEndMs = rt.state.simTimeMs;
128 let guard = 0;
129 while (rt.state.simTimeMs < replayMs && guard < 50000) {
130 stepArduinoRuntime(rt, 2, inputs);
131 guard++;
132 }
133 const schedule = (ser?.schedule || []).map((ev) => ({
134 ...ev,
135 loopPhase: ev.startMs >= setupEndMs - 0.5,
136 }));
137 const baud = ser?.baud > 0 ? ser.baud : 9600;
138 const loopPeriodMs = sketchHasLoop(uno.sketch)
139 ? inferLoopPeriodMs(uno.sketch, schedule)
140 : 0;
141 return { schedule, baud, loopPeriodMs };
142}
143
144export function uartScopeBitAt(model, tMs) {
145 if (!model?.schedule?.length) return 1;
146 if (model.loopPeriodMs > 0) {
147 return uartTxBitAtLoop(model.schedule, model.baud, tMs, model.loopPeriodMs);
148 }
149 return uartTxBitAt(model.schedule, model.baud, tMs);
150}
151
152/** Durée d'une trame 8N1 (s) pour réglage de la base de temps. */
153export function uartCharDurationSec(baud) {
154 if (!baud || baud <= 0) return 0;
155 return 10 / baud;
156}

1/**
2 * Arduino UNO R3 — modèle SPICE simplifié pour co-simulation avec le circuit.
3 * Alimentation : 5 V / 3,3 V / masse sur les broches correspondantes.

9function formatSpiceTime(seconds) {
10 const s = Math.abs(Number(seconds));
11 if (!Number.isFinite(s)) return "1n";
12 if (s === 0) return "0";
13 if (s >= 1) return String(s);
14 if (s >= 1e-3) return `${(s * 1e3).toPrecision(6)}m`;
15 if (s >= 1e-6) return `${(s * 1e6).toPrecision(6)}u`;
16 if (s >= 1e-9) return `${(s * 1e9).toPrecision(6)}n`;
17 return `${s.toExponential(3)}`;
18}
19
20function pinVoltageFromPhases(pinPhases, pinName) {
21 return pinPhases.map((ph) => (ph.levels?.[pinName] ? 5 : 0));
22}
23
24/** Carré périodique dérivé des phases (HIGH/LOW cumulés sur une période). */
25function pinPhaseToPulse(pinPhases, pinName) {
26 const levels = pinVoltageFromPhases(pinPhases, pinName);
27 if (levels.length < 2 || levels.every((v) => v === levels[0])) return null;
28 let highMs = 0;
29 let lowMs = 0;
30 for (let i = 0; i < pinPhases.length; i++) {
31 const d = pinPhases[i].durationMs || 0;
32 if (levels[i]) highMs += d;
33 else lowMs += d;
34 }
35 if (highMs <= 0 || lowMs <= 0) return null;
36 const highSec = highMs / 1000;
37 const lowSec = lowMs / 1000;
38 const period = highSec + lowSec;
39 const delaySec = levels[0] ? 0 : lowSec;
40 return { highSec, lowSec, period, delaySec };
41}
42
43function appendPinPhasePulse(c, pinName, nPin, pinPhases, lines, spiceBranchName) {
44 const pulse = pinPhaseToPulse(pinPhases, pinName);
45 if (!pulse) return false;
46 lines.push(
47 `${spiceBranchName("V", `${c.id}_${pinName}`)} ${nPin} 0 PULSE(0 5 ${formatSpiceTime(pulse.delaySec)} 1n 1n ${formatSpiceTime(pulse.highSec)} ${formatSpiceTime(pulse.period)})`
48 );
49 return true;
50}
51
52/** Séquence PWL pour motifs non périodiques (compteurs PORTD, bargraph…). */
53function appendPinPhasePwl(c, pinName, nPin, pinPhases, lines, spiceBranchName) {
54 const levels = pinVoltageFromPhases(pinPhases, pinName);
55 if (!levels.length) return false;
56 if (levels.every((v) => v === levels[0])) {
57 lines.push(`${spiceBranchName("V", `${c.id}_${pinName}`)} ${nPin} 0 DC ${levels[0]}`);
58 return true;
59 }
60 if (appendPinPhasePulse(c, pinName, nPin, pinPhases, lines, spiceBranchName)) return true;
61 let t = 0;
62 const parts = [];
63 for (let i = 0; i < pinPhases.length; i++) {
64 parts.push(formatSpiceTime(t), String(levels[i]));
65 t += (pinPhases[i].durationMs || 0) / 1000;
66 }
67 if (t <= 0) return false;
68 parts.push(formatSpiceTime(t), String(levels[levels.length - 1]));
69 lines.push(
70 `${spiceBranchName("V", `${c.id}_${pinName}`)} ${nPin} 0 PWL(${parts.join(" ")})`
71 );
72 return true;
73}

153/**
154 * @param {object} c composant moteur
155 * @param {(key: string) => string} nodeFor
156 * @param {string[]} lines
157 * @param {(prefix: string, id: string) => string} spiceBranchName
158 */
159export function appendArduinoUnoNetlist(c, nodeFor, lines, spiceBranchName, opts = {}) {
160 const id = c.id;
161 const n5 = nodeFor(`${id}#${UNO_PIN["5V"]}`);
162 const n33 = nodeFor(`${id}#${UNO_PIN["3V3"]}`);
163 const ng1 = nodeFor(`${id}#${UNO_PIN.GND}`);
164 const ng2 = nodeFor(`${id}#${UNO_PIN.GND2}`);
165 const nioref = nodeFor(`${id}#${UNO_PIN.IOREF}`);
166 const nreset = nodeFor(`${id}#${UNO_PIN.RESET}`);
167
168 lines.push(`* ${id} Arduino UNO (rails + GPIO passifs)`);
169 lines.push(`${spiceBranchName("R", `${id}_g1`)} ${ng1} 0 1m`);
170 lines.push(`${spiceBranchName("R", `${id}_g2`)} ${ng2} 0 1m`);
171 lines.push(`${spiceBranchName("V", `${id}_5v`)} ${n5} 0 DC 5`);
172 lines.push(`${spiceBranchName("V", `${id}_3v3`)} ${n33} 0 DC 3.3`);
173 lines.push(`${spiceBranchName("R", `${id}_ioref`)} ${nioref} ${n5} 100`);
174 lines.push(`${spiceBranchName("R", `${id}_rstpu`)} ${nreset} ${n5} 10000`);
175
176 const pinModes = c.pinModes && typeof c.pinModes === "object" ? c.pinModes : {};
177 const pinLevels = c.pinLevels && typeof c.pinLevels === "object" ? c.pinLevels : {};
178 const pinPulses = c.pinPulses && typeof c.pinPulses === "object" ? c.pinPulses : {};
179 const pinPhases = Array.isArray(c.pinPhases) ? c.pinPhases : [];
180 const hasMultiPhase = pinPhases.length >= 2;
181
182 for (const pinIdx of arduinoUnoGpioPinIndices()) {
183 const pinName = arduinoUnoGpioPinName(pinIdx);
184 if (c.i2cBus?.active && (pinName === "A4" || pinName === "A5")) continue;
185 const nPin = nodeFor(`${id}#${pinIdx}`);
186 if (pinModes[pinName] === "OUTPUT") {
187 const pulse = pinPulses[pinName];
188 if (pulse && pulse.highSec > 0 && pulse.lowSec > 0) {
189 const period = pulse.highSec + pulse.lowSec;
190 const ton = pulse.highSec;
191 lines.push(
192 `${spiceBranchName("V", `${id}_${pinName}`)} ${nPin} 0 PULSE(0 5 0 1n 1n ${formatSpiceTime(ton)} ${formatSpiceTime(period)})`
193 );
194 } else if (hasMultiPhase) {
195 const levels = pinVoltageFromPhases(pinPhases, pinName);
196 const constant = levels.length > 0 && levels.every((v) => v === levels[0]);
197 if (constant) {
198 lines.push(`${spiceBranchName("V", `${id}_${pinName}`)} ${nPin} 0 DC ${levels[0]}`);
199 } else if (!appendPinPhasePwl(c, pinName, nPin, pinPhases, lines, spiceBranchName)) {
200 const high = pinLevels[pinName] === 1 || pinLevels[pinName] === "1" || pinLevels[pinName] === true;
201 lines.push(`${spiceBranchName("V", `${id}_${pinName}`)} ${nPin} 0 DC ${high ? 5 : 0}`);
202 }
203 } else {
204 const high = pinLevels[pinName] === 1 || pinLevels[pinName] === "1" || pinLevels[pinName] === true;
205 const v = high ? 5 : 0;
206 lines.push(`${spiceBranchName("V", `${id}_${pinName}`)} ${nPin} 0 DC ${v}`);
207 }
208 } else if (pinModes[pinName] === "INPUT_PULLUP") {
209 lines.push(`${spiceBranchName("R", `${id}_${pinName}_pu`)} ${n5} ${nPin} 30000`);
210 } else {
211 lines.push(`${spiceBranchName("R", `${id}_${pinName}_z`)} ${nPin} 0 10Meg`);
212 }
213 }
214
215 if (c.i2cBus?.active) {
216 appendI2cBusNetlist(c, nodeFor, lines, spiceBranchName, opts.i2cRepeatSec ?? 0.02);
217 }
218}

1/** BCD 0–9 → segments 7 segments (cathode commune, 1 = segment allumé). */
2
3const SEG7_NAMES = ["a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f", "g"];
4
5const BCD_SEGMENTS = [
6 [1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0],
7 [0, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0],
8 [1, 1, 0, 1, 1, 0, 1],
9 [1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0, 1],
10 [0, 1, 1, 0, 0, 1, 1],
11 [1, 0, 1, 1, 0, 1, 1],
12 [1, 0, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1],
13 [1, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0],
14 [1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1],
15 [1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 1, 1],
16];
17
18export function bcdDigitToSeg7Segments(digit) {
19 const d = Math.min(9, Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(digit) || 0)));
20 const row = BCD_SEGMENTS[d];
21 const segments = {};
22 SEG7_NAMES.forEach((name, i) => {
23 segments[name] = !!row[i];
24 });
25 return segments;
26}
27
28/** @param {number[]} qVoltages [Q0,Q1,Q2,Q3] */
29export function bcdFromQVoltages(qVoltages, vth = 2.5) {
30 let n = 0;
31 for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
32 const v = qVoltages[i];
33 if (Number.isFinite(v) && v > vth) n |= 1 << i;
34 }
35 return n;
36}
37
38/** Retrouve le chiffre 0–9 à partir des segments allumés (afficheur). */
39export function seg7PatternToDigit(segments) {
40 if (!segments || typeof segments !== "object") return null;
41 for (let d = 0; d <= 9; d++) {
42 const ref = bcdDigitToSeg7Segments(d);
43 if (SEG7_NAMES.every((n) => !!segments[n] === ref[n])) return d;
44 }
45 return null;
46}
47
48export { SEG7_NAMES };

77jmap["__t#120#140"] = { x: 120, y: 140 };

92 wire("__t#300#200", "D_3_in", jmap),
93 wire("D_3_out", "__t#120#140", jmap),
94 wire("__t#300#200", "D_4_in", jmap),
95 wire("D_4_out", "__t#120#180", jmap),

97 wire("__t#300#80", "R_1_in", jmap),
98 wire("R_1_out", "__t#300#200", jmap),
99 wire("__t#300#80", "C_1_in", jmap, [{ x: 340, y: 80 }]),
100 wire("C_1_out", "__t#300#200", jmap, [{ x: 340, y: 200 }]),
101 // Voltmètre sur la charge (V+ / V-)
102 wire("__t#300#80", "V_1_in", jmap, [{ x: 380, y: 80 }]),
103 wire("V_1_out", "__t#300#200", jmap, [{ x: 380, y: 200 }]),
104 // Oscilloscope : GND = référence AC, CH1 = V+, CH2 = V-
105 wire("Osci_1_GND", "__t#120#180", jmap, [{ x: 520, y: 180 }]),
106 wire("__t#300#80", "Osci_1_CH1", jmap, [{ x: 460, y: 80 }, { x: 460, y: 120 }]),
107 wire("__t#300#200", "Osci_1_CH2", jmap, [{ x: 460, y: 200 }, { x: 460, y: 160 }]),
108];

110const counters = {
111 battery: 0, resistor: 1, capacitor: 1, inductor: 0, diode: 4, npn: 0, opamp: 0,
112 not: 0, and: 0, nand: 0, or: 0, nor: 0, xor: 0, xnor: 0, d_flipflop: 0, jk_flipflop: 0,
113 cd4511: 0, ic_74hc90: 0, led: 0, seg7: 0, voltmeter: 1, ammeter: 0, ohmmeter: 0,
114 oscilloscope: 1, bode_analyzer: 0, junction: 0, gnd: 1, vcc: 0, logic_terminal: 0,
115 gimp: 0, gsin: 1, gsqr: 0,
116};

118const json = { components, wires, autoJunctions, counters };

120// Validation netlist (format moteur)
121const simComponents = components.map((c) => ({
122 id: c.label,
123 type: c.type === "gsin" ? "vsin" : c.type === "gnd" ? "ground" : c.type,
124 x: c.x,
125 y: c.y,
126 rotation: c.rotation || 0,
127 value:
128 c.type === "gsin"
129 ? `${c.peakAmplitude}V ${c.frequency}Hz ${c.offset}V`
130 : c.value,
131 ...(c.type === "oscilloscope"
132 ? {
133 timeDivSec: c.timeDivSec,
134 ch1VoltsPerDiv: c.ch1VoltsPerDiv,
135 ch2VoltsPerDiv: c.ch2VoltsPerDiv,
136 }
137 : {}),
138}));

140const jonctionToKey = (jid) => {
141 if (jid.startsWith("__t#")) return jid;
142 const m = jid.match(/^(.+)_(in|out|CH1|CH2|GND)$/);
143 if (!m) return null;
144 const [, label, pin] = m;
145 const comp = components.find((c) => c.label === label);
146 if (!comp) return null;
147 if (pin === "in") return `${label}#0`;
148 if (pin === "out") return `${label}#1`;
149 if (pin === "CH1") return `${label}#0`;
150 if (pin === "CH2") return `${label}#1`;
151 if (pin === "GND") return `${label}#2`;
152 return null;
153};

155const simWires = wires
156 .map((w) => ({
157 solid: true,
158 fromKey: jonctionToKey(w.fromJonctionId),
159 toKey: jonctionToKey(w.toJonctionId),
160 points: w.points,
161 }))
162 .filter((w) => w.fromKey && w.toKey);
163
164const built = buildNetlistFromGraphicalState({ components: simComponents, wires: simWires });
165if (!built.ok) {
166 console.error("Netlist FAILED:", built.errors);
167 process.exit(1);
168}
169if (!built.analysisTran) {
170 console.error("Expected .tran analysis");
171 process.exit(1);
172}
173
174const outPath = join(import.meta.dirname, "..", "circuits", "pont-diode-double-alternance.json");
175writeFileSync(outPath, JSON.stringify(json, null, 4), "utf8");
176console.log("Written:", outPath);

16 if (comp.type === "vcc" && net.has(`${comp.label}_out`)) ok = true;
17 if (comp.type === "battery" && net.has(`${comp.label}_out`)) ok = true;
18 if (comp.type === "arduino_uno" && (net.has(`${comp.label}_5V`) || net.has(`${comp.label}_3V3`))) {
19 ok = true;
20 }
21 } else {
22 if (comp.type === "gnd" && net.has(`${comp.label}_out`)) ok = true;
23 if (comp.type === "battery" && net.has(`${comp.label}_in`)) ok = true;
24 if (comp.type === "arduino_uno" && (net.has(`${comp.label}_GND`) || net.has(`${comp.label}_GND2`))) {
25 ok = true;
26 }
27 }
28 }
29 if (!ok) return false;
30 }
31 return true;
32}

34function dataPinOnUno(dhtLabel, unoLabel, wires, autoJunctions) {

46export function findUnoForGroveDht22(dhtLabel, components, wires, autoJunctions = []) {

49 return { uno: null, wired: false, dataPin: null };
50 }

52 const candidates = components.filter((c) => c.type === "arduino_uno");
53 candidates.sort((a, b) => (b.lastCompileOk ? 1 : 0) - (a.lastCompileOk ? 1 : 0));

55 for (const uno of candidates) {
56 const dataPin = dataPinOnUno(dhtLabel, uno.label, wires, autoJunctions);

69 for (const comp of components) {

81export function resolveDhtPrintArg(arg, sketch, unoLabel, components, wires, autoJunctions = []) {
82 const t = String(arg || "").trim();
83 if (!t || !sketch || !unoLabel) return null;
84 const parsed = parseDht22FromSketch(sketch);
85 if (!parsed?.pinLabel) return null;
86 const { varName, pinLabel } = parsed;
87 const tempRe = new RegExp(`\\b${varName}\\.readTemperature\\s*\\(\\s*\\)`, "i");
88 const humRe = new RegExp(`\\b${varName}\\.readHumidity\\s*\\(\\s*\\)`, "i");
89 if (!tempRe.test(t) && !humRe.test(t)) return null;
90
91 const dht = findGroveDht22ForUnoDataPin(unoLabel, pinLabel, components, wires, autoJunctions);
92 if (!dht) return null;
93
94 const temperature = Number.isFinite(dht.temperature) ? dht.temperature : 24;
95 const humidity = Number.isFinite(dht.humidity) ? dht.humidity : 55;
96 if (tempRe.test(t)) return String(Math.round(temperature * 10) / 10);
97 if (humRe.test(t)) return String(Math.round(humidity));
98 return null;

105 const dht = findGroveDht22ForUnoDataPin(unoLabel, parsed.pinLabel, components, wires, autoJunctions);
106 if (!dht) return {};
107 const temperature = Number.isFinite(dht.temperature) ? dht.temperature : 24;
108 const humidity = Number.isFinite(dht.humidity) ? dht.humidity : 55;
109 return buildDhtVarBindingsFromBody(body, parsed.varName, temperature, humidity);
110}

112/**

114 */
115export function getIdealDht22Reading(dhtLabel, components, wires, autoJunctions = [], _elapsedSec = 0) {
116 const dht = components.find((c) => c.label === dhtLabel && c.type === "grove_dht22");
117 const temperature = Number.isFinite(dht?.temperature) ? dht.temperature : 24;
118 const humidity = Number.isFinite(dht?.humidity) ? dht.humidity : 55;
119
120 const { uno, wired, dataPin } = findUnoForGroveDht22(dhtLabel, components, wires, autoJunctions);
121 if (!wired || !uno) {

123 }

127 if (!parsed) {

129 }
130
131 return {
132 wired: true,
133 active: true,
134 temperature,
135 humidity,
136 dataPin,
137 sensorType: parsed.sensorType,
138 };
139}

1/**
2 * Interprétation minimale DHT.h (DHT22 / Grove T° humidité).
3 */
4
5function stripComments(src) {
6 return String(src || "")
7 .replace(/\/\/[^\n]*/g, "")
8 .replace(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g, "");
9}
10
11const PIN_MAP = {
12 0: "D0", 1: "D1", 2: "D2", 3: "D3", 4: "D4", 5: "D5", 6: "D6", 7: "D7",
13 8: "D8", 9: "D9", 10: "D10", 11: "D11", 12: "D12", 13: "D13",
14};
15
16function resolvePinToken(tok) {
17 const t = String(tok || "").trim();
18 if (/^D\d+$/i.test(t)) return t.toUpperCase();
19 const n = parseInt(t, 10);
20 if (Number.isFinite(n) && PIN_MAP[n]) return PIN_MAP[n];
21 if (/^A(\d+)$/i.test(t)) return t.toUpperCase();
22 return null;
23}
24
25function resolveSketchToken(src, tok) {
26 let t = String(tok || "").trim();
27 for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
28 if (!/^[A-Za-z_]\w*$/.test(t)) break;
29 const def = src.match(new RegExp(`#define\\s+${t}\\s+(\\S+)`));
30 if (!def) break;
31 t = def[1].trim();
32 }
33 return t;
34}
35
36export function sketchUsesDht(sketch) {
37 const src = stripComments(sketch);
38 return /#include\s*[<"]DHT\.h[>"]/i.test(src) || /\bDHT\s+\w+\s*\(/i.test(src);
39}
40
41/** Sketch avec lcd.print(dht.readTemperature|readHumidity()). */
42export function sketchLcdUsesDhtReads(sketch) {
43 if (!sketchUsesDht(sketch)) return false;
44 const src = stripComments(sketch);
45 return /\.read(Temperature|Humidity)\s*\(\s*\)/i.test(src);
46}
47
48/**
49 * @param {string} sketch
50 * @returns {{ varName: string, pinLabel: string | null, sensorType: string, baseTemp: number, baseHum: number } | null}
51 */
52export function parseDht22FromSketch(sketch) {
53 const src = stripComments(sketch);
54 if (!sketchUsesDht(src)) return null;
55
56 const ctor = src.match(/\bDHT\s+(\w+)\s*\(\s*([^,)]+)\s*,\s*([^)]+)\s*\)/i);
57 const varName = ctor?.[1] ?? "dht";
58 const pinRaw = ctor ? resolveSketchToken(src, ctor[2]) : null;
59 const pinLabel = pinRaw ? resolvePinToken(pinRaw) : null;
60 const typeRaw = resolveSketchToken(src, String(ctor?.[3] ?? "DHT22").trim());
61 const sensorType = /22/.test(typeRaw) ? "DHT22" : "DHT11";
62
63 let baseTemp = 24.0;
64 let baseHum = 55.0;
65 const tempConst = src.match(new RegExp(`\\b${varName}\\.readTemperature\\s*\\(\\s*\\)[^;]*;`, "i"));
66 const humConst = src.match(new RegExp(`\\b${varName}\\.readHumidity\\s*\\(\\s*\\)[^;]*;`, "i"));
67 const tempAssign = src.match(/(?:float|double)\s+\w+\s*=\s*(-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*;/);
68 const humAssign = src.match(/(?:float|double)\s+\w+\s*=\s*(-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*;[\s\S]{0,80}readHumidity/i);
69 if (tempAssign) baseTemp = parseFloat(tempAssign[1]);
70 if (humAssign) baseHum = parseFloat(humAssign[1]);
71 if (tempConst && /=\s*(-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)/.test(tempConst[0])) {
72 const m = tempConst[0].match(/=\s*(-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)/);
73 if (m) baseTemp = parseFloat(m[1]);
74 }
75 if (humConst && /=\s*(-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)/.test(humConst[0])) {
76 const m = humConst[0].match(/=\s*(-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)/);
77 if (m) baseHum = parseFloat(m[1]);
78 }
79
80 return { varName, pinLabel, sensorType, baseTemp, baseHum };
81}
82
83/** Variables locales assignées depuis dht.readTemperature() / readHumidity(). */
84export function buildDhtVarBindingsFromBody(body, dhtVarName, temperature, humidity) {
85 const bindings = {};
86 const tempStr = String(Math.round(temperature * 10) / 10);
87 const humStr = String(Math.round(humidity));
88 const tempRe = new RegExp(
89 `(?:float|double|int|unsigned\\s+int)?\\s*(\\w+)\\s*=\\s*${dhtVarName}\\.readTemperature\\s*\\(\\s*\\)\\s*;`,
90 "gi"
91 );
92 const humRe = new RegExp(
93 `(?:float|double|int|unsigned\\s+int)?\\s*(\\w+)\\s*=\\s*${dhtVarName}\\.readHumidity\\s*\\(\\s*\\)\\s*;`,
94 "gi"
95 );
96 let m;
97 while ((m = tempRe.exec(body)) !== null) bindings[m[1]] = tempStr;
98 while ((m = humRe.exec(body)) !== null) bindings[m[1]] = humStr;
99 return bindings;
100}
101
102export function dht22ReadingAt(parsed, elapsedSec = 0) {
103 if (!parsed) return null;
104 const t = Math.max(0, elapsedSec);
105 return {
106 temperature: parsed.baseTemp + 2.2 * Math.sin(t * 0.07),
107 humidity: Math.max(0, Math.min(100, parsed.baseHum + 9 * Math.sin(t * 0.045 + 0.8))),
108 sensorType: parsed.sensorType,
109 };
110}

164/**

167 * @returns {{ lines: string[], backlight: boolean, rgb: object | null, wired: boolean, address: number, blank: boolean }}
168 */
169export function getIdealGroveLcdDisplay(lcdLabel, components, wires, autoJunctions = [], elapsedSec = 0, opts = {}) {

173 }

180 rgb: null,
181 wired: false,
182 address: lcd.i2cAddress ?? GROVE_LCD_DEFAULT_I2C,
183 blank: false,
184 };
185 }

188 const printCtx = buildLcdPrintCtx(uno, components, wires, autoJunctions, elapsedSec, opts);
189 const needsRuntime = needsRuntimeLcdCtx(uno);

193 const loopCycleMs = effectiveLcdLoopCycleMs(parsedOrCache);
194 const resolveOpts = needsRuntime ? { ctx: printCtx } : {};

200 setupDurationMs: 0,

204 const backlight = phase?.backlight ?? parsedOrCache.backlight;
205 const rgb = phase?.rgb ?? parsedOrCache.rgb ?? null;
206 return {
207 lines,
208 backlight,
209 rgb: rgb ? { ...rgb } : null,
210 blank: !lines.some((l) => l.trim()),
211 address: parsedOrCache.address ?? lcd.i2cAddress ?? GROVE_LCD_DEFAULT_I2C,
212 };
213 };
214
215 if (lcd.lcdDisplayCache && !needsRuntime) {
216 const d = pickDisplay(lcd.lcdDisplayCache);
217 return { ...d, wired: true };
218 }
219
220 const parsed = parseGroveLcdFromSketch(uno.sketch || "", printCtx);
221 if (!parsed) {
222 const hint = uno.lastCompileOk
223 ? [padHint("LiquidCrystal"), padHint("_I2C requis")]
224 : emptyLcdBuffer();
225 return {
226 lines: hint,
227 backlight: true,
228 rgb: null,
229 wired: true,
230 address: lcd.i2cAddress ?? GROVE_LCD_DEFAULT_I2C,
231 blank: !hint.some((l) => l.trim()),
232 };
233 }
234
235 const d = pickDisplay(parsed);
236 return { ...d, wired: true };
237}

2 * Interprétation minimale LiquidCrystal_I2C / rgb_lcd (Seeed Grove 104020112).

6export const LCD_COLS = 16;
7export const LCD_ROWS = 2;
8/** Dernière adresse DDRAM par ligne (HD44780 : 0x27 = index 39, pas « 27 caractères »). */
9export const LCD_DDRAM_LAST_ADDR = 0x27;
10/** 40 colonnes DDRAM par ligne (adresses 0x00–0x27). */
11export const LCD_DDRAM_COLS = LCD_DDRAM_LAST_ADDR + 1;
12
13/** Défilement max. pour afficher l'adresse 0x27 en colonne 15 (40 − 16 = 24 pas). */
14export function maxLcdDisplayShift(visibleCols = LCD_COLS) {
15 const vis = Math.max(1, visibleCols || LCD_COLS);
16 return LCD_DDRAM_LAST_ADDR - (vis - 1);
17}
18
19export function emptyLcdBuffer() {
20 return [" ", " "];
21}
22

27function padDdramLine(s) {

30
31/** Fenêtre visible (16 colonnes) à partir du tampon DDRAM et du décalage scroll. */
32export function visibleLcdLines(st) {

35 const shift = Math.max(0, Math.min(maxShift, st.displayShift || 0));
36 return st.ddram.map((row) => padDdramLine(row).slice(shift, shift + vis).padEnd(vis, " "));
37}

43function stripComments(src) {

53 if (!parsed) return 0;

55 if (ms > 0) return ms;
56 if (parsed.loopEvents?.length) return LCD_DEFAULT_INSTANT_LOOP_MS;

60function extractFunctionBody(src, name) {

66 const start = i + 1;

110function resolveNumericConst(src, token) {

126 const rowsRaw = i2c[4] ? resolveNumericConst(src, i2c[4].trim()) : LCD_ROWS;

128 varName: i2c[1],
129 address: addr,

136 if (rgb) {

140 cols: LCD_COLS,

148function extractParenArg(body, openParenIndex) {

151 const start = i;

158}

160/** Événements setup()/loop() dans l'ordre du source : appels lcd.* et delay(). */
161function parseTimedEvents(body, varName) {

170 const lcdRe = new RegExp(`\\b${varName}\\.(\\w+)\\s*\\(`, "gi");

174 type: "lcd",
175 index: m.index,

184function createLcdState(cols, rows, supportsRgb = false) {
185 return {
186 ddram: emptyDdramBuffer(rows),
187 displayShift: 0,
188 cursorCol: 0,
189 cursorRow: 0,
190 backlight: true,

192 supportsRgb,
193 cols,
194 rows,
195 };

198/** Avance le curseur après écriture (rgb_lcd = DDRAM 0x00–0x27 puis ligne 2). */
199function advanceLcdCursor(st) {

201 st.cursorCol++;
202 if (st.cursorCol >= LCD_DDRAM_COLS) {
203 st.cursorCol = 0;
204 if (st.cursorRow + 1 < st.rows) st.cursorRow++;
205 }
206 return;
207 }
208 // LiquidCrystal_I2C : retour à la ligne visible après cols caractères
209 st.cursorCol++;
210 if (st.cursorCol >= st.cols) {

217function writeLcdChar(st, row, col, ch) {

224function parseRgbArgs(args, src) {

226 const resolve = (t) => {

228 const fromDef = resolveNumericConst(src, t);
229 if (fromDef != null) return Math.max(0, Math.min(255, fromDef));
230 const n = parseInt(t, 10);
231 return Number.isFinite(n) ? Math.max(0, Math.min(255, n)) : 0;
232 };

235 g: resolve(parts[1] ?? "0"),

238}

240function applyLcdCall(fn, args, st, src = "", ctx = null) {

245 st.cursorRow = 0;
246 return true;
247 }
248 if (fn === "home") {
249 st.cursorCol = 0;
250 st.cursorRow = 0;
251 return true;
252 }
253 if (fn === "backlight") {
254 st.backlight = true;
255 return false;
256 }
257 if (fn === "nobacklight") {

259 return false;
260 }

270 }
271 if (fn === "scrolldisplayright") {
272 st.displayShift = Math.max(0, (st.displayShift || 0) - 1);
273 return true;
274 }

276 const parts = args.split(",").map((x) => x.trim());
277 if (parts.length >= 2 && /^\d+$/.test(parts[0])) {
278 st.cols = Math.min(LCD_COLS, parseInt(parts[0], 10) || st.cols);
279 st.rows = Math.min(LCD_ROWS, parseInt(parts[1], 10) || st.rows);
280 st.ddram = emptyDdramBuffer(st.rows);
281 st.displayShift = 0;
282 }
283 return false;
284 }
285 if (fn === "setcursor") {
286 const parts = args.split(",").map((x) => x.trim());
287 if (parts.length >= 2) {
288 const col = parseInt(parts[0], 10) || 0;
289 const row = parseInt(parts[1], 10) || 0;
290 st.cursorCol = Math.max(0, Math.min(LCD_DDRAM_LAST_ADDR, col));

292 }
293 return false;
294 }

301 writeLcdChar(st, st.cursorRow, st.cursorCol, ch);
302 advanceLcdCursor(st);
303 }
304 } else {
305 let col = st.cursorCol;
306 let row = st.cursorRow;
307 for (const ch of text) {
308 if (row >= st.rows) break;
309 writeLcdChar(st, row, col, ch);
310 col++;
311 if (col >= st.cols) {
312 col = 0;
313 if (row + 1 < st.rows) row++;

315 }

317 st.cursorCol = col;
318 st.cursorRow = row;

325function cloneLcdState(st) {

328 displayShift: st.displayShift || 0,
329 cursorCol: st.cursorCol,
330 cursorRow: st.cursorRow,
331 backlight: st.backlight,

335 rows: st.rows,
336 };

339function loopBodyDurationMs(events) {
340 let t = 0;
341 for (const ev of events) {

345}

347/** Rejoue les événements loop() jusqu'à maxMs (ms dans le cycle courant). */

349 let t = 0;
350 for (const ev of events) {
351 if (ev.type === "delay") {
352 if (t >= maxMs) return;
353 const next = t + ev.ms;
354 if (next > maxMs) return;
355 t = next;
356 } else {

360 }
361}

363function runFullLoop(st, events, src, ctx = null) {

365}

367function snapshotPhase(phases, timeMs, st) {

376function runTimedBody(body, varName, phases, st, timeRef, src = "", ctx = null) {

382 for (const ev of parseTimedEvents(body, varName)) {

392/** Choisit la phase d'affichage pour un temps écoulé (ms). */
393export function pickLcdPhaseAt(phases, elapsedMs, opts = {}) {
394 if (!Array.isArray(phases) || phases.length === 0) return null;
395 const loopCycleMs = opts.loopCycleMs ?? 0;
396 const setupDurationMs = opts.setupDurationMs ?? 0;

398 if (loopCycleMs > 0 && t > setupDurationMs) {
399 t = setupDurationMs + ((t - setupDurationMs) % loopCycleMs);

402 for (const p of phases) {
403 if (p.atMs <= t) picked = p;
404 else break;
405 }
406 return picked;
407}

409/**
410 * État LCD à un instant donné — rejoue loop() à chaque cycle (scroll cumulatif, etc.).
411 * @param {ReturnType<typeof parseGroveLcdFromSketch>} parsed
412 * @param {number} elapsedMs

414export function resolveLcdDisplayAt(parsed, elapsedMs, opts = {}) {
415 if (!parsed) return null;
416 const ctx = opts.ctx ?? null;
417 const elapsed = Math.max(0, elapsedMs);
418 const setupDurationMs = parsed.setupDurationMs ?? 0;
419
420 if (elapsed < setupDurationMs) {
421 return pickLcdPhaseAt(parsed.phases, elapsed, { loopCycleMs: 0, setupDurationMs: 0 });

423
424 const loopCycleMs = effectiveLcdLoopCycleMs(parsed);
425 const loopEvents = parsed.loopEvents;
426 if (loopCycleMs <= 0 || !loopEvents?.length) {
427 const phase = pickLcdPhaseAt(parsed.phases, elapsed, { loopCycleMs: 0, setupDurationMs: 0 });

430 if (end) {

436 }
437 return null;
438 }

440 const st = cloneLcdState(parsed.setupEndState);
441 const loopT = elapsed - setupDurationMs;
442 const cyclesCompleted = Math.floor(loopT / loopCycleMs);
443 const cyclePos = loopT % loopCycleMs;

447 : null;

450 runFullLoop(st, loopEvents, src, loopCtx);
451 }
452 runLoopEvents(st, loopEvents, src, cyclePos, loopCtx);

455 lines: cloneLines(st),
456 backlight: st.backlight,
457 rgb: st.rgb ? { ...st.rgb } : null,
458 };
459}

461/**
462 * @param {string} sketch
463 * @returns {{ address: number, cols: number, rows: number, lines: string[], backlight: boolean, rgb: object | null, varName: string, phases: object[], hasTiming: boolean, setupDurationMs: number, loopCycleMs: number } | null}
464 */
465export function parseGroveLcdFromSketch(sketch, ctx = null) {
466 const src = stripComments(sketch);
467 const detected = detectLcdVariable(src);
468 if (!detected) return null;
469
470 const { varName, address, supportsRgb } = detected;
471 const st = createLcdState(detected.cols, detected.rows, supportsRgb);
472 const phases = [];
473 const timeRef = { ms: 0 };
474
475 const setupBody = extractFunctionBody(src, "setup");
476 const loopBody = extractFunctionBody(src, "loop");
477 const setupDurationMs = runTimedBody(setupBody, varName, phases, st, timeRef, src, ctx);
478 const setupEndState = cloneLcdState(st);
479 const loopEvents = parseTimedEvents(loopBody, varName);
480 const loopCycleMs = loopBody.trim() ? loopBodyDurationMs(loopEvents) : 0;
481 const effectiveLoopCycleMs = loopCycleMs > 0 ? loopCycleMs : (loopEvents.length ? LCD_DEFAULT_INSTANT_LOOP_MS : 0);
482 if (loopBody.trim() && loopCycleMs > 0) {
483 runTimedBody(loopBody, varName, phases, st, timeRef, src, ctx);
484 }
485
486 if (phases.length === 0) {
487 snapshotPhase(phases, 0, st);
488 }
489
490 const last = phases[phases.length - 1];
491 const hasTiming = effectiveLoopCycleMs > 0 || phases.length > 1 || phases.some((p) => p.atMs > 0);
492 const visible = visibleLcdLines(st);
493
494 const loopVarBindings = ctx?.collectVarBindings ? ctx.collectVarBindings(loopBody) : {};
495
496 return {
497 address,
498 cols: st.cols,
499 rows: st.rows,
500 lines: visible.slice(0, st.rows),
501 backlight: last.backlight,
502 rgb: last.rgb ? { ...last.rgb } : (st.rgb ? { ...st.rgb } : null),
503 varName,
504 phases,
505 hasTiming,
506 setupDurationMs,
507 loopCycleMs,
508 effectiveLoopCycleMs,
509 setupEndState,
510 loopEvents,
511 loopVarBindings,
512 sketchSrc: src,
513 };
514}

1/**

7const HC90_PIN_Q2 = 7;
8const HC90_PIN_Q3 = 10;
9const HC90_PIN_MR1 = 1;
10const HC90_PIN_MR2 = 2;

13const HC90_Q_RE = /^(.+)_Q([0-3])$/;
14const UI_AND_TYPES = new Set(["and", "logic_and"]);
15const UI_COMBINATORIAL_TYPES = new Set([
16 "and",
17 "logic_and",
18 "nand",
19 "logic_nand",
20 "or",
21 "logic_or",
22 "nor",
23 "logic_nor",
24]);

27
28function pointOnWireSegment(p, a, b) {
29 if (!p || !a || !b) return false;
30 if (Math.abs(a.x - b.x) < WIRE_EPS) {
31 return (
32 Math.abs(p.x - a.x) < WIRE_EPS &&
33 p.y >= Math.min(a.y, b.y) - WIRE_EPS &&
34 p.y <= Math.max(a.y, b.y) + WIRE_EPS
35 );
36 }
37 if (Math.abs(a.y - b.y) < WIRE_EPS) {
38 return (
39 Math.abs(p.y - a.y) < WIRE_EPS &&
40 p.x >= Math.min(a.x, b.x) - WIRE_EPS &&
41 p.x <= Math.max(a.x, b.x) + WIRE_EPS
42 );
43 }
44 return false;
45}

47/** Graphe électrique incluant les jonctions auto posées sur un fil (T). */
48function buildJonctionGroups(wires, autoJunctions = []) {
49 const parent = new Map();
50 function touch(id) {
51 if (id && !parent.has(id)) parent.set(id, id);
52 }
53 function find(id) {
54 touch(id);
55 let root = id;
56 while (parent.get(root) !== root) root = parent.get(root);
57 let cur = id;
58 while (parent.get(cur) !== root) {
59 const next = parent.get(cur);
60 parent.set(cur, root);
61 cur = next;
62 }
63 return root;
64 }
65 function union(a, b) {
66 if (!a || !b) return;
67 const ra = find(a);
68 const rb = find(b);
69 if (ra !== rb) parent.set(ra, rb);
70 }
71
72 for (const w of wires || []) {
73 if (!w?.fromJonctionId || !w?.toJonctionId) continue;
74 union(w.fromJonctionId, w.toJonctionId);
75 const pts = w.points;
76 if (!Array.isArray(pts) || pts.length < 2) continue;
77 for (const aj of autoJunctions) {
78 if (!aj?.id) continue;
79 for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) {
80 if (pointOnWireSegment({ x: aj.x, y: aj.y }, pts[i], pts[i + 1])) {
81 union(aj.id, w.fromJonctionId);
82 union(aj.id, w.toJonctionId);
83 break;
84 }
85 }
86 }
87 }
88 return parent;
89}

91/** Jonctions reliées électriquement à startId (graphe non orienté). */
92export function reachableJonctions(startId, wires, autoJunctions = []) {
93 if (!startId) return new Set();
94 const parent = buildJonctionGroups(wires, autoJunctions);
95 if (!parent.has(startId)) return new Set([startId]);
96 const root = findJonctionRoot(startId, parent);
97 const visited = new Set();
98 for (const id of parent.keys()) {
99 if (findJonctionRoot(id, parent) === root) visited.add(id);
100 }
101 return visited;
102}
103
104function findJonctionRoot(id, parent) {
105 let root = id;
106 while (parent.get(root) !== root) root = parent.get(root);
107 return root;
108}
109
110function hc90Labels(components) {
111 return components.filter((c) => c.type === "ic_74hc90" && c.label).map((c) => c.label);
112}
113
114function clockOutJonctions(components) {
115 const outs = [];
116 for (const c of components) {
117 if (!CLOCK_SOURCE_TYPES.has(c.type) || !c.label) continue;
118 outs.push(`${c.label}_out`);
119 }
120 return outs;
121}
122
123function cp0ClockedBySource(label, clockOuts, wires, autoJunctions = []) {
124 const cp0 = `${label}_CP0`;
125 const net = reachableJonctions(cp0, wires, autoJunctions);
126 return clockOuts.some((out) => net.has(out));
127}

129/** Report unités → dizaines : Q3 direct ou AND(Q0,Q3). */
130export function validateHc90Carry(unitsLabel, tensLabel, components, wires, autoJunctions = []) {
131 const cp0Net = reachableJonctions(`${tensLabel}_CP0`, wires, autoJunctions);
132 const q0 = `${unitsLabel}_Q0`;
133 const q3 = `${unitsLabel}_Q3`;
134 if (cp0Net.has(q3) && !hasAndBetween(unitsLabel, tensLabel, components, wires, autoJunctions)) {
135 return { valid: true, kind: "q3" };
136 }
137 for (const comp of components) {
138 if (!isAndGate(comp)) continue;
139 const out = `${comp.label}_out`;
140 if (!cp0Net.has(out)) continue;
141 const inANet = reachableJonctions(`${comp.label}_inA`, wires, autoJunctions);
142 const inBNet = reachableJonctions(`${comp.label}_inB`, wires, autoJunctions);
143 const okQ0Q3 =
144 (inANet.has(q0) && inBNet.has(q3)) || (inANet.has(q3) && inBNet.has(q0));
145 if (okQ0Q3) return { valid: true, kind: "and_q0_q3" };
146 }
147 return { valid: false, kind: "unknown" };
148}
149
150function hasAndBetween(unitsLabel, tensLabel, components, wires, autoJunctions = []) {
151 const cp0Net = reachableJonctions(`${tensLabel}_CP0`, wires, autoJunctions);
152 return components.some((c) => isAndGate(c) && cp0Net.has(`${c.label}_out`));
153}
154
155function isAndGate(comp) {
156 return !!(comp?.label && UI_AND_TYPES.has(comp.type));
157}
158
159function isCombinatorialGate(comp) {
160 return !!(comp?.label && UI_COMBINATORIAL_TYPES.has(comp.type));
161}
162
163function gateOutputJonction(comp) {
164 return `${comp.label}_out`;
165}
166
167function gateInputJonctions(comp) {
168 return [`${comp.label}_inA`, `${comp.label}_inB`];
169}
170
171function hc90MrJonctions(...labels) {
172 const out = [];
173 for (const label of labels) {
174 if (!label) continue;
175 out.push(`${label}_MR1`, `${label}_MR2`);
176 }
177 return out;
178}
179
180/** AND dont les entrées sont Q1 et Q2 du HC90 « dizaines ». */
181function findMod60Q1Q2And(tensLabel, components, wires, autoJunctions = []) {
182 const q1 = `${tensLabel}_Q1`;
183 const q2 = `${tensLabel}_Q2`;
184 return components.filter((comp) => {
185 if (!isAndGate(comp)) return false;
186 const inANet = reachableJonctions(`${comp.label}_inA`, wires, autoJunctions);
187 const inBNet = reachableJonctions(`${comp.label}_inB`, wires, autoJunctions);
188 return (inANet.has(q1) && inBNet.has(q2)) || (inANet.has(q2) && inBNet.has(q1));
189 });
190}
191
192/**
193 * Sortie d’une porte combinatoire (directe ou via d’autres portes) reliée à MR1/MR2.
194 * Ex. AND(Q1,Q2) → ANDRST → MR (reset mod-60 complet).
195 */
196function combinatorialOutputDrivesMr(outputJid, mrJids, components, wires, autoJunctions = [], visited = new Set()) {
197 const outNet = reachableJonctions(outputJid, wires, autoJunctions);
198 for (const mr of mrJids) {
199 if (outNet.has(mr)) return true;
200 }
201 for (const comp of components) {
202 if (!isCombinatorialGate(comp)) continue;
203 const inputs = gateInputJonctions(comp);
204 if (!inputs.some((inJ) => outNet.has(inJ))) continue;
205 if (visited.has(comp.label)) continue;
206 visited.add(comp.label);
207 if (combinatorialOutputDrivesMr(gateOutputJonction(comp), mrJids, components, wires, autoJunctions, visited)) {
208 return true;
209 }
210 }
211 return false;
212}
213
214/** Reset mod-60 : AND(Q1,Q2) du HC90 dizaines → MR (direct ou via portes intermédiaires). */
215export function detectHc90Mod60Reset(tensLabel, components, wires, unitsLabel = null, autoJunctions = []) {
216 if (!tensLabel) return false;
217 const mrJids = hc90MrJonctions(tensLabel, unitsLabel);
218 for (const andGate of findMod60Q1Q2And(tensLabel, components, wires, autoJunctions)) {
219 if (combinatorialOutputDrivesMr(gateOutputJonction(andGate), mrJids, components, wires, autoJunctions)) {
220 return true;
221 }
222 }
223 return false;
224}

226/**
227 * @returns {{
228 * mode: 'none'|'single'|'two_digit'|'multi',
229 * units: string|null,
230 * tens: string|null,
231 * clockSource: boolean,
232 * carryValid: boolean,
233 * carryKind: string,
234 * mod60: boolean
235 * }}
236 */
237export function detectHc90Cascade(components, wires, autoJunctions = []) {
238 const labels = hc90Labels(components);
239 const clockOuts = clockOutJonctions(components);
240 const hasClock = clockOuts.length > 0;
241
242 if (labels.length === 0) {
243 return { mode: "none", units: null, tens: null, clockSource: false, carryValid: false, carryKind: "none", mod60: false };
244 }
245 if (labels.length === 1) {
246 const units = labels[0];
247 const clocked = hasClock && cp0ClockedBySource(units, clockOuts, wires, autoJunctions);
248 return {
249 mode: "single",
250 units,
251 tens: null,
252 clockSource: clocked,
253 carryValid: true,
254 carryKind: "single",
255 mod60: false,
256 };
257 }
258 if (labels.length > 2) {
259 return { mode: "multi", units: null, tens: null, clockSource: hasClock, carryValid: false, carryKind: "unknown", mod60: false };
260 }
261
262 const [a, b] = labels;
263 const aClock = cp0ClockedBySource(a, clockOuts, wires, autoJunctions);
264 const bClock = cp0ClockedBySource(b, clockOuts, wires, autoJunctions);
265 let units = null;
266 let tens = null;
267 if (aClock && !bClock) {
268 units = a;
269 tens = b;
270 } else if (bClock && !aClock) {
271 units = b;
272 tens = a;
273 } else {
274 const carryAB = validateHc90Carry(a, b, components, wires, autoJunctions);
275 const carryBA = validateHc90Carry(b, a, components, wires, autoJunctions);
276 if (carryAB.valid && !carryBA.valid) {
277 units = a;
278 tens = b;
279 } else if (carryBA.valid && !carryAB.valid) {
280 units = b;
281 tens = a;
282 } else {
283 return { mode: "multi", units: null, tens: null, clockSource: hasClock, carryValid: false, carryKind: "unknown", mod60: false };
284 }
285 }
286
287 const carry = validateHc90Carry(units, tens, components, wires, autoJunctions);
288 return {
289 mode: "two_digit",
290 units,
291 tens,
292 clockSource: true,
293 carryValid: carry.valid,
294 carryKind: carry.kind,
295 mod60: detectHc90Mod60Reset(tens, components, wires, units, autoJunctions),
296 };
297}
298
299/** Niveau logique haut sur une broche HC90 (logic_terminal à 1 ou VCC). */
300function isHc90PinLogicHigh(pinJonctionId, components, wires, autoJunctions = []) {
301 const net = reachableJonctions(pinJonctionId, wires, autoJunctions);
302 for (const comp of components) {
303 if (comp.type === "logic_terminal" && comp.label) {
304 const out = `${comp.label}_out`;
305 if (net.has(out) && Number(comp.state) === 1) return true;
306 }
307 if (comp.type === "vcc" && comp.label) {
308 const out = `${comp.label}_out`;
309 if (net.has(out)) return true;
310 }
311 }
312 return false;
313}

315/**
316 * Master reset actif : MR1 ET MR2 au niveau haut sur au moins un 74HC90.
317 * (Broches reliées à la masse / logic_terminal à 0 → inactif.)
318 */
319export function isHc90MasterResetActive(components, wires, autoJunctions = []) {
320 for (const comp of components) {
321 if (comp.type !== "ic_74hc90" || !comp.label) continue;
322 const mr1 = `${comp.label}_MR1`;
323 const mr2 = `${comp.label}_MR2`;
324 if (isHc90PinLogicHigh(mr1, components, wires, autoJunctions) && isHc90PinLogicHigh(mr2, components, wires, autoJunctions)) {
325 return true;
326 }
327 }
328 return false;
329}

331/** Nombre total de fronts horloge depuis t = 0 (1 impulsion GImp = +1). */
332export function hc90PulseCount(elapsedSec, clockPeriodSec) {
333 if (!(clockPeriodSec > 0) || !(elapsedSec >= 0)) return 0;
334 return Math.floor(elapsedSec / clockPeriodSec);
335}
336
337/** Chiffre BCD 0–9 pour un HC90 donné (comptage idéal 0…99 ou 0…9). */
338export function idealHc90BcdForLabel(compLabel, cascade, elapsedSec, clockPeriodSec) {
339 if (!cascade || !compLabel || !(clockPeriodSec > 0)) return null;
340 const pulses = hc90PulseCount(elapsedSec, clockPeriodSec);
341 if (cascade.mode === "single" && compLabel === cascade.units) {
342 return pulses % 10;
343 }
344 if (cascade.mode === "two_digit" && cascade.units && cascade.tens) {
345 const mod = cascade.mod60 ? 60 : 100;
346 const total = pulses % mod;
347 if (compLabel === cascade.units) return total % 10;
348 if (compLabel === cascade.tens) return Math.floor(total / 10) % 10;
349 }
350 return null;
351}
352
353/**
354 * Temps .tran pour lire l’état stabilisé après N impulsions dans la fenêtre simulée.
355 * Quand totalPulses est un multiple de pulsesPerSpan, on lit la dernière impulsion
356 * du span (pas t=0 qui est l’état initial avant tout front).
357 */
358export function hc90TranSampleTimeSec(elapsedSec, clockPeriodSec, plotSpanSec, phase = 0.49) {
359 if (!(clockPeriodSec > 0) || !(plotSpanSec > 0)) return elapsedSec;
360 const totalPulses = hc90PulseCount(elapsedSec, clockPeriodSec);
361 if (totalPulses === 0) return 0;
362 const pulsesPerSpan = Math.max(1, Math.floor(plotSpanSec / clockPeriodSec));
363 let pulseInSpan = totalPulses % pulsesPerSpan;
364 if (pulseInSpan === 0) pulseInSpan = pulsesPerSpan;
365 return Math.min(
366 plotSpanSec - 1e-12,
367 (pulseInSpan - 1) * clockPeriodSec + clockPeriodSec * phase
368 );
369}

371const CD4511_BCD_PINS = ["A", "B", "C", "D"];
372const SEG7_SEG_PINS = ["a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f", "g"];
373
374/**
375 * LED dont l’anode est sur une sortie Q0…Q3 d’un 74HC90 (directement ou via résistance).
376 * @returns {{ hc90Label: string, qIndex: number } | null}
377 */
378export function hc90QBitForLed(ledLabel, components, wires, autoJunctions = []) {
379 if (!ledLabel) return null;
380 const anodeNet = reachableJonctions(`${ledLabel}_in`, wires, autoJunctions);
381 for (const hc of components) {
382 if (hc.type !== "ic_74hc90" || !hc.label) continue;
383 for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
384 if (anodeNet.has(`${hc.label}_Q${i}`)) {
385 return { hc90Label: hc.label, qIndex: i };
386 }
387 }
388 }
389 return null;
390}
391
392/** HC90 dont Q0…Q3 alimentent un CD4511 relié à cet afficheur SEG. */
393export function hc90LabelForSeg7(segLabel, components, wires, autoJunctions = []) {
394 if (!segLabel) return null;
395 for (const cd of components) {
396 if (cd.type !== "cd4511" || !cd.label) continue;
397 let segLinked = false;
398 for (const s of SEG7_SEG_PINS) {
399 const segPin = `${segLabel}_${s}`;
400 const cdPin = `${cd.label}_${s}`;
401 if (reachableJonctions(segPin, wires, autoJunctions).has(cdPin)) {
402 segLinked = true;
403 break;
404 }
405 }
406 if (!segLinked) continue;
407 for (const hc of components) {
408 if (hc.type !== "ic_74hc90" || !hc.label) continue;
409 let matched = 0;
410 for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
411 const qNet = reachableJonctions(`${hc.label}_Q${i}`, wires, autoJunctions);
412 const bcdPin = `${cd.label}_${CD4511_BCD_PINS[i]}`;
413 if (qNet.has(bcdPin)) matched++;
414 }
415 if (matched >= 4) return hc.label;
416 }
417 }
418 return null;
419}

421/** Animation fiable dès qu’un GImp horloge le HC90 (toute fréquence). */
422export function shouldUseIdealHc90Counting(cascade, clockPeriodSec) {
423 if (!cascade || !(clockPeriodSec > 0)) return false;
424 if (cascade.mode === "two_digit" && cascade.units && cascade.tens) {
425 return cascade.clockSource !== false;
426 }
427 // Un seul HC90 : comptage idéal dès qu’une horloge est présente (évite les erreurs
428 // de relecture .tran après le rollover 9→0).
429 if (cascade.mode === "single" && cascade.units) return true;
430 return false;
431}

433const ENGINE_AND_TYPES = new Set(["and", "logic_and"]);
434const ENGINE_COMB_TYPES = new Set([
435 "and",
436 "logic_and",
437 "or",
438 "logic_or",
439 "nand",
440 "logic_nand",
441 "nor",
442 "logic_nor",
443]);
444
445/** Graphe fils SPICE / moteur (clés terminal `id#pin`). */
446export function reachableTerminalKeys(startKey, wires) {
447 if (!startKey) return new Set();
448 const visited = new Set([startKey]);
449 const queue = [startKey];
450 while (queue.length) {
451 const key = queue.shift();
452 for (const w of wires || []) {
453 if (!w?.solid) continue;
454 let next = null;
455 if (w.fromKey === key) next = w.toKey;
456 else if (w.toKey === key) next = w.fromKey;
457 if (next && !visited.has(next)) {
458 visited.add(next);
459 queue.push(next);
460 }
461 }
462 }
463 return visited;
464}
465
466function isEngineAndGate(comp) {
467 const id = comp?.id || comp?.label;
468 return id && ENGINE_AND_TYPES.has(comp.type);
469}
470
471function isEngineCombGate(comp) {
472 const id = comp?.id || comp?.label;
473 return id && ENGINE_COMB_TYPES.has(comp.type);
474}
475
476function engineGateOutKey(comp) {
477 const id = comp.id || comp.label;
478 return `${id}#2`;
479}
480
481function engineGateInKeys(comp) {
482 const id = comp.id || comp.label;
483 return [`${id}#0`, `${id}#1`];
484}
485
486function findMod60Q1Q2AndKeys(tensId, components, wires) {
487 const q1 = `${tensId}#${HC90_PIN_Q1}`;
488 const q2 = `${tensId}#${HC90_PIN_Q2}`;
489 return components.filter((comp) => {
490 if (!isEngineAndGate(comp)) return false;
491 const inANet = reachableTerminalKeys(`${comp.id || comp.label}#0`, wires);
492 const inBNet = reachableTerminalKeys(`${comp.id || comp.label}#1`, wires);
493 return (inANet.has(q1) && inBNet.has(q2)) || (inANet.has(q2) && inBNet.has(q1));
494 });
495}
496
497function combinatorialKeyDrivesMr(outputKey, mrKeys, components, wires, visited = new Set()) {
498 const outNet = reachableTerminalKeys(outputKey, wires);
499 for (const mr of mrKeys) {
500 if (outNet.has(mr)) return true;
501 }
502 for (const comp of components) {
503 const id = comp.id || comp.label;
504 if (!isEngineCombGate(comp)) continue;
505 if (visited.has(id)) continue;
506 if (!engineGateInKeys(comp).some((inK) => outNet.has(inK))) continue;
507 visited.add(id);
508 if (combinatorialKeyDrivesMr(engineGateOutKey(comp), mrKeys, components, wires, visited)) {
509 return true;
510 }
511 }
512 return false;
513}
514
515/**
516 * AND(Q1,Q3) du même HC90 qui pilote MR1/MR2 — provoque des resets pendant les transitions.
517 * (Le report dizaines utilise AND(Q0,Q3) → CP0 du 2e HC90, pas MR.)
518 */
519export function detectHc90MrAndQ1Q3OnSameChip(hc90Id, components, wires) {
520 if (!hc90Id) return false;
521 const q1 = `${hc90Id}#${HC90_PIN_Q1}`;
522 const q3 = `${hc90Id}#${HC90_PIN_Q3}`;
523 const mrKeys = [`${hc90Id}#${HC90_PIN_MR1}`, `${hc90Id}#${HC90_PIN_MR2}`];
524 for (const comp of components) {
525 if (!isEngineAndGate(comp)) continue;
526 const cid = comp.id || comp.label;
527 const inA = reachableTerminalKeys(`${cid}#0`, wires);
528 const inB = reachableTerminalKeys(`${cid}#1`, wires);
529 const hasQ1Q3 = (inA.has(q1) && inB.has(q3)) || (inA.has(q3) && inB.has(q1));
530 if (!hasQ1Q3) continue;
531 if (combinatorialKeyDrivesMr(engineGateOutKey(comp), mrKeys, components, wires)) {
532 return true;
533 }
534 }
535 return false;
536}
537
538/** Détection mod-60 pour la netlist SPICE (clés `fromKey` / `toKey`). */
539export function detectHc90Mod60FromGraphicalState(components, wires) {
540 const hc90s = components.filter((c) => c.type === "ic_74hc90" && c.id);
541 if (hc90s.length < 2) return false;
542 const mrKeys = hc90s.flatMap((c) => [
543 `${c.id}#${HC90_PIN_MR1}`,
544 `${c.id}#${HC90_PIN_MR2}`,
545 ]);
546 for (const tens of hc90s) {
547 for (const andGate of findMod60Q1Q2AndKeys(tens.id, components, wires)) {
548 if (combinatorialKeyDrivesMr(engineGateOutKey(andGate), mrKeys, components, wires)) {
549 return true;
550 }
551 }
552 }
553 return false;
554}

75 const lcdId = lcd.id || lcd.label;

77 if (!isLcdI2cWiredToUnoEngine(unoId, lcdId, wires)) continue;
78 if (!isLcdPoweredEngine(lcdId, components, wires)) continue;
79 uno.i2cBus = {
80 active: true,
81 address: lcd.i2cAddress ?? 0x3e,
82 lcdId,
83 };
84 return;
85 }
86 delete uno.i2cBus;
87}

89export function i2cBusMinPeriodSec(components) {
90 for (const c of components) {
91 if (c.type === "arduino_uno" && c.i2cBus?.active) return I2C_SCL_PERIOD_SEC;
92 }
93 return 0;
94}

96/**
97 * Pull-up I²C + pilotes PWL (START/STOP/ACK, 100 kHz) sur SDA/SCL.
98 */
99export function appendI2cBusNetlist(c, nodeFor, lines, spiceBranchName, repeatUntilSec = 0.02) {
100 if (!c?.i2cBus?.active) return;
101 const wf = buildLcdI2cWaveformFromSketch(c.sketch || "", repeatUntilSec);
102 if (!wf?.sda?.length || !wf?.scl?.length) return;
103
104 const id = c.id;
105 const nSda = nodeFor(`${id}#${UNO_A4}`);
106 const nScl = nodeFor(`${id}#${UNO_A5}`);
107
108 lines.push(`* ${id} I²C PCF8574 — ${I2C_SCL_HZ / 1000} kHz, START/STOP/ACK, PWL ${formatSpiceTime(wf.durationSec)} s`);
109 lines.push(`${spiceBranchName("V", `${id}_SDA_DRV`)} ${nSda} 0 ${pwlToSpiceString(wf.sda)}`);
110 lines.push(`${spiceBranchName("V", `${id}_SCL_DRV`)} ${nScl} 0 ${pwlToSpiceString(wf.scl)}`);
111}

1/**
2 * Générateur de formes d'onde I²C (UM10204 mode standard 100 kHz).
3 * Modèle push-pull avec niveaux bus haut = 5 V (tireur relâché + pull-up), bas = 0 V.
4 */
5
6export const I2C_V_HIGH = 5;
7export const I2C_V_LOW = 0;
8/** Mode standard 100 kHz — t_LOW / t_HIGH ≥ 4,7 µs. */
9export const I2C_SCL_HZ = 100_000;
10export const I2C_SCL_PERIOD_SEC = 1 / I2C_SCL_HZ;
11export const I2C_T_LOW = 4.7e-6;
12export const I2C_T_HIGH = 4.0e-6;
13export const I2C_T_SU_STA = 4.7e-6;
14export const I2C_T_HD_STA = 4.0e-6;
15export const I2C_T_SU_STO = 4.0e-6;
16export const I2C_T_BUF = 4.7e-6;
17export const I2C_T_SU_DAT = 0.25e-6;
18export const I2C_T_RISE = 50e-9;
19
20export function formatSpiceTime(seconds) {
21 const s = Math.abs(Number(seconds));
22 if (!Number.isFinite(s)) return "1n";
23 if (s === 0) return "0";
24 if (s >= 1) return String(s);
25 if (s >= 1e-3) return `${(s * 1e3).toPrecision(6)}m`;
26 if (s >= 1e-6) return `${(s * 1e6).toPrecision(6)}u`;
27 if (s >= 1e-9) return `${(s * 1e9).toPrecision(6)}n`;
28 return `${s.toExponential(3)}`;
29}
30
31function coalescePwl(points) {
32 if (!points.length) return [[0, I2C_V_HIGH]];
33 const out = [[points[0][0], points[0][1]]];
34 for (let i = 1; i < points.length; i++) {
35 const [t, v] = points[i];
36 const prev = out[out.length - 1];
37 if (Math.abs(t - prev[0]) < 1e-15 && Math.abs(v - prev[1]) < 1e-9) continue;
38 if (Math.abs(v - prev[1]) < 1e-9 && t > prev[0]) {
39 prev[0] = t;
40 continue;
41 }
42 out.push([t, v]);
43 }
44 return out;
45}
46
47/** Émetteur maître I²C — construction SDA/SCL synchrones. */
48export class I2cMasterWaveform {
49 constructor() {
50 this.t = 0;
51 this.scl = I2C_V_HIGH;
52 this.sda = I2C_V_HIGH;
53 /** @type {[number, number][]} */
54 this.sdaPoints = [[0, I2C_V_HIGH]];
55 /** @type {[number, number][]} */
56 this.sclPoints = [[0, I2C_V_HIGH]];
57 }
58
59 durationSec() {
60 return this.t;
61 }
62
63 _snapshot() {
64 this.sdaPoints.push([this.t, this.sda]);
65 this.sclPoints.push([this.t, this.scl]);
66 }
67
68 _setSda(v) {
69 if (Math.abs(this.sda - v) > 1e-9) {
70 this.sda = v;
71 this._snapshot();
72 }
73 }
74
75 _setScl(v) {
76 if (Math.abs(this.scl - v) > 1e-9) {
77 this.scl = v;
78 this._snapshot();
79 }
80 }
81
82 _wait(dt) {
83 this.t += dt;
84 }
85
86 /** Condition START (t_HD;STA). */
87 start() {
88 this._setSda(I2C_V_HIGH);
89 this._setScl(I2C_V_HIGH);
90 this._wait(I2C_T_SU_STA);
91 this._setSda(I2C_V_LOW);
92 this._wait(I2C_T_HD_STA);
93 this._setScl(I2C_V_LOW);
94 this._wait(I2C_T_RISE);
95 }
96
97 /** Condition STOP (t_SU;STO). */
98 stop() {
99 this._setSda(I2C_V_LOW);
100 this._setScl(I2C_V_LOW);
101 this._wait(I2C_T_RISE);
102 this._setScl(I2C_V_HIGH);
103 this._wait(I2C_T_SU_STO);
104 this._setSda(I2C_V_HIGH);
105 this._wait(I2C_T_BUF);
106 }
107
108 /** Un bit de données (MSB→LSB), horloge 100 kHz. */
109 _writeBit(bit) {
110 this._setScl(I2C_V_LOW);
111 this._setSda(bit ? I2C_V_HIGH : I2C_V_LOW);
112 this._wait(I2C_T_SU_DAT);
113 this._setScl(I2C_V_HIGH);
114 this._wait(I2C_T_HIGH);
115 this._setScl(I2C_V_LOW);
116 this._wait(I2C_T_LOW);
117 }
118
119 /** Octet + créneau ACK (esclave tire SDA à 0). */
120 writeByte(byte) {
121 for (let i = 7; i >= 0; i--) {
122 this._writeBit((byte >> i) & 1);
123 }
124 this._setScl(I2C_V_LOW);
125 this._setSda(I2C_V_HIGH);
126 this._wait(I2C_T_SU_DAT);
127 this._setScl(I2C_V_HIGH);
128 this._wait(I2C_T_HIGH);
129 this._setSda(I2C_V_LOW);
130 this._setScl(I2C_V_LOW);
131 this._wait(I2C_T_LOW);
132 }
133
134 /** Transaction WRITE : START + adresse 8 bits (7b+R/W) + ACK + [data+ACK]* + STOP. */
135 writeTransaction(addr8, dataBytes = []) {
136 this.start();
137 this.writeByte(addr8 & 0xff);
138 for (const b of dataBytes) {
139 this.writeByte(b & 0xff);
140 }
141 this.stop();
142 }
143
144 toPwl() {
145 return {
146 sda: coalescePwl(this.sdaPoints),
147 scl: coalescePwl(this.sclPoints),
148 durationSec: this.t,
149 };
150 }
151}
152
153/**
154 * Répète une forme d'onde pour remplir la fenêtre SPICE.
155 * @param {{ sda: [number,number][], scl: [number,number][], durationSec: number }} once
156 * @param {number} repeatUntilSec
157 */
158export function repeatI2cWaveform(once, repeatUntilSec) {
159 const dur = Math.max(once.durationSec, 1e-9);
160 const target = Math.max(repeatUntilSec, dur);
161 const sda = [...once.sda];
162 const scl = [...once.scl];
163 let t = dur;
164 while (t + dur <= target + 1e-12) {
165 const offset = t;
166 for (let i = 1; i < once.sda.length; i++) {
167 sda.push([once.sda[i][0] + offset, once.sda[i][1]]);
168 }
169 for (let i = 1; i < once.scl.length; i++) {
170 scl.push([once.scl[i][0] + offset, once.scl[i][1]]);
171 }
172 t += dur + I2C_T_BUF;
173 }
174 return {
175 sda: coalescePwl(sda),
176 scl: coalescePwl(scl),
177 durationSec: t,
178 };
179}
180
181/**
182 * ngspice interpole linéairement entre points PWL : chaque palier doit être
183 * (t_début, V) puis (t_fin, V) avant un saut, sinon la tension « rampe » sur toute la durée du palier.
184 */
185export function expandPwlPlateaus(points) {
186 if (!points.length) return [[0, I2C_V_HIGH]];
187 const out = [[points[0][0], points[0][1]]];
188 for (let i = 1; i < points.length; i++) {
189 const [t, v] = points[i];
190 const [tPrev, vPrev] = points[i - 1];
191 if (Math.abs(v - vPrev) > 1e-9) {
192 if (t > tPrev + 1e-18) out.push([t, vPrev]);
193 out.push([t, v]);
194 } else if (t > tPrev + 1e-18) {
195 out.push([t, v]);
196 }
197 }
198 return out;
199}
200
201/** PWL ngspice : PWL(t1 v1 t2 v2 …). */
202export function pwlToSpiceString(points) {
203 const parts = [];
204 for (const [t, v] of expandPwlPlateaus(points)) {
205 parts.push(formatSpiceTime(t), String(v));
206 }
207 return `PWL(${parts.join(" ")})`;
208}
209
210/**
211 * Adresse 8 bits sur le bus (7 bits + R/W=0 pour écriture).
212 * LiquidCrystal_I2C(0x3E) Grove : octet d'adresse = 0x3E.
213 */
214export function i2cWriteAddress8From7bit(addr7) {
215 return ((addr7 & 0x7f) << 1) & 0xfe;
216}
217
218export function groveLcdBusAddress8(addrFromSketch) {
219 const a = addrFromSketch & 0xff;
220 if (a >= 0x80) return a;
221 if (a <= 0x7f && (a & 1) === 0 && a >= 0x20) return a;
222 return i2cWriteAddress8From7bit(a);
223}
