1/**
2 * Encode les opérations LiquidCrystal_I2C (PCF8574 + HD44780 4 bits) en transactions I²C.
3 * Compatible bibliothèque Frank de Brabander / Grove 104020112.
4 */
5
6import { parseGroveLcdFromSketch } from "./grove-lcd-sketch-parse.mjs";
7import { I2cMasterWaveform, groveLcdBusAddress8, repeatI2cWaveform } from "./i2c-protocol.mjs";
8
9const RS = 0x01;
10const EN = 0x04;
11const BL = 0x08;
12
13const LCD_CLEAR = 0x01;
14const LCD_ENTRYMODE = 0x06;
15const LCD_DISPLAYON = 0x0c;
16const LCD_FUNCTIONSET = 0x28;
17const LCD_SETDDRAM = 0x80;
18const LCD_SHIFT_LEFT = 0x18;
19const LCD_SHIFT_RIGHT = 0x1c;
20
21function ddramAddr(col, row) {
22 return row === 0 ? col : 0x40 + col;
23}
24
25function extractParenArg(body, openParenIndex) {
26 let i = openParenIndex + 1;
27 let depth = 1;
28 const start = i;
29 while (i < body.length && depth > 0) {
30 if (body[i] === "(") depth++;
31 else if (body[i] === ")") depth--;
32 i++;
33 }
34 return body.slice(start, i - 1);
35}
36
37function parsePrintArg(arg) {
38 const t = String(arg || "").trim();
39 const fMacro = t.match(/^F\s*\(\s*(["'])([\s\S]*?)\1\s*\)/);
40 if (fMacro) return fMacro[2];
41 if ((t.startsWith('"') && t.endsWith('"')) || (t.startsWith("'") && t.endsWith("'"))) {
42 return t.slice(1, -1);
43 }
44 return "";
45}
46
47/** @returns {number[]} octets PCF8574 pour une impulsion EN (2 writes I²C). */
48function expanderPulseBytes(value, backlight) {
49 const bl = backlight ? BL : 0;
50 const base = (value & 0xff) | bl;
51 return [base | EN, base & ~EN];
52}
53
54function encodeWrite4bits(wave, addr8, nibbleData, rs, backlight) {
55 const hi = (nibbleData & 0xf0) | rs;
56 const lo = ((nibbleData & 0x0f) << 4) | rs;
57 for (const val of [hi, lo]) {
58 for (const b of expanderPulseBytes(val, backlight)) {
59 wave.writeTransaction(addr8, [b]);
60 }
61 }
62}
63
64function encodeCommand(wave, addr8, cmd, backlight) {
65 encodeWrite4bits(wave, addr8, cmd, 0, backlight);
66}
67
68function encodeData(wave, addr8, data, backlight) {
69 encodeWrite4bits(wave, addr8, data, RS, backlight);
70}
71
72function encodeHd44780Init(wave, addr8, backlight) {
73 encodeWrite4bits(wave, addr8, 0x03, 0, backlight);
74 encodeWrite4bits(wave, addr8, 0x03, 0, backlight);
75 encodeWrite4bits(wave, addr8, 0x03, 0, backlight);
76 encodeWrite4bits(wave, addr8, 0x02, 0, backlight);
77 encodeCommand(wave, addr8, LCD_FUNCTIONSET, backlight);
78 encodeCommand(wave, addr8, LCD_DISPLAYON, backlight);
79 encodeCommand(wave, addr8, LCD_ENTRYMODE, backlight);
80 encodeCommand(wave, addr8, LCD_CLEAR, backlight);
81}
82
83function encodeSetCursor(wave, addr8, col, row, backlight) {
84 encodeCommand(wave, addr8, LCD_SETDDRAM | ddramAddr(col, row), backlight);
85}
86
87function encodePrintText(wave, addr8, text, backlight) {
88 for (const ch of String(text || "")) {
89 encodeData(wave, addr8, ch.charCodeAt(0) & 0xff, backlight);
90 }
91}
92
93function extractFunctionBody(src, name) {
94 const idx = src.search(new RegExp(`\\b(?:void|int)\\s+${name}\\s*\\([^)]*\\)\\s*\\{`, "i"));
95 if (idx < 0) return "";
96 let i = src.indexOf("{", idx);
97 if (i < 0) return "";
98 let depth = 0;
99 const start = i + 1;
100 for (; i < src.length; i++) {
101 if (src[i] === "{") depth++;
102 else if (src[i] === "}") {
103 depth--;
104 if (depth === 0) return src.slice(start, i);
105 }
106 }
107 return "";
108}
109
110/**
111 * Rejoue setup()/loop() du sketch et génère le bus I²C complet (100 kHz, START/ACK/STOP).
112 * @param {string} sketch
113 * @param {number} [repeatUntilSec=0.02]
114 */
115export function buildLcdI2cWaveformFromSketch(sketch, repeatUntilSec = 0.02) {
116 const parsed = parseGroveLcdFromSketch(sketch || "");
117 if (!parsed) return null;
118
119 const addr8 = groveLcdBusAddress8(parsed.address);
120 const wave = new I2cMasterWaveform();
121 let backlight = true;
122 let initDone = false;
123
124 const src = String(sketch || "").replace(/\/\/[^\n]*/g, "").replace(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g, "");
125 const varName = parsed.varName;
126
127 for (const fn of ["setup", "loop"]) {
128 const body = extractFunctionBody(src, fn);
129 if (!body) continue;
130 const lcdRe = new RegExp(`\\b${varName}\\.(\\w+)\\s*\\(`, "gi");
131 let m;
132 while ((m = lcdRe.exec(body)) !== null) {
133 const op = m[1].toLowerCase();
134 const open = m.index + m[0].length - 1;
135 const args = extractParenArg(body, open);
136 if (op === "init" || op === "begin") {
137 if (!initDone) {
138 encodeHd44780Init(wave, addr8, backlight);
139 initDone = true;
140 }
141 continue;
142 }
143 if (!initDone) {
144 encodeHd44780Init(wave, addr8, backlight);
145 initDone = true;
146 }
147 if (op === "backlight") {
148 backlight = true;
149 continue;
150 }
151 if (op === "nobacklight") {
152 backlight = false;
153 continue;
154 }
155 if (op === "clear") {
156 encodeCommand(wave, addr8, LCD_CLEAR, backlight);
157 continue;
158 }
159 if (op === "scrolldisplayleft") {
160 encodeCommand(wave, addr8, LCD_SHIFT_LEFT, backlight);
161 continue;
162 }
163 if (op === "scrolldisplayright") {
164 encodeCommand(wave, addr8, LCD_SHIFT_RIGHT, backlight);
165 continue;
166 }
167 if (op === "home") {
168 encodeSetCursor(wave, addr8, 0, 0, backlight);
169 continue;
170 }
171 if (op === "setcursor") {
172 const parts = args.split(",").map((x) => x.trim());
173 const col = Math.max(0, parseInt(parts[0], 10) || 0);
174 const row = Math.max(0, parseInt(parts[1], 10) || 0);
175 encodeSetCursor(wave, addr8, col, row, backlight);
176 continue;
177 }
178 if (op === "print" || op === "write") {
179 const text = parsePrintArg(args.split(",")[0]);
180 if (text) encodePrintText(wave, addr8, text, backlight);
181 }
182 }
183 }
184
185 if (!initDone) {
186 encodeHd44780Init(wave, addr8, backlight);
187 }
188
189 const once = wave.toPwl();
190 return repeatI2cWaveform(once, repeatUntilSec);
191}

8} from "./logic-sequential.mjs";
9import { logicJkXspiceInternalNodeKeys } from "./logic-xspice.mjs";

11export const IC90_PIN = {
12 CP1: 0,
13 MR1: 1,
14 MR2: 2,
15 NC4: 3,
16 VCC: 4,
17 MS1: 5,
18 MS2: 6,
19 Q2: 7,

54export function ic74hc90InputNodeKeys(c) {

57 `${c.id}#${IC90_PIN.CP1}`,
58 `${c.id}#${IC90_PIN.MR1}`,

76export function ic74hc90InternalNodeKeys(c, opts = {}) {

79 `${c.id}#__ms`,
80 `${c.id}#__rst_mid`,
81 `${c.id}#__set_lo`,

96function stepGt(node, th) {

100/**
101 * 74HC90 modélisé avec 4 bascules JK (datasheet) :
102 * - FFA (Q0) : diviseur par 2, J=K=1, horloge CP0 (front descendant).
103 * - Section ÷5 SYNCHRONE (CP1) :
104 * FFB (Q1) : J=/Q3, K=1, horloge CP1↓
105 * FFC (Q2) : J=K=1, horloge Q1↓ (ripple interne ÷5)
106 * FFD (Q3) : J=Q1·Q2, K=1, horloge CP1↓
107 * Aucune remise à zéro « décade » asynchrone auto-effaçante : la section ÷5
108 * boucle naturellement (0→4→0), ce qui supprime la course qui faisait
109 * « repartir de 4 » dès qu'on prélevait Q0/Q3 (report cascade).

113export function appendIc74hc90Netlist(c, nodeFor, vhi, lines, spiceBranchName, deckOpts = {}) {

116 const B = (suffix) => `${spiceBranchName("B", c.id)}${suffix}`;

118 const nMr1 = nodeFor(`${c.id}#${IC90_PIN.MR1}`);
119 const nMr2 = nodeFor(`${c.id}#${IC90_PIN.MR2}`);
120 const nMs1 = nodeFor(`${c.id}#${IC90_PIN.MS1}`);
121 const nMs2 = nodeFor(`${c.id}#${IC90_PIN.MS2}`);
122 const nMr = nodeFor(`${c.id}#__mr`);
123 const nMs = nodeFor(`${c.id}#__ms`);
124 const nRstMid = nodeFor(`${c.id}#__rst_mid`);
125 const nSetLo = nodeFor(`${c.id}#__set_lo`);
126 const nOne = nodeFor(`${c.id}#__one`);
127
128 lines.push(`${B("_mr")} ${nMr} 0 V = { ${stepGt(nMr1, th)}*${stepGt(nMr2, th)}*${v} }`);
129 lines.push(`${B("_ms")} ${nMs} 0 V = { ${stepGt(nMs1, th)}*${stepGt(nMs2, th)}*${v} }`);
130 // Reset des bascules Q1/Q2 : MR OU MS (le 9 a Q1=Q2=0).
131 lines.push(
132 `${B("_rstm")} ${nRstMid} 0 V = { (${stepGt(nMr, th)}+${stepGt(nMs, th)}-${stepGt(nMr, th)}*${stepGt(nMs, th)})*${v} }`
133 );
134 lines.push(`${spiceBranchName("V", c.id)}_setlo ${nSetLo} 0 DC 0`);
135 lines.push(`${B("_one")} ${nOne} 0 V = { ${v} }`);
136
137 const nCp0 = nodeFor(`${c.id}#${IC90_PIN.CP0}`);
138 const nCp1 = nodeFor(`${c.id}#${IC90_PIN.CP1}`);
139 const nQ0 = nodeFor(`${c.id}#${IC90_PIN.Q0}`);
140 const nQ1 = nodeFor(`${c.id}#${IC90_PIN.Q1}`);
141 const nQ2 = nodeFor(`${c.id}#${IC90_PIN.Q2}`);
142 const nQ3 = nodeFor(`${c.id}#${IC90_PIN.Q3}`);
143
144 // Entrées J combinatoires de la section ÷5.
145 const nJb = nodeFor(`${c.id}#__jb`); // FFB : J = /Q3
146 lines.push(`${B("_jb")} ${nJb} 0 V = { (1-${stepGt(nQ3, th)})*${v} }`);
147 const nJd = nodeFor(`${c.id}#__jd`); // FFD : J = Q1·Q2
148 lines.push(`${B("_jd")} ${nJd} 0 V = { ${stepGt(nQ1, th)}*${stepGt(nQ2, th)}*${v} }`);
149
150 // Horloges inversées : déclenchement sur front descendant (74HC90 = négatif).
151 const nClkA = nodeFor(`${c.id}#__clka`); // /CP0
152 const nClkBD = nodeFor(`${c.id}#__clkbd`); // /CP1
153 const nClkC = nodeFor(`${c.id}#__clkc`); // /Q1 (ripple FFC)
154 // Pendant MR actif, geler toutes les horloges : sinon Q1↓ lors du reset asynchrone
155 // horloge FFC (J=K=1) et le compteur se fige à 4 ; un front CP0 résiduel
156 // (report cascade) peut aussi corrompre l'état juste après le reset.
157 const mrOn = stepGt(nMr, th);
158 lines.push(
159 `${B("_clka")} ${nClkA} 0 V = { (1-(${mrOn}))*(${v} - V(${nCp0})) + (${mrOn})*${v} }`
160 );
161 lines.push(
162 `${B("_clkbd")} ${nClkBD} 0 V = { (1-(${mrOn}))*(${v} - V(${nCp1})) + (${mrOn})*${v} }`
163 );
164 lines.push(
165 `${B("_clkc")} ${nClkC} 0 V = { (1-(${mrOn}))*(${v} - V(${nQ1})) + (${mrOn})*${v} }`
166 );
167
168 const slices = [
169 { sfx: "u0", q: nQ0, clk: nClkA, j: nOne, k: nOne, set: nMs, reset: nMr, srWired: { set: true, reset: true } },
170 { sfx: "u1", q: nQ1, clk: nClkBD, j: nJb, k: nOne, set: nSetLo, reset: nRstMid, srWired: { set: false, reset: true } },
171 { sfx: "u2", q: nQ2, clk: nClkC, j: nOne, k: nOne, set: nSetLo, reset: nMr, srWired: { set: false, reset: true } },
172 { sfx: "u3", q: nQ3, clk: nClkBD, j: nJd, k: nOne, set: nMs, reset: nMr, srWired: { set: true, reset: true } },
173 ];
174
175 slices.forEach((sl, i) => {
176 const subId = `${c.id}_${sl.sfx}`;
177 const nQbar = nodeFor(`${c.id}#__qb${i}`);
178 // Remap des broches JK (#0 J, #1 K, #2 CLK, #3 Q, #4 /Q, #5 Set, #6 Reset).
179 const sub = { id: subId, type: "logic_jk" };
180 const sliceNodeFor = (key) => {
181 if (key === `${subId}#0`) return sl.j;
182 if (key === `${subId}#1`) return sl.k;
183 if (key === `${subId}#2`) return sl.clk;
184 if (key === `${subId}#3`) return sl.q;
185 if (key === `${subId}#4`) return nQbar;
186 if (key === `${subId}#5`) return sl.set;
187 if (key === `${subId}#6`) return sl.reset;
188 return nodeFor(key);
189 };
190 appendLogicJkNetlist(sub, sliceNodeFor, v, lines, spiceBranchName, {
191 ...deckOpts,
192 srWired: sl.srWired,
193 });
194 });
195}
196
197export function resolveIc74hc90Vhi(c, logicVhiByTerminal, parseLogicRail, logicVhiFn) {
198 const vccKey = `${c.id}#${ic74hc90VccPinIndex()}`;
199 let vhi = logicVhiByTerminal.get(vccKey) ?? 0;
200 for (const k of ic74hc90InputNodeKeys(c)) {
201 vhi = Math.max(vhi, logicVhiByTerminal.get(k) ?? 0);
202 }
203 for (const k of ic74hc90OutputNodeKeys(c)) {
204 vhi = Math.max(vhi, logicVhiByTerminal.get(k) ?? 0);
205 }
206 if (c.logicRail != null && c.logicRail !== "") {
207 vhi = Math.max(vhi, logicVhiFn(parseLogicRail(c.logicRail)));
208 }
209 return vhi > 0 ? vhi : 5;
210}

1/**
2 * CD4511 via sources comportementales (sans XSPICE d_genlut / d_dlatch).
3 * Compatible ngspice-39 Linux (Render, Docker).
4 */
5import {
6 cd4511InputPinIndices,
7 cd4511OutputPinIndices,
8} from "./logic-cd4511-xspice.mjs";
9
10const SEG_NAMES = ["a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f", "g"];
11
12const BCD_SEGMENTS = [
13 [1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0],
14 [0, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0],
15 [1, 1, 0, 1, 1, 0, 1],
16 [1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0, 1],
17 [0, 1, 1, 0, 0, 1, 1],
18 [1, 0, 1, 1, 0, 1, 1],
19 [1, 0, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1],
20 [1, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0],
21 [1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1],
22 [1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 1, 1],
23];
24
25const LATCH_STATE_C_F = 100e-9;
26const LATCH_Q_R_OHM = 10e3;
27
28function stepGt(node, th) {
29 return `u(V(${node})-${th})`;
30}
31
32function bitMatchExpr(nPin, bitVal, th) {
33 return bitVal ? stepGt(nPin, th) : `(1-${stepGt(nPin, th)})`;
34}
35
36/** Somme de produits BCD → un segment (après latch). */
37export function bcdLatchSegDecodeExpr(nA, nB, nC, nD, segIdx, th) {
38 const terms = [];
39 for (let d = 0; d <= 9; d++) {
40 if (!BCD_SEGMENTS[d][segIdx]) continue;
41 const t = [
42 bitMatchExpr(nA, d & 1, th),
43 bitMatchExpr(nB, d & 2, th),
44 bitMatchExpr(nC, d & 4, th),
45 bitMatchExpr(nD, d & 8, th),
46 ].join("*");
47 terms.push(`(${t})`);
48 }
49 return terms.length ? `(${terms.join("+")})` : "0";
50}
51
52export function logicCd4511BsourceInternalNodeKeys(c) {
53 if (!c?.id) return [];
54 const keys = [];
55 for (const s of ["a", "b", "c", "d"]) {
56 keys.push(`__inbuf_${s}`, `__lat_${s}`, `__lat_${s}_qi`);
57 }
58 return keys.map((k) => `${c.id}#${k}`);
59}
60
61/**
62 * @param {object} c composant logic_cd4511
63 */
64export function appendLogicCd4511BsourceNetlist(c, nodeFor, vhi, lines, spiceBranchName, opts = {}) {
65 const th = vhi > 0 ? vhi / 2 : 2.5;
66 const v = vhi > 0 ? vhi : 5;
67 const pins = cd4511InputPinIndices();
68 const outs = cd4511OutputPinIndices();
69
70 const nA = nodeFor(`${c.id}#${pins.A}`);
71 const nB = nodeFor(`${c.id}#${pins.B}`);
72 const nC = nodeFor(`${c.id}#${pins.C}`);
73 const nD = nodeFor(`${c.id}#${pins.D}`);
74 const nLE = nodeFor(`${c.id}#${pins.LE}`);
75 if (!opts.leWired) {
76 lines.push(`${spiceBranchName("V", c.id)}_lep ${nLE} 0 DC 0`);
77 }
78 const nBI = nodeFor(`${c.id}#${pins.BI}`);
79 const nLT = nodeFor(`${c.id}#${pins.LT}`);
80 if (!opts.biWired) {
81 lines.push(`${spiceBranchName("V", c.id)}_bipu ${nBI} 0 DC ${v}`);
82 }
83 if (!opts.ltWired) {
84 lines.push(`${spiceBranchName("V", c.id)}_ltpu ${nLT} 0 DC ${v}`);
85 }
86
87 const leTransparent = `(1-${stepGt(nLE, th)})`;
88
89 // Entrées BCD lues via VCVS (haute impédance) : évite de perturber les Q des bascules
90 // ripple au reset asynchrone (symptôme 9→4 au lieu de 9→0 quand B/D partagent le fil AND).
91 const inputBuf = (suffix, nIn) => {
92 const nBuf = nodeFor(`${c.id}#__inbuf_${suffix}`);
93 lines.push(`${spiceBranchName("E", c.id)}_buf${suffix} ${nBuf} 0 ${nIn} 0 1`);
94 return nBuf;
95 };
96
97 const latchBit = (suffix, nIn) => {
98 const nLat = nodeFor(`${c.id}#__lat_${suffix}`);
99 const nQi = nodeFor(`${c.id}#__lat_${suffix}_qi`);
100 const inHi = stepGt(nIn, th);
101 lines.push(
102 `${spiceBranchName("B", c.id)}_lat${suffix} ${nQi} 0 V = { (${leTransparent}*${inHi}+(1-${leTransparent})*${stepGt(nLat, th)})*${v} }`
103 );
104 lines.push(`${spiceBranchName("R", c.id)}_lat${suffix} ${nQi} ${nLat} ${LATCH_Q_R_OHM}`);
105 lines.push(`${spiceBranchName("C", c.id)}_lat${suffix} ${nLat} 0 ${LATCH_STATE_C_F}`);
106 return nLat;
107 };
108
109 const nLa = latchBit("a", inputBuf("a", nA));
110 const nLb = latchBit("b", inputBuf("b", nB));
111 const nLc = latchBit("c", inputBuf("c", nC));
112 const nLd = latchBit("d", inputBuf("d", nD));
113
114 const biOn = stepGt(nBI, th);
115 const ltActive = `(1-${stepGt(nLT, th)})`;
116
117 SEG_NAMES.forEach((s, segIdx) => {
118 const decode = bcdLatchSegDecodeExpr(nLa, nLb, nLc, nLd, segIdx, th);
119 const nOut = nodeFor(`${c.id}#${outs[s]}`);
120 lines.push(
121 `${spiceBranchName("B", c.id)}_seg${s} ${nOut} 0 V = { (${biOn}*(${ltActive}+${decode}*(1-${ltActive})))*${v} }`
122 );
123 });
124}
125

Simulateur/Engine/logic-cd4511-xspice.mjs — 194 lignes

1/**
2 * CD4511 (BCD → 7 segments, latch LE, BI, LT) via XSPICE :
3 * adc_bridge, d_dlatch (×4), d_genlut, d_or / d_and, dac_bridge.
4 */
5import { xspiceLogicThresholds } from "./logic-xspice.mjs";
6
7/** Chiffres 0–9 : segments a,b,c,d,e,f,g (1 = segment actif, cathode commune). */
8const BCD_SEGMENTS = [
9 [1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0],
10 [0, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0],
11 [1, 1, 0, 1, 1, 0, 1],
12 [1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0, 1],
13 [0, 1, 1, 0, 0, 1, 1],
14 [1, 0, 1, 1, 0, 1, 1],
15 [1, 0, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1],
16 [1, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0],
17 [1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1],
18 [1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 1, 1],
19];
20
21/** table_values pour d_genlut : 4 entrées [A B C D], 7 sorties a…g (concaténées). */
22export function cd4511BcdToSegGenlutTable() {
23 let table = "";
24 for (let seg = 0; seg < 7; seg++) {
25 table += cd4511SegGenlutTable(seg);
26 }
27 return table;
28}
29
30/** Une sortie 7-seg : 16 bits (2⁴ entrées BCD) pour compatibilité ngspice-39 (1 sortie / d_genlut). */
31export function cd4511SegGenlutTable(segIndex) {
32 let table = "";
33 for (let val = 0; val < 16; val++) {
34 if (val <= 9 && BCD_SEGMENTS[val][segIndex]) table += "1";
35 else table += "0";
36 }
37 return table;
38}
39
40export function cd4511InputPinIndices() {
41 return { A: 0, B: 1, C: 2, D: 3, LE: 4, BI: 5, LT: 6 };
42}
43
44export function cd4511OutputPinIndices() {
45 return { a: 7, b: 8, c: 9, d: 10, e: 11, f: 12, g: 13 };
46}
47
48export function cd4511InputNodeKeys(c) {
49 const p = cd4511InputPinIndices();
50 return Object.values(p).map((i) => `${c.id}#${i}`);
51}
52
53export function cd4511OutputNodeKeys(c) {
54 const p = cd4511OutputPinIndices();
55 return Object.values(p).map((i) => `${c.id}#${i}`);
56}
57
58const SEG_NAMES = ["a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f", "g"];
59
60/**
61 * @param {object} c composant logic_cd4511
62 * @param {function} nodeFor
63 * @param {number} vhi
64 * @param {string[]} lines
65 * @param {function} spiceBranchName
66 * @param {{ biWired?: boolean; ltWired?: boolean; leWired?: boolean }} [opts]
67 */
68export function appendLogicCd4511XspiceNetlist(c, nodeFor, vhi, lines, spiceBranchName, opts = {}) {
69 const th = xspiceLogicThresholds(vhi);
70 const v = vhi > 0 ? vhi : 5;
71 const pins = cd4511InputPinIndices();
72 const outs = cd4511OutputPinIndices();
73
74 const nA = nodeFor(`${c.id}#${pins.A}`);
75 const nB = nodeFor(`${c.id}#${pins.B}`);
76 const nC = nodeFor(`${c.id}#${pins.C}`);
77 const nD = nodeFor(`${c.id}#${pins.D}`);
78 const nLE = nodeFor(`${c.id}#${pins.LE}`);
79 if (!opts.leWired) {
80 lines.push(`${spiceBranchName("V", c.id)}_lep ${nLE} 0 DC 0`);
81 }
82 const nBI = nodeFor(`${c.id}#${pins.BI}`);
83 const nLT = nodeFor(`${c.id}#${pins.LT}`);
84
85 const mAdc = `${c.id}_m_adcio`;
86 const mDac = `${c.id}_m_dac`;
87 lines.push(`.model ${mAdc} adc_bridge(in_low=${th.inLow} in_high=${th.inHigh})`);
88 lines.push(
89 `.model ${mDac} dac_bridge(out_low=${th.outLow} out_high=${th.outHigh} t_rise=2e-9 t_fall=2e-9)`
90 );
91
92 const ndZero = nodeFor(`${c.id}#__xd_zero`);
93 const nZa = nodeFor(`${c.id}#__xa_zero`);
94 lines.push(`${spiceBranchName("V", c.id)}_xz ${nZa} 0 DC 0`);
95 lines.push(`${spiceBranchName("A", c.id)}_adcz [${nZa}] [${ndZero}] ${mAdc}`);
96
97 let ndPullHi = null;
98 const pullHighDigital = () => {
99 if (ndPullHi) return ndPullHi;
100 const nPullA = nodeFor(`${c.id}#__xa_pull`);
101 ndPullHi = nodeFor(`${c.id}#__xd_pull`);
102 lines.push(`${spiceBranchName("V", c.id)}_pull ${nPullA} 0 DC ${v}`);
103 lines.push(`${spiceBranchName("A", c.id)}_adcpull [${nPullA}] [${ndPullHi}] ${mAdc}`);
104 return ndPullHi;
105 };
106
107 const adcIn = (suffix, nAnalog) => {
108 const nd = nodeFor(`${c.id}#__xd_in_${suffix}`);
109 lines.push(`${spiceBranchName("A", c.id)}_adc${suffix} [${nAnalog}] [${nd}] ${mAdc}`);
110 return nd;
111 };
112
113 const ndA = adcIn("a", nA);
114 const ndB = adcIn("b", nB);
115 const ndC = adcIn("c", nC);
116 const ndD = adcIn("d", nD);
117
118 const ndBI = opts.biWired ? adcIn("bi", nBI) : pullHighDigital();
119 let ndLTbar;
120 if (opts.ltWired) {
121 const nLTinvA = nodeFor(`${c.id}#__xa_ltinv`);
122 lines.push(`${spiceBranchName("B", c.id)}_ltinv ${nLTinvA} 0 V = { ${v} - V(${nLT}) }`);
123 ndLTbar = nodeFor(`${c.id}#__xd_ltbar`);
124 lines.push(`${spiceBranchName("A", c.id)}_adcltbar [${nLTinvA}] [${ndLTbar}] ${mAdc}`);
125 } else {
126 lines.push(`${spiceBranchName("V", c.id)}_ltpu ${nLT} 0 DC ${v}`);
127 ndLTbar = ndZero;
128 }
129
130 // LE actif bas → transparent ; d_dlatch : enable=1 suit data, enable=0 mémorise.
131 const nLEenA = nodeFor(`${c.id}#__xa_le_en`);
132 lines.push(`${spiceBranchName("B", c.id)}_leen ${nLEenA} 0 V = { ${v} - V(${nLE}) }`);
133 const ndLEen = nodeFor(`${c.id}#__xd_le_en`);
134 lines.push(`${spiceBranchName("A", c.id)}_adcleen [${nLEenA}] [${ndLEen}] ${mAdc}`);
135
136 const mLatch = `${c.id}_m_dlatch`;
137 lines.push(
138 `.model ${mLatch} d_dlatch(data_delay=2e-9 enable_delay=2e-9 rise_delay=2e-9 fall_delay=2e-9 ic=0)`
139 );
140
141 const latchBit = (bit, ndIn) => {
142 const ndLat = nodeFor(`${c.id}#__xd_lat_${bit}`);
143 const ndQb = nodeFor(`${c.id}#__xd_lat_${bit}qb`);
144 lines.push(
145 `${spiceBranchName("A", c.id)}_lt${bit} ${ndIn} ${ndLEen} ${ndZero} ${ndZero} ${ndLat} ${ndQb} ${mLatch}`
146 );
147 return ndLat;
148 };
149
150 const ndLa = latchBit("a", ndA);
151 const ndLb = latchBit("b", ndB);
152 const ndLc = latchBit("c", ndC);
153 const ndLd = latchBit("d", ndD);
154
155 // 7× d_genlut 4→1 (évite « Defaulted array parameter… » sur ngspice Linux / Render).
156 const ndSeg = SEG_NAMES.map((s, segIdx) => {
157 const mSeg = `${c.id}_m_lut_${s}`;
158 const ndOut = nodeFor(`${c.id}#__xd_seg_${s}`);
159 lines.push(`.model ${mSeg} d_genlut(table_values="${cd4511SegGenlutTable(segIdx)}")`);
160 lines.push(
161 `${spiceBranchName("A", c.id)}_dec${s} [${ndLa} ${ndLb} ${ndLc} ${ndLd}] [${ndOut}] ${mSeg}`
162 );
163 return ndOut;
164 });
165
166 const mOr = `${c.id}_m_or`;
167 const mAnd = `${c.id}_m_and`;
168 lines.push(`.model ${mOr} d_or(rise_delay=2e-9 fall_delay=2e-9)`);
169 lines.push(`.model ${mAnd} d_and(rise_delay=2e-9 fall_delay=2e-9)`);
170
171 SEG_NAMES.forEach((s, i) => {
172 const ndTmp = nodeFor(`${c.id}#__xd_${s}_pre`);
173 const ndOutD = nodeFor(`${c.id}#__xd_${s}_out`);
174 // LT actif bas : test lampe = (¬LT) ∨ segment
175 lines.push(`${spiceBranchName("A", c.id)}_or${s} [${ndLTbar} ${ndSeg[i]}] ${ndTmp} ${mOr}`);
176 lines.push(`${spiceBranchName("A", c.id)}_and${s} [${ndTmp} ${ndBI}] ${ndOutD} ${mAnd}`);
177 const nOut = nodeFor(`${c.id}#${outs[s]}`);
178 lines.push(`${spiceBranchName("A", c.id)}_dac${s} [${ndOutD}] [${nOut}] ${mDac}`);
179 });
180}
181
182export function logicCd4511XspiceInternalNodeKeys(c) {
183 if (!c?.id) return [];
184 const keys = ["__xd_zero", "__xa_zero", "__xa_pull", "__xd_pull", "__xa_le_en", "__xd_le_en"];
185 for (const s of ["a", "b", "c", "d"]) {
186 keys.push(`__xd_in_${s}`, `__xd_lat_${s}`, `__xd_lat_${s}qb`);
187 }
188 keys.push("__xd_in_bi", "__xa_ltinv", "__xd_ltbar");
189 for (const s of SEG_NAMES) {
190 keys.push(`__xd_seg_${s}`, `__xd_${s}_pre`, `__xd_${s}_out`);
191 }
192 return keys.map((k) => `${c.id}#${k}`);
193}

1/** Niveaux logiques en tension (analogique ngspice) : 0 V et rail 3,3 V ou 5 V. */
2
3export function parseLogicRail(raw) {
4 if (raw == null || raw === "") return 5;
5 const n = parseFloat(String(raw).replace(",", "."));
6 return Number.isFinite(n) && Math.abs(n - 3.3) < 0.05 ? 3.3 : 5;
7}
8
9export function toggleLogicRail(rail) {
10 return parseLogicRail(rail) === 3.3 ? 5 : 3.3;
11}
12
13export function logicVhi(rail) {
14 return parseLogicRail(rail);
15}
16
17export function logicVth(rail) {
18 return logicVhi(rail) / 2;
19}
20
21export function logicLevelFromVoltage(v, railOrVth) {
22 if (!Number.isFinite(v)) return null;
23 const th =
24 typeof railOrVth === "number" && railOrVth > 0 && railOrVth < 3
25 ? railOrVth
26 : logicVth(railOrVth);
27 return v >= th ? "1" : "0";
28}
29
30export function formatLogicRailLabel(rail) {
31 return parseLogicRail(rail) === 3.3 ? "3,3 V" : "5 V";
32}
33
34export function parseLogicStateVolts(value, rail) {
35 const t = String(value ?? "")
36 .trim()
37 .toLowerCase();
38 if (t === "1" || t === "haut" || t === "high" || t === "true" || t === "on" || t === "vcc") {
39 return logicVhi(rail);
40 }
41 return 0;
42}

38 return t === "logic_cd4511";

53/** Nœuds internes (pré-déclaration union-find dans schematic-to-spice). */
54export function logicSequentialInternalNodeKeys(c, opts = {}) {
55 if (!c?.id) return [];
56 if (c.type === "logic_dff" && useLogicDffXspice(opts)) {
57 return logicDffXspiceInternalNodeKeys(c, opts);
58 }
59 if (c.type === "logic_dff") {
60 return [`${c.id}#__qi`, `${c.id}#__clkedge`, `${c.id}#__qbar`];
61 }
62 if (c.type === "logic_jk") {
63 if (useLogicJkXspice(opts)) {
64 return logicJkXspiceInternalNodeKeys(c, opts);
65 }
66 return [`${c.id}#__qi`, `${c.id}#__clkedge`, `${c.id}#__qbar`];
67 }
68 if (isIc74ls74Type(c.type)) {
69 const keys = [];
70 for (const sl of ic74ls74DffSlices()) {
71 keys.push(`${c.id}#__qi${sl.suffix}`, `${c.id}#__clkedge${sl.suffix}`);
72 }
73 return keys;
74 }
75 if (isLogicCd4511Type(c.type)) {
76 return useLogicCd4511Xspice(opts)
77 ? logicCd4511XspiceInternalNodeKeys(c)
78 : logicCd4511BsourceInternalNodeKeys(c);
79 }
80 return [];
81}

113export function logicJkOutputNodeKey(c) {

125/** Quatre portes NAND du 74LS00 (indices de bornes #0…#13). */
126export function ic74ls00NandGates() {
127 return [
128 { a: 0, b: 1, y: 2 },
129 { a: 3, b: 4, y: 5 },
130 { a: 8, b: 9, y: 7 },
131 { a: 11, b: 12, y: 10 },
132 ];
133}

135export function ic74ls00VccPinIndex() {
136 return 13;

139export function ic74ls74VccPinIndex() {

143/** Double bascule D 74LS74 : broches D, CLK, Q (indices #0…#13). */
144export function ic74ls74DffSlices() {
145 return [
146 { suffix: "1", d: 1, clk: 2, q: 4 },
147 { suffix: "2", d: 11, clk: 10, q: 8 },
148 ];
149}
150
151/** RC plus lents : évite « Timestep too small » sur __qi en .tran (surtout D relié à /Q). */
152const CLK_EDGE_C_F = 1e-9;
153const CLK_EDGE_R_OHM = 10e3;
154const FF_STATE_C_F = 10e-9;
155const FF_Q_R_OHM = 1e3;
156const FF_QBAR_R_OHM = 1e3;
157
158/** Encore plus lent si D et /Q sont court-circuités (diviseur par 2) — ngspice-46. */
159const TOGGLE_CLK_EDGE_C_F = 10e-9;
160const TOGGLE_CLK_EDGE_R_OHM = 100e3;
161const TOGGLE_FF_STATE_C_F = 100e-9;
162const TOGGLE_FF_Q_R_OHM = 10e3;
163const TOGGLE_D_HOLD_C_F = 50e-12;
164
165function stepGt(node, th) {
166 return `u(V(${node})-${th})`;
167}
168
169/**
170 * Front montant sans delay() ni ddt(clk) : RC entre horloge et nœud « edge ».
171 * Impulsion courte quand V(clk) >> V(edge) (condensateur en charge).
172 */
173function risingEdgeFromRc(edgeNode, clkNode, th) {
174 const pulseTh = Math.max(0.25, th * 0.12);
175 return `(u(V(${clkNode})-${th})*u(V(${clkNode})-V(${edgeNode})-${pulseTh}))`;
176}
177
178/** Front descendant (compteur ripple : horloge = Q de l'étage précédent). */
179function fallingEdgeFromRc(edgeNode, clkNode, th) {
180 const pulseTh = Math.max(0.25, th * 0.12);
181 return `(u(V(${edgeNode})-${th})*u(V(${edgeNode})-V(${clkNode})-${pulseTh}))`;
182}
183
184/** Horloge reliée à la sortie Q d'une autre bascule (chaînage ripple). */
185export function logicFlipFlopClockNodeKey(c) {
186 if (c.type === "logic_dff") return `${c.id}#1`;
187 if (c.type === "logic_jk") return `${c.id}#2`;
188 return null;
189}
190
191export function logicFlipFlopOutputNodeKey(c) {
192 if (c.type === "logic_dff") return `${c.id}#2`;
193 if (c.type === "logic_jk") return `${c.id}#3`;
194 return null;
195}
196
197export function logicFlipFlopQbarOutputNodeKey(c) {
198 if (c.type === "logic_dff") return logicDffQbarOutputNodeKey(c);
199 if (c.type === "logic_jk") return logicJkQbarOutputNodeKey(c);
200 return null;
201}
202
203/**
204 * Chaînage ripple : horloge = Q ou /Q de l'étage précédent.
205 * @returns {'q'|'qbar'|null}
206 */
207export function getRippleClockFromPrev(c, wires, components) {
208 if (!c?.id || !isLogicSequentialType(c.type)) return null;
209 const clkKey = logicFlipFlopClockNodeKey(c);
210 if (!clkKey) return null;
211 for (const w of wires) {
212 if (!w?.solid || !w.fromKey || !w.toKey) continue;
213 let otherKey = null;
214 if (w.fromKey === clkKey) otherKey = w.toKey;
215 else if (w.toKey === clkKey) otherKey = w.fromKey;
216 if (!otherKey) continue;
217 for (const prev of components) {
218 if (!isLogicSequentialType(prev.type) || prev.id === c.id) continue;
219 if (otherKey === logicFlipFlopOutputNodeKey(prev)) return "q";
220 if (otherKey === logicFlipFlopQbarOutputNodeKey(prev)) return "qbar";
221 }
222 }
223 return null;
224}
225
226/** @deprecated Utiliser getRippleClockFromPrev(c) === 'q' */
227export function isRippleClockFromPrevQ(c, wires, components) {
228 return getRippleClockFromPrev(c, wires, components) === "q";
229}
230
231function appendClkEdgeDetector(clkNode, edgeNode, lines, spiceBranchName, idLabel, cF, rOhm) {
232 lines.push(`${spiceBranchName("C", idLabel)}_cedge ${clkNode} ${edgeNode} ${cF}`);
233 lines.push(`${spiceBranchName("R", idLabel)}_cedge ${edgeNode} 0 ${rOhm}`);
234}
235
236export function logicNandBsourceExpression(aNode, bNode, vhi) {
237 const th = vhi / 2;
238 return `{ (1-${stepGt(aNode, th)}*${stepGt(bNode, th)})*${vhi} }`;
239}
240
241export function logicDffQiExpression(
242 dNode,
243 edgeNode,
244 clkNode,
245 qOutNode,
246 vhi,
247 dFromComplementOfQ = false,
248 setNode = null,
249 resetNode = null,
250 useFallingClockEdge = false
251) {
252 const th = vhi / 2;
253 const edge = useFallingClockEdge
254 ? fallingEdgeFromRc(edgeNode, clkNode, th)
255 : risingEdgeFromRc(edgeNode, clkNode, th);
256 // Si D et /Q sont sur le même nœud, ne pas lire V(D) dans B_qi : boucle avec B_qbar → nœud D.
257 // On impose alors D = ¬Q au front (diviseur par 2), cohérent avec le câblage.
258 const dVal = dFromComplementOfQ
259 ? `(1-${stepGt(qOutNode, th)})*${vhi}`
260 : `${stepGt(dNode, th)}*${vhi}`;
261 const hold = `${stepGt(qOutNode, th)}*${vhi}`;
262 const clocked = `(${edge})*(${dVal}) + (1-(${edge}))*(${hold})`;
263 if (setNode == null && resetNode == null) {
264 return `{ ${clocked} }`;
265 }
266 // Set / Reset asynchrones, actifs à l'état haut, Reset prioritaire sur Set.
267 const set = setNode != null ? stepGt(setNode, th) : "0";
268 const rst = resetNode != null ? stepGt(resetNode, th) : "0";
269 return `{ (1-(${rst}))*( (${set})*${vhi} + (1-(${set}))*(${clocked}) ) }`;
270}
271
272export function logicJkQiExpression(jNode, kNode, edgeNode, clkNode, qOutNode, vhi, setNode = null, resetNode = null, useFallingClockEdge = false) {
273 const th = vhi / 2;
274 const edge = useFallingClockEdge
275 ? fallingEdgeFromRc(edgeNode, clkNode, th)
276 : risingEdgeFromRc(edgeNode, clkNode, th);
277 const j = stepGt(jNode, th);
278 const k = stepGt(kNode, th);
279 const q = stepGt(qOutNode, th);
280 const toggle = `(1-${q})*${vhi}`;
281 const hold = `${q}*${vhi}`;
282 const next = `((${j})*(${k})*(${toggle}) + (${j})*(1-(${k}))*${vhi} + (1-(${j}))*(${k})*0 + (1-(${j}))*(1-(${k}))*(${hold}))`;
283 const clocked = `(${edge})*(${next}) + (1-(${edge}))*(${hold})`;
284 if (setNode == null && resetNode == null) {
285 return `{ ${clocked} }`;
286 }
287 const set = setNode != null ? stepGt(setNode, th) : "0";
288 const rst = resetNode != null ? stepGt(resetNode, th) : "0";
289 return `{ (1-(${rst}))*( (${set})*${vhi} + (1-(${set}))*(${clocked}) ) }`;
290}
291
292function appendQbarDriver(c, nQ, nQbarPin, nodeFor, vhi, lines, spiceBranchName, rSeries = FF_QBAR_R_OHM) {
293 const th = vhi / 2;
294 const nQbarDrv = nodeFor(`${c.id}#__qbar`);
295 lines.push(
296 `${spiceBranchName("B", c.id)}_qbar ${nQbarDrv} 0 V = { (1-${stepGt(nQ, th)})*${vhi} }`
297 );
298 if (nQbarDrv !== nQbarPin) {
299 lines.push(
300 `${spiceBranchName("R", c.id)}_qbr ${nQbarDrv} ${nQbarPin} ${rSeries}`
301 );
302 }
303}
304
305/**
306 * true si bascule D via XSPICE : digital.cm présent + binaire ngspice compilé avec XSPICE.
307 * @param {{ repoRoot?: string; ngspiceExe?: string; ngspiceEnv?: NodeJS.ProcessEnv; forceBsourceDff?: boolean; forceXspiceDff?: boolean }} opts
308 */
309export function useLogicDffXspice(opts = {}) {
310 if (opts.forceBsourceDff === true) return false;
311 if (!isXspiceDffAvailable(opts.repoRoot)) return false;
312 if (opts.forceXspiceDff === true) return true;
313 if (opts.ngspiceExe) return ngspiceHasXspice(opts.ngspiceExe, opts.ngspiceEnv);
314 return false;
315}
316
317export { xspiceCodemodelLines, isXspiceDffAvailable };
318
319export function appendLogicDffNetlist(c, nodeFor, vhi, lines, spiceBranchName, opts = {}) {
320 if (useLogicDffXspice(opts)) {
321 appendLogicDffXspiceNetlist(c, nodeFor, vhi, lines, spiceBranchName, opts);
322 return;
323 }
324 appendLogicDffBsourceNetlist(c, nodeFor, vhi, lines, spiceBranchName, opts);
325}
326
327function appendLogicDffBsourceNetlist(c, nodeFor, vhi, lines, spiceBranchName, opts = {}) {
328 const nD = nodeFor(`${c.id}#0`);
329 const nClk = nodeFor(`${c.id}#1`);
330 const nQ = nodeFor(`${c.id}#2`);
331 const nQbar = nodeFor(`${c.id}#3`);
332 const nSet = nodeFor(`${c.id}#4`);
333 const nReset = nodeFor(`${c.id}#5`);
334 const nQi = nodeFor(`${c.id}#__qi`);
335 const nEdge = nodeFor(`${c.id}#__clkedge`);
336 const dAndQbarShared = nD === nQbar;
337 const cEdge = dAndQbarShared ? TOGGLE_CLK_EDGE_C_F : CLK_EDGE_C_F;
338 const rEdge = dAndQbarShared ? TOGGLE_CLK_EDGE_R_OHM : CLK_EDGE_R_OHM;
339 const cSt = dAndQbarShared ? TOGGLE_FF_STATE_C_F : FF_STATE_C_F;
340 const rQ = dAndQbarShared ? TOGGLE_FF_Q_R_OHM : FF_Q_R_OHM;
341 // Tirage à 0 V des broches Set/Reset : inactives (état bas) si non câblées.
342 lines.push(`${spiceBranchName("R", c.id)}_setpd ${nSet} 0 1e9`);
343 lines.push(`${spiceBranchName("R", c.id)}_rstpd ${nReset} 0 1e9`);
344 const vClk = vhi > 0 ? vhi : 5;
345 let nClkDet = nClk;
346 if (opts.clockInvert && opts.rippleClockFromPrev !== "q") {
347 nClkDet = nodeFor(`${c.id}#__xa_clkinv`);
348 lines.push(
349 `${spiceBranchName("B", c.id)}_clkinv ${nClkDet} 0 V = { ${vClk} - V(${nClk}) }`
350 );
351 }
352 appendClkEdgeDetector(nClkDet, nEdge, lines, spiceBranchName, c.id, cEdge, rEdge);
353 lines.push(
354 `${spiceBranchName("B", c.id)}_qi ${nQi} 0 V = ${logicDffQiExpression(
355 nD,
356 nEdge,
357 nClkDet,
358 nQ,
359 vhi,
360 dAndQbarShared,
361 nSet,
362 nReset,
363 opts.rippleClockFromPrev === "q"
364 )}`
365 );
366 lines.push(`${spiceBranchName("R", c.id)}_q ${nQi} ${nQ} ${rQ}`);
367 lines.push(`${spiceBranchName("C", c.id)}_st ${nQi} 0 ${cSt}`);
368 if (dAndQbarShared) {
369 // D et /Q sur le même fil : piloter directement le nœud D (= /Q) depuis Q, sans nœud
370 // interne __qbar + R (sinon ngspice-46 peut bloquer sur n4 en .tran).
371 const th = vhi / 2;
372 lines.push(
373 `${spiceBranchName("B", c.id)}_qbar ${nD} 0 V = { (1-${stepGt(nQ, th)})*${vhi} }`
374 );
375 lines.push(`${spiceBranchName("C", c.id)}_dhold ${nD} 0 ${TOGGLE_D_HOLD_C_F}`);
376 } else {
377 appendQbarDriver(c, nQ, nQbar, nodeFor, vhi, lines, spiceBranchName);
378 }
379}
380
381/** true si D et /Q partagent le même nœud (fil entre broches 0 et 3). */
382export function logicDffDAndQbarShareNode(c, nodeFor) {
383 return nodeFor(`${c.id}#0`) === nodeFor(`${c.id}#3`);
384}

391 return false;

395 if (opts.forceBsourceCd4511 === true) return false;
396 if (!isXspiceDffAvailable(opts.repoRoot)) return false;
397 if (opts.forceXspiceCd4511 === true) return true;

402export function appendLogicCd4511Netlist(c, nodeFor, vhi, lines, spiceBranchName, opts = {}) {
403 if (useLogicCd4511Xspice(opts)) {
404 appendLogicCd4511XspiceNetlist(c, nodeFor, vhi, lines, spiceBranchName, opts);

410export function resolveLogicCd4511Vhi(c, logicVhiByTerminal, parseLogicRail, logicVhiFn) {
411 let vhi = 0;
412 for (const k of cd4511InputNodeKeys(c)) {
413 vhi = Math.max(vhi, logicVhiByTerminal.get(k) ?? 0);
414 }
415 for (const k of cd4511OutputNodeKeys(c)) {
416 vhi = Math.max(vhi, logicVhiByTerminal.get(k) ?? 0);
417 }
418 if (c.logicRail != null && c.logicRail !== "") {
419 vhi = Math.max(vhi, logicVhiFn(parseLogicRail(c.logicRail)));
420 }
421 if (vhi <= 0) vhi = 5;
422 return vhi > 0 ? vhi : 5;
423}

425export function appendLogicJkNetlist(c, nodeFor, vhi, lines, spiceBranchName, opts = {}) {
426 if (useLogicJkXspice(opts)) {
427 appendLogicJkXspiceNetlist(c, nodeFor, vhi, lines, spiceBranchName, opts);
428 return;
429 }
430 appendLogicJkBsourceNetlist(c, nodeFor, vhi, lines, spiceBranchName, opts);
431}
432
433function appendLogicJkBsourceNetlist(c, nodeFor, vhi, lines, spiceBranchName, opts = {}) {
434 const nJ = nodeFor(`${c.id}#0`);
435 const nK = nodeFor(`${c.id}#1`);
436 const nClk = nodeFor(`${c.id}#2`);
437 const nQ = nodeFor(`${c.id}#3`);
438 const nQbar = nodeFor(`${c.id}#4`);
439 const nSet = nodeFor(`${c.id}#5`);
440 const nReset = nodeFor(`${c.id}#6`);
441 const nQi = nodeFor(`${c.id}#__qi`);
442 const nEdge = nodeFor(`${c.id}#__clkedge`);
443 lines.push(`${spiceBranchName("R", c.id)}_setpd ${nSet} 0 1e9`);
444 lines.push(`${spiceBranchName("R", c.id)}_rstpd ${nReset} 0 1e9`);
445 appendClkEdgeDetector(nClk, nEdge, lines, spiceBranchName, c.id, TOGGLE_CLK_EDGE_C_F, TOGGLE_CLK_EDGE_R_OHM);
446 lines.push(
447 `${spiceBranchName("B", c.id)}_qi ${nQi} 0 V = ${logicJkQiExpression(nJ, nK, nEdge, nClk, nQ, vhi, nSet, nReset, opts.rippleClockFromPrev === "q")}`
448 );
449 lines.push(`${spiceBranchName("R", c.id)}_q ${nQi} ${nQ} ${TOGGLE_FF_Q_R_OHM}`);
450 lines.push(`${spiceBranchName("C", c.id)}_st ${nQi} 0 ${TOGGLE_FF_STATE_C_F}`);
451 appendQbarDriver(c, nQ, nQbar, nodeFor, vhi, lines, spiceBranchName);
452}

454export function appendIc74ls00Netlist(c, nodeFor, vhi, lines, spiceBranchName) {
455 for (let gi = 0; gi < ic74ls00NandGates().length; gi++) {
456 const g = ic74ls00NandGates()[gi];
457 const nA = nodeFor(`${c.id}#${g.a}`);
458 const nB = nodeFor(`${c.id}#${g.b}`);
459 const nY = nodeFor(`${c.id}#${g.y}`);
460 const expr = logicNandBsourceExpression(nA, nB, vhi);
461 lines.push(`${spiceBranchName("B", c.id)}_g${gi + 1} ${nY} 0 V = ${expr}`);
462 }
463}

465function appendLogicDffSlice(c, nodeFor, vhi, lines, spiceBranchName, suffix, dIdx, clkIdx, qIdx) {
466 const nD = nodeFor(`${c.id}#${dIdx}`);
467 const nClk = nodeFor(`${c.id}#${clkIdx}`);
468 const nQ = nodeFor(`${c.id}#${qIdx}`);
469 const nQi = nodeFor(`${c.id}#__qi${suffix}`);
470 const nEdge = nodeFor(`${c.id}#__clkedge${suffix}`);
471 appendClkEdgeDetector(nClk, nEdge, lines, spiceBranchName, `${c.id}${suffix}`, CLK_EDGE_C_F, CLK_EDGE_R_OHM);
472 lines.push(
473 `${spiceBranchName("B", c.id)}_qi${suffix} ${nQi} 0 V = ${logicDffQiExpression(
474 nD,
475 nEdge,
476 nClk,
477 nQ,
478 vhi,
479 false
480 )}`
481 );
482 lines.push(`${spiceBranchName("R", c.id)}_q${suffix} ${nQi} ${nQ} ${FF_Q_R_OHM}`);
483 lines.push(`${spiceBranchName("C", c.id)}_st${suffix} ${nQi} 0 ${FF_STATE_C_F}`);
484}

486export function appendIc74ls74Netlist(c, nodeFor, vhi, lines, spiceBranchName) {
487 for (const sl of ic74ls74DffSlices()) {
488 appendLogicDffSlice(c, nodeFor, vhi, lines, spiceBranchName, sl.suffix, sl.d, sl.clk, sl.q);
489 }

492export function resolveIc74ls74Vhi(c, logicVhiByTerminal, parseLogicRail, logicVhiFn) {
493 const vccKey = `${c.id}#${ic74ls74VccPinIndex()}`;
494 let vhi = logicVhiByTerminal.get(vccKey) ?? 0;
495 for (const sl of ic74ls74DffSlices()) {
496 vhi = Math.max(vhi, logicVhiByTerminal.get(`${c.id}#${sl.d}`) ?? 0);
497 vhi = Math.max(vhi, logicVhiByTerminal.get(`${c.id}#${sl.clk}`) ?? 0);
498 vhi = Math.max(vhi, logicVhiByTerminal.get(`${c.id}#${sl.q}`) ?? 0);
499 }
500 if (c.logicRail != null && c.logicRail !== "") {
501 vhi = Math.max(vhi, logicVhiFn(parseLogicRail(c.logicRail)));
502 }
503 if (vhi <= 0) vhi = 5;
504 return vhi > 0 ? vhi : 5;
505}
506
507export function resolveSequentialVhi(c, logicVhiByTerminal, parseLogicRail, logicVhiFn, inputKeys) {
508 let vhi = 0;
509 for (const k of inputKeys) {
510 vhi = Math.max(vhi, logicVhiByTerminal.get(k) ?? 0);
511 }
512 if (c.logicRail != null && c.logicRail !== "") {
513 vhi = Math.max(vhi, logicVhiFn(parseLogicRail(c.logicRail)));
514 }
515 const outKeys =
516 c.type === "logic_dff"
517 ? logicDffOutputNodeKeys(c)
518 : c.type === "logic_jk"
519 ? logicJkOutputNodeKeys(c)
520 : [];
521 for (const k of outKeys) {
522 vhi = Math.max(vhi, logicVhiByTerminal.get(k) ?? 0);
523 }
524 if (vhi <= 0) vhi = 5;
525 return vhi > 0 ? vhi : 5;
526}
527
528export function resolveIc74ls00Vhi(c, logicVhiByTerminal, parseLogicRail, logicVhiFn) {
529 const vccKey = `${c.id}#${ic74ls00VccPinIndex()}`;
530 let vhi = logicVhiByTerminal.get(vccKey) ?? 0;
531 for (const g of ic74ls00NandGates()) {
532 vhi = Math.max(vhi, logicVhiByTerminal.get(`${c.id}#${g.a}`) ?? 0);
533 vhi = Math.max(vhi, logicVhiByTerminal.get(`${c.id}#${g.b}`) ?? 0);
534 vhi = Math.max(vhi, logicVhiByTerminal.get(`${c.id}#${g.y}`) ?? 0);
535 }

539 if (vhi <= 0) vhi = 5;
540 return vhi > 0 ? vhi : 5;

14 ["Simulateur", "share", "ngspice", "lib", "ngspice", "digital.cm"],

17/**

48export function xspiceLogicThresholds(vhi) {
49 const v = vhi > 0 ? vhi : 5;
50 return {
51 inLow: 0.2 * v,
52 inHigh: 0.8 * v,
53 outLow: 0,
54 outHigh: v,
55 };

78/**
79 * Bascule D XSPICE : broches analogiques via ponts ; cœur numérique d_dff.
80 * @param {object} c composant logic_dff
81 * @param {function} nodeFor clé broche → nœud SPICE
82 * @param {number} vhi
83 * @param {string[]} lines
84 * @param {function} spiceBranchName
85 * @param {{srWired?: {set?: boolean, reset?: boolean}}} [opts]
86 */
87export function appendLogicDffXspiceNetlist(c, nodeFor, vhi, lines, spiceBranchName, opts = {}) {
88 const th = xspiceLogicThresholds(vhi);
89 const srWired = opts.srWired || {};
90 const nD = nodeFor(`${c.id}#0`);
91 const nClk = nodeFor(`${c.id}#1`);
92 const nQ = nodeFor(`${c.id}#2`);
93 const nQbar = nodeFor(`${c.id}#3`);
94 const nSet = nodeFor(`${c.id}#4`);
95 const nReset = nodeFor(`${c.id}#5`);
96
97 const ndData = nodeFor(`${c.id}#__xd_d`);
98 const ndClk = nodeFor(`${c.id}#__xd_clk`);
99 const ndQ = nodeFor(`${c.id}#__xd_q`);
100 const ndQbar = nodeFor(`${c.id}#__xd_qbar`);
101
102 // Seuils mi-rail pour Set/Reset (niveaux logiques 0…Vhi) : actifs à l'état haut (1).
103 const v = vhi > 0 ? vhi : 5;
104 const srLow = 0.4 * v;
105 const srHigh = 0.6 * v;
106
107 const rippleFromQ = opts.rippleClockFromPrev === "q";
108 let nClkAdc = nClk;
109 if (rippleFromQ || opts.clockInvert) {
110 nClkAdc = nodeFor(`${c.id}#__xa_clkinv`);
111 lines.push(
112 `${spiceBranchName("B", c.id)}_clkinv ${nClkAdc} 0 V = { ${v} - V(${nClk}) }`
113 );
114 }
115
116 // Entrées Data / Clock : analogique -> numérique. Data passe toujours par un pont
117 // (même si D est relié à /Q) : la rétroaction traverse alors les délais dac+adc,
118 // ce qui casse la boucle algébrique numérique (sinon la sortie q reste UNKNOWN).
119 lines.push(`${spiceBranchName("A", c.id)}_adcd [${nD}] [${ndData}] ${c.id}_m_adcio`);
120 lines.push(`${spiceBranchName("A", c.id)}_adcc [${nClkAdc}] [${ndClk}] ${c.id}_m_adcio`);
121 lines.push(
122 `.model ${c.id}_m_adcio adc_bridge(in_low=${th.inLow} in_high=${th.inHigh})`
123 );
124
125 // Set / Reset asynchrones. Si une broche n'est PAS câblée, on ne la tire pas par une
126 // simple résistance (un nœud haute impédance reste « UNKNOWN » côté adc_bridge et
127 // contamine la sortie Q). On la relie à un nœud numérique ZÉRO franc, issu d'une
128 // source 0 V dédiée -> adc : état logique bas garanti dès t=0.
129 lines.push(`.model ${c.id}_m_adcsr adc_bridge(in_low=${srLow} in_high=${srHigh})`);
130 let ndZero = null;
131 const zeroNode = () => {
132 if (ndZero) return ndZero;
133 const nZa = nodeFor(`${c.id}#__xa_zero`);
134 ndZero = nodeFor(`${c.id}#__xd_zero`);
135 lines.push(`${spiceBranchName("V", c.id)}_xz ${nZa} 0 DC 0`);
136 lines.push(`${spiceBranchName("A", c.id)}_adcz [${nZa}] [${ndZero}] ${c.id}_m_adcsr`);
137 return ndZero;
138 };
139
140 let ndSet;
141 if (srWired.set) {
142 ndSet = nodeFor(`${c.id}#__xd_set`);
143 lines.push(`${spiceBranchName("A", c.id)}_adcs [${nSet}] [${ndSet}] ${c.id}_m_adcsr`);
144 } else {
145 ndSet = zeroNode();
146 }
147
148 let ndRst;
149 if (srWired.reset) {
150 ndRst = nodeFor(`${c.id}#__xd_rst`);
151 lines.push(`${spiceBranchName("A", c.id)}_adcr [${nReset}] [${ndRst}] ${c.id}_m_adcsr`);
152 } else {
153 ndRst = zeroNode();
154 }
155
156 const mname = dffModelName(c.id);
157 // Reset asynchrone ripple mod-10 : maintien plus long pour éviter 9→4 (course avec l’horloge ripple).
158 const srDelay = opts.rippleMod10 ? "100e-9" : "2e-9";
159 lines.push(
160 `.model ${mname} d_dff(clk_delay=2e-9 set_delay=${srDelay} reset_delay=${srDelay} ic=0 rise_delay=2e-9 fall_delay=2e-9)`
161 );
162
163 // d_dff : ports scalaires (data clk set reset out Nout), sans crochets [ ].
164 lines.push(
165 `${spiceBranchName("A", c.id)}_dff ${ndData} ${ndClk} ${ndSet} ${ndRst} ${ndQ} ${ndQbar} ${mname}`
166 );
167
168 // Sorties numériques -> analogique.
169 lines.push(`${spiceBranchName("A", c.id)}_dacq [${ndQ}] [${nQ}] ${c.id}_m_dac`);
170 lines.push(`${spiceBranchName("A", c.id)}_dacqb [${ndQbar}] [${nQbar}] ${c.id}_m_dac`);
171 lines.push(
172 `.model ${c.id}_m_dac dac_bridge(out_low=${th.outLow} out_high=${th.outHigh} t_rise=2e-9 t_fall=2e-9)`
173 );
174}

Simulateur/Engine/ngspice-xspice-probe.mjs — 92 lignes

1/**
2 * Détecte si le binaire ngspice supporte XSPICE (codemodel + devices A).
3 * ngspice -v n'affiche pas toujours "XSPICE" même si devhelp d_dff fonctionne.
4 */
5import { existsSync, mkdtempSync, writeFileSync, readFileSync, rmSync } from "fs";
6import { execFileSync } from "child_process";
7import { tmpdir } from "os";
8import { join } from "path";
9
10let cachedByExe = new Map();
11
12const D_DFF_HELP = /d_dff\s*-\s*digital/i;
13
14/**
15 * @param {string} exe
16 * @param {NodeJS.ProcessEnv} [env]
17 * @returns {boolean}
18 */
19function probeXspiceViaDevhelp(exe, env) {
20 const dir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), "ngspice-xspice-probe-"));
21 const cir = join(dir, "probe.cir");
22 const log = join(dir, "out.log");
23 writeFileSync(
24 cir,
25 "* xspice probe\n.control\ndevhelp d_dff\n.quit\n.endc\n",
26 "utf8"
27 );
28 let combined = "";
29 try {
30 try {
31 combined = execFileSync(exe, ["-b", "-o", log, cir], {
32 encoding: "utf8",
33 timeout: 20000,
34 windowsHide: true,
35 env: env || process.env,
36 maxBuffer: 4 * 1024 * 1024,
37 });
38 } catch (err) {
39 /* devhelp s'affiche souvent sur stdout/stderr, pas dans le .log */
40 combined =
41 (err && typeof err.stdout === "string" ? err.stdout : "") +
42 (err && typeof err.stderr === "string" ? err.stderr : "");
43 }
44 if (D_DFF_HELP.test(combined)) return true;
45 if (existsSync(log)) {
46 const text = readFileSync(log, "utf8");
47 if (D_DFF_HELP.test(text)) return true;
48 }
49 } finally {
50 try {
51 rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
52 } catch {
53 /* ignore */
54 }
55 }
56 return false;
57}
58
59/**
60 * @param {string | null | undefined} exe chemin vers ngspice / ngspice_con
61 * @param {NodeJS.ProcessEnv} [env] PATH étendu (bin/lib) si bundle portable
62 * @returns {boolean}
63 */
64function cacheKeyForExe(exe, env) {
65 const pathEnv = env && (env.PATH || env.Path) ? String(env.PATH || env.Path) : "";
66 return `${String(exe).toLowerCase()}|${pathEnv}`;
67}
68
69export function ngspiceHasXspice(exe, env) {
70 if (!exe || !existsSync(exe)) return false;
71 const key = cacheKeyForExe(exe, env);
72 if (cachedByExe.has(key)) return cachedByExe.get(key);
73
74 let ok = false;
75 try {
76 const out = execFileSync(exe, ["-v"], {
77 encoding: "utf8",
78 timeout: 8000,
79 windowsHide: true,
80 env: env || process.env,
81 });
82 ok = /\bxspice\b/i.test(out);
83 } catch {
84 ok = false;
85 }
86
87 if (!ok) ok = probeXspiceViaDevhelp(exe, env);
88
89 cachedByExe.set(key, ok);
90 return ok;
91}

Simulateur/Engine/ripple-mod10.mjs — 84 lignes

1/**
2 * Compteur ripple mod-10 (4× DFF, AND Q2+Q4 → reset) — détection UI + animation idéale.
3 */
4import { reachableJonctions } from "./hc90-cascade.mjs";
5
6const CD4511_BCD_PINS = ["A", "B", "C", "D"];
7const SEG7_SEG_PINS = ["a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f", "g"];
8
9function dffLabelIndex(label) {
10 const m = /(\d+)$/.exec(String(label || ""));
11 return m ? parseInt(m[1], 10) : null;
12}
13
14/**
15 * Détecte un compteur ripple décade correctement câblé (AND sur DFF2.Q et DFF4.Q → RESET).
16 * @returns {{ mode: "mod10" } | null}
17 */
18export function detectRippleMod10ForAnim(components, wires, autoJunctions = []) {
19 const dffs = components.filter((c) => c.type === "d_flipflop" && c.label);
20 const ands = components.filter((c) => c.type === "and" && c.label);
21 if (dffs.length < 4 || ands.length === 0) return null;
22
23 for (const and of ands) {
24 const outNet = reachableJonctions(`${and.label}_out`, wires, autoJunctions);
25 if (dffs.filter((d) => outNet.has(`${d.label}_RESET`)).length < 4) continue;
26
27 const inANet = reachableJonctions(`${and.label}_inA`, wires, autoJunctions);
28 const inBNet = reachableJonctions(`${and.label}_inB`, wires, autoJunctions);
29 const qIdx = [];
30 for (const d of dffs) {
31 const qPin = `${d.label}_Q`;
32 if (inANet.has(qPin) || inBNet.has(qPin)) {
33 const idx = dffLabelIndex(d.label);
34 if (idx != null && !qIdx.includes(idx)) qIdx.push(idx);
35 }
36 }
37 if (qIdx.length !== 2) continue;
38 qIdx.sort((a, b) => a - b);
39 if (qIdx[0] === 2 && qIdx[1] === 4) return { mode: "mod10" };
40 }
41 return null;
42}
43
44/** Afficheur 7 seg alimenté par CD4511 lui-même relié aux Q des bascules ripple mod-10. */
45export function rippleMod10Seg7Linked(segLabel, components, wires, autoJunctions = []) {
46 if (!segLabel || !detectRippleMod10ForAnim(components, wires, autoJunctions)) return false;
47
48 for (const cd of components) {
49 if (cd.type !== "cd4511" || !cd.label) continue;
50 let segLinked = false;
51 for (const s of SEG7_SEG_PINS) {
52 if (reachableJonctions(`${segLabel}_${s}`, wires, autoJunctions).has(`${cd.label}_${s}`)) {
53 segLinked = true;
54 break;
55 }
56 }
57 if (!segLinked) continue;
58
59 const dffs = components.filter((c) => c.type === "d_flipflop" && c.label);
60 let matched = 0;
61 for (const d of dffs) {
62 const idx = dffLabelIndex(d.label);
63 if (idx == null || idx < 1 || idx > 4) continue;
64 const bcdPin = `${cd.label}_${CD4511_BCD_PINS[idx - 1]}`;
65 if (reachableJonctions(`${d.label}_Q`, wires, autoJunctions).has(bcdPin)) matched++;
66 }
67 if (matched >= 4) return true;
68 }
69 return false;
70}
71
72/** Chiffre 0…9 : 1 impulsion GImp = +1 (modulo 10). */
73export function idealRippleMod10Bcd(elapsedSec, clockPeriodSec) {
74 if (!(clockPeriodSec > 0) || !(elapsedSec >= 0)) return 0;
75 return Math.floor(elapsedSec / clockPeriodSec) % 10;
76}
77
78export function shouldUseIdealRippleMod10Seg7(segLabel, components, wires, autoJunctions, clockPeriodSec) {
79 return (
80 clockPeriodSec > 0 &&
81 rippleMod10Seg7Linked(segLabel, components, wires, autoJunctions)
82 );
83}

92/** Nœud SPICE relié à une masse ou une source « 0 » (borne logique, VCC à 0 V, etc.). */
93function isNodeLikelyLogicLow(nodeName, components, nodeFor) {
94 if (!nodeName || nodeName === "0") return true;
95 for (const g of components) {
96 if (g.type === "ground" && nodeFor(`${g.id}#0`) === nodeName) return true;
97 }
98 for (const g of components) {
99 if ((g.type === "vsin" || g.type === "vsquare") && nodeFor(`${g.id}#0`) === nodeName) {
100 return true;
101 }
102 }
103 for (const g of components) {
104 const key = `${g.id}#0`;
105 if (nodeFor(key) !== nodeName) continue;
106 if (g.type === "logic_state" && parseLogicStateVolts(g.value, g.logicRail) < 0.5) return true;
107 if (g.type === "logic_terminal" && Number(g.state) === 0) return true;
108 if (g.type === "vterm" && parseDcVolts(g.value) < 0.5) return true;
109 }
110 return false;
111}

113/** Nœud relié à +5 V (VCC, borne à 1, etc.). */
114function isNodeLikelyLogicHigh(nodeName, components, nodeFor) {
115 if (!nodeName) return false;
116 for (const g of components) {
117 const key = `${g.id}#0`;
118 if (nodeFor(key) !== nodeName) continue;
119 if (g.type === "logic_state" && parseLogicStateVolts(g.value, g.logicRail) > 2.5) return true;
120 if (g.type === "logic_terminal" && Number(g.state) === 1) return true;
121 if (g.type === "vterm" && parseDcVolts(g.value) > 2.5) return true;
122 }
123 return false;
124}

261/** Fréquence de résonance d’un circuit LC parallèle (bobine + condensateur). */
262function estimateParallelLcResonantHz(components) {

264 let lHenry = 0;
265 for (const c of components) {
266 if (c.type === "capacitor") cFarad = Math.max(cFarad, parseCapacitanceFarad(c.value));
267 if (c.type === "inductor") lHenry = Math.max(lHenry, parseInductanceHenry(c.value));
268 }
269 if (cFarad <= 0 || lHenry <= 0) return 0;
270 return 1 / (2 * Math.PI * Math.sqrt(lHenry * cFarad));

283/** Comparateur / Schmitt (boucle + ou boucle ouverte) : bascule dure. Amplificateur (boucle −) : tanh raide. */
284function opampUsesComparatorModel(c, parent, components) {
285 const topo = new Map(parent);

287 const outKey = `${c.id}#2`;
288 const posKey = `${c.id}#0`;
289 const negKey = `${c.id}#1`;
290 const outRoot = ufFind(topo, outKey);
291 const posRoot = ufFind(topo, posKey);
292 const negRoot = ufFind(topo, negKey);
293 const positiveFeedback = outRoot === posRoot;
294 const negativeFeedback = outRoot === negRoot;
295 if (
296 positiveFeedback &&
297 negativeFeedback &&
298 components.some((x) => x.type === "inductor") &&
299 components.some((x) => x.type === "capacitor")
300 ) {
301 return false;
302 }
303 return positiveFeedback || !negativeFeedback;
304}

306/** Source comportementale AOP : saturation aux rails (comparateur, hystérésis, amplif.). */
307function formatOpampBsourceLine(c, nOut, nPlus, nMinus, { comparatorMode = false, gain = 1e5 } = {}) {

312 if (comparatorMode) {
313 return `${bname} ${nOut} 0 V={${vn}+(${vp}-${vn})*u(${diff})}`;
314 }
315 const vmid = (vp + vn) / 2;
316 const vhalf = (vp - vn) / 2;
317 return `${bname} ${nOut} 0 V={${vmid}+${vhalf}*tanh(${gain}*(${diff}))}`;
318}

337/** Met à 0 les sources indépendantes pour mesure Ω (comme un multimètre). */
338function zeroIndependentSourceLine(line) {
339 const t = String(line || "").trim();
340 if (/^IOHM_/i.test(t)) return line;
341 if (/^VI_/i.test(t)) return line;
342 if (/^V[^\s]+\s+.+\s+DC\s+/i.test(t)) {
343 return line.replace(/(\sDC\s+)[^\s]+/i, "$10");

345 if (/^V[^\s]+\s+.+\s+(SIN|PULSE)\(/i.test(t)) {

351/**
352 * Netlist .op avec sources coupées — mesure de résistance entre les bornes de l'ohmmètre.
353 * @param {string} fullNetlist
354 * @param {{ id: string; nodePlus: string; nodeMinus: string }[]} ohmeters
355 */
356export function buildOhmmeterIsolationNetlist(fullNetlist, ohmeters) {
357 if (!fullNetlist || !Array.isArray(ohmeters) || ohmeters.length === 0) return "";
358 const out = [];
359 let skipControl = false;
360 for (const raw of fullNetlist.split(/\r?\n/)) {
361 const t = raw.trim();
362 if (/^\.(tran|op)\b/i.test(t)) continue;
363 if (t === ".control") {
364 skipControl = true;
365 continue;
366 }
367 if (t === ".endc") {
368 skipControl = false;
369 continue;
370 }
371 if (skipControl) continue;
372 if (t.startsWith("wrdata")) continue;
373 if (t === ".end") continue;
374 if (/^\.options\b/i.test(t)) continue;
375 out.push(zeroIndependentSourceLine(raw));
376 }
377 out.push(".op");
378 out.push(".control");
379 out.push("op");
380 for (const om of ohmeters) {
381 out.push(`echo @@OH:${om.id}@@`);
382 if (om.nodePlus !== "0") out.push(`print v(${om.nodePlus})`);
383 if (om.nodeMinus !== "0") out.push(`print v(${om.nodeMinus})`);
384 }
385 out.push("quit");
386 out.push(".endc");
387 out.push(".end");
388 return out.join("\n");
389}

391function ufFind(parent, x) {
392 if (!parent.has(x)) parent.set(x, x);
393 const p = parent.get(x);
394 if (p !== x) {
395 const r = ufFind(parent, p);
396 parent.set(x, r);
397 return r;
398 }
399 return x;
400}
401
402function ufUnion(parent, a, b) {
403 const ra = ufFind(parent, a);
404 const rb = ufFind(parent, b);
405 if (ra !== rb) parent.set(ra, rb);
406}

408/**
409 * Détecte un AND de reset mod-10 sur deux sorties Q de bascules D (indices DFF1…DFF4).
410 * @returns {{ a: number, b: number } | null}
411 */
412function getRippleMod10ResetAndIndices(components, parent) {
413 const dffs = components.filter((c) => c.type === "logic_dff");
414 const ands = components.filter((c) => c.type === "logic_and" || c.type === "and");
415 if (dffs.length < 4 || ands.length === 0) return null;
416
417 const dffIndex = (c) => {
418 const m = /(\d+)$/.exec(String(c.id || ""));
419 return m ? parseInt(m[1], 10) : null;
420 };
421 const sameNet = (a, b) => ufFind(parent, a) === ufFind(parent, b);
422
423 for (const and of ands) {
424 const outKey = `${and.id}#2`;
425 if (!parent.has(outKey)) continue;
426 if (!dffs.some((d) => sameNet(outKey, `${d.id}#5`))) continue;
427
428 const inputIdx = [];
429 for (const inKey of [`${and.id}#0`, `${and.id}#1`]) {
430 if (!parent.has(inKey)) continue;
431 for (const d of dffs) {
432 const qKey = `${d.id}#2`;
433 if (parent.has(qKey) && sameNet(inKey, qKey)) {
434 const idx = dffIndex(d);
435 if (idx != null && !inputIdx.includes(idx)) inputIdx.push(idx);
436 }
437 }
438 }
439 if (inputIdx.length !== 2) continue;
440 inputIdx.sort((a, b) => a - b);
441 return { a: inputIdx[0], b: inputIdx[1] };
442 }
443 return null;
444}

446/**
447 * AND de reset mal câblé sur compteur ripple 4 bits (symptôme typique : 4…9 au lieu de 0…9).
448 * @returns {string|null}
449 */
450function detectRippleMod10ResetAndWarning(components, parent) {
451 const pair = getRippleMod10ResetAndIndices(components, parent);
452 if (!pair) return null;
453 const { a, b } = pair;
454 if (a === 2 && b === 4) return null;
455 if (a === 1 && b === 4) {
456 return (
457 "Compteur ripple mod-10 : AND sur la Q de DFF1 et DFF4 — reset au 9 (1001) au lieu du 10 (1010), " +
458 "comptage souvent bloqué entre 4 et 8. Corrigez : AND sur DFF2.Q et DFF4.Q (bits de poids 2 et 8)."
459 );
460 }
461 if (a === 3 && b === 4) {
462 return (
463 "Compteur ripple mod-10 : AND sur DFF3.Q et DFF4.Q — reset au 12 (1100), pas une décade 0…9. " +
464 "Corrigez : AND sur DFF2.Q et DFF4.Q pour détecter 1010."
465 );
466 }
467 return (
468 `Compteur ripple mod-10 : AND de reset sur DFF${a} et DFF${b} — pour le 10 décimal (1010), ` +
469 "reliez AND à DFF2.Q et DFF4.Q seulement."
470 );
471}

473/** Résistances / passifs : même nœud électrique aux deux bornes (pour détecter la rétroaction AOP). */
474function ufUnionPassiveInternals(parent, components) {
475 for (const c of components) {
476 if (c.type === "resistor" || c.type === "capacitor" || c.type === "inductor") {
477 ufUnion(parent, `${c.id}#0`, `${c.id}#1`);
478 }
479 }
480}

496function parseResistanceOhm(s) {
497 if (s == null) return 1000;
498 let t = String(s).trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s/g, "");
499 if (!t) return 1000;
500 let mult = 1;
501 if (t.endsWith("meg")) {
502 mult = 1e6;
503 t = t.slice(0, -3);
504 } else if (t.endsWith("k")) {
505 mult = 1e3;
506 t = t.slice(0, -1);
507 } else if (t.endsWith("m") && /^\d/.test(t.slice(0, -1))) {
508 mult = 1e-3;
509 t = t.slice(0, -1);
510 }
511 const n = parseFloat(t.replace(",", "."));
512 return Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0 ? n * mult : 1000;
513}

515function parseCapacitanceFarad(s) {
516 if (s == null) return 1e-6;
517 let t = String(s).trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s/g, "").replace(",", ".").replace("µ", "u");
518 if (!t) return 1e-6;
519 let mult = 1;
520 if (t.endsWith("uf")) {
521 mult = 1e-6;
522 t = t.slice(0, -2);
523 } else if (t.endsWith("u")) {
524 mult = 1e-6;
525 t = t.slice(0, -1);
526 } else if (t.endsWith("pf")) {
527 mult = 1e-12;
528 t = t.slice(0, -2);
529 } else if (t.endsWith("nf")) {
530 mult = 1e-9;
531 t = t.slice(0, -2);
532 } else if (t.endsWith("mf")) {
533 mult = 1e-3;
534 t = t.slice(0, -2);
535 } else if (t.endsWith("p")) {
536 mult = 1e-12;
537 t = t.slice(0, -1);
538 } else if (t.endsWith("n")) {
539 mult = 1e-9;
540 t = t.slice(0, -1);
541 } else if (t.endsWith("m")) {
542 mult = 1e-3;
543 t = t.slice(0, -1);
544 } else if (t.endsWith("f")) {
545 mult = 1;
546 t = t.slice(0, -1);
547 }
548 const n = parseFloat(t);
549 return Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0 ? n * mult : 1e-6;
550}
551
552function parseInductanceHenry(s) {
553 if (s == null) return 1e-3;
554 let t = String(s).trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s/g, "").replace(",", ".").replace("µ", "u");
555 if (!t) return 1e-3;
556 let mult = 1;
557 if (t.endsWith("mh")) {
558 mult = 1e-3;
559 t = t.slice(0, -2);
560 } else if (t.endsWith("m")) {
561 mult = 1e-3;
562 t = t.slice(0, -1);
563 } else if (t.endsWith("uh")) {
564 mult = 1e-6;
565 t = t.slice(0, -2);
566 } else if (t.endsWith("kh")) {
567 mult = 1e3;
568 t = t.slice(0, -2);
569 } else if (t.endsWith("h")) {
570 mult = 1;
571 t = t.slice(0, -1);
572 }
573 const n = parseFloat(t);
574 return Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0 ? n * mult : 1e-3;

606/** Carré : « 5V 5V 1kHz 0V » — amplitudes + et − au-dessus / en dessous de l’offset. */

629/** Phase sinus (°) : « 90° », « phase 45 », etc. */

640 return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : 0;

642 return 0;

655/** Offset DC (V) : dernier « …V » après la fréquence (sinus ou carré), ou mot offset. */
656function parseOffsetVolts(s) {

680/** Extrait la fréquence (Hz) d’une chaîne du type « 5V 1kHz », « 5V 60s », « 5V 1/60Hz ». */

688 }
689 m = /([\d.]+)s(?:period|per)?$/.exec(t) || /([\d.]+)s(?!\/)/.exec(t);
690 if (m) {
691 const p = parseFloat(m[1]);
692 return Number.isFinite(p) && p > 0 ? 1 / p : 1000;
693 }
694 m = /1\/([\d.]+)\s*hz/.exec(t);
695 if (m) {
696 const p = parseFloat(m[1]);
697 return Number.isFinite(p) && p > 0 ? 1 / p : 1000;
698 }
699 m = /([\d.]+)\s*khz/.exec(t);
700 if (m) {
701 const n = parseFloat(m[1]);
702 return Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0 ? n * 1000 : 1000;
703 }
704 m = /([\d.]+)\s*mhz/.exec(t);
705 if (m) {
706 const n = parseFloat(m[1]);
707 return Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0 ? n * 1e6 : 1000;
708 }
709 m = /([\d.]+)\s*hz/.exec(t);
710 if (m) {
711 const n = parseFloat(m[1]);
712 return Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0 ? n : 1000;
713 }
714 return 1000;
715}

717/** Amplitude haute d'un générateur d'impulsions : « 5V 1kHz 10% ». */

725 return 5;

728/** Rapport cyclique (%) : « 5V 1kHz 10% » ou « duty 25 ». */
729function parseDutyPercent(s) {
730 if (s == null) return 10;

732 let m = /([\d.]+)\s*%/.exec(raw);

735 return Number.isFinite(n) ? Math.min(99, Math.max(1, n)) : 10;

737 m = /duty\s*([\d.]+)/i.exec(raw);

764/** Expression ngspice (source comportementale B) : niveaux 0 / rail, seuil à mi-rail. */

767 const lo = LOGIC_VLO;

770 const b = inputNodes[1];

773 case "logic_not":

775 case "logic_and":
776 return `{ (${gt(a)})*(${gt(b)})*${hi} }`;
777 case "logic_nand":
778 return `{ (1-(${gt(a)})*(${gt(b)}))*${hi} }`;
779 case "logic_or":
780 return `{ ((${gt(a)})+(${gt(b)})>0)*${hi} }`;
781 case "logic_nor":
782 return `{ (1-((${gt(a)})+(${gt(b)})>0))*${hi} }`;
783 case "logic_xor":
784 return `{ abs(${gt(a)}-${gt(b)})*${hi} }`;
785 case "logic_xnor":
786 return `{ (1-abs(${gt(a)}-${gt(b)}))*${hi} }`;

788 return `{ ${lo} }`;
789 }
790}

908/** Durée SPICE (ex. 2.5u, 4m) pour .tran / wrdata. */

914 if (s >= 1e-6) return `${(s * 1e6).toPrecision(6)}u`;

922const TRAN_SAMPLES_PER_PERIOD = 200;

924/** Au-delà de cette période (f ≤ 1 Hz), .tran court + animation temps réel côté client. */

926/** Un seul HC90 : 2 cycles décade (0…9 × 2). */

930/** Deux HC90 en cascade : cycle complet 0…99 (100 impulsions) ou 0…59 (60) si reset mod-60. */

932const SLOW_CLOCK_MOD60_PERIODS = 60;

939 if (c.type !== "vsin" && c.type !== "vsquare" && c.type !== "vpulse") continue;

980 }

1015 }

1024 }

1048 if (deckOpts.quickTran && deckOpts.rippleMod10) {

1069 tstop,

1219 ok: false,

1221 "Voltmètre, ampèremètre (DC ou efficace), oscilloscope : ajoutez une source (pile, borne, état logique, sinus, carré ou impulsions GImp).",
1222 ],
1223 warnings,
1224 netlist: "",
1225 voltmeters: [],
1226 ammeters: [],
1227 ohmeters: [],
1228 oscilloscopes: [],
1229 nodeMeasures: [],
1230 scopesTranMeta: [],
1231 analysisTran: false,
1232 };

1234 if (!powerSrc && !hasVtermPower && !hasArduinoUno && ohmeterComponents.length === 0 && groundComponents.length === 0) {
1235 return {
1236 ok: false,
1237 errors: [
1238 "Ajoutez une pile DC, une borne, un état logique, un générateur (sinus/carré), une masse, ou un ohmmètre pour définir le circuit.",
1239 ],
1240 warnings,
1241 netlist: "",
1242 voltmeters: [],
1243 ammeters: [],
1244 ohmeters: [],
1245 oscilloscopes: [],
1246 nodeMeasures: [],
1247 scopesTranMeta: [],
1248 analysisTran: false,
1249 };
1250 }
1251
1252 let gndKey;
1253 if (groundComponents.length > 0) {
1254 gndKey = `${groundComponents[0].id}#0`;
1255 } else if (powerSrc) {
1256 if (powerSrc.type === "vsin" || powerSrc.type === "vsquare") {
1257 gndKey = `${powerSrc.id}#0`;
1258 } else {
1259 gndKey = `${powerSrc.id}#1`;
1260 }
1261 } else if (ohmeterComponents.length > 0) {
1262 gndKey = `${ohmeterComponents[0].id}#1`;
1263 } else {
1264 gndKey = "__spice_gnd__";
1265 }
1266
1267 touch(gndKey);
1268 for (const g of groundComponents) {
1269 ufUnion(parent, `${g.id}#0`, gndKey);
1270 }
1271 if (
1272 powerSrc &&
1273 (powerSrc.type === "vsin" || powerSrc.type === "vsquare") &&
1274 groundComponents.length > 0
1275 ) {
1276 ufUnion(parent, `${powerSrc.id}#0`, gndKey);
1277 }
1278 const gndRoot = ufFind(parent, gndKey);
1279 if (powerSrc) {
1280 const vsrcP = `${powerSrc.id}#0`;
1281 const vsrcM = `${powerSrc.id}#1`;
1282 if ((terminalWireCount.get(vsrcP) || 0) === 0 || (terminalWireCount.get(vsrcM) || 0) === 0) {
1283 warnings.push(`Source ${powerSrc.id} : au moins une borne n’est reliée à aucun fil.`);
1284 }
1285 } else if (ohmeterComponents.length > 0) {
1286 warnings.push(
1287 "Mode ohmmètre : pas de pile — référence sur la borne « − » du premier ohmmètre ; courant de test injecté pour calculer R."
1288 );
1289 } else if (hasVtermPower) {
1290 for (const vt of vtermComponents) {
1291 const kp = `${vt.id}#0`;
1292 if ((terminalWireCount.get(kp) || 0) === 0) {
1293 const label = isLogicStateType(vt.type) ? "État logique" : "Borne";
1294 warnings.push(`${label} ${vt.id} : la connexion n’est reliée à aucun fil.`);
1295 }
1296 }
1297 }

1299 /* Nœuds internes LED / bascules : doivent exister avant l’attribution n1, n2… */
1300 for (const c of components) {
1301 if (isLedType(c.type)) touch(`${c.id}#__ledint`);
1302 for (const k of logicSequentialInternalNodeKeys(c, {
1303 ...deckOpts,
1304 rippleClockFromPrev: getRippleClockFromPrev(c, wires, components),
1305 })) touch(k);

1307 for (const k of ic74hc90InternalNodeKeys(c, deckOpts)) touch(k);
1308 }
1309 }

1311 const roots = new Set();
1312 for (const k of parent.keys()) roots.add(ufFind(parent, k));
1313
1314 const rootToSpice = new Map();
1315 rootToSpice.set(gndRoot, "0");
1316 let ni = 1;
1317 const sortedRoots = [...roots].sort();
1318 for (const r of sortedRoots) {
1319 if (r === gndRoot) continue;
1320 rootToSpice.set(r, `n${ni++}`);
1321 }
1322
1323 function nodeFor(key) {
1324 touch(key);
1325 const root = ufFind(parent, key);
1326 if (!rootToSpice.has(root)) {
1327 rootToSpice.set(root, `n${ni++}`);
1328 }
1329 return rootToSpice.get(root);
1330 }
1331
1332 const logicVhiByTerminal = computeLogicVhiByTerminalKey(components, parent);
1333
1334 const rippleMod10Pair = getRippleMod10ResetAndIndices(components, parent);
1335 if (rippleMod10Pair?.a === 2 && rippleMod10Pair?.b === 4) {
1336 deckOpts.rippleMod10 = true;
1337 }

1339 const bodeAnalyzerComponents = components.filter((c) => isBodeAnalyzerType(c.type));
1340 const hasBodeAnalyzer = bodeAnalyzerComponents.length > 0;
1341 const hasBlockingTranForBode =
1342 components.some((c) => c.type === "vpulse") ||
1343 components.some((c) => isLogicGateComponentType(c.type) || isLogicDigitalSimType(c.type)) ||
1344 hasAutonomousLcOscillator;
1345 const useAcForBode = hasBodeAnalyzer && !hasBlockingTranForBode;
1346 if (hasBodeAnalyzer && hasBlockingTranForBode) {
1347 warnings.push(

1349 );
1350 }
1351 if (useAcForBode && !components.some((c) => c.type === "vsin")) {
1352 return {
1353 ok: false,
1354 errors: [
1355 "Analyse fréquentielle : ajoutez un générateur sinus (Sin) comme source d’entrée du filtre.",
1356 ],
1357 warnings,
1358 netlist: "",
1359 voltmeters: [],
1360 ammeters: [],
1361 ohmeters: [],
1362 oscilloscopes: [],
1363 bodeAnalyzers: [],
1364 nodeMeasures: [],
1365 scopesTranMeta: [],
1366 bodeAcMeta: [],

1368 analysisAc: false,
1369 };

1378 const usesBsourceCd4511 = hasLogicCd4511 && !usesXspiceCd4511;

1388 if (hasLogicJk && useLogicJkXspice(deckOpts)) xParts.push("JK (d_jkff)");
1389 if (usesXspiceCd4511) xParts.push("CD4511 (d_dlatch + d_genlut)");

1391 `${xParts.length ? xParts.join(", ") : "Circuits logiques"} : modèle XSPICE (digital.cm) — simulation mixte analogique/numérique.`

1395 "CD4511 : modèle sources B (compatibilité ngspice Linux / serveur distant — pas de d_genlut)."
1396 );
1397 } else if (
1398 (hasLogicDff || hasLogicJk) &&
1399 isXspiceDffAvailable(deckOpts.repoRoot)
1400 ) {
1401 warnings.push(

1406 const declaredDiodeModels = new Set();
1407 const declaredBjtModels = new Set();

1417 for (const c of components) {

1/**
2 * Oscilloscope : signaux idéaux 0/5 V depuis GPIO Arduino (comme LED / voltmètre).

5import { reachableJonctions } from "./hc90-cascade.mjs";
6import {
7 applyArduinoSketchToComponent,
8 resolveArduinoPinLevelAt,
9 sketchHasLoop,
10 createArduinoRuntime,
11 stepArduinoRuntime,
12 arduinoRuntimeLevels,
13} from "./arduino-sketch-parse.mjs";
14import {
15 buildUartScopeModel,
16 uartScopeBitAt,
17 sketchUsesSerial,
18 uartCharDurationSec,
19 uartSketchLoopPeriodMs,
20} from "./arduino-uart-wave.mjs";
21
22const uartModelCache = new WeakMap();
23
24function pinHasSketchTiming(uno, pinLabel) {
25 if (uno?.pinPulses?.[pinLabel]) return true;
26 if (Array.isArray(uno?.pinPhases) && uno.pinPhases.length >= 2) {
27 return uno.pinPhases.some((ph) => Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(ph.levels || {}, pinLabel));
28 }
29 return false;
30}
31
32function isUartTxPin(uno, pinLabel) {
33 return pinLabel === "D1" && sketchUsesSerial(uno?.sketch || "");
34}
35
36function getUartScopeModel(uno) {
37 const sketch = uno?.sketch || "";
38 const cached = uartModelCache.get(uno);
39 if (cached && cached.sketch === sketch) return cached;
40 const model = { sketch, ...buildUartScopeModel(uno) };
41 uartModelCache.set(uno, model);
42 return model;
43}
44
45/** Période (s) du signal sur une broche, si connue depuis le sketch. */
46export function arduinoPinPeriodSec(uno, pinLabel) {
47 if (!uno || !pinLabel) return 0;
48 if (isUartTxPin(uno, pinLabel)) {
49 const model = getUartScopeModel(uno);
50 if (model.loopPeriodMs > 0) return model.loopPeriodMs / 1000;
51 if (model.baud > 0) return uartCharDurationSec(model.baud) * 4;
52 }
53 const pulse = uno.pinPulses?.[pinLabel];
54 if (pulse?.highSec > 0 && pulse?.lowSec > 0) {
55 return pulse.highSec + pulse.lowSec;
56 }
57 if (Array.isArray(uno.pinPhases) && uno.pinPhases.length >= 2) {
58 const usesPin = uno.pinPhases.some((ph) =>
59 Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(ph.levels || {}, pinLabel)
60 );
61 if (usesPin) {
62 const totalMs = uno.pinPhases.reduce((s, p) => s + (p.durationMs || 0), 0);
63 if (totalMs > 0) return totalMs / 1000;
64 }
65 }
66 return 0;
67}
68
69/**
70 * UNO en sortie câblé sur CH1 ou CH2 de l'oscilloscope.
71 * @param {'CH1'|'CH2'} channelSuffix
72 */
73export function findArduinoDriveForScopeChannel(
74 oscLabel,
75 channelSuffix,
76 components,
77 wires,
78 autoJunctions = []
79) {
80 const net = reachableJonctions(`${oscLabel}_${channelSuffix}`, wires, autoJunctions);
81 for (const comp of components) {
82 if (comp.type !== "arduino_uno") continue;
83 applyArduinoSketchToComponent(comp);
84 for (const jid of net) {
85 if (!jid.startsWith(`${comp.label}_`)) continue;
86 const pinLabel = jid.slice(comp.label.length + 1);
87 if (!/^D\d+$|^A\d+$/.test(pinLabel)) continue;
88 if (isUartTxPin(comp, pinLabel)) {
89 return { uno: comp, pinLabel, uart: true };
90 }
91 if (comp.pinModes?.[pinLabel] === "OUTPUT") {
92 return { uno: comp, pinLabel, uart: false };
93 }
94 }
95 }
96 return null;
97}
98
99function runtimePinLevelAt(uno, pinLabel, tSec, inputs = {}) {
100 const rt = createArduinoRuntime(uno);
101 stepArduinoRuntime(rt, Math.max(0, tSec) * 1000, inputs);
102 const lv = arduinoRuntimeLevels(rt)[pinLabel];
103 return lv === 1 || lv === "1" || lv === true ? 1 : 0;
104}
105
106function synthesizeUartScopeTrace(uno, windowSec, timeOffsetSec = 0) {
107 const model = getUartScopeModel(uno);
108 if (!model.schedule?.length || !model.baud) return [];
109 const samplesPerBit = 4;
110 const n = Math.max(
111 128,
112 Math.min(4000, Math.ceil(windowSec * model.baud * samplesPerBit))
113 );
114 const points = [];
115 for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
116 const frac = n > 1 ? i / (n - 1) : 0;
117 const tScreenSec = frac * windowSec;
118 const tMs = timeOffsetSec * 1000 + tScreenSec * 1000;
119 const bit = uartScopeBitAt(model, tMs);
120 points.push({ t: tScreenSec, v: bit ? 5 : 0 });
121 }
122 return points;
123}
124
125/**
126 * Courbe numérique 0/5 V.
127 * Signaux périodiques (delay / blink / UART) : fenêtre verrouillée sur la phase.
128 */
129export function synthesizeArduinoScopeTrace(uno, pinLabel, windowSec, elapsedSec, inputs = {}, timeOffsetSec = 0) {
130 if (!uno || !pinLabel || windowSec <= 0) return [];
131
132 if (isUartTxPin(uno, pinLabel)) {
133 return synthesizeUartScopeTrace(uno, windowSec, timeOffsetSec);
134 }
135
136 const period = arduinoPinPeriodSec(uno, pinLabel);
137 const synced = period > 0;
138 const useRuntime = sketchHasLoop(uno.sketch || "") && !pinHasSketchTiming(uno, pinLabel);
139 const n = Math.max(64, Math.min(800, Math.ceil(windowSec * 4000)));
140
141 const points = [];
142 for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
143 const frac = n > 1 ? i / (n - 1) : 0;
144 const tScreen = frac * windowSec;
145 let tAbs;
146 if (synced) {
147 tAbs = ((timeOffsetSec + tScreen) % period + period) % period;
148 } else {
149 const tEnd = Math.max(0, elapsedSec) + timeOffsetSec;
150 tAbs = Math.max(0, tEnd - windowSec) + tScreen;
151 }
152 const lv = useRuntime
153 ? runtimePinLevelAt(uno, pinLabel, tAbs, inputs)
154 : resolveArduinoPinLevelAt(uno, pinLabel, tAbs);
155 points.push({ t: tScreen, v: lv ? 5 : 0 });
156 }
157 return points;
158}

1/** Import à chaque build pour éviter le cache ESM de schematic-to-spice (rechargé via importFresh côté serveur). */
2async function loadSchematicBuilder() {
3 const mod = await import(`./schematic-to-spice.mjs?fresh=${Date.now()}`);
4 if (typeof mod.buildNetlistFromGraphicalState !== "function") {
5 throw new Error("buildNetlistFromGraphicalState introuvable dans schematic-to-spice.mjs");
6 }
7 return mod.buildNetlistFromGraphicalState;
8}
9
10/**
11 * Mode batch ngspice (-b) : un bloc .control sans analyse au niveau circuit
12 * (.op, .tran, .dc, …) échoue souvent. On insère .op avant .control si besoin,
13 * et « quit » avant .endc pour une sortie propre.
14 * @param {string} text
15 */
16function normalizeSpiceNetlistForNgspiceBatch(text) {
17 let s = String(text || "").replace(/^\uFEFF/, "");
18 // SPICE / ngspice : la **première ligne non vide** du fichier est toujours le « titre »
19 // et n’est **pas** un composant. Si on supprime notre ligne * …, la 1re ligne devient
20 // par ex. « V_V1 … » : elle est alors ignorée comme titre → circuit faux (0 V, etc.).
21 // Remplacer par une ligne titre minimale (ASCII) — ngspice accepte tout commentaire *.
22 s = s.replace(
23 /^\* Circuit Designer - netlist SPICE \(\.(?:op|tran|ac)\)[^\r\n]*\r?\n(?:\s*\r?\n)?/i,
24 "* CD\n"
25 );
26 // Ne PAS forcer CRLF tout le fichier : sur certaines installs ngspice-46 sous Windows,
27 // ça combiné au bloc .control / wrdata donne une analyse transitoire « réussie » mais
28 // sans données exploitables dans l’interface.
29 if (!/\S/.test(s) || !/^\s*\.control\b/im.test(s)) return s;
30
31 const hasCircuitAnalysis = /^\s*\.(op|tran|dc|ac|pz|noise|sens|tf)\b/im.test(s);
32 if (!hasCircuitAnalysis) {
33 s = s.replace(/^\s*\.control\b/im, ".op\n.control");
34 }
35
36 const controlBlock = s.match(/\.control\b([\s\S]*?)\.endc\b/i);
37 if (controlBlock && !/\bquit\b/i.test(controlBlock[1])) {
38 s = s.replace(/(\r?\n)(\s*\.endc\b)/i, "$1quit$1$2");
39 }
40 return s;
41}
42
43// Netlist brute (éditeur Simulateur) ou état JSON avec champ .netlist
44export async function buildNgspiceDeck(state, opts = {}) {
45 if (
46 state &&
47 typeof state === "object" &&
48 !state.netlist &&
49 Array.isArray(state.components) &&
50 Array.isArray(state.wires)
51 ) {
52 const buildNetlistFromGraphicalState = await loadSchematicBuilder();
53 const built = buildNetlistFromGraphicalState(state, opts);
54 if (!built.ok) return built;
55 const nrm = normalizeSpiceNetlistForNgspiceBatch(built.netlist);
56 return {
57 ...built,
58 netlist: nrm,
59 warnings: built.warnings || [],
60 };
61 }
62
63 const raw =
64 typeof state === "string"
65 ? state
66 : typeof state?.netlist === "string"
67 ? state.netlist
68 : "";
69 const netlist = typeof raw === "string" ? normalizeSpiceNetlistForNgspiceBatch(raw) : "";
70 if (!netlist.trim()) {
71 return {
72 ok: false,
73 errors: ["Netlist vide ou invalide : fournir une chaîne SPICE ou un objet { netlist: string }."],
74 warnings: [],
75 netlist: "",
76 };
77 }
78 const warnings = [];
79 if (typeof raw === "string" && raw !== netlist) {
80 warnings.push("Netlist ajustée pour le mode batch ngspice (-b) : analyse .op ou commande quit ajoutée si nécessaire.");
81 }
82 return {
83 ok: true,
84 netlist,
85 analysisTran: /\b\.tran\b/i.test(netlist),
86 voltmeters: [],
87 ammeters: [],
88 ohmeters: [],
89 nodeMeasures: [],
90 scopesTranMeta: [],
91 warnings,
92 };
93}

13/**
14
15 * @param {string} log
16
17 * @returns {Record<string, number>}
18
19 */
20
21function collectNodeVoltagesFromLog(log) {
22
23 const map = Object.create(null);
24
25 if (!log || typeof log !== "string") return map;
26
27
28
29 const reEquals = /\bV\s*\(\s*([^)]+?)\s*\)\s*=\s*([-+eE0-9.]+)/gi;
30
31 let m;
32
33 while ((m = reEquals.exec(log)) !== null) {
34
35 const node = String(m[1]).trim().toLowerCase();
36
37 const v = parseFloat(m[2]);
38
39 if (node && Number.isFinite(v)) map[node] = v;
40
41 }
42
43
44
45 const reSpaced = /\bV\s*\(\s*([^)]+?)\s*\)\s+([-+eE0-9.]+)/gi;
46
47 while ((m = reSpaced.exec(log)) !== null) {
48
49 const node = String(m[1]).trim().toLowerCase();
50
51 const v = parseFloat(m[2]);
52
53 if (node && Number.isFinite(v)) map[node] = v;
54
55 }
56
57
58
59 const lines = log.split(/\r?\n/);
60
61 for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
62
63 if (!/Node.*Voltage/i.test(lines[i])) continue;
64
65 let j = i + 1;
66
67 while (j < lines.length && /^\s*(-+|\.{3,})/.test(lines[j])) j++;
68
69 for (; j < lines.length; j++) {
70
71 const line = lines[j];
72
73 if (!line || !line.trim()) break;
74
75 if (/^Reference value/i.test(line)) continue;
76
77 const row = /^\s*(\S+)\s+([-+]?(?:\d+\.?\d*|\.\d+)(?:[eE][-+]?\d+)?)\s*$/i.exec(line.trim());
78
79 if (!row) continue;
80
81 const node = row[1].toLowerCase();
82
83 if (node === "node" || node === "----" || /^\.{2,}/.test(row[1])) continue;
84
85 const v = parseFloat(row[2]);
86
87 if (Number.isFinite(v)) map[node] = v;
88
89 }
90
91 }
92
93
94
95 return map;
96
97}
