101/** Courants de branches : i(vi_e1) = … */
102
103function collectBranchCurrentsFromLog(log) {
104
105 const map = Object.create(null);
106
107 if (!log || typeof log !== "string") return map;
108
109
110
111 const reEquals = /\bI\s*\(\s*([^)]+?)\s*\)\s*=\s*([-+eE0-9.]+)/gi;
112
113 let m;
114
115 while ((m = reEquals.exec(log)) !== null) {
116
117 const branch = String(m[1]).trim().toLowerCase();
118
119 const i = parseFloat(m[2]);
120
121 if (branch && Number.isFinite(i)) map[branch] = i;
122
123 }
124
125
126
127 const reSpaced = /\bI\s*\(\s*([^)]+?)\s*\)\s+([-+eE0-9.]+)/gi;
128
129 while ((m = reSpaced.exec(log)) !== null) {
130
131 const branch = String(m[1]).trim().toLowerCase();
132
133 const i = parseFloat(m[2]);
134
135 if (branch && Number.isFinite(i)) map[branch] = i;
136
137 }
138
139 const reRev = /\b([-+eE0-9.]+)\s*=\s*i\s*\(\s*([^)]+?)\s*\)/gi;
140
141 while ((m = reRev.exec(log)) !== null) {
142
143 const branch = String(m[2]).trim().toLowerCase();
144
145 const i = parseFloat(m[1]);
146
147 if (branch && Number.isFinite(i)) map[branch] = i;
148
149 }
150
151 const reDev = /\b((?:vil|vi|d)_[a-z0-9_]+)(?:#branchcurrent)?\s*[:=]?\s+([-+eE0-9.]+)/gi;
152
153 while ((m = reDev.exec(log)) !== null) {
154
155 const branch = String(m[1]).trim().toLowerCase();
156
157 const i = parseFloat(m[2]);
158
159 if (branch && Number.isFinite(i)) map[branch] = i;
160
161 }
162
163 return map;
164
165}

169function isSpiceReferenceNode(name) {
170
171 const n = String(name || "")
172
173 .trim()
174
175 .toLowerCase();
176
177 return n === "0" || n === "gnd";
178
179}
180
181
182
183function nodeVoltageFromMap(name, map) {
184
185 if (isSpiceReferenceNode(name)) return 0;
186
187 const n = String(name || "")
188
189 .trim()
190
191 .toLowerCase();
192
193 const v = map[n];
194
195 return v != null && Number.isFinite(v) ? v : null;
196
197}
198
199
200
201function branchCurrentFromMap(branchName, map) {
202
203 const b = String(branchName || "")
204
205 .trim()
206
207 .toLowerCase();
208
209 const i = map[b];
210
211 return i != null && Number.isFinite(i) ? i : null;
212
213}

217/**
218
219 * @param {string} log
220
221 * @param {{ id: string; nodePlus: string; nodeMinus: string }[]} voltmeters
222
223 * @param {unknown[]} _nodeMeasures
224
225 */
226
227export function mergeVoltmeterMeasurements(log, voltmeters, _nodeMeasures) {
228
229 const out = {};
230
231 if (!log || typeof log !== "string" || !Array.isArray(voltmeters) || voltmeters.length === 0) return out;
232
233
234
235 const map = collectNodeVoltagesFromLog(log);
236
237
238
239 for (const vm of voltmeters) {
240
241 const np = String(vm.nodePlus || "").trim().toLowerCase();
242
243 const nm = String(vm.nodeMinus || "").trim().toLowerCase();
244
245 if (!np || !nm) continue;
246
247 if (isSpiceReferenceNode(vm.nodePlus) && isSpiceReferenceNode(vm.nodeMinus)) continue;
248
249
250
251 const vp = nodeVoltageFromMap(vm.nodePlus, map);
252
253 const vmv = nodeVoltageFromMap(vm.nodeMinus, map);
254
255 if (vp == null || vmv == null) continue;
256
257
258
259 out[vm.id] = {
260
261 voltage: vp - vmv,
262
263 unit: "V",
264
265 nodePlus: vm.nodePlus,
266
267 nodeMinus: vm.nodeMinus,
268
269 };
270
271 }
272
273
274
275 return out;
276
277}

289export function mergeAmmeterMeasurements(log, ammeters) {

297 const map = collectBranchCurrentsFromLog(log);

299
300
301 for (const am of ammeters) {
302

306
307 if (i == null) continue;

309 out[am.id] = {
310
311 current: i,
312
313 unit: "A",
314
315 branch: am.branch,
316
317 nodePlus: am.nodePlus,

319 nodeMinus: am.nodeMinus,
320
321 };
322
323 }

325
326
327 return out;

331/**
332 * @param {string} log
333 * @param {{ id: string; branch: string }[]} leds
334 */
335function ledForwardCurrentFromRow(row, meta, vmap) {
336 if (!row || typeof row.current !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(row.current)) return 0;
337 const i = row.current;
338 const np = meta?.nodePlus;
339 const nm = meta?.nodeMinus;
340 if (np && nm && vmap && Object.keys(vmap).length > 0) {
341 const vp = nodeVoltageFromMap(np, vmap);
342 const vm = nodeVoltageFromMap(nm, vmap);
343 if (vp != null && vm != null) {
344 if (vp <= vm + 0.15) return 0;
345 return Math.abs(i);
346 }
347 }
348 return i > 0 ? i : 0;
349}

351export function mergeLedMeasurements(log, leds) {
352 const out = {};
353 if (!log || typeof log !== "string" || !Array.isArray(leds) || leds.length === 0) return out;
354
355 const map = collectBranchCurrentsFromLog(log);
356 const vmap = collectNodeVoltagesFromLog(log);
357
358 for (const ld of leds) {
359 if (!ld.branch) continue;
360 const i = branchCurrentFromMap(ld.branch, map);
361 if (i == null) continue;
362 const iFwd = ledForwardCurrentFromRow({ current: i }, ld, vmap);
363 out[ld.id] = {
364 current: iFwd,
365 unit: "A",
366 branch: ld.branch,
367 nodePlus: ld.nodePlus,
368 nodeMinus: ld.nodeMinus,
369 };
370 }
371
372 return out;
373}

375/**
376 * @param {string} log
377 * @param {{ id: string; nodePlus: string; nodeMinus: string; testCurrent?: number }[]} ohmmeters
378 */
379export function mergeOhmmeterMeasurements(log, ohmmeters) {
380 const out = {};
381 if (!log || typeof log !== "string" || !Array.isArray(ohmmeters) || ohmmeters.length === 0) return out;
382
383 const map = collectNodeVoltagesFromLog(log);
384
385 for (const om of ohmmeters) {
386 const iTest = om.testCurrent > 0 ? om.testCurrent : 0.001;
387 const vp = nodeVoltageFromMap(om.nodePlus, map);
388 const vm = nodeVoltageFromMap(om.nodeMinus, map);
389 if (vp == null || vm == null) continue;
390 const r = Math.abs(vp - vm) / iTest;
391 if (!Number.isFinite(r) || r <= 0) continue;
392
393 out[om.id] = {
394 resistance: r,
395 unit: "Ohm",
396 nodePlus: om.nodePlus,
397 nodeMinus: om.nodeMinus,
398 };
399 }
400
401 return out;
402}

404/**
405 * @param {string} log
406 * @param {{ id: string; ch1NodePlus: string; ch1NodeMinus: string; ch2NodePlus: string; ch2NodeMinus: string }[]} oscilloscopes
407 */
408export function mergeOscilloscopeMeasurements(log, oscilloscopes) {
409 const out = {};
410 if (!log || typeof log !== "string" || !Array.isArray(oscilloscopes) || oscilloscopes.length === 0) {
411 return out;
412 }
413
414 const map = collectNodeVoltagesFromLog(log);
415
416 function channelVoltage(nodePlus, nodeMinus) {
417 const np = String(nodePlus || "").trim().toLowerCase();
418 const nm = String(nodeMinus || "").trim().toLowerCase();
419 if (!np || !nm) return null;
420 if (isSpiceReferenceNode(nodePlus) && isSpiceReferenceNode(nodeMinus)) return null;
421 const vp = nodeVoltageFromMap(nodePlus, map);
422 const vm = nodeVoltageFromMap(nodeMinus, map);
423 if (vp == null || vm == null) return null;
424 return vp - vm;
425 }
426
427 for (const osc of oscilloscopes) {
428 const v1 = channelVoltage(osc.ch1NodePlus, osc.ch1NodeMinus);
429 const v2 = channelVoltage(osc.ch2NodePlus, osc.ch2NodeMinus);
430 if (v1 == null && v2 == null) continue;
431 const row = { id: osc.id };
432 if (v1 != null) {
433 row.ch1 = {
434 voltage: v1,
435 unit: "V",
436 nodePlus: osc.ch1NodePlus,
437 nodeMinus: osc.ch1NodeMinus,
438 };
439 }
440 if (v2 != null) {
441 row.ch2 = {
442 voltage: v2,
443 unit: "V",
444 nodePlus: osc.ch2NodePlus,
445 nodeMinus: osc.ch2NodeMinus,
446 };
447 }
448 out[osc.id] = row;
449 }
450
451 return out;
452}

454/**
455 * @param {string} waveTxt
456 * @returns {number[][]}
457 */
458function parseWrdataNumericRows(waveTxt) {
459 const rows = [];
460 if (!waveTxt || typeof waveTxt !== "string") return rows;
461 for (const line of waveTxt.split(/\r?\n/)) {
462 const t = line.trim();
463 if (!t || t.startsWith("*")) continue;
464 const nums = t.split(/\s+/).map(s => parseFloat(s)).filter(n => Number.isFinite(n));
465 if (nums.length >= 2) rows.push(nums);
466 }
467 return rows;
468}
469
470function waveformPeakToPeak(values) {
471 if (!Array.isArray(values) || values.length === 0) return NaN;
472 let min = Infinity;
473 let max = -Infinity;
474 for (const v of values) {
475 if (!Number.isFinite(v)) continue;
476 if (v < min) min = v;
477 if (v > max) max = v;
478 }
479 return Number.isFinite(min) && Number.isFinite(max) ? max - min : NaN;
480}
481
482function waveformRms(values) {
483 if (!Array.isArray(values) || values.length === 0) return NaN;
484 let sum = 0;
485 let n = 0;
486 for (const v of values) {
487 if (!Number.isFinite(v)) continue;
488 sum += v * v;
489 n++;
490 }
491 return n > 0 ? Math.sqrt(sum / n) : NaN;
492}
493
494/**
495 * @param {string} waveTxt — sortie ngspice wrdata
496 * @param {{ id: string; timeCol?: number; wrVarCount?: number; ch1: { wrIndex?: number; minusWrIndex?: number | null; minusIsGnd?: boolean }; ch2: { wrIndex?: number; minusWrIndex?: number | null; minusIsGnd?: boolean } }[]} meta
497 */
498export function mergeScopePlotsFromTranWrdata(waveTxt, meta) {
499 const out = {};
500 const rows = parseWrdataNumericRows(waveTxt);
501 if (!rows.length || !Array.isArray(meta) || meta.length === 0) return out;
502
503 let wrVarCount = 0;
504 for (const m of meta) {
505 if (m.wrVarCount > wrVarCount) wrVarCount = m.wrVarCount;
506 const idxs = [m.ch1?.wrIndex, m.ch2?.wrIndex, m.ch1?.minusWrIndex, m.ch2?.minusWrIndex];
507 for (const ix of idxs) {
508 if (ix != null && ix + 1 > wrVarCount) wrVarCount = ix + 1;
509 }
510 }
511 if (wrVarCount < 2) wrVarCount = 2;
512 const ncol = rows[0].length;
513 const colOffset = Math.max(0, ncol - wrVarCount);
514
515 function channelDiff(row, ch) {
516 if (!ch) return NaN;
517 const plusIsGnd = ch.plusIsGnd ?? isSpiceReferenceNode(ch.plusNode);
518 const minusIsGnd = ch.minusIsGnd ?? isSpiceReferenceNode(ch.minusNode);
519 let vp = 0;
520 let vm = 0;
521 if (!plusIsGnd) {
522 if (ch.wrIndex == null || ch.wrIndex === undefined) return NaN;
523 vp = row[ch.wrIndex + colOffset];
524 if (!Number.isFinite(vp)) return NaN;
525 }
526 if (!minusIsGnd) {
527 if (ch.minusWrIndex == null) return NaN;
528 vm = row[ch.minusWrIndex + colOffset];
529 if (!Number.isFinite(vm)) return NaN;
530 }
531 return vp - vm;
532 }
533
534 for (const m of meta) {
535 if (!m || !m.id) continue;
536 const timeCol = m.timeCol ?? 0;
537 const tArr = [];
538 const v1Arr = [];
539 const v2Arr = [];
540 for (const row of rows) {
541 if (row.length <= timeCol) continue;
542 const d1 = channelDiff(row, m.ch1);
543 const d2 = channelDiff(row, m.ch2);
544 if (!Number.isFinite(row[timeCol])) continue;
545 const ok1 = Number.isFinite(d1);
546 const ok2 = Number.isFinite(d2);
547 if (!ok1 && !ok2) continue;
548 tArr.push(row[timeCol]);
549 v1Arr.push(ok1 ? d1 : 0);
550 v2Arr.push(ok2 ? d2 : 0);
551 }
552 if (tArr.length === 0) continue;
553 out[m.id] = {
554 ch1: { time: tArr, voltage: v1Arr, unit: "V", label: "CH1" },
555 ch2: { time: tArr, voltage: v2Arr, unit: "V", label: "CH2" },
556 };
557 }
558
559 return out;
560}
561
562/**
563 * Valeurs résumées (crête à crête) pour le tableau lorsque l’analyse est .tran.
564 * @param {Record<string, { ch1?: { voltage?: number[] }; ch2?: { voltage?: number[] } }>} scopePlots
565 */
566function channelDiffFromRow(row, ch, colOffset) {
567 if (!ch) return NaN;
568 const plusIsGnd = ch.plusIsGnd ?? isSpiceReferenceNode(ch.plusNode);
569 const minusIsGnd = ch.minusIsGnd ?? isSpiceReferenceNode(ch.minusNode);
570 let vp = 0;
571 let vm = 0;
572 if (!plusIsGnd) {
573 if (ch.wrIndex == null || ch.wrIndex === undefined) return NaN;
574 vp = row[ch.wrIndex + colOffset];
575 if (!Number.isFinite(vp)) return NaN;
576 }
577 if (!minusIsGnd) {
578 if (ch.minusWrIndex == null) return NaN;
579 vm = row[ch.minusWrIndex + colOffset];
580 if (!Number.isFinite(vm)) return NaN;
581 }
582 return vp - vm;
583}

586 * @param {string} waveTxt

589export function mergeVoltmeterRmsFromTranWrdata(waveTxt, meta) {

591 const rows = parseWrdataNumericRows(waveTxt);

593
594 for (const m of meta) {
595 if (!m?.id || !m.channel) continue;
596 let wrVarCount = m.wrVarCount || 2;
597 if (m.channel.wrIndex != null && m.channel.wrIndex + 1 > wrVarCount) {
598 wrVarCount = m.channel.wrIndex + 1;
599 }
600 const ncol = rows[0].length;
601 const colOffset = Math.max(0, ncol - wrVarCount);
602 const vals = [];
603 for (const row of rows) {
604 const d = channelDiffFromRow(row, m.channel, colOffset);
605 if (Number.isFinite(d)) vals.push(d);
606 }
607 const vrms = waveformRms(vals);
608 if (!Number.isFinite(vrms)) continue;
609 out[m.id] = {
610 voltage: vrms,
611 unit: "V",
612 measure: "Vrms",
613 nodePlus: m.nodePlus,
614 nodeMinus: m.nodeMinus,
615 };
616 }
617 return out;
618}

766export function mergeOhmmeterFromTranWrdata(waveTxt, meta) {

771 for (const m of meta) {
772 if (!m?.id || !m.channel) continue;
773 const iTest = m.testCurrent > 0 ? m.testCurrent : 0.001;
774 let wrVarCount = m.wrVarCount || 2;
775 if (m.channel.wrIndex != null && m.channel.wrIndex + 1 > wrVarCount) {
776 wrVarCount = m.channel.wrIndex + 1;
777 }

784 }
785 if (!vals.length) continue;
786 const r = vals[vals.length - 1] / iTest;
787 if (!Number.isFinite(r) || r <= 0) continue;
788 out[m.id] = {
789 resistance: r,
790 unit: "Ohm",
791 nodePlus: m.nodePlus,
792 nodeMinus: m.nodeMinus,
793 };

801 * @param {{ id: string; timeCol?: number; wrVarCount?: number; currentWrIndex?: number; branch?: string; nodePlus?: string; nodeMinus?: string }[]} meta
802 */
803export function mergeLedTranPlotsFromWrdata(waveTxt, meta) {
804 const out = {};
805 const rows = parseWrdataNumericRows(waveTxt);
806 if (!rows.length || !Array.isArray(meta) || meta.length === 0) return out;
807
808 let wrVarCount = 0;
809 for (const m of meta) {
810 if (m.wrVarCount > wrVarCount) wrVarCount = m.wrVarCount;
811 if (m.currentWrIndex != null && m.currentWrIndex + 1 > wrVarCount) {
812 wrVarCount = m.currentWrIndex + 1;
813 }
814 }
815 if (wrVarCount < 2) wrVarCount = 2;
816 const ncol = rows[0].length;
817 const colOffset = Math.max(0, ncol - wrVarCount);
818 const timeCol = meta[0]?.timeCol ?? 0;

1240function vdbFromNodeChannel(row, ch) {

1247/** Gain en dB : différence des vdb si les références sont sur la masse. */
1248function gainDbFromChannels(row, outPlus, outMinus, inPlus, inMinus) {
1249 const vdbOut = vdbFromNodeChannel(row, outPlus) - vdbFromNodeChannel(row, outMinus);
1250 const vdbIn = vdbFromNodeChannel(row, inPlus) - vdbFromNodeChannel(row, inMinus);
1251 if (!Number.isFinite(vdbOut) || !Number.isFinite(vdbIn)) return NaN;
1252 return vdbOut - vdbIn;

1255/**
1256 * Fréquences de coupure à −3 dB (interpolation linéaire en échelle log).
1257 * @param {number[]} frequency
1258 * @param {number[]} gainDb
1259 * @returns {number[]}
1260 */
1261export function computeCutoffFrequencies(frequency, gainDb) {
1262 if (!frequency?.length || frequency.length !== gainDb?.length || frequency.length < 2) return [];
1263 let refGain = gainDb[0];
1264 for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(5, gainDb.length); i++) {
1265 if (Number.isFinite(gainDb[i])) refGain = Math.max(refGain, gainDb[i]);
1266 }
1267 const target = refGain - 3;
1268 const cutoffs = [];
1269 for (let i = 1; i < gainDb.length; i++) {
1270 const g0 = gainDb[i - 1];
1271 const g1 = gainDb[i];
1272 const f0 = frequency[i - 1];
1273 const f1 = frequency[i];
1274 if (!Number.isFinite(g0) || !Number.isFinite(g1) || f0 <= 0 || f1 <= 0) continue;
1275 const crossesDown = g0 >= target && g1 < target;
1276 const crossesUp = g0 < target && g1 >= target;
1277 if (!crossesDown && !crossesUp) continue;
1278 const t = (target - g0) / (g1 - g0);
1279 const logF = Math.log10(f0) + t * (Math.log10(f1) - Math.log10(f0));
1280 cutoffs.push(Math.pow(10, logF));
1281 }
1282 return cutoffs;
1283}

1285/**
1286 * @param {string} waveTxt — sortie ngspice wrdata (analyse .ac)

1288 */
1289export function mergeBodePlotsFromAcWrdata(waveTxt, meta) {
1290 const out = {};
1291 const rows = parseWrdataNumericRows(waveTxt);
1292 if (!rows.length || !Array.isArray(meta) || meta.length === 0) return out;
1293
1294 for (const m of meta) {
1295 if (!m?.id) continue;
1296 const freqCol = m.freqCol ?? 0;
1297 const frequency = [];
1298 const gainDb = [];
1299 for (const row of rows) {
1300 if (row.length <= freqCol) continue;
1301 const f = row[freqCol];
1302 if (!Number.isFinite(f) || f <= 0) continue;
1303 const gain = gainDbFromChannels(row, m.outPlus, m.outMinus, m.inPlus, m.inMinus);
1304 if (!Number.isFinite(gain)) continue;
1305 frequency.push(f);
1306 gainDb.push(gain);
1307 }
1308 if (frequency.length === 0) continue;
1309 const cutoffHz = computeCutoffFrequencies(frequency, gainDb);
1310 let responseHint = null;
1311 const gLo = gainDb[0];
1312 const gHi = gainDb[gainDb.length - 1];
1313 if (Number.isFinite(gLo) && Number.isFinite(gHi)) {
1314 if (gHi > gLo + 6) {
1315 responseHint =
1316 "Courbe type passe-haut : reliez + sur la jonction R/C (sortie du filtre) et − sur la masse (GND), pas aux bornes de la résistance.";
1317 } else if (gLo > 1 && gHi < gLo - 6) {
1318 responseHint = "Filtre passe-bas détecté.";
1319 }
1320 }
1321 out[m.id] = {
1322 frequency,
1323 gainDb,
1324 fMin: m.fMin ?? frequency[0],
1325 fMax: m.fMax ?? frequency[frequency.length - 1],
1326 cutoffHz,
1327 unit: "dB",
1328 label: "Gain",
1329 responseHint,
1330 };
1331 }
1332 return out;
1333}

1/**
2 * Affichage voltmètre : quantification 0/Vhi pour la logique, tensions négatives conservées.
3 * @param {number} v
4 * @param {number[]|null} [samples] échantillons .tran (détection signal logique unipolaire)
5 */
6export function quantizeVoltmeterReading(v, samples) {
7 if (typeof v !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(v)) return v;
8 const vals = Array.isArray(samples) ? samples.filter(Number.isFinite) : [];
9 if (vals.length >= 4) {
10 const maxV = Math.max(...vals);
11 const minV = Math.min(...vals);
12 // Uniquement signaux unipolaires (0 / Vhi) — pas AC ni DC négatif.
13 if (maxV - minV > 1.5 && minV >= -0.5) {
14 const vhi = maxV >= 3 ? maxV : 5;
15 const vlo = minV <= 0.5 ? 0 : minV;
16 return v >= vhi / 2 ? vhi : vlo;
17 }
18 }
19 if (Math.abs(v) >= 4) return Math.round(v * 10) / 10;
20 if (v >= 0 && v <= 0.5) return 0;
21 return v;
22}

51export function isPointOnSegment(px, py, p1, p2, tolerance = 1) {
52 const minX = Math.min(p1.x, p2.x) - tolerance, maxX = Math.max(p1.x, p2.x) + tolerance;
53 const minY = Math.min(p1.y, p2.y) - tolerance, maxY = Math.max(p1.y, p2.y) + tolerance;
54 if (px < minX || px > maxX || py < minY || py > maxY) return false;
55 if (Math.abs(p1.x - p2.x) < 2) return Math.abs(px - p1.x) <= tolerance;
56 if (Math.abs(p1.y - p2.y) < 2) return Math.abs(py - p1.y) <= tolerance;
57 const A = px - p1.x; const B = py - p1.y; const C = p2.x - p1.x; const D = p2.y - p1.y;
58 const dot = A * C + B * D; const lenSq = C * C + D * D;
59 const param = lenSq !== 0 ? dot / lenSq : -1;
60 if (param >= 0 && param <= 1) {
61 const xx = p1.x + param * C; const yy = p1.y + param * D;
62 return Math.hypot(px - xx, py - yy) <= tolerance;
63 }
64 return false;
65}

67export function findWireIntersection(x, y) {
68 for (let w of circuit.wires) {
69 for (let i = 0; i < w.points.length - 1; i++) {
70 if (isPointOnSegment(x, y, w.points[i], w.points[i+1], 1)) {
71 return { x: snapToGrid(x), y: snapToGrid(y) };
72 }
73 }
74 }
75 return null;
76}

167 localPts = [

187 localPts = inNames.map((n, i) => ({ id: `${comp.label}_${n}`, x: CD4511_JUNC_L, y: CD4511_PIN_Y[i] }));

189 outNames.forEach((n, i) => {
190 localPts.push({ id: `${comp.label}_${n}`, x: CD4511_JUNC_R, y: CD4511_PIN_Y[i] });
191 });
192 } else if (comp.type === 'ic_74hc90') {

194 const right = ['Q0', 'Q1', 'Q2', 'Q3', null, 'GND', 'CP0'];
195 left.forEach((n, i) => {

200 });

202 UNO_LEFT_PINS.forEach((n, i) => {

204 });

207 });
208 } else if (['gnd', 'vcc', 'logic_terminal'].includes(comp.type)) {

212 localPts.forEach(pt => {
213 let lx = pt.x;
214 let ly = pt.y;
215 if (comp.type !== 'gimp' && comp.type !== 'gsin' && comp.type !== 'gsqr' && comp.type !== 'oscilloscope' && comp.type !== 'd_flipflop' && comp.type !== 'jk_flipflop' && comp.type !== 'cd4511' && comp.type !== 'ic_74hc90' && comp.type !== 'arduino_uno' && comp.type !== 'npn' && comp.type !== 'opamp' && comp.type !== 'seg7' && comp.type !== 'bargraph_dc10h' && comp.type !== 'grove_lcd16x2' && comp.type !== 'grove_dht22') {
216 const rx = lx * Math.cos(rad) - ly * Math.sin(rad);
217 const ry = lx * Math.sin(rad) + ly * Math.cos(rad);
218 lx = rx;
219 ly = ry;
220 }
221 if (comp.flipX && (comp.type === 'npn' || comp.type === 'opamp')) lx = -lx;
222 if (comp.flipY && comp.type === 'opamp') ly = -ly;
223 list.push({ id: pt.id, x: snapToGrid(comp.x + lx), y: snapToGrid(comp.y + ly) });
224 });
225 return list;

228/** Zone cliquable pour sélectionner un composant (coords schéma). */
229export function componentHitTest(comp, mx, my) {
230 const dx = Math.abs(mx - comp.x);
231 const dy = Math.abs(my - comp.y);
232 if (comp.type === 'logic_terminal') return dx < 24 && dy < 14;
233 if (comp.type === 'd_flipflop' || comp.type === 'jk_flipflop') return dx < 45 && dy < 68;
234 if (comp.type === 'cd4511') return dx < CD4511_HIT_DX && dy < CD4511_HIT_DY;
235 if (comp.type === 'ic_74hc90') return dx < IC90_HIT_DX && dy < IC90_HIT_DY;
236 if (comp.type === 'arduino_uno') return dx < UNO_HIT_DX && dy < UNO_HIT_DY;
237 if (comp.type === 'gimp' || comp.type === 'gsin' || comp.type === 'gsqr') return dx < 45 && dy < 50;
238 if (comp.type === 'oscilloscope') return dx < 52 && dy < 62;
239 if (comp.type === 'seg7') return dx < 60 && dy < 110;
240 if (comp.type === 'bargraph_dc10h') {
241 const x = mx - comp.x;
242 const y = my - comp.y;
243 return x >= DC10H_SEL_L && x <= DC10H_SEL_L + DC10H_SEL_W
244 && y >= DC10H_SEL_T && y <= DC10H_SEL_T + DC10H_SEL_H;
245 }
246 if (comp.type === 'grove_lcd16x2') return dx < GROVE_LCD_HIT_DX && dy < GROVE_LCD_HIT_DY;
247 if (comp.type === 'grove_dht22') return dx < GROVE_DHT22_HIT_DX && dy < GROVE_DHT22_HIT_DY;
248 if (comp.type === 'opamp') return dx < 44 && dy < 42;
249 if (comp.type === 'npn') return dx < 44 && dy < 44;
250 if (comp.type === 'switch_spdt') return dx < 38 && dy < 38;
251 if (comp.type === 'push_button') return dx < 34 && dy < 26;
252 if (comp.type === 'potentiometer') return dx < 34 && dy < 38;
253 return dx < 30 && dy < 30;
254}
255
256export function compLocalCoords(comp, mx, my) {
257 const dx = mx - comp.x;
258 const dy = my - comp.y;
259 const rad = -(comp.rotation || 0) * Math.PI / 180;
260 return {
261 x: dx * Math.cos(rad) - dy * Math.sin(rad),
262 y: dx * Math.sin(rad) + dy * Math.cos(rad),
263 };
264}
265
266/** Clic sur ◀ / ▶ du potentiomètre. */
267export function potentiometerControlHit(comp, mx, my) {
268 if (comp.type !== 'potentiometer') return null;
269 const { x, y } = compLocalCoords(comp, mx, my);
270 if (x >= -16 && x <= -2 && y >= 11 && y <= 25) return 'dec';
271 if (x >= 2 && x <= 16 && y >= 11 && y <= 25) return 'inc';
272 return null;
273}
274
275/** Zone du levier (clic = bascule A ↔ B). */
276export function switchSpdtToggleHit(comp, mx, my) {
277 if (comp.type !== 'switch_spdt') return false;
278 const { x, y } = compLocalCoords(comp, mx, my);
279 return x >= -12 && x <= 12 && y >= -18 && y <= 18;
280}
281
282/** Zone du capuchon du bouton poussoir (clic = appui ↔ relâche). */
283export function pushButtonToggleHit(comp, mx, my) {
284 if (comp.type !== 'push_button') return false;
285 const { x, y } = compLocalCoords(comp, mx, my);
286 return x >= -16 && x <= 16 && y >= -20 && y <= 16;
287}

289export function isJonctionConnected(jonctionId) {
290 return circuit.wires.some(w => w.fromJonctionId === jonctionId || w.toJonctionId === jonctionId);
291}
292
293export function getVoltageAtJonction(targetJonctionId) {
294 if (!flags.isSimulating || !simulationResults.voltmeters) return 0;
295 let openList = [targetJonctionId];
296 let connectedJonctions = new Set(openList);
297
298 while (openList.length > 0) {
299 let current = openList.pop();
300 for (let w of circuit.wires) {
301 if (w.fromJonctionId === current && !connectedJonctions.has(w.toJonctionId)) {
302 connectedJonctions.add(w.toJonctionId); openList.push(w.toJonctionId);
303 }
304 if (w.toJonctionId === current && !connectedJonctions.has(w.fromJonctionId)) {
305 connectedJonctions.add(w.fromJonctionId); openList.push(w.fromJonctionId);
306 }
307 }
308 }
309
310 for (let jId of connectedJonctions) {
311 if (jId.startsWith('GND')) return 0;
312 for (let vName in simulationResults.voltmeters) {
313 let measureData = simulationResults.voltmeters[vName];
314 let v = (typeof measureData === 'object') ? measureData.voltage : measureData;
315 if (jId === `${vName}_in`) return v || 0;
316 if (jId === `${vName}_out`) return 0;
317 }
318 for (let comp of circuit.components) {
319 if (comp.label && jId.startsWith(comp.label)) {
320 if (comp.type === 'vcc') return comp.value !== undefined ? comp.value : 5;
321 if (comp.type === 'battery' && jId.endsWith('_in')) return comp.value !== undefined ? comp.value : 5;
322 }
323 }
324 }
325 return 0;
326}

1/** Grove LCD RGB 2×16 I2C — géométrie calée grille, centré sur comp.x/y (origine = centre du boîtier). */
2import { GRID_SIZE as G } from './state.js';
3
4export const GROVE_LCD_COLS = 16;
5export const GROVE_LCD_ROWS = 2;
6export const GROVE_LCD_DEFAULT_I2C = 0x3e;
7
8export const GROVE_LCD_PINS = ['SDA', 'SCL', 'VCC', 'GND'];
9export const GROVE_LCD_PIN_COUNT = GROVE_LCD_PINS.length;
10
11/** Boîtier : 12 pas (long) × 4 pas (haut). */
12export const GROVE_LCD_BOX_W = 12 * G;
13export const GROVE_LCD_BOX_H = 4 * G;
14export const GROVE_LCD_BOX_L = -GROVE_LCD_BOX_W / 2;
15export const GROVE_LCD_BOX_R = GROVE_LCD_BOX_W / 2;
16
17/** Translation Y commune : caler les 4 jonctions sur la grille sans déformer le bloc. */
18const GROVE_LCD_Y_NUDGE = G / 2;
19
20/** 4 broches équidistantes (pas = G), centrées verticalement sur le boîtier. */
21export const GROVE_LCD_PIN_Y = [-1.5, -0.5, 0.5, 1.5].map((f) => f * G + GROVE_LCD_Y_NUDGE);
22
23/** Boîtier centré sur le faisceau de 4 fils. */
24const _wireCenterY = (GROVE_LCD_PIN_Y[0] + GROVE_LCD_PIN_Y[GROVE_LCD_PIN_COUNT - 1]) / 2;
25export const GROVE_LCD_BOX_T = _wireCenterY - GROVE_LCD_BOX_H / 2;
26export const GROVE_LCD_BOX_B = _wireCenterY + GROVE_LCD_BOX_H / 2;
27
28/** Connecteur Grove : 1 pas de large, bord gauche du boîtier. */
29export const GROVE_LCD_CONNECTOR_W = G;
30export const GROVE_LCD_CONN_L = GROVE_LCD_BOX_L;
31
32/** Pattes : 4 pas vers la gauche (jonctions sur la grille). */
33export const GROVE_LCD_STUB_LEN = 4 * G;
34export const GROVE_LCD_JUNC_X = GROVE_LCD_CONN_L - GROVE_LCD_STUB_LEN;
35
36export const GROVE_LCD_BEZEL = 4;
37export const GROVE_LCD_SEL_L = GROVE_LCD_JUNC_X - 4;
38export const GROVE_LCD_SEL_T = GROVE_LCD_BOX_T - 4;
39export const GROVE_LCD_SEL_W = GROVE_LCD_BOX_R - GROVE_LCD_SEL_L + 4;
40export const GROVE_LCD_SEL_H = GROVE_LCD_BOX_H + 8;
41
42export const GROVE_LCD_PIN_LABEL_X = (GROVE_LCD_JUNC_X + GROVE_LCD_CONN_L) / 2;
43
44export const GROVE_LCD_HIT_DX = Math.max(-GROVE_LCD_SEL_L, GROVE_LCD_BOX_R) + 4;
45export const GROVE_LCD_HIT_DY = GROVE_LCD_BOX_H / 2 + 16;
46
47/** Zone verte (écran) : à droite du connecteur, dans le cadre. */
48export const GROVE_LCD_SCREEN_L = GROVE_LCD_BOX_L + GROVE_LCD_CONNECTOR_W + GROVE_LCD_BEZEL;
49export const GROVE_LCD_SCREEN_R = GROVE_LCD_BOX_R - GROVE_LCD_BEZEL;
50export const GROVE_LCD_SCREEN_T = GROVE_LCD_BOX_T + GROVE_LCD_BEZEL;
51export const GROVE_LCD_SCREEN_B = GROVE_LCD_BOX_B - GROVE_LCD_BEZEL;

114const SPACE_GLYPH = new Uint8Array(8);
115
116/** @returns {Uint8Array} */
117export function getHd44780Glyph(ch) {
118 const code = ch.charCodeAt(0);
119 if (code >= 0x20 && code <= 0x7f) {
120 const off = (code - 0x20) * 8;
121 return FONT.subarray(off, off + 8);
122 }
123 return SPACE_GLYPH;
124}

1/** Géométrie 74HC90 / 74LS90 — boîtier DIP 14 broches (datasheet TI). */
2import { GRID_SIZE as G } from './state.js';
3
4export const IC90_BOX_L = -2 * G;
5export const IC90_BOX_R = 2 * G;
6export const IC90_BOX_T = -3.5 * G;
7export const IC90_BOX_B = 3.5 * G;
8export const IC90_LABEL_L = IC90_BOX_L + G / 2;
9export const IC90_LABEL_R = IC90_BOX_R - G / 2;
10export const IC90_JUNC_L = -3 * G;
11export const IC90_JUNC_R = 3 * G;
12
13/** Broches 1–7 (gauche) et 14–8 (droite), espacement 1 pas. */
14export const IC90_LEFT_PIN_Y = [-3, -2, -1, 0, 1, 2, 3].map((n) => n * G);
15export const IC90_RIGHT_PIN_Y = [-3, -2, -1, 0, 1, 2, 3].map((n) => n * G);
16
17/** Q0…Q3 empilés (même hauteur que A…D du CD4511) pour câblage direct. */
18export const IC90_Q_STACK_INDICES = [0, 1, 2, 3];
19
20/** Numéros de broches DIP 14 (TI 74HC90 / 74LS90). */
21export const IC90_DIP = {
22 CP1: 1,
23 MR1: 2,
24 MR2: 3,
25 NC4: 4,
26 VCC: 5,
27 MS1: 6,
28 MS2: 7,
29 Q2: 8,
30 Q1: 9,
31 GND: 10,
32 Q3: 11,
33 Q0: 12,
34 NC13: 13,
35 CP0: 14,
36};
37
38export const IC90_HIT_DX = 3 * G + G / 2;
39export const IC90_HIT_DY = 3.5 * G + G / 2;
40
41/** Indice SPICE (#0…#13) = numéro de broche DIP − 1. */
42export const IC90_PIN = {
43 CP1: 0,
44 MR1: 1,
45 MR2: 2,
46 NC4: 3,
47 VCC: 4,
48 MS1: 5,
49 MS2: 6,
50 Q2: 7,
51 Q1: 8,
52 GND: 9,
53 Q3: 10,
54 Q0: 11,
55 NC13: 12,
56 CP0: 13,
57};
58
59/** Suffixe jonction schéma → indice broche. */
60export const IC90_JONCTION_SUFFIX = {
61 CP1: IC90_PIN.CP1,
62 MR1: IC90_PIN.MR1,
63 MR2: IC90_PIN.MR2,
64 VCC: IC90_PIN.VCC,
65 MS1: IC90_PIN.MS1,
66 MS2: IC90_PIN.MS2,
67 Q2: IC90_PIN.Q2,
68 Q1: IC90_PIN.Q1,
69 GND: IC90_PIN.GND,
70 Q3: IC90_PIN.Q3,
71 Q0: IC90_PIN.Q0,
72 CP0: IC90_PIN.CP0,
73};
74
75export function ic74hc90JonctionToTerminalKey(label, jonctionId) {
76 if (!label || !jonctionId?.startsWith(`${label}_`)) return null;
77 const suffix = jonctionId.slice(label.length + 1);
78 const idx = IC90_JONCTION_SUFFIX[suffix];
79 if (idx === undefined) return null;
80 return `${label}#${idx}`;
81}
82
83export function ic74hc90OutputPinIndices() {
84 return [IC90_PIN.Q0, IC90_PIN.Q1, IC90_PIN.Q2, IC90_PIN.Q3];
85}
86
87export function ic74hc90InputPinIndices() {
88 return [IC90_PIN.CP1, IC90_PIN.MR1, IC90_PIN.MR2, IC90_PIN.MS1, IC90_PIN.MS2, IC90_PIN.CP0];
89}

367 <div id="cd4511-doc-modal" class="modal hidden">
368 <div class="modal-content modal-content--doc">
369 <span class="close-modal" id="close-cd4511-doc">&times;</span>
370 <h2 id="cd4511-doc-title">CD4511 — Décodeur BCD / 7 segments</h2>
371 <div class="modal-body modal-body--doc">
372 <p>
373 Le <strong>CD4511</strong> (ou équivalent CMOS) convertit un code <strong>BCD 4 bits</strong>
374 (A = LSB) en sorties pour un afficheur <strong>7 segments</strong> en cathode commune.
375 Il intègre une <strong>mémorisation</strong> (broche LE) et les fonctions
376 <strong>extinction</strong> (BI) et <strong>test lampe</strong> (LT).
377 </p>
378 <h3>Broches du symbole (simulateur)</h3>
379 <table class="doc-pin-table">
380 <thead>
381 <tr><th>Broche</th><th>Rôle</th><th>Niveau actif</th></tr>
382 </thead>
383 <tbody>
384 <tr><td>A, B, C, D</td><td>Entrées BCD (A = bit faible)</td><td>1 = logique haut (0…V<sub>CC</sub>)</td></tr>
385 <tr><td>LE</td><td>Verrouillage — 0 : suivi des entrées ; 1 : mémorise</td><td>Relier à <strong>0 V</strong> pour suivre un compteur</td></tr>
386 <tr><td>BI</td><td>Extinction de l’affichage</td><td><strong>0 V = éteint</strong> — relier BI au <strong>+5 V</strong></td></tr>
387 <tr><td>LT</td><td>Test lampe (tous segments ON)</td><td><strong>0 V = test</strong> — relier LT au <strong>+5 V</strong> en usage normal</td></tr>
388 <tr><td>a … g</td><td>Sorties vers les segments</td><td>1 = segment allumé (cathode commune)</td></tr>
389 </tbody>
390 </table>
391 <h3>Brochage réel (boîtier DIP 16 — repères courants)</h3>
392 <table class="doc-pin-table">
393 <thead>
394 <tr><th>Broche DIP</th><th>Symbole</th><th>Rôle</th></tr>
395 </thead>
396 <tbody>
397 <tr><td>7</td><td>A</td><td>Entrée BCD bit faible (LSB)</td></tr>
398 <tr><td>1</td><td>B</td><td>Entrée BCD</td></tr>
399 <tr><td>2</td><td>C</td><td>Entrée BCD</td></tr>
400 <tr><td>6</td><td>D</td><td>Entrée BCD bit fort (MSB)</td></tr>
401 <tr><td>1</td><td>LE</td><td>Verrouillage (0 = suivi direct)</td></tr>
402 <tr><td>2</td><td>BI</td><td>Extinction (1 = affichage actif)</td></tr>
403 <tr><td>3</td><td>LT</td><td>Test lampe (1 = fonctionnement normal)</td></tr>
404 <tr><td>12</td><td>V<sub>DD</sub></td><td>+5 V (alimentation du circuit, hors symbole)</td></tr>
405 <tr><td>8</td><td>V<sub>SS</sub></td><td>Masse</td></tr>
406 <tr><td>9, 10, 11, 13, 14, 15, 16</td><td>e, d, c, b, a, f, g</td><td>Sorties vers l’afficheur 7 segments</td></tr>
407 </tbody>
408 </table>
409 <h3>Câblage typique</h3>
410 <ul class="doc-list">
411 <li>Relier <strong>a … g</strong> aux entrées du composant <em>Afficheur 7 segments</em> (<code>SEG_1</code>).</li>
412 <li>Relier la <strong>cathode commune (COM)</strong> de l’afficheur à la <strong>masse</strong> (<code>GND_1</code>).</li>
413 <li><strong>BI</strong> et <strong>LT</strong> au <strong>+5 V</strong> (<code>VCC_1</code> ou <code>LOGIC_1</code> à 1) — pas à la masse.</li>
414 <li><strong>LE</strong> à <strong>0 V</strong> (<code>GND_1</code> ou borne à 0) pour suivre un compteur.</li>
415 </ul>
416 <h3>Simulation</h3>
417 <p>
418 Modèle <strong>XSPICE</strong> : bascules <code>d_dlatch</code>, table <code>d_genlut</code>,
419 ponts analogiques/numériques. Nécessite <code>digital.cm</code> et ngspice avec XSPICE
420 (<code>npm run check-ngspice</code>).
421 </p>
422 <p class="doc-hint">Double-clic sur le symbole pour rouvrir cette fiche.</p>
423 </div>
424 </div>
425 </div>
426
427 <div id="bargraph-doc-modal" class="modal hidden">
428 <div class="modal-content modal-content--doc">
429 <span class="close-modal" id="close-bargraph-doc">&times;</span>
430 <h2 id="bargraph-doc-title">Bargraph DC10H — Lite-On</h2>
431 <div class="modal-body modal-body--doc">
432 <p>
433 Le <strong>DC10H</strong> (Lite-On, série LTA) est un afficheur à barres de
434 <strong>10 segments LED</strong> en <strong>cathode commune</strong>.
435 Chaque segment s’allume lorsque son anode est au niveau haut par rapport à la cathode commune (COM).
436 </p>
437 <h3>Couleur des segments</h3>
438 <p>Choisissez la couleur d’affichage (cosmétique — n’affecte pas la simulation SPICE) :</p>
439 <div id="bargraph-color-picker" class="bargraph-color-picker"></div>
440 <h3>Broches du symbole (simulateur)</h3>
441 <table class="doc-pin-table">
442 <thead>
443 <tr><th>Broche</th><th>Rôle</th><th>Connexion typique</th></tr>
444 </thead>
445 <tbody>
446 <tr><td>s1 … s10</td><td>Anodes des segments (s1 = barre du bas, s10 = barre du haut)</td><td>Sorties logiques ou résistances de limitation</td></tr>
447 <tr><td>COM</td><td>Cathode commune</td><td>Relier à la <strong>masse (0 V)</strong></td></tr>
448 </tbody>
449 </table>
450 <h3>Brochage réel (DIP 20 — repères courants LTA/DC10H)</h3>
451 <table class="doc-pin-table">
452 <thead>
453 <tr><th>Broches DIP</th><th>Segment</th><th>Broches DIP</th><th>Segment</th></tr>
454 </thead>
455 <tbody>
456 <tr><td>1, 11</td><td>s1 (bas)</td><td>6, 16</td><td>s6</td></tr>
457 <tr><td>2, 12</td><td>s2</td><td>7, 17</td><td>s7</td></tr>
458 <tr><td>3, 13</td><td>s3</td><td>8, 18</td><td>s8</td></tr>
459 <tr><td>4, 14</td><td>s4</td><td>9, 19</td><td>s9</td></tr>
460 <tr><td>5, 15</td><td>s5</td><td>10, 20</td><td>s10 (haut)</td></tr>
461 </tbody>
462 </table>
463 <p class="doc-hint">
464 Les broches impaires (1–10) et paires (11–20) sont respectivement anode et cathode de chaque segment ;
465 toutes les cathodes sont reliées en interne (cathode commune).
466 </p>
467 <h3>Câblage typique</h3>
468 <ul class="doc-list">
469 <li>Relier <strong>COM</strong> à la masse du circuit.</li>
470 <li>Placer une résistance (220 Ω … 1 kΩ) en série avec chaque anode si alimentation directe en 5 V.</li>
471 <li>Pour un niveau analogique : comparateur ou sorties numériques décimales (CD4511, compteur, Arduino).</li>
472 </ul>
473 <p class="doc-hint">Double-clic sur le symbole pour rouvrir cette fiche et changer la couleur.</p>
474 </div>
475 </div>
476 </div>

478 <div id="hc90-doc-modal" class="modal hidden">
479 <div class="modal-content modal-content--doc">
480 <span class="close-modal" id="close-hc90-doc">&times;</span>
481 <h2 id="hc90-doc-title">74HC90 — Compteur décade asynchrone</h2>
482 <div class="modal-body modal-body--doc">
483 <p>
484 Le <strong>74HC90</strong> (ou 74LS90) est un compteur <strong>asynchrone</strong>
485 en deux sections : <strong>÷2</strong> (bascule A, horloge <strong>CP0</strong>) et
486 <strong>÷5</strong> (bascules B–D). En <strong>mode décade</strong>, la sortie
487 <strong>Q0</strong> est reliée à <strong>CP1</strong> pour former un compteur
488 <strong>0…9</strong> sur les sorties Q0–Q3 (code binaire naturel).
489 </p>
490 <h3>Brochage réel (boîtier DIP 14 — 74HC90)</h3>
491 <table class="doc-pin-table">
492 <thead>
493 <tr><th>Broche DIP</th><th>Symbole</th><th>Rôle</th></tr>
494 </thead>
495 <tbody>
496 <tr><td>14</td><td>CP0</td><td>Horloge principale (GImp) — section ÷2</td></tr>
497 <tr><td>1</td><td>CP1</td><td>Horloge section ÷5 — relier à <strong>Q0</strong> (décade)</td></tr>
498 <tr><td>12</td><td>Q0</td><td>Sortie LSB — vers <strong>CD4511_1</strong> entrée <strong>A</strong></td></tr>
499 <tr><td>9</td><td>Q1</td><td>Vers entrée <strong>B</strong></td></tr>
500 <tr><td>8</td><td>Q2</td><td>Vers entrée <strong>C</strong></td></tr>
501 <tr><td>11</td><td>Q3</td><td>MSB — vers entrée <strong>D</strong></td></tr>
502 <tr><td>2, 3</td><td>MR1, MR2</td><td>Reset (niveau haut = compteur à 0)</td></tr>
503 <tr><td>6, 7</td><td>MS1, MS2</td><td>Mode — laisser à 0 V (décade)</td></tr>
504 <tr><td>5</td><td>VCC</td><td>+5 V (<code>VCC_1</code>)</td></tr>
505 <tr><td>10</td><td>GND</td><td>Masse (<code>GND_1</code>)</td></tr>
506 <tr><td>4, 13</td><td>NC</td><td>Non connectées</td></tr>
507 </tbody>
508 </table>
509 <p class="doc-hint">Sur le schéma, <strong>Q0…Q3</strong> sont alignés verticalement (comme <strong>A…D</strong> du CD4511) pour des fils horizontaux courts.</p>
510 <h3>Montage compteur → afficheur (noms du simulateur)</h3>
511 <table class="doc-pin-table">
512 <thead>
513 <tr><th>De</th><th>Vers</th><th>Fil</th></tr>
514 </thead>
515 <tbody>
516 <tr><td><code>GND_1</code></td><td><code>HC90_1</code> GND, <code>CD4511_1</code> (masse circuit), <code>SEG_1</code> COM</td><td>Masse commune</td></tr>
517 <tr><td><code>VCC_1</code></td><td><code>HC90_1</code> VCC</td><td>+5 V</td></tr>
518 <tr><td><code>VCC_1</code> ou <code>LOGIC_1</code> (1)</td><td><code>CD4511_1</code> BI, LT</td><td>Afficheur actif</td></tr>
519 <tr><td><code>GND_1</code> ou <code>LOGIC_2</code> (0)</td><td><code>CD4511_1</code> LE</td><td>Suivi direct du compteur</td></tr>
520 <tr><td><code>GND_1</code> ou <code>LOGIC_3</code> (0)</td><td><code>HC90_1</code> MR1, MR2, MS1, MS2</td><td>Comptage décade</td></tr>
521 <tr><td><code>GImp_1</code> sortie</td><td><code>HC90_1</code> CP0</td><td>Horloge</td></tr>
522 <tr><td><code>HC90_1</code> Q0</td><td><code>HC90_1</code> CP1</td><td>Décade (aussi forcé en simulation)</td></tr>
523 <tr><td><code>HC90_1</code> Q0</td><td><code>CD4511_1</code> A</td><td>BCD bit 0</td></tr>
524 <tr><td><code>HC90_1</code> Q1</td><td><code>CD4511_1</code> B</td><td>BCD bit 1</td></tr>
525 <tr><td><code>HC90_1</code> Q2</td><td><code>CD4511_1</code> C</td><td>BCD bit 2</td></tr>
526 <tr><td><code>HC90_1</code> Q3</td><td><code>CD4511_1</code> D</td><td>BCD bit 3</td></tr>
527 <tr><td><code>CD4511_1</code> a…g</td><td><code>SEG_1</code> a…g</td><td>Segments</td></tr>
528 </tbody>
529 </table>
530 <h3>Câblage typique (mode décade 0…9)</h3>
531 <ul class="doc-list">
532 <li>Les composants sont numérotés <code>HC90_1</code>, <code>CD4511_1</code>, <code>SEG_1</code>, <code>GND_1</code>, <code>VCC_1</code>, <code>GImp_1</code>, etc.</li>
533 <li>Horloge <strong>1 Hz</strong> sur <code>GImp_1</code> → CP0 pour une seconde par pas (préréglage « tick seconde » dans le panneau GImp).</li>
534 <li>Le fil <strong>Q0 → CP1</strong> reste recommandé sur la plaquette ; il est aussi appliqué automatiquement en simulation.</li>
535 </ul>
536 <h3>Deux chiffres (unités + dizaines)</h3>
537 <ul class="doc-list">
538 <li>Dupliquer la chaîne <code>HC90 → CD4511 → SEG</code> (<code>HC90_2</code>, <code>CD4511_2</code>, <code>SEG_2</code>).</li>
539 <li>Horloge <code>GImp_1</code> uniquement sur <code>HC90_1</code> CP0 ; <code>HC90_2</code> CP0 via une porte <strong>ET</strong>.</li>
540 <li><strong>Report au chiffre 9</strong> : relier <code>HC90_1</code> <strong>Q0</strong> et <strong>Q3</strong> aux entrées de l’ET, sortie → <code>HC90_2</code> CP0. Au comptage 9 (binaire 1001), Q0 et Q3 sont à 1 → un front horloge sur les dizaines.</li>
541 <li><strong>Ne pas utiliser Q1 + Q3</strong> : en BCD 0…9 ces sorties ne sont jamais hautes en même temps (seul l’état invalide 10 = 1010 les active).</li>
542 <li><code>HC90_2</code> : même câblage décade (Q0 → CP1, MR/MS à 0, VCC/GND).</li>
543 <li><strong>Affichage 0…99</strong> : si le report est correct (AND Q0+Q3 ou Q3), l’animation utilise un comptage idéal en temps réel (1 impulsion = +1), fiable à toute fréquence du GImp.</li>
544 </ul>
545 <h3>Simulation</h3>
546 <p>
547 Quatre bascules <strong>D</strong> en mode bascule (D relié à /Q, horloges en cascade).
548 Modèle <strong>XSPICE</strong> (<code>d_dff</code>) si ngspice et <code>digital.cm</code> sont disponibles ;
549 sinon repli sur sources comportementales (comme la bascule D du simulateur).
550 Vérification : <code>node Simulateur/Engine/ic74hc90-decade.test.mjs</code>,
551 <code>node Simulateur/Engine/hc90-cascade.test.mjs</code> ou
552 <code>npm run check-ngspice</code>.
553 </p>
554 <p class="doc-hint">Double-clic sur le symbole pour rouvrir cette fiche.</p>
555 </div>
556 </div>
557 </div>
558
559 <div id="uno-doc-modal" class="modal hidden">
560 <div class="modal-content modal-content--doc">
561 <span class="close-modal" id="close-uno-doc">&times;</span>
562 <h2 id="uno-doc-title">Arduino UNO R3</h2>
563 <div class="modal-body modal-body--doc">
564 <p>
565 Carte <strong>Arduino UNO R3</strong> (ATmega328P) : alimentation <strong>5 V</strong> / <strong>3,3 V</strong>,
566 <strong>14 broches digitales</strong> D0–D13 et <strong>6 entrées analogiques</strong> A0–A5.
567 L’éditeur de sketch est dans le <strong>panneau à droite</strong> (ouvert à la pose du composant).
568 </p>
569 <h3>Broches du symbole (simulateur)</h3>
570 <table class="doc-pin-table">
571 <thead>
572 <tr><th>Broche</th><th>Rôle</th></tr>
573 </thead>
574 <tbody>
575 <tr><td>5V, 3V3</td><td>Alimentation sortie (rails simulés)</td></tr>
576 <tr><td>GND, GND2</td><td>Masse</td></tr>
577 <tr><td>VIN</td><td>Alimentation externe (entrée)</td></tr>
578 <tr><td>RESET</td><td>Reset (pull-up interne modélisé)</td></tr>
579 <tr><td>A0 … A5</td><td>Entrées analogiques / I²C (A4/A5)</td></tr>
580 <tr><td>D0, D1</td><td>UART (RX/TX)</td></tr>
581 <tr><td>D2 … D13</td><td>GPIO digitales (PWM : D3, D5, D6, D9, D10, D11)</td></tr>
582 <tr><td>D13</td><td>LED intégrée (<code>LED_BUILTIN</code> = 13)</td></tr>
583 </tbody>
584 </table>
585 <h3>Registres AVR — ports et broches (ATmega328P)</h3>
586 <p>
587 Chaque broche GPIO est pilotée par un couple <strong>DDRx</strong> (direction) et
588 <strong>PORTx</strong> (niveau ou pull-up). Le simulateur interprète
589 <code>pinMode</code> / <code>digitalWrite</code> et les accès directs aux registres
590 (<code>DDRD |= (1&lt;&lt;5)</code>, <code>PORTB = 0xFF</code>, etc.).
591 Pendant la simulation, les valeurs hex des registres s’affichent sur le symbole UNO.
592 </p>
593 <table class="doc-pin-table">
594 <thead>
595 <tr><th>Port AVR</th><th>Registres</th><th>Bits</th><th>Broches Arduino</th><th>Repères MCU</th></tr>
596 </thead>
597 <tbody>
598 <tr>
599 <td><strong>Port D</strong></td>
600 <td><code>DDRD</code> / <code>PORTD</code></td>
601 <td>0 … 7</td>
602 <td><strong>D0</strong> … <strong>D7</strong></td>
603 <td>PD0 … PD7</td>
604 </tr>
605 <tr>
606 <td><strong>Port B</strong></td>
607 <td><code>DDRB</code> / <code>PORTB</code></td>
608 <td>0 … 5</td>
609 <td><strong>D8</strong> … <strong>D13</strong></td>
610 <td>PB0 … PB5 (<code>LED_BUILTIN</code> = PB5 / D13)</td>
611 </tr>
612 <tr>
613 <td><strong>Port C</strong></td>
614 <td><code>DDRC</code> / <code>PORTC</code></td>
615 <td>0 … 5</td>
616 <td><strong>A0</strong> … <strong>A5</strong></td>
617 <td>PC0 … PC5 (pins Arduino 14 … 19 en mode digital)</td>
618 </tr>
619 </tbody>
620 </table>
621 <h3>Correspondance broche ↔ bit (référence rapide)</h3>
622 <table class="doc-pin-table">
623 <thead>
624 <tr><th>Broche</th><th>Port / bit</th><th>Numéro Arduino</th><th>Usage courant</th></tr>
625 </thead>
626 <tbody>
627 <tr><td>D0</td><td>PORTD bit 0</td><td>0</td><td>UART RX</td></tr>
628 <tr><td>D1</td><td>PORTD bit 1</td><td>1</td><td>UART TX</td></tr>
629 <tr><td>D2 … D7</td><td>PORTD bits 2 … 7</td><td>2 … 7</td><td>GPIO (PWM : D3, D5, D6)</td></tr>
630 <tr><td>D8 … D12</td><td>PORTB bits 0 … 4</td><td>8 … 12</td><td>GPIO (PWM : D9, D10, D11)</td></tr>
631 <tr><td>D13</td><td>PORTB bit 5</td><td>13</td><td>GPIO, LED intégrée</td></tr>
632 <tr><td>A0 … A3</td><td>PORTC bits 0 … 3</td><td>14 … 17</td><td>Analogique / GPIO digital</td></tr>
633 <tr><td>A4</td><td>PORTC bit 4</td><td>18</td><td>I²C SDA (SDA)</td></tr>
634 <tr><td>A5</td><td>PORTC bit 5</td><td>19</td><td>I²C SCL (SCL)</td></tr>
635 </tbody>
636 </table>
637 <p>
638 <strong>DDRx</strong> : bit à <code>1</code> = sortie, à <code>0</code> = entrée.
639 <strong>PORTx</strong> en sortie : bit à <code>1</code> = HIGH (5 V), à <code>0</code> = LOW.
640 En entrée avec <code>pinMode(n, INPUT_PULLUP)</code> : bit PORT à <code>1</code> active le pull-up interne.
641 </p>
642 <h3>CD4511 + PORTD (4 bits faibles)</h3>
643 <p>
644 Pour afficher le chiffre <strong>0…9</strong> avec <code>PORTD = n</code>, reliez
645 <strong>A→D0, B→D1, C→D2, D→D3</strong>, puis :
646 </p>
647 <pre class="doc-code">void setup() {
648 DDRD = 0b00001111; // D0…D3 en sortie
649}
650void loop() {
651 PORTD = 6; // affiche 6
652}</pre>
653 <p>
654 Attention : écrire <code>DDRD = 6</code> dans <code>loop()</code> (au lieu de
655 <code>PORTD</code>) reconfigure les directions et peut bloquer l’affichage.
656 Seul <code>PORTD</code> fixe les niveaux logiques.
657 </p>
658 <h3>Programmation</h3>
659 <ul class="doc-list">
660 <li>Éditeur à droite : sketch <code>.ino</code> + bouton <strong>Compiler (arduino-cli)</strong>.</li>
661 <li>Carte cible : <code>arduino:avr:uno</code>.</li>
662 <li>À la simulation, le moteur interprète <code>pinMode(…, OUTPUT|INPUT|INPUT_PULLUP)</code>, <code>digitalWrite</code>, <code>delay(ms)</code> et les écritures <code>DDRx</code> / <code>PORTx</code> pour piloter D0–D13 et A0–A5.</li>
663 <li>Reliez <strong>GND</strong> de l’UNO à la masse du circuit si vous utilisez les rails 5 V / 3,3 V.</li>
664 </ul>
665 <p class="doc-hint">Double-clic sur le symbole pour rouvrir cette fiche.</p>
666 </div>

1/**
2 * Parse JSON texte (fichiers circuit) — tolère BOM UTF-8 et espaces.
3 */
4
5import { DC10H_COLOR_IDS } from './bargraph-dc10h-layout.js';
6
7export function parseJsonText(raw) {
8 if (raw == null) {
9 throw new Error('Le fichier est vide.');
10 }
11 const text = String(raw).replace(/^\uFEFF/, '').trim();
12 if (!text) {
13 throw new Error('Le fichier est vide.');
14 }
15 try {
16 return JSON.parse(text);
17 } catch (e) {
18 const detail = e instanceof SyntaxError ? e.message : String(e);
19 throw new Error(`Syntaxe JSON invalide : ${detail}`);
20 }
21}
22
23/** Normalise un objet exporté par le simulateur (ou exemple circuits/). */
24export function normalizeCircuitPayload(data) {
25 if (!data || typeof data !== 'object' || Array.isArray(data)) {
26 throw new Error('Format attendu : un objet JSON avec au minimum "components".');
27 }
28 if (data.components != null && !Array.isArray(data.components)) {
29 throw new Error('Le champ "components" doit être un tableau.');
30 }
31 if (data.wires != null && !Array.isArray(data.wires)) {
32 throw new Error('Le champ "wires" doit être un tableau.');
33 }
34 if (data.autoJunctions != null && !Array.isArray(data.autoJunctions)) {
35 throw new Error('Le champ "autoJunctions" doit être un tableau.');
36 }
37 return {
38 name: data.name,
39 components: Array.isArray(data.components) ? data.components : [],
40 wires: Array.isArray(data.wires) ? data.wires : [],
41 autoJunctions: Array.isArray(data.autoJunctions) ? data.autoJunctions : [],
42 counters:
43 data.counters && typeof data.counters === 'object' && !Array.isArray(data.counters)
44 ? data.counters
45 : {},
46 };
47}
48
49/** Valeurs par défaut et nettoyage des composants après chargement JSON. */
50export function migrateLoadedComponents(components) {
51 if (!Array.isArray(components)) return [];
52 for (const comp of components) {
53 if (!comp || typeof comp !== 'object') continue;
54 if (comp.type === 'grove_lcd16x2') {
55 if (comp.i2cAddress == null) comp.i2cAddress = 0x3e;
56 comp.flipX = !!comp.flipX;
57 delete comp.lcdDisplayCache;
58 }
59 if (comp.type === 'grove_dht22') {
60 comp.flipX = !!comp.flipX;
61 if (comp.temperature == null || !Number.isFinite(comp.temperature)) comp.temperature = 24;
62 if (comp.humidity == null || !Number.isFinite(comp.humidity)) comp.humidity = 55;
63 }
64 if (comp.type === 'bargraph_dc10h') {
65 if (!comp.barColor || !DC10H_COLOR_IDS.includes(comp.barColor)) comp.barColor = 'red';
66 comp.flipX = !!comp.flipX;
67 comp.rotation = 0;
68 }
69 }
70 return components;
71}

104/* --- Runtime Arduino temps réel (sketches pilotés par digitalRead) --------- */
105
106/** @type {Map<string, { rt: object, sketch: string }>} */
107const arduinoRuntimes = new Map();
108let lastRuntimeStepMs = 0;
109
110function junctionNetReachesGnd(net) {
111 for (const j of net) {
112 if (typeof j === 'string' && (j.startsWith('GND') || /^GND\d*_/.test(j))) return true;
113 }
114 return false;
115}
116
117function junctionNetReachesHigh(net) {
118 for (const j of net) {
119 if (typeof j !== 'string') continue;
120 if (j.startsWith('VCC')) return true;
121 if (/^VDC\d*_in$/.test(j)) return true;
122 }
123 return false;
124}
125
126/** Niveaux d'entrée live (boutons/interrupteurs vers une rampe) pour un UNO. */
127function readUnoInputs(uno) {
128 const inputs = {};
129 const modes = uno.pinModes || {};
130 const wires = circuit.wires;
131 const aj = circuit.autoJunctions;
132 for (const [label, mode] of Object.entries(modes)) {
133 if (mode !== 'INPUT' && mode !== 'INPUT_PULLUP') continue;
134 const net = reachableJonctions(`${uno.label}_${label}`, wires, aj);
135 let value = 1;
136 if (junctionNetReachesGnd(net)) value = 0;
137 else if (junctionNetReachesHigh(net)) value = 1;
138 for (const comp of circuit.components) {
139 if (comp.type !== 'push_button' && comp.type !== 'switch_spdt') continue;
140 const a = `${comp.label}_in`;
141 const b = `${comp.label}_out`;
142 const pinSide = net.has(a) ? a : net.has(b) ? b : null;
143 if (!pinSide && comp.type === 'switch_spdt') continue;
144 if (comp.type === 'push_button') {
145 if (!pinSide) continue;
146 const otherSide = pinSide === a ? b : a;
147 const other = reachableJonctions(otherSide, wires, aj);
148 if (junctionNetReachesGnd(other)) value = comp.state === 1 ? 0 : 1;
149 else if (junctionNetReachesHigh(other)) value = comp.state === 1 ? 1 : 0;
150 }
151 }
152 inputs[label] = value;
153 }
154 return inputs;
155}
156
157/** Avance (une fois par frame) les runtimes des UNO dont le sketch a un loop(). */
158function updateArduinoRuntimes() {
159 const now = performance.now();
160 if (lastRuntimeStepMs <= 0) lastRuntimeStepMs = now;
161 const deltaMs = now - lastRuntimeStepMs;
162 lastRuntimeStepMs = now;
163 const seen = new Set();
164 for (const comp of circuit.components) {
165 if (comp.type !== 'arduino_uno') continue;
166 applyArduinoSketchToComponent(comp);
167 if (!sketchHasLoop(comp.sketch || '')) {
168 comp.liveLevels = null;
169 continue;
170 }
171 seen.add(comp.label);
172 let entry = arduinoRuntimes.get(comp.label);
173 if (!entry || entry.sketch !== (comp.sketch || '')) {
174 entry = { rt: createArduinoRuntime(comp), sketch: comp.sketch || '', lastAnalogKey: '' };
175 arduinoRuntimes.set(comp.label, entry);
176 }
177 const analogInputs = readUnoAnalogInputs(comp, {
178 components: circuit.components,
179 wires: circuit.wires,
180 autoJunctions: circuit.autoJunctions,
181 tSec: getSimulationElapsedSec(),
182 getVoltageAtJonction,
183 voltmeters: simulationResults.voltmeters,
184 });
185 if (sketchUsesAnalogInput(comp.sketch || '')) {
186 const analogKey = JSON.stringify(analogInputs);
187 if (entry.lastAnalogKey && entry.lastAnalogKey !== analogKey) {
188 entry.rt.gen = null;
189 entry.rt.sleepMs = 0;
190 entry.rt.idle = false;
191 }
192 entry.lastAnalogKey = analogKey;
193 }
194 stepArduinoRuntime(entry.rt, deltaMs, readUnoInputs(comp), analogInputs);
195 comp.liveLevels = arduinoRuntimeLevels(entry.rt);
196 comp.serialLog = getRuntimeSerialTx(entry.rt);
197 const serMeta = getRuntimeSerialMeta(entry.rt);
198 comp.serialBegun = serMeta.begun;
199 comp.serialBaud = serMeta.baud;
200 if (entry.rt.state.regs) {
201 comp.avrRegisters = { ...(comp.avrRegisters || {}), ...entry.rt.state.regs };
202 }
203 }
204 for (const key of [...arduinoRuntimes.keys()]) {
205 if (!seen.has(key)) arduinoRuntimes.delete(key);
206 }
207 onArduinoRuntimeTick();
208}
209
210function resetArduinoRuntimes() {
211 arduinoRuntimes.clear();
212 lastRuntimeStepMs = 0;
213 for (const comp of circuit.components) {
214 if (comp.type === 'arduino_uno') {
215 comp.liveLevels = null;
216 comp.serialLog = '';
217 comp.serialBegun = false;
218 comp.serialBaud = 0;
219 }
220 }
221}

287function hasRippleCounter() {
288 const ffTypes = new Set(['d_flipflop', 'jk_flipflop']);
289 for (const comp of circuit.components) {
290 if (!ffTypes.has(comp.type)) continue;
291 const clkJon = `${comp.label}_CLK`;
292 for (const w of circuit.wires) {
293 const other = w.fromJonctionId === clkJon ? w.toJonctionId
294 : w.toJonctionId === clkJon ? w.fromJonctionId : null;
295 if (!other) continue;
296 const mQ = /^([A-Za-z0-9_]+)_Q$/.exec(other);
297 const mQb = /^([A-Za-z0-9_]+)_Qbar$/.exec(other);
298 const prevLabel = (mQ || mQb)?.[1];
299 if (!prevLabel || prevLabel === comp.label) continue;
300 if (circuit.components.some((c) => ffTypes.has(c.type) && c.label === prevLabel)) return true;
301 }
302 }
303 return false;
304}

306/** 74HC90 en mode décade : l’animation doit balayer le .tran, pas figer une phase d’horloge. */

311function indexHc90QPlots(logicGateTranPlots) {
312 const byComp = {};
313 for (const [id, plot] of Object.entries(logicGateTranPlots || {})) {
314 const m = /^(.+)_Q([0-3])$/.exec(id);
315 if (!m || !plot?.time?.length) continue;
316 const base = m[1];
317 const qi = Number(m[2]);
318 if (!byComp[base]) byComp[base] = { q: [null, null, null, null], span: 0 };
319 byComp[base].q[qi] = plot;
320 const span = plot.time[plot.time.length - 1] - plot.time[0];
321 if (span > byComp[base].span) byComp[base].span = span;
322 }
323 return byComp;
324}

632function fallbackPeriodSec(plots) {
633 const freqHz = getSourceFrequencyHz();
634 if (freqHz > 0) return 1 / freqHz;
635 const plot = Object.values(plots)[0];
636 if (plot?.time?.length > 1) {
637 const span = plot.time[plot.time.length - 1] - plot.time[0];
638 if (span > 0) return span;
639 }
640 return 1;
641}

643/** Période détectée dans le tracé SPICE (ex. diviseur par 2 → 2× l'horloge). */
644function detectLedPeriodSec(plot) {
645 const { time, current } = plot;
646 if (!time?.length || !current?.length) return null;
647
648 const rising = [];
649 for (let i = 1; i < current.length; i++) {
650 if (current[i] > LED_ON_A && current[i - 1] <= LED_ON_A) rising.push(time[i]);
651 }
652 if (rising.length >= 2) return rising[1] - rising[0];
653
654 let toggles = 0;
655 for (let i = 1; i < current.length; i++) {
656 if ((current[i] > LED_ON_A) !== (current[i - 1] > LED_ON_A)) toggles++;
657 }
658 const span = time[time.length - 1] - time[0];
659 if (toggles >= 2 && span > 0) return (2 * span) / toggles;
660 return null;
661}
662
663function interpolateSeries(time, values, tSec) {
664 if (!time?.length || !values?.length) return NaN;
665 if (tSec <= time[0]) return values[0] ?? NaN;
666 const last = time.length - 1;
667 if (tSec >= time[last]) return values[last] ?? NaN;
668 let lo = 0;
669 let hi = last;
670 while (hi - lo > 1) {
671 const mid = (lo + hi) >> 1;
672 if (time[mid] <= tSec) lo = mid;
673 else hi = mid;
674 }
675 const t0 = time[lo];
676 const t1 = time[hi];
677 const v0 = values[lo];
678 const v1 = values[hi];
679 if (t1 <= t0) return v0;
680 const f = (tSec - t0) / (t1 - t0);
681 return v0 + f * (v1 - v0);
682}

684function seg7LitFromVoltages(segmentV, vCom) {
685 const lit = {};
686 const vc = Number.isFinite(vCom) ? vCom : 0;
687 for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
688 const v = segmentV[i];
689 lit[SEG7_NAMES[i]] = Number.isFinite(v) && v - vc >= SEG7_LIT_DELTA_V;
690 }
691 return lit;
692}
693
694function bargraphLitFromVoltages(segmentV, vCom) {
695 const lit = {};
696 const vc = Number.isFinite(vCom) ? vCom : 0;
697 for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
698 const v = segmentV[i];
699 lit[BARGRAPH_SEG_NAMES[i]] = Number.isFinite(v) && v - vc >= SEG7_LIT_DELTA_V;
700 }
701 return lit;
702}

704function interpolatePlot(plot, tSec) {
705 const { time, current } = plot;
706 if (!time?.length) return 0;
707 if (tSec <= time[0]) return current[0] ?? 0;
708 const last = time.length - 1;
709 if (tSec >= time[last]) return current[last] ?? 0;
710 let lo = 0;
711 let hi = last;
712 while (hi - lo > 1) {
713 const mid = (lo + hi) >> 1;
714 if (time[mid] <= tSec) lo = mid;
715 else hi = mid;
716 }
717 const t0 = time[lo];
718 const t1 = time[hi];
719 const i0 = current[lo] ?? 0;
720 const i1 = current[hi] ?? 0;
721 if (t1 <= t0) return i0;
722 const f = (tSec - t0) / (t1 - t0);
723 return i0 + f * (i1 - i0);
724}

726function averageCurrentOverPeriod(plot, periodSec) {
727 const { time, current } = plot;
728 if (!time?.length) return 0;
729 const tEnd = time[0] + periodSec;
730 let sum = 0;
731 let count = 0;
732 for (let i = 0; i < time.length; i++) {
733 if (time[i] >= tEnd) break;
734 sum += current[i] ?? 0;
735 count++;
736 }
737 return count > 0 ? sum / count : 0;
738}

740function prepareLedTiming(plots) {
741 const fallback = fallbackPeriodSec(plots);
742 anim.ledPeriods = {};
743 anim.ledPersistence = {};
744 anim.steadyCurrent = {};
745
746 for (const [id, plot] of Object.entries(plots)) {
747 const period = detectLedPeriodSec(plot) ?? fallback;
748 anim.ledPeriods[id] = period;
749 const freqHz = period > 0 ? 1 / period : 0;
750 if (freqHz > PERSISTENCE_FREQ_HZ) {
751 anim.ledPersistence[id] = true;
752 anim.steadyCurrent[id] = averageCurrentOverPeriod(plot, period);
753 }
754 }
755}
756
757function interpolateVoltagePlot(plot, tSec) {
758 const { time, voltage } = plot;
759 if (!time?.length) return 0;
760 if (tSec <= time[0]) return voltage[0] ?? 0;
761 const last = time.length - 1;
762 if (tSec >= time[last]) return voltage[last] ?? 0;
763 let lo = 0;
764 let hi = last;
765 while (hi - lo > 1) {
766 const mid = (lo + hi) >> 1;
767 if (time[mid] <= tSec) lo = mid;
768 else hi = mid;
769 }
770 const t0 = time[lo];
771 const t1 = time[hi];
772 const v0 = voltage[lo] ?? 0;
773 const v1 = voltage[hi] ?? 0;
774 if (t1 <= t0) return v0;
775 return v0 + ((tSec - t0) / (t1 - t0)) * (v1 - v0);
776}

778function detectPlotPeriodSec(time, values, threshold = 2.5) {
779 if (!time?.length || !values?.length) return null;
780 const rising = [];
781 for (let i = 1; i < values.length; i++) {
782 if (values[i] > threshold && values[i - 1] <= threshold) rising.push(time[i]);
783 }
784 if (rising.length >= 2) return rising[1] - rising[0];
785 let toggles = 0;
786 for (let i = 1; i < values.length; i++) {
787 if ((values[i] > threshold) !== (values[i - 1] > threshold)) toggles++;
788 }
789 const span = time[time.length - 1] - time[0];
790 if (toggles >= 2 && span > 0) return (2 * span) / toggles;
791 return null;
792}

925export function startLedAnimation(plots, vmPlots = {}, seg7Plots = {}, logicGateTranPlots = {}, opts = {}) {

927 const mrReleased = anim.hc90MrActive && !mrActive;

1/** Affichage des modales sans bloquer la barre de menus. */
2
3export function showModal(el) {
4 if (!el) return;
5 el.classList.add('is-open');
6 el.classList.remove('hidden');
7 el.style.removeProperty('display');
8}
9
10export function hideModal(el) {
11 if (!el) return;
12 el.classList.remove('is-open');
13 el.classList.add('hidden');
14 el.style.display = 'none';
15}
16
17export function initModalUi() {
18 for (const el of document.querySelectorAll('.modal')) {
19 if (!el.classList.contains('is-open')) hideModal(el);
20 }
21}

559/** Grille native HD44780 : 16×5 = 80 px/ligne, 2×8 = 16 px haut → 1280 points. */
560const LCD_NATIVE_H = HD44780_CHAR_H * GROVE_LCD_ROWS;
561/** Marge 1 px natif (haut, gauche, droite) pour ne pas toucher le cadre vert. */
562const LCD_MARGIN_L = 1;
563const LCD_MARGIN_T = 1;
564const LCD_MARGIN_R = 1;
565const LCD_FRAME_W = HD44780_NATIVE_W + LCD_MARGIN_L + LCD_MARGIN_R;
566const LCD_FRAME_H = LCD_NATIVE_H + LCD_MARGIN_T;
567
568function groveLcdTextColor(state, screenOn) {
569 if (!screenOn) return state.wired ? '#1a2a1a' : '#6a8a6a';
570 const rgb = state.rgb;
571 if (rgb && rgb.r != null) {
572 const lum = (0.299 * rgb.r + 0.587 * rgb.g + 0.114 * rgb.b) / 255;
573 return lum > 0.45 ? '#111111' : '#e8e8e8';
574 }
575 return '#111111';
576}
577
578function groveLcdBacklightFill(state, screenOn) {
579 if (!screenOn) return '#1e2a1e';
580 const rgb = state.rgb;
581 if (rgb && rgb.r != null) {
582 return `rgb(${rgb.r | 0},${rgb.g | 0},${rgb.b | 0})`;
583 }
584 return '#c5d84a';
585}
586
587function drawGroveLcdCharGrid(scrL, scrT, scrW, scrH, lines, screenOn, state, flipX, fx) {
588 if (state.blank && state.wired) return;
589 const fg = groveLcdTextColor(state, screenOn);
590 const pxW = scrW / LCD_FRAME_W;
591 const pxH = scrH / LCD_FRAME_H;
592
593 ctx.save();
594 ctx.fillStyle = fg;
595 ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
596 for (let row = 0; row < GROVE_LCD_ROWS; row++) {
597 const line = String(lines[row] || '').padEnd(GROVE_LCD_COLS, ' ').slice(0, GROVE_LCD_COLS);
598 for (let col = 0; col < GROVE_LCD_COLS; col++) {
599 const glyph = getHd44780Glyph(line[col]);
600 const baseNx = col * HD44780_CHAR_W;
601 const baseNy = row * HD44780_CHAR_H;
602 for (let r = 0; r < HD44780_CHAR_H; r++) {
603 const bits = glyph[r] & 0x1f;
604 for (let c = 0; c < HD44780_CHAR_W; c++) {
605 if ((bits >> (4 - c)) & 1) {
606 const nx = baseNx + c;
607 const ny = baseNy + r;
608 const x = scrL + (LCD_MARGIN_L + nx) * pxW;
609 const y = scrT + (LCD_MARGIN_T + ny) * pxH;
610 const xa = fx(x);
611 const xb = fx(x + pxW);
612 ctx.fillRect(Math.min(xa, xb), y, Math.abs(pxW), pxH);
613 }
614 }
615 }
616 }
617 }
618 ctx.restore();
619}

621function drawGroveLcd16x2(comp) {
622 const state = getGroveLcdDisplayState(comp);
623 const flip = comp.flipX ? -1 : 1;
624 const fx = (x) => flip * x;
625 const fillRectFx = (x, y, w, h) => {
626 const xa = fx(x);
627 const xb = fx(x + w);
628 ctx.fillRect(Math.min(xa, xb), y, Math.abs(w), h);
629 };
630 const strokeRectFx = (x, y, w, h) => {
631 const xa = fx(x);
632 const xb = fx(x + w);
633 ctx.strokeRect(Math.min(xa, xb), y, Math.abs(w), h);
634 };
635 const drawTextFx = (text, x, y) => {
636 ctx.save();
637 if (comp.flipX) {
638 ctx.translate(fx(x), y);
639 ctx.scale(-1, 1);
640 ctx.fillText(text, 0, 0);
641 } else {
642 ctx.fillText(text, x, y);
643 }
644 ctx.restore();
645 };
646
647 const boxL = GROVE_LCD_BOX_L;
648 const boxR = GROVE_LCD_BOX_R;
649 const boxT = GROVE_LCD_BOX_T;
650 const boxB = GROVE_LCD_BOX_B;
651 const connL = GROVE_LCD_CONN_L;
652
653 const scrL = GROVE_LCD_SCREEN_L;
654 const scrT = GROVE_LCD_SCREEN_T;
655 const scrW = GROVE_LCD_SCREEN_R - GROVE_LCD_SCREEN_L;
656 const scrH = GROVE_LCD_SCREEN_B - GROVE_LCD_SCREEN_T;
657
658 // Connecteur Grove (colonne gauche, 1 pas)
659 ctx.fillStyle = '#141414';
660 fillRectFx(connL, boxT, GROVE_LCD_CONNECTOR_W, boxB - boxT);
661
662 // Cadre noir
663 ctx.fillStyle = '#1c1c1c';
664 ctx.strokeStyle = '#0a0a0a';
665 ctx.lineWidth = 2;
666 fillRectFx(boxL, boxT, boxR - boxL, boxB - boxT);
667 strokeRectFx(boxL, boxT, boxR - boxL, boxB - boxT);
668
669 // Écran vert 16×2 (couleur rétroéclairage jaune-vert)
670 const screenOn = flags.isSimulating
671 && state.wired
672 && state.backlight !== false
673 && !state.blank;
674 ctx.fillStyle = groveLcdBacklightFill(state, screenOn);
675 fillRectFx(scrL, scrT, scrW, scrH);
676
677 const lines = state.lines || ['', ''];
678 drawGroveLcdCharGrid(scrL, scrT, scrW, scrH, lines, screenOn, state, comp.flipX, fx);
679
680 // Fils/pattes vers les jonctions
681 ctx.strokeStyle = COLORS.strokeMuted;
682 ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
683 ctx.lineCap = 'round';
684 for (let i = 0; i < GROVE_LCD_PINS.length; i++) {
685 const py = GROVE_LCD_PIN_Y[i];
686 ctx.beginPath();
687 ctx.moveTo(fx(GROVE_LCD_JUNC_X), py);
688 ctx.lineTo(fx(connL), py);
689 ctx.stroke();
690 }
691
692 const pinStep = GROVE_LCD_PIN_Y.length > 1
693 ? GROVE_LCD_PIN_Y[1] - GROVE_LCD_PIN_Y[0]
694 : 14;
695 const labelGap = 3;
696 const pinLabelFontSize = Math.min(9, Math.max(7, Math.floor(pinStep - labelGap - 2)));
697 const labelX = GROVE_LCD_PIN_LABEL_X;
698 ctx.font = `bold ${pinLabelFontSize}px Arial`;
699 ctx.textAlign = 'center';
700 ctx.textBaseline = 'bottom';
701 ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.ink;
702 for (let i = 0; i < GROVE_LCD_PINS.length; i++) {
703 const py = GROVE_LCD_PIN_Y[i];
704 drawTextFx(GROVE_LCD_PINS[i], labelX, py - labelGap);
705 }
706
707 ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.ink;
708 ctx.font = '11px Arial';
709 ctx.textAlign = 'center';
710 ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
711 drawTextFx(comp.label, 0, boxB + 10);
712}

714function drawGroveDht22SensorGrid(sx, sy, sw, sh, fx) {
715 const cols = 6;
716 const rows = 3;
717 const gap = 2;
718 const cellW = (sw - gap * (cols - 1)) / cols;
719 const cellH = (sh - gap * (rows - 1)) / rows;
720 ctx.fillStyle = '#f4f4f0';
721 ctx.strokeStyle = '#c8c8c0';
722 ctx.lineWidth = 1;
723 for (let r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
724 for (let c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
725 const x = sx + c * (cellW + gap);
726 const y = sy + r * (cellH + gap);
727 const xa = fx(x);
728 const xb = fx(x + cellW);
729 ctx.fillRect(Math.min(xa, xb), y, Math.abs(cellW), cellH);
730 ctx.strokeRect(Math.min(xa, xb), y, Math.abs(cellW), cellH);
731 const hx = x + cellW * 0.22;
732 const hy = y + cellH * 0.22;
733 const hw = cellW * 0.56;
734 const hh = cellH * 0.56;
735 ctx.fillStyle = '#d8d8d0';
736 const hxa = fx(hx);
737 const hxb = fx(hx + hw);
738 ctx.fillRect(Math.min(hxa, hxb), hy, Math.abs(hw), hh);
739 ctx.fillStyle = '#f4f4f0';
740 }
741 }
742}

769 const boxL = GROVE_DHT22_BOX_L;

806 ctx.font = `bold ${pinLabelFontSize}px Arial`;
807 ctx.textAlign = 'center';

817 ctx.textAlign = 'center';

819 drawTextFx('DHT22', 0, boxT - 12);

823function drawLogicGateSymbol(gateType) {
824 const inTopY = -20;
825 const inBottomY = 20;
826 const inMidY = 0;
827 const gateLeft = -20;
828 const gateArcR = 20;
829 const outBubbleR = (gateType === 'nand' || gateType === 'nor' || gateType === 'xnor' || gateType === 'not') ? 4 : 0;
830 const isOrFamily = gateType === 'or' || gateType === 'nor' || gateType === 'xor' || gateType === 'xnor';
831 const isXorFamily = gateType === 'xor' || gateType === 'xnor';
832 const isNot = gateType === 'not';
833
834 ctx.strokeStyle = '#00ca71';
835 ctx.lineWidth = 2;
836 ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.componentFill;
837
838 if (isNot) {
839 ctx.beginPath();
840 ctx.moveTo(-16, -18);
841 ctx.lineTo(14, 0);
842 ctx.lineTo(-16, 18);
843 ctx.closePath();
844 ctx.fill();
845 ctx.stroke();
846 } else if (isOrFamily) {
847 ctx.beginPath();
848 ctx.moveTo(-20, -20);
849 ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0, -20, 14, 0);
850 ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0, 20, -20, 20);
851 ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-8, 0, -20, -20);
852 ctx.closePath();
853 ctx.fill();
854 ctx.stroke();
855
856 if (isXorFamily) {
857 ctx.beginPath();
858 ctx.moveTo(-25, -20);
859 ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-13, 0, -25, 20);
860 ctx.stroke();
861 }
862 } else {
863 // Forme AND / NAND
864 ctx.beginPath();
865 ctx.moveTo(gateLeft, -20);
866 ctx.lineTo(0, -20);
867 ctx.arc(0, 0, gateArcR, -Math.PI / 2, Math.PI / 2);
868 ctx.lineTo(gateLeft, 20);
869 ctx.closePath();
870 ctx.fill();
871 ctx.stroke();
872 }
873
874 const outStemStart = 20 + outBubbleR;
875 if (isNot) {
876 // La pointe du triangle est à x=14
877 const notStemStart = 14 + outBubbleR;
878 ctx.beginPath();
879 ctx.moveTo(notStemStart, 0);
880 ctx.lineTo(40, 0);
881 ctx.stroke();
882 } else {
883 ctx.beginPath();
884 ctx.moveTo(outStemStart, 0);
885 ctx.lineTo(40, 0);
886 ctx.stroke();
887 }
888
889 if (isNot) {
890 ctx.beginPath();
891 ctx.moveTo(-40, 0);
892 ctx.lineTo(-16, 0);
893 ctx.stroke();
894 } else {
895 ctx.beginPath();
896 ctx.moveTo(-40, inTopY);
897 ctx.lineTo(gateLeft, inTopY);
898 ctx.moveTo(-40, inBottomY);
899 ctx.lineTo(gateLeft, inBottomY);
900 ctx.stroke();
901 }
902
903 if (outBubbleR > 0) {
904 const cx = isNot ? 14 + outBubbleR : 20 + outBubbleR;
905 ctx.beginPath();
906 ctx.arc(cx, 0, outBubbleR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
907 ctx.stroke();
908 ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.componentFill;
909 ctx.fill();
910 }
911
912 ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.inkMuted;
913 ctx.font = '10px Arial';
914 ctx.textAlign = 'left';
915 if (isNot) {
916 ctx.fillText('A', -34, inMidY - 4);
917 } else {
918 ctx.fillText('A', -34, inTopY - 4);
919 ctx.fillText('B', -34, inBottomY - 4);
920 }
921}

936 ctx.restore();

948function drawLedSmoke(phase) {

965/** Set/Reset : trait vertical uniquement à l'extérieur du boîtier ; jonction au bout ; S/R à gauche du fil. */

981function drawComponentBody(comp) {
982 ctx.save(); ctx.translate(comp.x, comp.y);
983 const noRotate = comp.type === 'gimp' || comp.type === 'gsin' || comp.type === 'gsqr' || comp.type === 'oscilloscope' || comp.type === 'd_flipflop' || comp.type === 'jk_flipflop' || comp.type === 'cd4511' || comp.type === 'ic_74hc90' || comp.type === 'arduino_uno' || comp.type === 'npn' || comp.type === 'opamp' || comp.type === 'seg7' || comp.type === 'bargraph_dc10h' || comp.type === 'grove_lcd16x2' || comp.type === 'grove_dht22';
984 const rot = noRotate ? 0 : (comp.rotation || 0);
985 ctx.rotate(rot * Math.PI / 180);
986
987 if (interaction.selectedComponents.includes(comp)) {
988 ctx.strokeStyle = '#00bcd4'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
989 if (comp.type === 'cd4511') {
990 ctx.strokeRect(-CD4511_HIT_DX, -CD4511_HIT_DY, CD4511_HIT_DX * 2, CD4511_HIT_DY * 2);
991 }
992 else if (comp.type === 'ic_74hc90') {
993 ctx.strokeRect(-IC90_HIT_DX, -IC90_HIT_DY, IC90_HIT_DX * 2, IC90_HIT_DY * 2);
994 }
995 else if (comp.type === 'jk_flipflop' || comp.type === 'd_flipflop') ctx.strokeRect(-45, -68, 90, 136);
996 else if (comp.type === 'oscilloscope') ctx.strokeRect(-50, -38, 100, 100);
997 else if (comp.type === 'npn') ctx.strokeRect(-42, -42, 64, 84);
998 else if (comp.type === 'opamp') ctx.strokeRect(-44, -40, 88, 80);
999 else if (comp.type === 'seg7') ctx.strokeRect(-52, -86, 124, 200);
1000 else if (comp.type === 'bargraph_dc10h') {
1001 ctx.strokeRect(DC10H_SEL_L, DC10H_SEL_T, DC10H_SEL_W, DC10H_SEL_H);
1002 }
1003 else if (comp.type === 'grove_lcd16x2') {
1004 const flip = comp.flipX ? -1 : 1;
1005 const fx = (x) => flip * x;
1006 const selL = Math.min(fx(GROVE_LCD_SEL_L), fx(GROVE_LCD_SEL_L + GROVE_LCD_SEL_W));
1007 ctx.strokeRect(selL, GROVE_LCD_SEL_T, GROVE_LCD_SEL_W, GROVE_LCD_SEL_H);
1008 }
1009 else if (comp.type === 'grove_dht22') {
1010 const flip = comp.flipX ? -1 : 1;
1011 const fx = (x) => flip * x;
1012 const selL = Math.min(fx(GROVE_DHT22_SEL_L), fx(GROVE_DHT22_SEL_L + GROVE_DHT22_SEL_W));
1013 ctx.strokeRect(selL, GROVE_DHT22_SEL_T, GROVE_DHT22_SEL_W, GROVE_DHT22_SEL_H);
1014 }
1015 else if (comp.type === 'logic_terminal') ctx.strokeRect(-14, -10, 24, 20);
1016 else if (comp.type !== 'logic_terminal') ctx.strokeRect(-45, -25, 90, 50);
1017 }
1018
1019 const railLead = GRID_SIZE;
1020 if (comp.type === 'gnd') {
1021 ctx.strokeStyle = COLORS.inkDim; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
1022 ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-12, 0); ctx.lineTo(railLead, 0);
1023 ctx.moveTo(-12, -10); ctx.lineTo(-12, 10);
1024 ctx.moveTo(-17, -6); ctx.lineTo(-17, 6);
1025 ctx.moveTo(-22, -3); ctx.lineTo(-22, 3);
1026 ctx.stroke(); drawLabels(comp.label, "0V", rot);
1027 }
1028 else if (comp.type === 'vcc') {
1029 ctx.strokeStyle = '#ff3d00'; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
1030 ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-12, 0); ctx.lineTo(railLead, 0);
1031 ctx.moveTo(-12, 0); ctx.lineTo(-4, -7); ctx.lineTo(-4, 7); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fillStyle = '#ff3d00'; ctx.fill();
1032 ctx.stroke();
1033 let val = comp.value !== undefined ? comp.value + "V" : "5V";
1034 drawLabels(comp.label, val, rot);
1035 }
1036 else if (comp.type === 'logic_terminal') {
1037 if (interaction.selectedComponents.includes(comp)) {
1038 ctx.strokeStyle = '#00bcd4'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
1039 ctx.strokeRect(-14, -10, 24, 20);
1040 }
1041 ctx.strokeStyle = '#9c27b0'; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
1042 ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(8, 0); ctx.lineTo(railLead, 0);
1043 ctx.stroke();
1044 ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.componentFill; ctx.fillRect(-12, -8, 20, 16); ctx.strokeRect(-12, -8, 20, 16);
1045 let state = comp.state || 0;
1046 ctx.fillStyle = state === 1 ? '#00e676' : '#ff1744';
1047 ctx.font = 'bold 11px Arial'; ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
1048 ctx.fillText(state, -2, 0);
1049 }
1050 else if (comp.type === 'battery') {
1051 ctx.strokeStyle = '#ff9800'; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
1052 // Grande barre (gauche, haute) = + ; petite barre (droite, basse) = −
1053 ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-5, -15); ctx.lineTo(-5, 15); ctx.stroke();
1054 ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(5, -8); ctx.lineTo(5, 8); ctx.stroke();
1055 ctx.beginPath();
1056 ctx.moveTo(-40, 0); ctx.lineTo(-5, 0);
1057 ctx.moveTo(5, 0); ctx.lineTo(40, 0);
1058 ctx.stroke();
1059 drawWirePlusLabel(-40, 0);
1060 let val = comp.value !== undefined ? comp.value + "V" : "5V";

1// scope-animation.js — affichage des courbes CH1/CH2 sur l'oscilloscope
2import { circuit } from './state.js';
3import { getSimulationElapsedSec } from './led-animation.js';
4import {
5 findArduinoDriveForScopeChannel,
6 synthesizeArduinoScopeTrace,
7} from './Engine/scope-arduino-ideal.mjs';
8
9export const SCOPE_H_DIVS = 8;
10export const SCOPE_V_DIVS = 8;
11
12let scopePlots = {};
13let scopeAnimStartMs = 0;
14let rafId = null;
15let redraw = () => {};
16let popupRedraw = () => {};
17
18export function bindScopeAnimationRedraw(fn) {
19 redraw = typeof fn === 'function' ? fn : () => {};
20}
21
22export function bindScopePopupRedraw(fn) {
23 popupRedraw = typeof fn === 'function' ? fn : () => {};
24}

26function hasArduinoScopeChannels() {
27 for (const comp of circuit.components) {
28 if (comp.type !== 'oscilloscope') continue;
29 if (
30 findArduinoDriveForScopeChannel(
31 comp.label,
32 'CH1',
33 circuit.components,
34 circuit.wires,
35 circuit.autoJunctions
36 ) ||
37 findArduinoDriveForScopeChannel(
38 comp.label,
39 'CH2',
40 circuit.components,
41 circuit.wires,
42 circuit.autoJunctions
43 )
44 ) {
45 return true;
46 }
47 }
48 return false;
49}
50
51function getScopeElapsedSec() {
52 const ledElapsed = getSimulationElapsedSec();
53 if (ledElapsed > 0) return ledElapsed;
54 if (scopeAnimStartMs > 0) return (performance.now() - scopeAnimStartMs) / 1000;
55 return 0;
56}
57
58export function startScopeAnimation(plots) {
59 stopScopeAnimation();
60 scopePlots = plots && typeof plots === 'object' ? plots : {};
61 if (!Object.keys(scopePlots).length && !hasArduinoScopeChannels()) return;
62 scopeAnimStartMs = performance.now();
63 const tick = () => {
64 popupRedraw();
65 rafId = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
66 };
67 rafId = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
68}
69
70export function stopScopeAnimation() {
71 if (rafId != null) cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
72 rafId = null;
73 scopePlots = {};
74 scopeAnimStartMs = 0;
75}
76
77export function hasScopeAnimation() {
78 return rafId != null && (Object.keys(scopePlots).length > 0 || hasArduinoScopeChannels());
79}
