81function detectChannelPeriodSec(channel, threshold = 2.5) {
82 const time = channel?.time;
83 const voltage = channel?.voltage;
84 if (!time?.length || !voltage?.length) return 0;
85 const rising = [];
86 for (let i = 1; i < voltage.length; i++) {
87 if (voltage[i] > threshold && voltage[i - 1] <= threshold) rising.push(time[i]);
88 }
89 if (rising.length >= 2) return rising[1] - rising[0];
90 let toggles = 0;
91 for (let i = 1; i < voltage.length; i++) {
92 if ((voltage[i] > threshold) !== (voltage[i - 1] > threshold)) toggles++;
93 }
94 const span = time[time.length - 1] - time[0];
95 if (toggles >= 2 && span > 0) return (2 * span) / toggles;
96 return 0;
97}
98
99function interpolateChannelVoltage(channel, tSec) {
100 const time = channel?.time;
101 const voltage = channel?.voltage;
102 if (!time?.length || !voltage?.length) return 0;
103 if (tSec <= time[0]) return voltage[0];
104 const tLast = time[time.length - 1];
105 if (tSec >= tLast) return voltage[voltage.length - 1];
106 let lo = 0;
107 let hi = time.length - 1;
108 while (hi - lo > 1) {
109 const mid = (lo + hi) >> 1;
110 if (time[mid] <= tSec) lo = mid;
111 else hi = mid;
112 }
113 const t0 = time[lo];
114 const t1 = time[hi];
115 const v0 = voltage[lo];
116 const v1 = voltage[hi];
117 if (t1 <= t0) return v0;
118 return v0 + ((tSec - t0) / (t1 - t0)) * (v1 - v0);
119}
120
121/** Échantillons SPICE sur la dernière fenêtre, ou phase verrouillée si périodique. */
122function sampleChannelWindow(channel, windowSec, options = {}) {
123 if (!channel?.time?.length || !channel?.voltage?.length) return [];
124 const timeOffsetSec = Number.isFinite(options.timeOffsetSec) ? options.timeOffsetSec : 0;
125 const period = options.periodSec ?? detectChannelPeriodSec(channel);
126 const synced = options.synced !== false && period > 0;
127
128 if (synced) {
129 const n = Math.max(64, Math.min(800, Math.ceil(windowSec * 4000)));
130 const out = [];
131 for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
132 const tScreen = (i / (n - 1)) * windowSec;
133 const tPhase = ((timeOffsetSec + tScreen) % period + period) % period;
134 const tSample = channel.time[0] + tPhase;
135 const v = interpolateChannelVoltage(channel, tSample);
136 if (Number.isFinite(v)) out.push({ t: tScreen, v });
137 }
138 return out;
139 }
140
141 const tEnd = channel.time[channel.time.length - 1] + timeOffsetSec;
142 const tStart = Math.max(channel.time[0], tEnd - windowSec);
143 const out = [];
144 for (let i = 0; i < channel.time.length; i++) {
145 const t = channel.time[i];
146 if (t < tStart) continue;
147 const v = channel.voltage[i];
148 if (Number.isFinite(t) && Number.isFinite(v)) out.push({ t: t - tStart, v });
149 }
150 return out;
151}
152
153/**
154 * Fenêtre temporelle + échantillons pour les deux voies (superposées à l'affichage).
155 * @param {{ label: string; timeDivSec?: number; ch1VoltsPerDiv?: number; ch2VoltsPerDiv?: number }} comp
156 */
157export function getScopeTraceWindow(comp) {
158 const timeDiv = comp.timeDivSec > 0 ? comp.timeDivSec : 1e-3;
159 const windowSec = timeDiv * SCOPE_H_DIVS;
160 const timeOffsetSec = (Number.isFinite(comp.timePositionDiv) ? comp.timePositionDiv : 0) * timeDiv;
161 const elapsed = getScopeElapsedSec();
162 const plot = scopePlots[comp.label];
163 const sampleOpts = { timeOffsetSec };
164
165 const ch1Drive = findArduinoDriveForScopeChannel(
166 comp.label,
167 'CH1',
168 circuit.components,
169 circuit.wires,
170 circuit.autoJunctions
171 );
172 const ch2Drive = findArduinoDriveForScopeChannel(
173 comp.label,
174 'CH2',
175 circuit.components,
176 circuit.wires,
177 circuit.autoJunctions
178 );
179
180 const ch1 = ch1Drive
181 ? synthesizeArduinoScopeTrace(ch1Drive.uno, ch1Drive.pinLabel, windowSec, elapsed, {}, timeOffsetSec)
182 : plot
183 ? sampleChannelWindow(plot.ch1, windowSec, sampleOpts)
184 : [];
185 const ch2 = ch2Drive
186 ? synthesizeArduinoScopeTrace(ch2Drive.uno, ch2Drive.pinLabel, windowSec, elapsed, {}, timeOffsetSec)
187 : plot
188 ? sampleChannelWindow(plot.ch2, windowSec, sampleOpts)
189 : [];
190
191 if (!ch1.length && !ch2.length) return null;
192
193 return {
194 ch1,
195 ch2,
196 windowSec,
197 timeDiv,
198 timeOffsetSec,
199 ch1Vdiv: comp.ch1VoltsPerDiv > 0 ? comp.ch1VoltsPerDiv : 1,
200 ch2Vdiv: comp.ch2VoltsPerDiv > 0 ? comp.ch2VoltsPerDiv : 1,
201 ch1PosDiv: Number.isFinite(comp.ch1PositionDiv) ? comp.ch1PositionDiv : 0,
202 ch2PosDiv: Number.isFinite(comp.ch2PositionDiv) ? comp.ch2PositionDiv : 0,
203 ch1Digital: !!ch1Drive || isLikelyDigitalTrace(ch1),
204 ch2Digital: !!ch2Drive || isLikelyDigitalTrace(ch2),
205 };
206}
207
208/** Signal logique 0/5 V (I²C, GPIO) — affichage en créneaux, pas en diagonales. */
209export function isLikelyDigitalTrace(points) {
210 if (!points || points.length < 8) return false;
211 let min = Infinity;
212 let max = -Infinity;
213 for (const pt of points) {
214 if (!Number.isFinite(pt.v)) continue;
215 if (pt.v < min) min = pt.v;
216 if (pt.v > max) max = pt.v;
217 }
218 const span = max - min;
219 if (span < 1.5) return false;
220 const margin = span * 0.12;
221 let binary = 0;
222 let n = 0;
223 for (const pt of points) {
224 if (!Number.isFinite(pt.v)) continue;
225 n++;
226 if (pt.v <= min + margin || pt.v >= max - margin) binary++;
227 }
228 return n >= 8 && binary / n > 0.88;
229}
230
231/**
232 * Trace CH1/CH2 sur un canvas (mode créneau pour signaux numériques).
233 */
234export function drawScopeTrace(ctx, points, windowSec, vdiv, posDiv, x0, y0, w, h, color, options = {}) {
235 if (!points?.length || windowSec <= 0 || vdiv <= 0) return;
236 const pxPerDivY = h / SCOPE_V_DIVS;
237 const midY = y0 + h / 2;
238 const pos = Number.isFinite(posDiv) ? posDiv : 0;
239 const digital = options.digital ?? isLikelyDigitalTrace(points);
240 const toY = (v) => midY - ((v / vdiv) + pos) * pxPerDivY;
241 const toX = (t) => x0 + (t / windowSec) * w;
242
243 ctx.save();
244 ctx.beginPath();
245 ctx.rect(x0, y0, w, h);
246 ctx.clip();
247 ctx.strokeStyle = color;
248 ctx.lineWidth = options.lineWidth ?? 2;
249 ctx.lineJoin = 'miter';
250 ctx.beginPath();
251
252 let prevX = toX(points[0].t);
253 let prevY = toY(points[0].v);
254 ctx.moveTo(prevX, prevY);
255
256 for (let i = 1; i < points.length; i++) {
257 const x = toX(points[i].t);
258 const y = toY(points[i].v);
259 if (digital) {
260 ctx.lineTo(x, prevY);
261 ctx.lineTo(x, y);
262 } else {
263 ctx.lineTo(x, y);
264 }
265 prevX = x;
266 prevY = y;
267 }
268 ctx.stroke();
269 ctx.restore();
270}

46export function renderScopePopup() {

48 const w = popupCanvas.width;

88 drawScopeTrace(popupCtx, win.ch2, win.windowSec, win.ch2Vdiv, win.ch2PosDiv, x0, y0, plotW, plotH, '#00e5ff', { digital: win.ch2Digital });
89 popupCtx.fillStyle = '#8899aa';

93 ? `${(win.timeDiv * 1000).toFixed(win.timeDiv >= 0.01 ? 1 : 2)} ms/div`

97 popupCtx.fillText(

99 w - margin.r,

108 }

110 popupCtx.fillStyle = '#556677';
111 popupCtx.font = '14px Arial';
112 popupCtx.textAlign = 'center';

119 popupCtx.textAlign = 'left';

155function stepTimeDiv(cur, zoomIn) {
156 const idx = TIME_DIV_STEPS.findIndex((v) => Math.abs(v - cur) < cur * 0.01);
157 const base = idx >= 0 ? idx : TIME_DIV_STEPS.findIndex((v) => v >= cur);
158 const i = base < 0 ? 0 : base;

160 return TIME_DIV_STEPS[Math.min(TIME_DIV_STEPS.length - 1, i + 1)];

173 dragging = true;
174 const rect = popupEl()?.getBoundingClientRect();
175 if (rect) {
176 dragOffX = e.clientX - rect.left;
177 dragOffY = e.clientY - rect.top;
178 }
179 e.preventDefault();
180 });

183 popupCanvas?.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {

188 onViewChanged(popupComp);

190 }, { passive: false });
191

193 if (e.button !== 0 || !popupComp) return;
194 panning = true;
195 panStartX = e.clientX;
196 panStartPosDiv = popupComp.timePositionDiv ?? 0;
197 e.preventDefault();
198 });
199
200 window.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
201 if (panning && popupComp && popupCanvas) {
202 const plotW = popupCanvas.width - 64;
203 const timeDiv = popupComp.timeDivSec > 0 ? popupComp.timeDivSec : 1e-3;
204 const pxPerDiv = plotW / SCOPE_H_DIVS;
205 const deltaDiv = (e.clientX - panStartX) / pxPerDiv;
206 popupComp.timePositionDiv = Math.max(-4, Math.min(4, panStartPosDiv + deltaDiv));
207 renderScopePopup();
208 return;
209 }
210 if (!dragging) return;
211 floatX = e.clientX - dragOffX;
212 floatY = e.clientY - dragOffY;
213 clampFloatPosition();

215 });

220 onViewChanged(popupComp);

222 }
223 dragging = false;

226 window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
227 if (isScopePopupOpen()) {
228 clampFloatPosition();

138 if (jonctionId === `${id}_Qbar`) return `${id}#3`;
139 if (jonctionId === `${id}_SET`) return `${id}#4`;

144 if (jonctionId === `${id}_CLK`) return `${id}#2`;
145 if (jonctionId === `${id}_Q`) return `${id}#3`;
146 if (jonctionId === `${id}_Qbar`) return `${id}#4`;
147 if (jonctionId === `${id}_SET`) return `${id}#5`;
148 if (jonctionId === `${id}_RESET`) return `${id}#6`;
149 } else if (['gnd', 'vcc', 'logic_terminal'].includes(comp.type)) {
150 if (jonctionId === `${id}_out`) return `${id}#0`;
151 } else if (comp.type === 'gimp') {
152 if (jonctionId === `${id}_in`) return `${id}#1`;
153 if (jonctionId === `${id}_out`) return `${id}#0`;
154 } else if (comp.type === 'gsin') {
155 if (jonctionId === `${id}_in`) return `${id}#0`;
156 if (jonctionId === `${id}_out`) return `${id}#1`;
157 } else if (comp.type === 'gsqr') {
158 if (jonctionId === `${id}_in`) return `${id}#0`;
159 if (jonctionId === `${id}_out`) return `${id}#1`;
160 } else if (comp.type === 'oscilloscope') {
161 if (jonctionId === `${id}_CH1`) return `${id}#0`;
162 if (jonctionId === `${id}_CH2`) return `${id}#1`;
163 if (jonctionId === `${id}_GND`) return `${id}#2`;
164 } else if (comp.type === 'npn') {
165 if (jonctionId === `${id}_B`) return `${id}#0`;
166 if (jonctionId === `${id}_C`) return `${id}#1`;
167 if (jonctionId === `${id}_E`) return `${id}#2`;
168 } else if (comp.type === 'opamp') {
169 if (jonctionId === `${id}_plus`) return `${id}#0`;
170 if (jonctionId === `${id}_minus`) return `${id}#1`;
171 if (jonctionId === `${id}_out`) return `${id}#2`;
172 } else if (comp.type === 'seg7') {
173 const segs = ['a', 'b', 'c', 'd', 'e', 'f', 'g'];
174 for (let i = 0; i < segs.length; i++) {
175 if (jonctionId === `${id}_${segs[i]}`) return `${id}#${i}`;
176 }
177 if (jonctionId === `${id}_COM`) return `${id}#7`;
178 } else if (comp.type === 'bargraph_dc10h') {
179 for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
180 if (jonctionId === `${id}_s${i + 1}`) return `${id}#${i}`;
181 }
182 if (jonctionId === `${id}_COM`) return `${id}#10`;
183 } else if (comp.type === 'grove_lcd16x2') {
184 const pins = ['SDA', 'SCL', 'VCC', 'GND'];
185 for (let i = 0; i < pins.length; i++) {
186 if (jonctionId === `${id}_${pins[i]}`) return `${id}#${i}`;
187 }
188 } else if (comp.type === 'grove_dht22') {
189 const pins = ['DATA', 'VCC', 'NC', 'GND'];
190 for (let i = 0; i < pins.length; i++) {
191 if (jonctionId === `${id}_${pins[i]}`) return `${id}#${i}`;
192 }
193 } else if (comp.type === 'cd4511') {
194 const key = cd4511JonctionToTerminalKey(id, jonctionId);
195 if (key) return key;
196 } else if (comp.type === 'ic_74hc90') {
197 const key = ic74hc90JonctionToTerminalKey(id, jonctionId);
198 if (key) return key;
199 } else if (comp.type === 'arduino_uno') {
200 const key = arduinoUnoJonctionToTerminalKey(id, jonctionId);
201 if (key) return key;
202 } else if (comp.type === 'potentiometer') {
203 if (jonctionId === `${id}_in`) return `${id}#0`;
204 if (jonctionId === `${id}_wip`) return `${id}#1`;
205 if (jonctionId === `${id}_out`) return `${id}#2`;
206 } else if (comp.type === 'switch_spdt') {
207 if (jonctionId === `${id}_com`) return `${id}#0`;
208 if (jonctionId === `${id}_a`) return `${id}#1`;
209 if (jonctionId === `${id}_b`) return `${id}#2`;
210 } else {
211 if (jonctionId === `${id}_in`) return `${id}#0`;
212 if (jonctionId === `${id}_out`) return `${id}#1`;
213 }

218function buildSimulationState() {
219 const simComponents = circuit.components.map((comp) => {
220 const id = comp.label;
221 const engineType = COMPONENT_TYPE_TO_ENGINE[comp.type] || comp.type;
222 const out = { id, type: engineType, x: comp.x, y: comp.y, rotation: comp.rotation || 0 };
223 if (comp.type === 'logic_terminal') {
224 out.value = comp.state === 1 ? '1' : '0';
225 out.logicRail = comp.highVoltage !== undefined ? comp.highVoltage : 5;
226 } else if (comp.type === 'vcc') {
227 out.value = comp.value !== undefined ? String(comp.value) : '5';
228 } else if (engineType === 'vsource') {
229 out.value = comp.value || '5';
230 } else if (comp.type === 'gimp') {
231 out.value = formatGimpValue(comp);
232 } else if (comp.type === 'gsin') {
233 out.value = formatGsinValue(comp);
234 } else if (comp.type === 'gsqr') {
235 out.value = formatGsqrValue(comp);
236 }
237 if (comp.type === 'resistor') out.value = comp.value || '1k';
238 if (comp.type === 'potentiometer') {
239 out.value = comp.value || '10k';
240 out.position = comp.position ?? 50;
241 }
242 if (comp.type === 'switch_spdt') out.state = comp.state ?? 0;
243 if (comp.type === 'push_button') out.state = comp.state ?? 0;
244 if (comp.type === 'capacitor') out.value = comp.value || '1u';
245 if (comp.type === 'inductor') out.value = comp.value || '1m';
246 if (comp.type === 'diode') out.value = comp.value || '1N4148';
247 if (comp.type === 'speaker') out.value = comp.value || '8';
248 if (comp.type === 'npn') out.value = comp.value || '2N2222';
249 if (comp.type === 'opamp') {
250 out.value = comp.value || 'uA741';
251 out.vp = comp.vp ?? 15;
252 out.vn = comp.vn ?? -15;
253 }
254 if (comp.type === 'oscilloscope') {
255 out.timeDivSec = comp.timeDivSec ?? 0.001;
256 out.ch1VoltsPerDiv = comp.ch1VoltsPerDiv ?? 1;
257 out.ch2VoltsPerDiv = comp.ch2VoltsPerDiv ?? 1;
258 out.ch1PositionDiv = comp.ch1PositionDiv ?? 0;
259 out.ch2PositionDiv = comp.ch2PositionDiv ?? 0;
260 out.timePositionDiv = comp.timePositionDiv ?? 0;
261 }
262 if (comp.type === 'arduino_uno') {
263 applyArduinoSketchToComponent(comp);
264 out.sketch = comp.sketch || '';
265 out.fqbn = comp.fqbn || 'arduino:avr:uno';
266 out.pinModes = comp.pinModes || {};
267 out.pinLevels = comp.pinLevels || {};
268 out.pinPulses = comp.pinPulses || {};
269 out.pinPhases = comp.pinPhases || [];
270 out.avrRegisters = comp.avrRegisters || null;
271 }
272 return out;
273 });
274 const simWires = circuit.wires
275 .filter((w) => w.fromJonctionId && w.toJonctionId)
276 .map((w) => {
277 const fromKey = jonctionIdToTerminalKey(w.fromJonctionId);
278 const toKey = jonctionIdToTerminalKey(w.toJonctionId);
279 const pts = Array.isArray(w.points) && w.points.length >= 2
280 ? w.points
281 : [{ x: 0, y: 0 }, { x: 0, y: 0 }];
282 return { solid: true, fromKey, toKey, points: pts };
283 })
284 .filter((w) => w.fromKey && w.toKey);
285 const dropped = circuit.wires.length - simWires.length;
286 if (dropped > 0) {
287 console.warn(
288 `[Simulation] ${dropped} fil(s) ignoré(s) : jonction non reconnue ou extrémité manquante. Vérifiez le câblage (CD4511 : broches A…LT, a…g).`
289 );
290 }
291 return { components: simComponents, wires: simWires };
292}

294/** URL de POST /api/simulate (serveur Node, même machine que la page). */
295function resolveSimulationApiBaseUrl() {
296 const { protocol, hostname, port, pathname } = window.location;
297 const isSimulateurH = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('app') === 'h';
298 if (protocol === 'file:') {
299 return isSimulateurH ? 'http://127.0.0.1:43721' : 'http://127.0.0.1:3000';
300 }
301 if (pathname.startsWith('/Simulateur')) return window.location.origin;
302 const p = port || (protocol === 'https:' ? '443' : '80');
303 if (p === '3000' || p === '80' || p === '443') return window.location.origin;
304 const host =
305 hostname === 'localhost' || hostname === '127.0.0.1' ? '127.0.0.1' : hostname;
306 return `${protocol}//${host}:3000`;
307}

309function formatSimulationNetworkError(err, baseUrl) {
310 const msg = err?.message || String(err);
311 if (/Cannot GET/i.test(msg)) {
312 return (
313 `Le serveur Node ne gère pas cette requête (réponse « Cannot GET »).\n\n` +
314 `1. Dans le dossier du projet : npm start\n` +
315 `2. Ouvrez http://localhost:3000/Simulateur/ (pas le fichier HTML en double-clic)\n\n` +
316 `URL tentée : ${baseUrl}/api/simulate`
317 );
318 }
319 if (/Failed to fetch|NetworkError|ERR_CONNECTION|fetch/i.test(msg)) {
320 return (
321 `Impossible de joindre le serveur (${baseUrl}).\n\n` +
322 `Lancez « npm start », puis ouvrez http://localhost:3000/Simulateur/`
323 );
324 }
325 if (/EPERM|operation not permitted|bloqué|blocked|antivirus/i.test(msg)) {
326 return (
327 `ngspice bloqué par l'antivirus Windows (EPERM).\n\n` +
328 `Les circuits 74HC90 / CD4511 nécessitent ngspice_con.exe dans Simulateur/bin/.\n` +
329 `Demandez une exception pour ce dossier, ou testez : npm run check-ngspice`
330 );
331 }
332 return msg;
333}

335function formatSpiceEngineErrors(result) {
336 if (Array.isArray(result?.errors) && result.errors.length) {
337 return result.errors.map(String).filter((e) => e.trim()).join('\n');
338 }
339 return result?.error || result?.message || 'Vérifiez les masses et le câblage (VCC, GND, BI/LT du CD4511, MR du 74HC90).';
340}

342function warnDroppedWiresForLogicCircuits(dropped, isSilentUpdate) {
343 if (isSilentUpdate || dropped <= 0) return;
344 const hasLogicIc = circuit.components.some((c) => c.type === 'cd4511' || c.type === 'ic_74hc90');
345 if (!hasLogicIc) return;
346 alert(
347 `${dropped} fil(s) ignoré(s) — le schéma n'est pas entièrement transmis au moteur SPICE.\n\n` +
348 `Vérifiez le câblage (74HC90 : CP0, VCC, GND, MR1/MR2 à 0 V, Q0→CP1, Q0…Q3→CD4511 A…D ; ` +
349 `CD4511 : BI et LT au +5 V, LE à 0 V, a…g → afficheur).`
350 );
351}
352function showSimulationWarnings(warnings, isSilentUpdate) {
353 if (isSilentUpdate || !Array.isArray(warnings) || !warnings.length) return;
354 const text = warnings.map(String).filter((w) => w.trim()).join('\n');
355 if (!text) return;
356 const critical = warnings.some((w) =>
357 /CD4511|74HC90|XSPICE|digital\.cm|BI relié|LT relié|Q0 relié|fréquentielle|Analyse fréquentielle|Bode/i.test(String(w))
358 );
359 if (critical) alert(`Avertissement simulation :\n${text}`);
360}

365 for (const comp of circuit.components) {

373 c.type === 'bargraph_dc10h' || c.type === 'seg7' || c.type === 'grove_lcd16x2'

377export async function triggerSimulation(isSilentUpdate = false) {
378 if (simulationInFlight) {
379 if (isSilentUpdate) simulationQueuedSilent = true;
380 return;
381 }
382 simulationInFlight = true;
383 simulationGeneration += 1;
384 const myGeneration = simulationGeneration;
385 if (simulationAbortController) simulationAbortController.abort();
386 simulationAbortController = new AbortController();
387 const { signal } = simulationAbortController;
388 prepareArduinoForSimulation();
389 if (!isSilentUpdate) {
390 autoTuneScopeForI2c();
391 autoTuneScopeForArduino();
392 refreshScopePanelFields();
393 }
394 const baseUrl = resolveSimulationApiBaseUrl();
395 const payload = { state: buildSimulationState(), gridStep: GRID_SIZE };
396 const wiredCount = circuit.wires.filter((w) => w.fromJonctionId && w.toJonctionId).length;
397 warnDroppedWiresForLogicCircuits(wiredCount - payload.state.wires.length, isSilentUpdate);
398 const btnSim = document.getElementById('btn-simulate');
399 const btnStop = document.getElementById('btn-stop');
400 if (btnSim && !isSilentUpdate) { btnSim.innerText = "⚡ Calculs SPICE..."; btnSim.style.background = "#ff9800"; }
401 if (!isSilentUpdate && shouldStartArduinoLiveDisplayEarly()) {
402 flags.isSimulating = true;
403 resetArduinoRuntimes();
404 ensureArduinoLedAnimation();
405 if (btnStop) btnStop.classList.remove('disabled');
406 draw();
407 }
408 try {
409 const response = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/api/simulate`, {
410 method: 'POST',
411 headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
412 credentials: 'include',
413 body: JSON.stringify(payload),
414 signal,
415 });
416 if (myGeneration !== simulationGeneration) return;
417 if (!response.ok) {
418 let backendError = "";
419 try {
420 const errJson = await response.json();
421 backendError =
422 errJson.error ||
423 errJson.message ||
424 (Array.isArray(errJson.errors) ? errJson.errors.join('\n') : '');
425 } catch (e) {
426 backendError = await response.text();
427 }
428 throw new Error(formatSimulationNetworkError({ message: backendError }, baseUrl));
429 }
430 const result = await response.json();
431 if (myGeneration !== simulationGeneration) return;
432 if (result.ok) {
433 showSimulationWarnings(result.warnings, isSilentUpdate);
434 simulationResults.voltmeters = result.voltmeterValues || {};
435 simulationResults.ammeters = result.ammeterValues || {};
436 simulationResults.ohmmeters = result.ohmmeterValues || {};
437 simulationResults.leds = result.ledValues || {};
438 simulationResults.scopePlots = result.scopePlots || {};
439 simulationResults.bodePlots = result.bodePlots || {};
440 simulationResults.seg7 = result.seg7Values || {};
441 simulationResults.bargraph = result.bargraphValues || {};
442 simulationResults.logicValues = result.logicValues || {};
443 const scopePlotKeys = Object.keys(simulationResults.scopePlots);
444 const hasOsc = circuit.components.some((c) => c.type === 'oscilloscope');
445 if (scopePlotKeys.length > 0 || hasOsc) {
446 startScopeAnimation(simulationResults.scopePlots);
447 } else {
448 stopScopeAnimation();
449 }
450 const osc = circuit.components.find((c) => c.type === 'oscilloscope');
451 if (osc) {
452 if (!isSilentUpdate) {
453 openScopePanel(osc, { openPopup: true });
454 } else {
455 const keepPopup = isScopePopupOpen();
456 const keepPanel = isScopePanelOpen();
457 if (keepPanel || keepPopup) {
458 openScopePanel(getActiveScope() || osc, { openPopup: keepPopup });
459 }
460 refreshScopePopup();
461 }
462 }
463 if (isSerialMonitorOpen()) refreshSerialMonitor();
464 const bodeComp = circuit.components.find((c) => c.type === 'bode_analyzer');
465 if (bodeComp && (result.analysisAc || Object.keys(simulationResults.bodePlots).length > 0)) {
466 if (!isSilentUpdate) {
467 openBodePopup(bodeComp);
468 } else if (isBodePopupOpen()) {
469 refreshBodePopup();
470 }
471 }
472 if (result.analysisTran) {
473 const vmPlots = result.voltmeterTranPlots || {};
474 const ledPlots = result.ledTranPlots || {};
475 const seg7Plots = result.seg7TranPlots || {};
476 const bargraphPlots = result.bargraphTranPlots || {};
477 const logicGateTranPlots = result.logicGateTranPlots || {};
478 const arduinoIdeal = hasArduinoStaticIdealDisplay();
479 if (
480 Object.keys(vmPlots).length ||
481 Object.keys(ledPlots).length ||
482 Object.keys(seg7Plots).length ||
483 Object.keys(bargraphPlots).length ||
484 Object.keys(logicGateTranPlots).length
485 ) {
486 startLedAnimation(ledPlots, vmPlots, seg7Plots, logicGateTranPlots, {
487 keepClock: isSilentUpdate,
488 bargraphPlots,
489 });
490 } else if (!arduinoIdeal) {
491 stopLedAnimation();
492 }
493 const speakerPlots = result.speakerTranPlots || {};
494 if (Object.keys(speakerPlots).length > 0) {
495 startSpeakerAudio(speakerPlots);
496 } else {
497 stopSpeakerAudio();
498 }
499 } else {
500 stopLedAnimation(true);
501 stopSpeakerAudio();
502 }
503 const hasBurntLed = Object.values(simulationResults.leds).some((m) => {
504 const i = m && typeof m === 'object' ? m.current : m;
505 return isLedOvercurrent(i);
506 });
507 if (hasBurntLed && !hasLedAnimation() && !hasVoltmeterAnimation()) startBurntLedSmokeLoop();
508 flags.isSimulating = true;
509 resetArduinoRuntimes();
510 ensureArduinoLedAnimation();
511 if (btnSim) { btnSim.innerText = "▶️ Simulation Live"; btnSim.style.background = "#00bcd4"; }
512 if (btnStop) btnStop.classList.remove('disabled');
513 draw();
514 } else {
515 if (!isSilentUpdate) alert("Erreur du moteur SPICE :\n" + formatSpiceEngineErrors(result));
516 stopSimulation();
517 }
518 } catch (err) {
519 if (err?.name === 'AbortError' || myGeneration !== simulationGeneration) return;
520 if (!isSilentUpdate) alert(`Erreur réseau :\n${formatSimulationNetworkError(err, baseUrl)}`);
521 stopSimulation();
522 } finally {
523 simulationInFlight = false;
524 if (myGeneration !== simulationGeneration) return;
525 if (simulationQueuedSilent) {
526 simulationQueuedSilent = false;
527 triggerSimulation(true);
528 }
529 }
530}

154function formatFreqLabel(f) {
155 if (!(f > 0)) return '?';
156 if (f >= 1000 && f % 1000 === 0) return `${f / 1000} kHz`;
157 if (f < 1) {
158 const p = 1 / f;
159 if (p >= 3600 && Math.abs(p % 3600) < 0.01) return `1/${p / 3600} h`;
160 if (p >= 60 && Math.abs(p % 60) < 0.01) return `1/${p / 60} min`;
161 return `${p >= 10 ? Math.round(p) : p.toFixed(2)} s`;
162 }
163 return `${f} Hz`;
164}

198 const f = parseFloat(preset);

200 if (!flags.isSimulating) saveState();
201 activeSource.frequency = f;
202 if (gimpFreqEl()) gimpFreqEl().value = String(f);
203 applyFieldsToComponent();
204 });
205 gsinAmpEl()?.addEventListener('change', onChange);
206 gsinFreqEl()?.addEventListener('change', onChange);
207 gsinOffsetEl()?.addEventListener('change', onChange);
208 gsqrAmpEl()?.addEventListener('change', onChange);
209 gsqrFreqEl()?.addEventListener('change', onChange);
210 gsqrOffsetEl()?.addEventListener('change', onChange);
211
212 gimpVoltageEl()?.addEventListener('input', apply);

215 gsinAmpEl()?.addEventListener('input', apply);

1// speaker-audio.js — restitution carte son à partir des courbes .tran du haut-parleur
2import { circuit } from './state.js';
3import { reachableJonctions } from './Engine/hc90-cascade.mjs';
4
5/** Tension crête de référence du circuit (plein volume numérique). */
6export const SPEAKER_MAX_CIRCUIT_VOLTS = 5;
7
8const AUDIO_HEADROOM = 0.88;
9const TARGET_SAMPLE_RATE = 44100;
10const FADE_IN_MS = 30;
11const FADE_OUT_MS = 25;
12
13const AC_SOURCE_TYPES = new Set(['gsin', 'gsqr', 'gimp']);
14
15let audioCtx = null;
16/** @type {AudioBufferSourceNode|null} */
17let sourceNode = null;
18/** @type {OscillatorNode|null} */
19let oscNode = null;
20let gainNode = null;
21let filterNode = null;
22let playing = false;
23let animRaf = null;
24let lastPlaySig = '';
25let redraw = () => {};
26
27export function bindSpeakerAudioRedraw(fn) {
28 redraw = typeof fn === 'function' ? fn : () => {};
29}
30
31function ensureAudioContext() {
32 if (!audioCtx) audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
33 if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume().catch(() => {});
34 return audioCtx;
35}
36
37function speakerNet() {
38 const sp = circuit.components.find((c) => c.type === 'speaker' && c.label);
39 if (!sp) return new Set();
40 const wires = circuit.wires || [];
41 const auto = circuit.autoJunctions || [];
42 const net = new Set([
43 ...reachableJonctions(`${sp.label}_in`, wires, auto),
44 ...reachableJonctions(`${sp.label}_out`, wires, auto),
45 ]);
46 return net;
47}
48
49function acSourceOnSpeakerNet(comp) {
50 if (!comp?.label) return false;
51 return speakerNet().has(`${comp.label}_out`);
52}
53
54function plotPeakVolts(plot) {
55 if (!plot?.voltage?.length) return 0;
56 let peak = 0;
57 for (const v of plot.voltage) {
58 const a = Math.abs(v);
59 if (a > peak) peak = a;
60 }
61 return peak;
62}
63
64function voltsToGain(peakVolts) {
65 if (!(peakVolts > 1e-4)) return AUDIO_HEADROOM * 0.5;
66 return Math.min(1, (peakVolts / SPEAKER_MAX_CIRCUIT_VOLTS) * AUDIO_HEADROOM);
67}
68
69function buildDriveFromComp(comp, plot) {
70 const freq = comp.frequency > 0 ? comp.frequency : 440;
71 let wave = 'sine';
72 if (comp.type === 'gsqr' || comp.type === 'gimp') wave = 'square';
73
74 let nominalPeak = 5;
75 if (comp.type === 'gsin') nominalPeak = comp.peakAmplitude ?? 5;
76 else if (comp.type === 'gsqr') nominalPeak = comp.peakAmplitude ?? 5;
77 else if (comp.type === 'gimp') nominalPeak = comp.voltageRail ?? 5;
78
79 const peak = plotPeakVolts(plot);
80 const amplitude = peak > 1e-3 ? voltsToGain(peak) : voltsToGain(nominalPeak);
81 return { wave, frequency: freq, amplitude, sourceLabel: comp.label };
82}
83
84/**
85 * Générateur Sin/Carré/Impulsions → OscillatorNode (pas de boucle .tran).
86 * @param {{ time?: number[]; voltage?: number[] }} plot
87 */
88function detectOscillatorDrive(plot) {
89 const speakers = circuit.components.filter((c) => c.type === 'speaker');
90 const acSources = circuit.components.filter((c) => AC_SOURCE_TYPES.has(c.type));
91 if (!speakers.length || !acSources.length) return null;
92
93 for (const comp of acSources) {
94 if (acSourceOnSpeakerNet(comp)) return buildDriveFromComp(comp, plot);
95 }
96
97 // Montage simple : un HP + un générateur (même si fils en T non détectés)
98 if (acSources.length === 1 && speakers.length >= 1) {
99 return buildDriveFromComp(acSources[0], plot);
100 }
101
102 // Priorité au sinus si présent avec un HP
103 const gsin = acSources.find((c) => c.type === 'gsin');
104 if (gsin) return buildDriveFromComp(gsin, plot);
105
106 return null;
107}
108
109/** Signature stable (sans amplitude SPICE qui varie à chaque .tran). */
110function driveSignature(drive) {
111 if (!drive) return '';
112 return `osc|${drive.wave}|${drive.frequency}|${drive.sourceLabel}`;
113}
114
115function interpolateVoltage(time, voltage, t) {
116 if (!time?.length || !voltage?.length) return 0;
117 if (t <= time[0]) return voltage[0];
118 if (t >= time[time.length - 1]) return voltage[voltage.length - 1];
119 for (let i = 1; i < time.length; i++) {
120 if (t <= time[i]) {
121 const t0 = time[i - 1];
122 const t1 = time[i];
123 const v0 = voltage[i - 1];
124 const v1 = voltage[i];
125 if (t1 <= t0) return v0;
126 const u = (t - t0) / (t1 - t0);
127 return v0 + u * (v1 - v0);
128 }
129 }
130 return voltage[voltage.length - 1];
131}
132
133function estimatePeriodSec(time, voltage) {
134 if (!time?.length || time.length < 8) return null;
135 const mean = voltage.reduce((s, v) => s + v, 0) / voltage.length;
136 const crossings = [];
137 for (let i = 1; i < voltage.length; i++) {
138 const a = voltage[i - 1] - mean;
139 const b = voltage[i] - mean;
140 if (a < 0 && b >= 0) crossings.push(time[i]);
141 }
142 if (crossings.length < 3) return null;
143 let sum = 0;
144 for (let i = 1; i < crossings.length; i++) sum += crossings[i] - crossings[i - 1];
145 return (sum / (crossings.length - 1)) * 2;
146}
147
148function buildPeriodicLoopBuffer(plot, sampleRate) {
149 const time = plot.time;
150 const voltage = plot.voltage;
151 const t0 = time[0];
152 const tEnd = time[time.length - 1];
153 const fullDuration = tEnd - t0;
154 if (!Number.isFinite(fullDuration) || fullDuration <= 1e-9) return null;
155
156 const period = estimatePeriodSec(time, voltage);
157 if (!(period > 1e-9)) return null;
158
159 const periodsInSpan = Math.max(2, Math.floor(fullDuration / period));
160 const loopDuration = periodsInSpan * period;
161 const loopT0 = t0 + fullDuration - loopDuration;
162 if (loopDuration <= 1e-9) return null;
163
164 const numSamples = Math.max(256, Math.round(loopDuration * sampleRate));
165 const data = new Float32Array(numSamples);
166 const scale = AUDIO_HEADROOM / SPEAKER_MAX_CIRCUIT_VOLTS;
167
168 let sum = 0;
169 for (let i = 0; i < numSamples; i++) {
170 const t = loopT0 + (i / numSamples) * loopDuration;
171 const v = interpolateVoltage(time, voltage, t);
172 const s = Number.isFinite(v) ? v * scale : 0;
173 data[i] = s;
174 sum += s;
175 }
176 const mean = sum / numSamples;
177 for (let i = 0; i < numSamples; i++) data[i] -= mean;
178
179 const fadeSamples = Math.min(Math.floor(0.01 * sampleRate), Math.floor(numSamples / 8));
180 if (fadeSamples >= 4) {
181 for (let i = 0; i < fadeSamples; i++) {
182 const w = i / fadeSamples;
183 const tail = numSamples - fadeSamples + i;
184 data[tail] = data[tail] * (1 - w) + data[i] * w;
185 }
186 }
187 data[numSamples - 1] = data[0];
188
189 for (let i = 0; i < numSamples; i++) {
190 data[i] = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, data[i]));
191 }
192 return { data };
193}
194
195function plotSignature(plot) {
196 const t = plot?.time;
197 const v = plot?.voltage;
198 if (!t?.length || !v?.length) return '';
199 const n = t.length;
200 return `buf|${n}|${t[n - 1].toFixed(6)}`;
201}
202
203function connectOutputChain(ctx, outputNode, amplitude, useFilter) {
204 let chain = outputNode;
205 filterNode = null;
206
207 if (useFilter) {
208 filterNode = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
209 filterNode.type = 'lowpass';
210 filterNode.frequency.value = 6000;
211 filterNode.Q.value = 0.5;
212 chain.connect(filterNode);
213 chain = filterNode;
214 }
215
216 gainNode = ctx.createGain();
217 gainNode.gain.setValueAtTime(0, ctx.currentTime);
218 gainNode.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(amplitude, ctx.currentTime + FADE_IN_MS / 1000);
219 chain.connect(gainNode);
220 gainNode.connect(ctx.destination);
221}
222
223function updateOscillatorLive(drive) {
224 if (!oscNode || !gainNode || !audioCtx) return false;
225 const t = audioCtx.currentTime;
226 oscNode.frequency.setTargetAtTime(drive.frequency, t, 0.02);
227 gainNode.gain.setTargetAtTime(drive.amplitude, t, 0.02);
228 return true;
229}
230
231function startOscillatorPlayback(ctx, drive) {
232 oscNode = ctx.createOscillator();
233 oscNode.type = drive.wave;
234 oscNode.frequency.value = drive.frequency;
235 connectOutputChain(ctx, oscNode, drive.amplitude, drive.wave === 'square');
236 oscNode.start(0);
237}
238
239function startBufferPlayback(ctx, plot) {
240 const pcm = buildPeriodicLoopBuffer(plot, TARGET_SAMPLE_RATE);
241 if (!pcm) return false;
242
243 const buffer = ctx.createBuffer(1, pcm.data.length, TARGET_SAMPLE_RATE);
244 buffer.getChannelData(0).set(pcm.data);
245
246 sourceNode = ctx.createBufferSource();
247 sourceNode.buffer = buffer;
248 sourceNode.loop = true;
249 sourceNode.loopStart = 0;
250 sourceNode.loopEnd = buffer.duration;
251
252 connectOutputChain(ctx, sourceNode, voltsToGain(plotPeakVolts(plot)), false);
253 sourceNode.start(0);
254 return true;
255}
256
257/**
258 * @param {Record<string, { time?: number[]; voltage?: number[] }>} speakerPlots
259 */
260export function startSpeakerAudio(speakerPlots) {
261 if (!speakerPlots || typeof speakerPlots !== 'object') return;
262
263 const plots = Object.values(speakerPlots).filter(
264 (p) => p?.time?.length >= 2 && p?.voltage?.length >= 2
265 );
266 if (!plots.length) return;
267
268 const plot = plots[0];
269 const drive = detectOscillatorDrive(plot);
270
271 if (drive) {
272 const sig = driveSignature(drive);
273 if (playing && oscNode && sig === lastPlaySig) return;
274 if (playing && oscNode && updateOscillatorLive(drive)) {
275 lastPlaySig = sig;
276 return;
277 }
278 } else if (playing && sourceNode) {
279 const sig = plotSignature(plot);
280 if (sig === lastPlaySig) return;
281 }
282
283 stopSpeakerAudio({ immediate: true });
284
285 const ctx = ensureAudioContext();
286 try {
287 if (drive) {
288 startOscillatorPlayback(ctx, drive);
289 lastPlaySig = driveSignature(drive);
290 } else if (!startBufferPlayback(ctx, plot)) {
291 return;
292 } else {
293 lastPlaySig = plotSignature(plot);
294 }
295 playing = true;
296 redraw();
297 const tick = () => {
298 if (!playing) return;
299 redraw();
300 animRaf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
301 };
302 animRaf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
303 } catch {
304 playing = false;
305 sourceNode = null;
306 oscNode = null;
307 gainNode = null;
308 filterNode = null;
309 lastPlaySig = '';
310 }
311}
312
313export function stopSpeakerAudio(opts = {}) {
314 if (animRaf != null) cancelAnimationFrame(animRaf);
315 animRaf = null;
316
317 const immediate = opts.immediate === true;
318 const ctx = audioCtx;
319 const src = sourceNode;
320 const osc = oscNode;
321 const gain = gainNode;
322 const filt = filterNode;
323
324 sourceNode = null;
325 oscNode = null;
326 gainNode = null;
327 filterNode = null;
328 playing = false;
329 lastPlaySig = '';
330
331 if (!src && !osc) return;
332
333 const finalize = () => {
334 if (src) {
335 try { src.stop(); } catch { /* */ }
336 try { src.disconnect(); } catch { /* */ }
337 }
338 if (osc) {
339 try { osc.stop(); } catch { /* */ }
340 try { osc.disconnect(); } catch { /* */ }
341 }
342 try { filt?.disconnect(); } catch { /* */ }
343 try { gain?.disconnect(); } catch { /* */ }
344 };
345
346 if (immediate || !ctx || !gain) {
347 finalize();
348 return;
349 }
350
351 const t = ctx.currentTime;
352 try {
353 gain.gain.cancelScheduledValues(t);
354 gain.gain.setValueAtTime(gain.gain.value, t);
355 gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0, t + FADE_OUT_MS / 1000);
356 } catch {
357 finalize();
358 return;
359 }
360 setTimeout(finalize, FADE_OUT_MS + 10);
361}
362
363export function isSpeakerAudioPlaying() {
364 return playing;
365}

175.dropdown {
176 display: none;
177 position: absolute;
178 top: 100%;
179 left: 0;
180 background-color: var(--panel-bg);
181 border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
182 box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
183 z-index: 501;
184 min-width: 200px;
185 border-radius: 0 0 8px 8px;
186 padding: 4px 0;
187}
188
189.dropdown-item {
190 color: var(--text-muted);
191 padding: 9px 16px;
192 text-decoration: none;
193 display: block;
194 font-size: 13px;
195 font-weight: 500;
196 white-space: nowrap;
197}
198
199.dropdown-item:hover {
200 background-color: var(--border-color);
201 color: white;
202}
203
204.menu-item:hover > .dropdown,
205.menu-item.open > .dropdown {
206 display: block;
207}
208
209.dropdown-submenu {
210 position: relative;
211}
212
213.dropdown-submenu > .submenu {
214 display: none;
215 position: absolute;
216 left: 100%;
217 top: 0;
218 min-width: 120px;
219 border-radius: 4px;
220 background-color: var(--panel-bg);
221 border: 2px solid var(--border-color);
222 box-shadow: 0px 8px 16px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
223 z-index: 2;
224}
225
226.dropdown-submenu.open > .submenu {
227 display: block;
228}
229
230.submenu-title {
231 cursor: pointer;
232 color: var(--text-muted);
233 user-select: none;
234}
235
236.submenu .dropdown-item {
237 padding: 10px 14px;
238 text-align: left;
239 min-width: 0;
240}
241
242.submenu .dropdown-item::before {
243 content: none !important;
244}
245
246.dropdown-submenu > .submenu-title::after {
247 content: '▸';
248 float: right;
249 opacity: 0.55;
250 margin-left: 12px;
251}
252
253/* Menus avec sous-menus : texte seul, aligné */
254.menu-item:has(.dropdown-submenu) > .dropdown > .dropdown-item,
255.submenu .dropdown-item {
256 padding-left: 14px;
257 padding-right: 14px;
258}

1/** Boîte de saisie modale (remplace window.prompt, compatible Electron). */
2import { showModal, hideModal } from './modal-ui.js';
3
4/** @type {((value: string | null) => void) | null} */
5let pendingResolve = null;
6
7function getModal() {
8 return document.getElementById('value-prompt-modal');
9}
10
11/**
12 * @param {string} message
13 * @param {string} [defaultValue]
14 * @returns {Promise<string | null>}
15 */
16export function showValuePrompt(message, defaultValue = '') {
17 return new Promise((resolve) => {
18 const modal = getModal();
19 const input = document.getElementById('value-prompt-input');
20 const label = document.getElementById('value-prompt-message');
21 if (!modal || !input || !label) {
22 resolve(typeof window.prompt === 'function' ? window.prompt(message, defaultValue) : null);
23 return;
24 }
25 if (pendingResolve) pendingResolve(null);
26 pendingResolve = resolve;
27 label.textContent = message;
28 input.value = defaultValue ?? '';
29 showModal(modal);
30 input.focus();
31 input.select();
32 });
33}
34
35export function initValuePrompt() {
36 const modal = getModal();
37 const input = document.getElementById('value-prompt-input');
38 const okBtn = document.getElementById('value-prompt-ok');
39 const cancelBtn = document.getElementById('value-prompt-cancel');
40 const closeBtn = document.getElementById('close-value-prompt');
41
42 function finish(value) {
43 if (!pendingResolve) return;
44 const resolve = pendingResolve;
45 pendingResolve = null;
46 hideModal(modal);
47 resolve(value);
48 }
49
50 okBtn?.addEventListener('click', () => finish(input?.value ?? null));
51 cancelBtn?.addEventListener('click', () => finish(null));
52 closeBtn?.addEventListener('click', () => finish(null));
53 input?.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
54 if (e.key === 'Enter') {
55 e.preventDefault();
56 finish(input.value);
57 }
58 if (e.key === 'Escape') {
59 e.preventDefault();
60 finish(null);
61 }
62 });
63 modal?.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
64 if (e.target === modal) finish(null);
65 });
66}

27async function startBackend() {
28 const { startStandaloneSimulateServer } = resolveStandaloneServerModule();
29 const repoRoot = resolveRepoRoot();
30 const port = Number(process.env.SIMULATEUR_H_PORT) || DEFAULT_PORT;
31 const { server, url } = await startStandaloneSimulateServer({
32 repoRoot,

35 });

40function createWindow(startUrl) {
41 mainWindow = new BrowserWindow({
42 title: "Simulateur H",
43 width: 1280,
44 height: 860,
45 minWidth: 960,
46 minHeight: 640,
47 autoHideMenuBar: true,
48 webPreferences: {
49 contextIsolation: true,
50 nodeIntegration: false,
51 sandbox: true,
52 },
53 });
54
55 mainWindow.loadURL(startUrl);
56
57 mainWindow.webContents.setWindowOpenHandler(({ url }) => {
58 if (url.startsWith("http://127.0.0.1") || url.startsWith("http://localhost")) {
59 return { action: "allow" };
60 }
61 shell.openExternal(url);
62 return { action: "deny" };
63 });
64
65 mainWindow.on("closed", () => {
66 mainWindow = null;
67 });
68}
69
70function stopBackend() {
71 if (httpServer) {
72 try {
73 httpServer.close();
74 } catch {
75 /* ignore */
76 }
77 httpServer = null;
78 }
79}
80
81const gotLock = app.requestSingleInstanceLock();
82if (!gotLock) {
83 app.quit();
84} else {
85 app.on("second-instance", () => {
86 if (mainWindow) {
87 if (mainWindow.isMinimized()) mainWindow.restore();
88 mainWindow.focus();
89 }
90 });
91
92 app.whenReady().then(async () => {
93 try {
94 const startUrl = await startBackend();
95 createWindow(startUrl);
96 } catch (err) {
97 console.error("[Simulateur H] Démarrage impossible :", err);
98 const { dialog } = require("electron");
99 dialog.showErrorBox(
100 "Simulateur H — erreur de démarrage",
101 (err && err.message) || String(err)
102 );
103 app.exit(1);
104 }
105 });
106
107 app.on("window-all-closed", () => {
108 stopBackend();
109 app.quit();
110 });
111
112 app.on("before-quit", () => {
113 stopBackend();
114 });
115}

46/**
47 * Détecte si le binaire ngspice du serveur supporte XSPICE (résultat mis en cache).
48 * @param {string} exe
49 * @param {NodeJS.ProcessEnv} env
50 */
51async function serverNgspiceHasXspice(exe, env) {
52 const envKey = envPathKey(env);
53 if (
54 cachedNgspiceXspice.exe === exe &&
55 cachedNgspiceXspice.envKey === envKey &&
56 cachedNgspiceXspice.value !== null
57 ) {
58 return cachedNgspiceXspice.value;
59 }
60 try {
61 const mod = await import(ngspiceXspiceProbeModuleUrl);
62 const value = mod.ngspiceHasXspice(exe, env);
63 cachedNgspiceXspice = { exe, envKey, value };
64 return value;
65 } catch {
66 cachedNgspiceXspice = { exe, envKey, value: false };
67 return false;
68 }

82function isNgspiceMissingError(error) {
83 if (!error) return false;
84 if (error.code === "ENOENT") return true;
85 const msg = `${error.message || ""}`;
86 // Ne pas matcher seul « spawn » : spawn EPERM = blocage sécurité, pas « introuvable ».
87 return /not recognized|introuvable|pas reconnu|cannot find|No such file|est pas une commande|n'est pas reconnu|n'est pas reconnu|command not found/i.test(
88 msg
89 );
90}

92/**
93 * @param {{ message?: string; code?: string | number }} error

96function isLikelySecuritySoftwareBlock(error, exeTried) {
97 if (!error || isNgspiceWrongPlatformBinary(exeTried || "")) return false;
98 if (!isWin32Platform()) return false;
99 const c = error.code;
100 if (c === "EPERM" || c === "EACCES") return true;
101 const msg = `${error.message || ""}`;
102 return /operation not permitted|accès refusé|access denied|bloqué|blocked|not permitted by/i.test(msg);
103}

115/** buildNgspiceDeck est async (ESM) ; tolère aussi une version synchrone ancienne. */
116async function invokeBuildNgspiceDeck(buildFn, state, opts) {
117 const result = buildFn(state, opts);
118 if (result != null && typeof result.then === "function") return await result;
119 return result;
120}

122/** Délai exec ngspice : circuits 74HC90 / CD4511 (.tran jusqu'à ~120 s simulées). */
123function ngspiceExecTimeoutMs(netlistText) {
124 const text = String(netlistText || "");
125 if (!/\.tran\b/i.test(text)) return 30000;
126 const m = text.match(/\.tran\s+\S+\s+(\S+)/i);
127 if (!m) return 90000;
128 const tstop = parseFloat(m[1]);
129 if (!Number.isFinite(tstop) || tstop <= 0) return 90000;
130 return Math.min(180000, Math.max(15000, Math.round(tstop * 3000 + 10000)));
131}
132
133function runNgspice(netlistPath, outputPath, opts = {}) {
134 const { exe, prependPath } = resolveNgspiceForServer(repoRoot);
135 const env = applyPathPrepend(process.env, prependPath);
136 const cwd = opts.cwd || repoRoot;
137 const timeoutMs = opts.timeoutMs ?? 90000;
138 // Linux (Docker/Render) : -i charge digital.cm copié dans le répertoire de travail.
139 // Windows : pas de -i/-f (ngspice_con charge spinit du bundle).
140 const args = ["-b"];
141 if (opts.xspiceRc && process.platform !== "win32") {
142 args.push("-i", opts.xspiceRc);
143 }
144 args.push("-o", outputPath, netlistPath);
145 return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
146 execFile(
147 exe,
148 args,
149 {
150 windowsHide: true,
151 timeout: timeoutMs,
152 maxBuffer: 8 * 1024 * 1024,
153 env,
154 cwd,
155 },
156 (error, stdout, stderr) => {
157 if (error) {
158 reject({
159 message: error.message,
160 code: error.code,
161 stdout: stdout || "",
162 stderr: stderr || "",
163 ngspiceExe: exe,
164 });
165 return;
166 }
167 resolve({ stdout: stdout || "", stderr: stderr || "" });
168 }
169 );
170 });
171}

600function startStandaloneSimulateServer(options = {}) {
601 const repoRoot = options.repoRoot;
602 if (!repoRoot) throw new Error("repoRoot requis");
603 const port = options.port ?? 43721;
604 const host = options.host ?? "127.0.0.1";
605 const app = createSimulateStandaloneApp(repoRoot);
606 const { preloadSimEngineModules: preloadEngine } = require(path.join(
607 repoRoot,
608 "tools",
609 "simulate-engine-loader.cjs"
610 ));
611 preloadEngine(repoRoot);
612 const { resolveNgspiceForServer } = require(path.join(repoRoot, "tools", "ngspice-bundle.cjs"));
613 return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
614 const server = app.listen(port, host, () => {
615 const { exe: ngspiceExe } = resolveNgspiceForServer(repoRoot);
616 console.log("[Simulateur H] ngspice : " + ngspiceExe);
617 console.log("[Simulateur H] http://" + host + ":" + port + "/Simulateur/");
618 resolve({ server, port, host, url: "http://" + host + ":" + port + "/Simulateur/" });
619 });
620 server.on("error", reject);
621 });
622}
623
624module.exports = { createSimulateStandaloneApp, startStandaloneSimulateServer, SIM_ENGINE_BUILD_TAG };

1"use strict";
2/**
3 * Intégration arduino-cli : compilation de sketches Arduino UNO.
4 * Variable d'environnement ARDUINO_CLI = chemin vers arduino-cli(.exe).
5 */
6const { execFile } = require("node:child_process");
7const fs = require("node:fs");
8const path = require("node:path");
9const os = require("node:os");
10const { mkdir, mkdtemp, readFile, rm, writeFile } = require("node:fs/promises");
11
12const DEFAULT_FQBN = "arduino:avr:uno";

14function cleanEnvExecutable(s) {
15 let x = String(s || "").trim();
16 if ((x.startsWith('"') && x.endsWith('"')) || (x.startsWith("'") && x.endsWith("'"))) {
17 x = x.slice(1, -1).trim();
18 }
19 return x;
20}
21
22function resolveArduinoCliPath() {
23 const fromEnv = cleanEnvExecutable(process.env.ARDUINO_CLI);
24 if (fromEnv) {
25 if (path.isAbsolute(fromEnv) && fs.existsSync(fromEnv)) return fromEnv;
26 const fromCwd = path.resolve(process.cwd(), fromEnv);
27 if (fs.existsSync(fromCwd)) return fromCwd;
28 // Chemin ARDUINO_CLI invalide (ex. build Docker incomplet) — retomber sur le PATH
29 }
30 if (process.platform === "win32") {
31 const desktop = path.join(process.env.USERPROFILE || process.env.HOME || "", "Desktop");
32 const candidates = [
33 path.join(desktop, "Arduino-cli", "arduino-cli.exe"),
34 path.join(desktop, "arduino-cli", "arduino-cli.exe"),
35 path.join(process.env.ProgramFiles || "", "Arduino CLI", "arduino-cli.exe"),
36 path.join(process.env["ProgramFiles(x86)"] || "", "Arduino CLI", "arduino-cli.exe"),
37 ];
38 for (const c of candidates) {
39 if (c && fs.existsSync(c)) return c;
40 }
41 }
42 return "arduino-cli";
43}
44
45function runCli(args, opts = {}) {
46 const exe = opts.exe || resolveArduinoCliPath();
47 const timeoutMs = opts.timeoutMs ?? 120000;
48 return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
49 execFile(
50 exe,
51 args,
52 {
53 windowsHide: true,
54 timeout: timeoutMs,
55 maxBuffer: 4 * 1024 * 1024,
56 env: process.env,
57 },
58 (error, stdout, stderr) => {
59 resolve({
60 ok: !error,
61 exe,
62 stdout: stdout || "",
63 stderr: stderr || "",
64 code: error?.code,
65 message: error?.message || "",
66 });
67 }
68 );
69 });
70}

72function sanitizeSketchFolderName(name) {
73 const base = String(name || "sketch")
74 .replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_]/g, "_")
75 .replace(/^_+/, "")
76 .slice(0, 40);
77 return base.match(/^[a-zA-Z_]/) ? base : `sketch_${base || "uno"}`;
78}

80/** Dossiers racine où l'utilisateur peut déposer des bibliothèques Arduino. */
81function resolveUserLibraryRoots() {
82 const roots = [];
83 const envPaths = String(process.env.ARDUINO_LIBRARIES || "")
84 .split(/[;|]/)
85 .map((p) => p.trim())
86 .filter(Boolean);
87 for (const p of envPaths) {
88 const abs = path.isAbsolute(p) ? p : path.resolve(process.cwd(), p);
89 if (fs.existsSync(abs)) roots.push(abs);
90 }
91 for (const rel of ["arduino-libraries", path.join("Simulateur", "arduino-libraries")]) {
92 const abs = path.resolve(process.cwd(), rel);
93 if (fs.existsSync(abs) && !roots.includes(abs)) roots.push(abs);
94 }
95 return roots;
96}
97
98function isArduinoLibraryDir(dir) {
99 if (!fs.existsSync(dir) || !fs.statSync(dir).isDirectory()) return false;
100 if (fs.existsSync(path.join(dir, "library.properties"))) return true;
101 const entries = fs.readdirSync(dir);
102 if (entries.some((f) => f.endsWith(".h"))) return true;
103 const src = path.join(dir, "src");
104 return fs.existsSync(src) && fs.statSync(src).isDirectory()
105 && fs.readdirSync(src).some((f) => f.endsWith(".h"));
106}
107
108/** Chemins des bibliothèques locales (--library arduino-cli). */
109function resolveUserLibraryPaths() {
110 const paths = [];
111 for (const root of resolveUserLibraryRoots()) {
112 for (const name of fs.readdirSync(root)) {
113 const libDir = path.join(root, name);
114 if (isArduinoLibraryDir(libDir)) paths.push(libDir);
115 }
116 }
117 return paths;
118}

120function parseSketchIncludes(sketch) {
121 const headers = new Set();
122 for (const m of String(sketch || "").matchAll(/#include\s*[<"]([^">]+)[">]/g)) {
123 headers.add(m[1].trim());
124 }
125 return [...headers];
126}
127
128/** Correspondance en-tête → nom Library Manager (installable via arduino-cli lib install). */
129const HEADER_LIB_REGISTRY = {
130 "LiquidCrystal_I2C.h": "LiquidCrystal I2C",
131 "rgb_lcd.h": "Grove - LCD RGB Backlight",
132};
133
134function findLocalLibraryForHeader(header, libraryPaths) {
135 for (const libDir of libraryPaths) {
136 if (fs.existsSync(path.join(libDir, header))) return libDir;
137 if (fs.existsSync(path.join(libDir, "src", header))) return libDir;
138 }
139 return null;
140}
141
142async function ensureRegistryLibraries(headers, libraryPaths) {
143 const installed = [];
144 const skipped = [];
145 for (const header of headers) {
146 if (findLocalLibraryForHeader(header, libraryPaths)) {
147 skipped.push(header);
148 continue;
149 }
150 const libName = HEADER_LIB_REGISTRY[header];
151 if (!libName) continue;
152 const result = await installArduinoLibrary(libName);
153 if (result.ok) installed.push(libName);
154 }
155 return { installed, skipped };
156}

158function tryParseCliJson(text) {
159 const t = String(text || "").trim();
160 if (!t) return null;
161 try {
162 return JSON.parse(t);
163 } catch {
164 return null;
165 }
166}
167
168function normalizeLibraryEntry(entry) {
169 if (!entry || typeof entry !== "object") return null;
170 if (entry.library && typeof entry.library === "object") {
171 return normalizeLibraryEntry(entry.library);
172 }
173 const name = entry.name || entry.Name;
174 if (!name) return null;
175 return {
176 name: String(name),
177 author: String(entry.author || entry.maintainer || entry.Author || ""),
178 version: String(entry.version || entry.Version || ""),
179 description: String(entry.sentence || entry.paragraph || entry.Sentence || "").slice(0, 160),
180 };
181}
182
183function dedupeLibrariesByName(items) {
184 const seen = new Set();
185 const out = [];
186 for (const item of items) {
187 const key = item.name.toLowerCase();
188 if (seen.has(key)) continue;
189 seen.add(key);
190 out.push(item);
191 }
192 return out;
193}

195/** @returns {Promise<{ ok: boolean; libraries: object[]; log?: string; errors?: string[] }>} */
196async function searchArduinoLibraries(query) {
197 const q = String(query || "").trim();
198 if (!q) {
199 return { ok: false, libraries: [], errors: ["Saisissez un nom de bibliothèque à rechercher."] };
200 }
201 const run = await runCli(["lib", "search", q, "--format", "json"], { timeoutMs: 120000 });
202 const log = [run.stdout, run.stderr].filter(Boolean).join("\n").trim();
203 const data = tryParseCliJson(run.stdout);
204 let raw = [];
205 if (Array.isArray(data)) raw = data;
206 else if (Array.isArray(data?.libraries)) raw = data.libraries;
207 const libraries = dedupeLibrariesByName(
208 raw.map(normalizeLibraryEntry).filter(Boolean)
209 );
210 if (!run.ok) {
211 return {
212 ok: false,
213 libraries,
214 log,
215 errors: ["Recherche Library Manager échouée.", run.message, log].filter(Boolean),
216 };
217 }
218 return { ok: true, libraries, log };
219}

302async function getArduinoCliStatus() {

305 const version = [versionRun.stdout, versionRun.stderr].join("\n").trim();
306 const libraryPaths = resolveUserLibraryPaths();
307 return {
308 ok: versionRun.ok,
309 exe,
310 version: version || null,
311 fqbnDefault: DEFAULT_FQBN,
312 libraryRoots: resolveUserLibraryRoots(),
313 libraryPaths,
314 hint: versionRun.ok
315 ? null
316 : process.env.ARDUINO_CLI && !fs.existsSync(cleanEnvExecutable(process.env.ARDUINO_CLI))
317 ? `ARDUINO_CLI pointe vers un fichier absent (${process.env.ARDUINO_CLI}). Reconstruisez l'image Docker ou corrigez la variable.`
318 : "Installez arduino-cli (https://arduino.github.io/arduino-cli/) puis définissez ARDUINO_CLI ou ajoutez-le au PATH.",

322/**
323 * @param {{ sketch: string; sketchName?: string; fqbn?: string }} opts
324 */
325async function compileArduinoSketch(opts) {
326 const sketch = String(opts?.sketch || "");
327 if (!sketch.trim()) {
328 return { ok: false, errors: ["Sketch vide."], log: "" };
329 }
330 const fqbn = String(opts?.fqbn || DEFAULT_FQBN);
331 const folderName = sanitizeSketchFolderName(opts?.sketchName || "sketch");
332 const tmpRoot = await mkdtemp(path.join(os.tmpdir(), "sim-arduino-"));
333 const sketchDir = path.join(tmpRoot, folderName);
334 await mkdir(sketchDir, { recursive: true });
335 await writeFile(path.join(sketchDir, `${folderName}.ino`), sketch, "utf8");
336 const outDir = path.join(tmpRoot, "build");
337 await mkdir(outDir, { recursive: true });
338

340 const headers = parseSketchIncludes(sketch);
341 let registryInstall = await ensureRegistryLibraries(headers, libraryPaths);
342 if (registryInstall.installed.length > 0) {
343 libraryPaths = resolveUserLibraryPaths();
344 }

347 let compileRun = await runCli(
348 buildCompileArgs(fqbn, outDir, sketchDir, libraryPaths),
349 { timeoutMs: 180000 }
350 );
351 let log = [compileRun.stdout, compileRun.stderr].filter(Boolean).join("\n").trim();
352
353 if (!compileRun.ok && /No such file or directory/i.test(log)) {
354 registryInstall = await ensureRegistryLibraries(headers, libraryPaths);
355 if (registryInstall.installed.length > 0) {
356 libraryPaths = resolveUserLibraryPaths();
357 compileRun = await runCli(
358 buildCompileArgs(fqbn, outDir, sketchDir, libraryPaths),
359 { timeoutMs: 180000 }
360 );
361 log = [compileRun.stdout, compileRun.stderr].filter(Boolean).join("\n").trim();
362 }
363 }
364
365 if (!compileRun.ok) {
366 const libHint = libraryPaths.length
367 ? `Bibliothèques locales : ${libraryPaths.map((p) => path.basename(p)).join(", ")}`
368 : "Ajoutez vos bibliothèques dans le dossier arduino-libraries/ (un sous-dossier par lib).";
369 return {
370 ok: false,
371 errors: [
372 "Compilation Arduino échouée.",
373 compileRun.message ? `(${compileRun.message})` : "",
374 libHint,
375 log ? log.slice(-6000) : "Vérifiez arduino-cli core install arduino:avr.",
376 ].filter(Boolean),
377 log,
378 fqbn,
379 exe: compileRun.exe,
380 libraryPaths,
381 };
382 }
383 let hexPath = null;
384 try {
385 const files = fs.readdirSync(outDir);
386 const hex = files.find((f) => f.endsWith(".hex"));
387 if (hex) hexPath = path.join(outDir, hex);
388 } catch {
389 /* ignore */
390 }
391 return {
392 ok: true,
393 log: log || "Compilation OK.",
394 fqbn,
395 exe: compileRun.exe,
396 hexPath,
397 buildDir: outDir,
398 sketchDir,
399 tmpRoot,
400 libraryPaths,
401 };
402 } catch (err) {
403 await rm(tmpRoot, { recursive: true, force: true }).catch(() => {});
404 return {
405 ok: false,
406 errors: [err?.message || String(err)],
407 log: "",
408 };
409 }
410}
411
412module.exports = {
413 DEFAULT_FQBN,
414 resolveArduinoCliPath,
415 resolveUserLibraryRoots,
416 resolveUserLibraryPaths,
417 parseSketchIncludes,
418 searchArduinoLibraries,
419 listInstalledArduinoLibraries,
420 installArduinoLibrary,

423 getArduinoCliStatus,
424 compileArduinoSketch,
425 sanitizeSketchFolderName,

29 }
30 );

73 );

90 : "\nSur Linux : apt install ngspice puis NGSPICE=/usr/bin/ngspice, " +

1"use strict";
2/**
3 * Résolution ngspice : variables NGSPICE / NGSPICE_PATH, sinon bundle portable
4 * dans Simulateur/bin (+ lib pour les DLL Windows).
5 * Sur Linux/macOS : ngspice (ELF), jamais ngspice.exe même s'il est présent dans bin/.
6 */
7const fs = require("node:fs");
8const path = require("node:path");
9
10function isWin32() {
11 return process.platform === "win32";
12}
13
14function isPortableWindowsExe(exePath) {
15 return /\.exe$/i.test(String(exePath || ""));
16}
17
18function cleanEnvExecutable(s) {
19 let x = String(s).trim();
20 if ((x.startsWith('"') && x.endsWith('"')) || (x.startsWith("'") && x.endsWith("'")))
21 x = x.slice(1, -1).trim();
22 return x;
23}
24
25function resolveNgspiceCandidate(p, appRoot) {
26 const t = cleanEnvExecutable(p);
27 if (!t) return "ngspice";
28 if (path.isAbsolute(t)) return path.normalize(t);
29 const fromCwd = path.resolve(process.cwd(), t);
30 if (fs.existsSync(fromCwd)) return fromCwd;
31 const fromApp = path.resolve(appRoot, t);
32 if (fs.existsSync(fromApp)) return fromApp;
33 return t;
34}
35
36/** Chemin explicite (absolu ou relatif) vers un fichier exécutable existant. */
37function ngspiceCandidateExists(exe, appRoot) {
38 if (!exe) return false;
39 if (path.isAbsolute(exe)) return fs.existsSync(exe);
40 if (/[\\/]/.test(exe)) {
41 return (
42 fs.existsSync(path.resolve(process.cwd(), exe)) ||
43 fs.existsSync(path.resolve(appRoot, exe))
44 );
45 }
46 return false;
47}
48
49function pathsEqual(a, b) {
50 return path.normalize(a).toLowerCase() === path.normalize(b).toLowerCase();
51}
52
53/** Noms des exécutables Windows dans Simulateur/bin (ordre de préférence). */
54const WIN_BUNDLE_EXE_NAMES = ["ngspice_con.exe", "ngspice.exe"];
55
56function isBareNgspiceCommand(exe) {
57 const base = path.basename(String(exe || "")).toLowerCase().replace(/\.exe$/i, "");
58 return base === "ngspice" || base === "ngspice_con";
59}
60
61/**
62 * @param {string} binDir
63 * @param {string} libDir
64 * @returns {string[]}
65 */
66function prependPathForSimulateurBundle(binDir, libDir) {
67 const segments = [];
68 if (fs.existsSync(binDir)) segments.push(binDir);
69 if (isWin32() && fs.existsSync(libDir)) segments.push(libDir);
70 const libNgspice = path.join(libDir, "ngspice");
71 if (isWin32() && fs.existsSync(libNgspice)) segments.push(libNgspice);
72 return segments;
73}
74
75/**
76 * @param {string} binDir
77 * @returns {string | null}
78 */
79function findWindowsBundledExe(binDir) {
80 for (const name of WIN_BUNDLE_EXE_NAMES) {
81 const candidate = path.join(binDir, name);
82 if (fs.existsSync(candidate)) return path.normalize(candidate);
83 }
84 const noExt = path.join(binDir, "ngspice");
85 if (fs.existsSync(noExt)) return path.normalize(noExt);
86 return null;
87}
88
89/**
90 * Binaire portable selon l’OS (sans variables d’environnement).
91 * @param {string} binDir
92 * @param {string} libDir
93 * @returns {{ exe: string, prependPath: string[] } | null}
94 */
95function resolveBundledNgspice(binDir, libDir) {
96 const unixExe = path.join(binDir, "ngspice");
97 const prepend = prependPathForSimulateurBundle(binDir, libDir);
98
99 if (isWin32()) {
100 const win = findWindowsBundledExe(binDir);
101 if (win) return { exe: win, prependPath: prepend };
102 } else if (fs.existsSync(unixExe)) {
103 return { exe: path.normalize(unixExe), prependPath: prepend };
104 }
105
106 const winCon = path.join(binDir, "ngspice_con.exe");
107 if (!isWin32() && fs.existsSync(winCon)) {
108 return { exe: path.normalize(winCon), prependPath: prepend };
109 }
110
111 return null;
112}
113
114/**
115 * @param {string} exe Chemin ou nom du binaire ngspice tenté
116 * @returns {boolean} true si .exe sur Linux/macOS (ne peut pas s’exécuter)
117 */
118function isNgspiceWrongPlatformBinary(exe) {
119 return !isWin32() && isPortableWindowsExe(exe);
120}
121
122/**
123 * @param {string} appRoot Racine du projet (typiquement __dirname de server.js)
124 * @returns {{ exe: string, prependPath: string[] }}
125 */
126function resolveNgspiceForServer(appRoot) {
127 const simRoot = path.join(appRoot, "Simulateur");
128 const binDir = path.join(simRoot, "bin");
129 const libDir = path.join(simRoot, "lib");
130
131 const prependForSimulateurBin = () => prependPathForSimulateurBundle(binDir, libDir);
132
133 const bundled = resolveBundledNgspice(binDir, libDir);
134
135 const raw = process.env.NGSPICE || process.env.NGSPICE_PATH;
136 if (typeof raw === "string" && raw.trim().length > 0) {
137 const exe = resolveNgspiceCandidate(raw, appRoot);
138 if (
139 bundled &&
140 (isBareNgspiceCommand(exe) || !ngspiceCandidateExists(exe, appRoot))
141 ) {
142 return bundled;
143 }
144 const exeDir = path.dirname(path.resolve(exe));
145 if (pathsEqual(exeDir, path.resolve(binDir))) {
146 return { exe, prependPath: prependForSimulateurBin() };
147 }
148 return { exe, prependPath: [] };
149 }
150
151 if (bundled) return bundled;
152
153 const winFallback = isWin32() ? findWindowsBundledExe(binDir) : null;
154 if (winFallback) {
155 return { exe: winFallback, prependPath: prependForSimulateurBin() };
156 }
157
158 // Aucun bundle trouvé : tenter le nom le plus courant sur la plateforme.
159 // Windows : ngspice_con (console build, sans dépendance X). Linux/macOS : ngspice.
160 return { exe: isWin32() ? "ngspice_con" : "ngspice", prependPath: [] };
161}
162
163/**
164 * @param {NodeJS.ProcessEnv} base
165 * @param {string[]} prependPath absolute dirs to prepend to PATH
166 */
167function applyPathPrepend(base, prependPath) {
168 if (!prependPath.length) return base;
169 const env = { ...base };
170 const sep = path.delimiter;
171 const prefix = prependPath.filter((d) => fs.existsSync(d)).join(sep);
172 if (!prefix) return env;
173 env.PATH = prefix + sep + (env.PATH || "");
174 return env;
175}
176
177/**
178 * Chemin source de digital.cm dans le dépôt (pour copie vers dossier temp ngspice).
179 * @param {string} appRoot
180 * @returns {string | null}
181 */
182function resolveDigitalCmSourcePath(appRoot) {
183 const candidates = [
184 path.join(appRoot, "Simulateur", "lib", "ngspice", "digital.cm"),
185 path.join(appRoot, "Simulateur", "share", "ngspice", "lib", "ngspice", "digital.cm"),
186 ];
187 for (const p of candidates) {
188 if (fs.existsSync(p)) return path.normalize(p);
189 }
190 return null;
191}
192
193module.exports = {
194 resolveNgspiceForServer,
195 applyPathPrepend,
196 isNgspiceWrongPlatformBinary,
197 isPortableWindowsExe,
198 resolveDigitalCmSourcePath,
199};

26 console.warn(`[JSON] Lecture échouée (${filePath}) : ${err?.message || err}`);
27 return defaultValue;
28 }
29}
30
31module.exports = { parseJsonText, readJsonFileSafe };

9let loadPromise = null;

39/**
40 * @param {string} repoRoot répertoire racine du dépôt (contient Simulateur/)
41 * @returns {Promise<Record<string, Function>>}
42 */
43async function loadSimEngineModules(repoRoot) {
44 if (loadPromise) return loadPromise;
45 loadPromise = (async () => {
46 const deckPath = path.join(repoRoot, "Simulateur", "Engine", "spice-netlist-v2.mjs");
47 const parserPath = path.join(repoRoot, "Simulateur", "Engine", "v2", "result-parser.mjs");
48 const [deckMod, parserMod] = await Promise.all([
49 import(pathToFileURL(deckPath).href),
50 import(pathToFileURL(parserPath).href),
51 ]);
52 if (typeof deckMod.buildNgspiceDeck !== "function") {
53 throw new Error("Module buildNgspiceDeck introuvable.");
54 }
55 const out = { buildNgspiceDeck: deckMod.buildNgspiceDeck };
56 for (const name of PARSER_EXPORTS) {
57 if (typeof parserMod[name] !== "function") {
58 throw new Error(`Module ${name} introuvable.`);
59 }
60 out[name] = parserMod[name];
61 }
62 return out;
63 })();
64 loadPromise.catch(() => {
65 loadPromise = null;
66 });
67 return loadPromise;
68}
69
70/** Pré-charge au démarrage du serveur (Render : 1er clic simulation plus rapide). */
71function preloadSimEngineModules(repoRoot) {
72 loadSimEngineModules(repoRoot).catch((err) => {
73 console.error("[Simulateur] préchargement moteur SPICE :", err?.message || err);
74 });
75}
76
77module.exports = { loadSimEngineModules, preloadSimEngineModules };
